book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְאׇהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְכֹ֣ל  אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה חׇכְמָ֤ה וּתְבוּנָה֙ בָּהֵ֔מָּה לָדַ֣עַת לַעֲשֹׂ֔ת אֶֽת־כׇּל־מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shh btsl'l v'hly'b vkhl  'ysh chkhmlb 'shr ntn yhvh chkhmh vtbvnh bhmh ld't l'sht 'tkhlml'kht 'bdt hqdsh lkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And Bezalel and Oholiab shall work, and every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD hath put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD hath commanded.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל־בְּצַלְאֵל֮ וְאֶל־אׇֽהֳלִיאָב֒ וְאֶל֙ כׇּל־אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה חׇכְמָ֖ה בְּלִבּ֑וֹ כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֔וֹ לְקׇרְבָ֥ה אֶל־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'lbtsl'l v'l'hly'b v'l khl'ysh chkhmlb 'shr ntn yhvh chkhmh blbv khl 'shr nsh'v lbv lqrbh 'lhml'khh l'sht 'th
verses.translation: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַתְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִמְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑הּ וְ֠הֵ֠ם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥יו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: vyqchv mlpny mshh 't khlhtrvmh 'shr hby'v bny yshr'l lml'kht 'bdt hqdsh l'sht 'th vhm hby'v 'lyv 'vd ndbh bbqr bbqr
verses.translation: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, wherewith to make it. And they brought yet unto him freewill-offerings every morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כׇּל־הַ֣חֲכָמִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֕ים אֵ֖ת כׇּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אִֽישׁ־אִ֥ישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: vyb'v khlhchkhmym h'shym 't khlml'kht hqdsh 'ysh'ysh mml'khtv 'shrhmh 'shym
verses.translation: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they wrought.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה לֵּאמֹ֔ר מַרְבִּ֥ים הָעָ֖ם לְהָבִ֑יא מִדֵּ֤י הָֽעֲבֹדָה֙ לַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lmshh l'mr mrbym h'm lhby' mdy h'bdh lml'khh 'shrtsvh yhvh l'sht 'th
verses.translation: And they spoke unto Moses, saying: ‘The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַל־יַעֲשׂוּ־ע֛וֹד מְלָאכָ֖ה לִתְרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א הָעָ֖ם מֵהָבִֽיא׃
verses.translit: vytsv mshh vy'byrv qvl bmchnh l'mr 'ysh v'shh 'ly'shv'vd ml'khh ltrvmt hqdsh vykhl' h'm mhby'
verses.translation: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying: ‘Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary.’ So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַיָּ֛ם לְכׇל־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֹתָ֑הּ וְהוֹתֵֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhml'khh hyth dym lkhlhml'khh l'shvt 'th vhvtr {s}
verses.translation: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ כׇל־חֲכַם־לֵ֜ב בְּעֹשֵׂ֧י הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'shv khlchkhmlb b'shy hml'khh 'thmshkhn 'shr yry't shsh mshzr vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny khrbym m'shh chshb 'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And every wise-hearted man among them that wrought the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains: of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim the work of the skilful workman made he them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכׇל־הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.translit: 'rkh hyry'h h'cht shmnh v'shrym b'mh vrchb 'rb' b'mh hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht lkhlhyry't
verses.translation: The length of each curtain was eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains had one measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַבֵּר֙ אֶת־חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָ֑ת וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חִבַּ֔ר אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: vychbr 'tchmsh hyry't 'cht 'l'cht vchmsh yry't chbr 'cht 'l'cht
verses.translation: And he coupled five curtains one to another; and the other five curtains he coupled one to another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vy'sh ll't tkhlt 'l shpt hyry'h h'cht mqtsh bmchbrt khn 'shh bshpt hyry'h hqytsvnh bmchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain that was outmost in the first set; likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the second set.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: chmshym ll't 'shh byry'h h'cht vchmshym ll't 'shh bqtsh hyry'h 'shr bmchbrt hshnyt mqbylt hll't 'cht 'l'cht
verses.translation: Fifty loops made he in the one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain that was in the second set; the loops were opposite one to another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֕עַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַיְחַבֵּ֨ר אֶת־הַיְרִיעֹ֜ת אַחַ֤ת אֶל־אַחַת֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וַיְהִ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'sh chmshym qrsy zhb vychbr 'thyry't 'cht 'l'cht bqrsym vyhy hmshkhn 'chd {p}
verses.translation: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps; so the tabernacle was one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּֽי־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh yry't 'zym l'hl 'lhmshkhn 'shty'shrh yry't 'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And he made curtains of goats’hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains he made them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת רֹ֖חַב הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.translit: 'rkh hyry'h h'cht shlshym b'mh v'rb' 'mvt rchb hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht l'shty 'shrh yry't
verses.translation: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of each curtain; the eleven curtains had one measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־חֲמֵ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְאֶת־שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָֽד׃
verses.translit: vychbr 'tchmsh hyry't lbd v'tshsh hyry't lbd
verses.translation: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ עַל־שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vy'sh ll't chmshym 'l shpt hyry'h hqytsnh bmchbrt vchmshym ll't 'shh 'lshpt hyry'h hchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outmost in the first set, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which was outmost in the second set.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים לְחַבֵּ֥ר אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל לִהְיֹ֥ת אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'sh qrsy nchsht chmshym lchbr 'th'hl lhyt 'chd
verses.translation: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאׇדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh mkhsh l'hl 'rt 'ylm m'dmym vmkhsh 'rt tchshym mlm'lh {s}
verses.translation: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’skins dyed red, and a covering of sealskins above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thqrshym lmshkhn 'tsy shtym 'mdym
verses.translation: And he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia-wood, standing up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמֹּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'mt 'rkh hqrsh v'mh vchtsy h'mh rchb hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדֹ֗ת לַקֶּ֙רֶשׁ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁ֨לָּבֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: shty ydt lqrsh h'chd mshlbt 'cht 'l'cht khn 'shh lkhl qrshy hmshkhn
verses.translation: Each board had two tenons, joined one to another. Thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קְרָשִׁ֔ים לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גֶב תֵּימָֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thqrshym lmshkhn 'shrym qrshym lp't ngb tymnh
verses.translation: And he made the boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־כֶ֔סֶף עָשָׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dnykhsf 'shh tcht 'shrym hqrshym shny 'dnym tchthqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv vshny 'dnym tchthqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv
verses.translation: And he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עָשָׂ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים קְרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vltsl' hmshkhn hshnyt lp't tspvn 'shh 'shrym qrshym
verses.translation: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dnyhm khsf shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה עָשָׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vlyrkhty hmshkhn ymh 'shh shshh qrshym
verses.translation: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vshny qrshym 'shh lmqts't hmshkhn byrkhtym
verses.translation: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ תוֹאֲמִם֮ מִלְּמַ֒טָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ אֶל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן עָשָׂ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֖י הַמִּקְצֹעֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vhyv tv'mm mlmth vychdv yhyv tmym 'lr'shv 'lhtb't h'cht khn 'shh lshnyhm lshny hmqts't
verses.translation: that they might be double beneath, and in like manner they should be complete unto the top thereof unto the first ring. Thus he did to both of them in the two corners.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֤י אֲדָנִים֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyv shmnh qrshym v'dnyhm khsf shshh 'shr 'dnym shny 'dnym shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: And there were eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets: under every board two sockets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּרִיחֵ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh brychy 'tsy shtym chmshh lqrshy tsl'hmshkhn h'cht
verses.translation: And he made bars of acacia-wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה בְרִיחִם֙ לְקַרְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vchmshh brychm lqrshy tsl'hmshkhn hshnyt vchmshh brychm lqrshy hmshkhn lyrkhtym ymh
verses.translation: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֑ן לִבְרֹ֙חַ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֔ים מִן־הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־הַקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thbrych htykhn lbrch btvkh hqrshym mnhqtsh 'lhqtsh
verses.translation: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the midst of the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־טַבְּעֹתָם֙ עָשָׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'thqrshym tsph zhb v'ttb'tm 'shh zhb btym lbrychm vytsf 'thbrychm zhb
verses.translation: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold for holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thprkht tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh chshb 'shh 'th khrbym
verses.translation: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; with the cherubim the work of the skilful workman made he it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֗הּ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַפֵּ֣ם זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וַיִּצֹ֣ק לָהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־כָֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: vy'sh lh 'rb'h 'mvdy shtym vytspm zhb vvyhm zhb vytsq lhm 'rb'h 'dnykhsf
verses.translation: And he made thereunto four pillars of acacia, and overlaid them with gold, their hooks being of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh mskh lptch h'hl tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh rqm
verses.translation: And he made a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the weaver in colours;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדָ֤יו חֲמִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת־וָ֣וֵיהֶ֔ם וְצִפָּ֧ה רָאשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't'mvdyv chmshh v'tvvyhm vtsph r'shyhm vchshqyhm zhb v'dnyhm chmshh nchsht {p}
verses.translation: and the five pillars of it with their hooks; and he overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold; and their five sockets were of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל אֶת־הָאָרֹ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אׇרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רׇחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh btsl'l 'th'rn 'tsy shtym 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhv v'mh vchtsy rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And Bezalel made the ark of acacia-wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַפֵּ֛הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vytsphv zhb thvr mbyt vmchvts vy'sh lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vytsq lv 'rb' tb't zhb 'l 'rb' p'mtyv vshty tb't 'ltsl'v h'cht vshty tb't 'ltsl'v hshnyt
verses.translation: And he cast for it four rings of gold, in the four feet thereof: even two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh bdy 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And he made staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הָאָרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'thbdym btb't 'l tsl't h'rn lsh't 'th'rn
verses.translation: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כַּפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֙צִי֙ אׇרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רׇחְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh khprt zhb thvr 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhh v'mh vchtsy rchbh
verses.translation: And he made an ark-cover of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֥י כְרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh shny khrbym zhb mqshh 'shh 'tm mshny qtsvt hkhprt
verses.translation: And he made two cherubim of gold: of beaten work made he them, at the two ends of the ark-cover:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרוּב־אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים מִשְּׁנֵ֥י (קצוותו) [קְצוֹתָֽיו]׃
verses.translit: khrvb'chd mqtsh mzh vkhrvb'chd mqtsh mzh mnhkhprt 'shh 'thkhrbym mshny (qtsvvtv) [qtsvtyv]
verses.translation: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the ark-cover made he the cherubim at the two ends thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹֽכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו אֶ֨ל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhyv hkhrbym prshy khnpym lm'lh skhkhym bkhnpyhm 'lhkhprt vpnyhm 'ysh 'l'chyv 'lhkhprt hyv pny hkhrbym {p}
verses.translation: And the cherubim spread out their wings on high, screening the ark-cover with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the ark-cover were the faces of the cherubim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אׇרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רׇחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thshlchn 'tsy shtym 'mtym 'rkhv v'mh rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And he made the table of acacia-wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vytsf 'tv zhb thvr vy'sh lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ זֵר־זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh lv msgrt tpch sbyb vy'sh zrzhb lmsgrtv sbyb
verses.translation: And he made unto it a border of a hand-breadth round about, and made a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vytsq lv 'rb' tb't zhb vytn 'thtb't 'l 'rb' hp't 'shr l'rb' rglyv
verses.translation: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that were on the four feet thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת בָּתִּים֙ לַבַּדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.translit: l'mt hmsgrt hyv htb't btym lbdym lsh't 'thshlchn
verses.translation: Close by the border were the rings, the holders for the staves to bear the table.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thbdym 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm zhb lsh't 'thshlchn
verses.translation: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־הַכֵּלִ֣ים  אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֶת־קְעָרֹתָ֤יו וְאֶת־כַּפֹּתָיו֙ וְאֵת֙ מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו וְאֶ֨ת־הַקְּשָׂוֺ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thkhlym  'shr 'lhshlchn 'tq'rtyv v'tkhptyv v't mnqytyv v'thqshvt 'shr yskh bhn zhb thvr {p}
verses.translation: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, the dishes thereof, and the pans thereof, and the bowls thereof, and the jars thereof, wherewith to pour out, of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה הָיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thmnrh zhb thvr mqshh 'shh 'thmnrh yrkhh vqnh gby'yh khptryh vprchyh mmnh hyv
verses.translation: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, its knops, and its flowers, were of one piece with it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה  קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vshshh qnym yts'ym mtsdyh shlshh  qny mnrh mtsdh h'chd vshlshh qny mnrh mtsdh hshny
verses.translation: And there were six branches going out of the sides thereof: three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִ֠ים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶ֒רַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh h'chd khptr vprch vshlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh 'chd khptr vprch khn lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mnhmnrh
verses.translation: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower. So for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁ֨קָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbmnrh 'rb'h gb'ym mshqdym khptryh vprchyh
verses.translation: And in the candlestick were four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּ֩חַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּֽחַת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֙שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tchtshny hqnym mmnh lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mmnh
verses.translation: and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה הָי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: khptryhm vqntm mmnh hyv khlh mqshh 'cht zhb thvr
verses.translation: Their knops and their branches were of one piece with it; the whole of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tnrtyh shb'h vmlqchyh vmchttyh zhb thvr
verses.translation: And he made the lamps thereof, seven, and the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־כֵּלֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khkhr zhb thvr 'shh 'th v't khlkhlyh {p}
verses.translation: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּ֣ה אׇרְכּוֹ֩ וְאַמָּ֨ה רׇחְבּ֜וֹ רָב֗וּעַ וְאַמָּתַ֙יִם֙ קֹֽמָת֔וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֥וּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tmzbch hqtrt 'tsy shtym 'mh 'rkhv v'mh rchbv rbv' v'mtym qmtv mmnv hyv qrntyv
verses.translation: And he made the altar of incense of acacia-wood: a cubit was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, four-square; and two cubits was the height thereof; the horns thereof were of one piece with it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֨ף אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vytsf 'tv zhb thvr 'tggv v'tqyrtyv sbyb v'tqrntyv vy'sh lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it; and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב עָֽשָׂה־ל֣וֹ  מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshty tb't zhb 'shhlv  mtcht lzrv 'l shty tsl'tyv 'l shny tsdyv lbtym lbdym lsh't 'tv bhm
verses.translation: And he made for it two golden rings under the crown thereof, upon the two ribs thereof, upon the two sides of it, for holders for staves wherewith to bear it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thbdym 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶת־שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים טָה֑וֹר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽחַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tshmn hmshchh qdsh v'tqtrt hsmym thvr m'shh rqch {s}
verses.translation: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אׇרְכּ֜וֹ וְחָֽמֵשׁ־אַמּ֤וֹת רׇחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֔וּעַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tmzbch h'lh 'tsy shtym chmsh 'mvt 'rkhv vchmsh'mvt rchbv rbv' vshlsh 'mvt qmtv
verses.translation: And he made the altar of burnt-offering of acacia-wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof, four-square, and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֣וּ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh qrntyv 'l 'rb' pntyv mmnv hyv qrntyv vytsf 'tv nchsht
verses.translation: And he made the horns thereof upon the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of one piece with it; and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶת־הַסִּירֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת אֶת־הַמִּזְלָגֹ֖ת וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתֹּ֑ת כׇּל־כֵּלָ֖יו עָשָׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tkhlkhly hmzbch 'thsyrt v'thy'ym v'thmzrqt 'thmzlgt v'thmchtt khlkhlyv 'shh nchsht
verses.translation: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, the flesh-hooks, and the fire-pans; all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת תַּ֧חַת כַּרְכֻּבּ֛וֹ מִלְּמַ֖טָּה עַד־חֶצְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh lmzbch mkhbr m'shh rsht nchsht tcht khrkhbv mlmth 'dchtsyv
verses.translation: And he made for the altar a grating of network of brass, under the ledge round it beneath, reaching halfway up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצֹ֞ק אַרְבַּ֧ע טַבָּעֹ֛ת בְּאַרְבַּ֥ע הַקְּצָוֺ֖ת לְמִכְבַּ֣ר הַנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת בָּתִּ֖ים לַבַּדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vytsq 'rb' tb't b'rb' hqtsvt lmkhbr hnchsht btym lbdym
verses.translation: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grating of brass, to be holders for the staves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thbdym 'tsy shtym vytsf 'tm nchsht
verses.translation: And he made the staves of acacia-wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֜ים בַּטַּבָּעֹ֗ת עַ֚ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶ֑ם נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb' 'thbdym btb't 'l tsl't hmzbch lsh't 'tv bhm nbvb lcht 'shh 'tv {s}
verses.translation: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, wherewith to bear it; he made it hollow with planks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַשׂ אֵ֚ת הַכִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאֵ֖ת כַּנּ֣וֹ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת בְּמַרְאֹת֙ הַצֹּ֣בְאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽבְא֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hkhyvr nchsht v't khnv nchsht bmr't htsb't 'shr tsb'v ptch 'hl mv'd {s}
verses.translation: And he made the laver of brass, and the base thereof of brass, of the mirrors of the serving women that did service at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֑ר לִפְאַ֣ת  נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֗נָה קַלְעֵ֤י הֶֽחָצֵר֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֔ר מֵאָ֖ה בָּאַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thchtsr lp't  ngb tymnh ql'y hchtsr shsh mshzr m'h b'mh
verses.translation: And he made the court; for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, a hundred cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמּוּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: 'mvdyhm 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mvdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: Their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ מֵאָ֣ה בָֽאַמָּ֔ה עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: vlp't tspvn m'h b'mh 'mvdyhm 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mvdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And for the north side a hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִפְאַת־יָ֗ם קְלָעִים֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: vlp'tym ql'ym chmshym b'mh 'mvdyhm 'shrh v'dnyhm 'shrh vvy h'mdym vchshvqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vlp't qdmh mzrchh chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְלָעִ֛ים חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־הַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: ql'ym chmsh'shrh 'mh 'lhkhtf 'mvdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: The hangings for the one side [of the gate] were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַכָּתֵ֣ף הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית מִזֶּ֤ה וּמִזֶּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר קְלָעִ֕ים חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vlkhtf hshnyt mzh vmzh lsh'r hchtsr ql'ym chmsh 'shrh 'mh 'mdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: And so for the other side; on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קַלְעֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב שֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.translit: khlql'y hchtsr sbyb shsh mshzr
verses.translation: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֲדָנִ֣ים לָֽעַמֻּדִים֮ נְחֹ֒שֶׁת֒ וָוֵ֨י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֜ים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְצִפּ֥וּי רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְהֵם֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף כֹּ֖ל עַמֻּדֵ֥י הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vh'dnym l'mdym nchsht vvy h'mvdym vchshvqyhm khsf vtspvy r'shyhm khsf vhm mchshqym khsf khl 'mdy hchtsr
verses.translation: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their capitals of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָסַ֞ךְ שַׁ֤עַר הֶחָצֵר֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֔ם תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְקוֹמָ֤ה בְרֹ֙חַב֙ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת לְעֻמַּ֖ת קַלְעֵ֥י הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vmskh sh'r hchtsr m'shh rqm tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr v'shrym 'mh 'rkh vqvmh brchb chmsh 'mvt l'mt ql'y hchtsr
verses.translation: And the screen for the gate of the court was the work of the weaver in colours, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף וְצִפּ֧וּי רָאשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'mdyhm 'rb'h v'dnyhm 'rb'h nchsht vvyhm khsf vtspvy r'shyhm vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And their pillars were four, and their sockets four of brass; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their fillets of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽכׇל־הַיְתֵדֹ֞ת לַמִּשְׁכָּ֧ן וְלֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhlhytdt lmshkhn vlchtsr sbyb nchsht {s}
verses.translation: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֤י הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֻּקַּ֖ד עַל־פִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה עֲבֹדַת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy hmshkhn mshkhn h'dt 'shr pqd 'lpy mshh 'bdt hlvym byd 'ytmr bn'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: These are the accounts of the tabernacle, even the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were rendered according to the commandment of Moses, through the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vbtsl'l bn'vry bnchvr lmth yhvdh 'shh 't khl'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: And Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִתּ֗וֹ אׇהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־אֲחִיסָמָ֛ךְ לְמַטֵּה־דָ֖ן חָרָ֣שׁ וְחֹשֵׁ֑ב וְרֹקֵ֗ם בַּתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְתוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tv 'hly'b bn'chysmkh lmthdn chrsh vchshb vrqm btkhlt vb'rgmn vbtvl't hshny vbshsh {s}
verses.translation: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, a craftsman, and a skilful workman, and a weaver in colours, in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַזָּהָ֗ב הֶֽעָשׂוּי֙ לַמְּלָאכָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַיְהִ֣י  זְהַ֣ב הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה תֵּ֤שַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ כִּכָּ֔ר וּשְׁבַ֨ע מֵא֧וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khlhzhb h'shvy lml'khh bkhl ml'kht hqdsh vyhy  zhb htnvph tsh' v'shrym khkhr vshb' m'vt vshlshym shql bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֶ֛סֶף פְּקוּדֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה מְאַ֣ת כִּכָּ֑ר וְאֶ֩לֶף֩ וּשְׁבַ֨ע מֵא֜וֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vkhsf pqvdy h'dh m't khkhr v'lf vshb' m'vt vchmshh vshb'ym shql bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and three-score and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּ֚קַע לַגֻּלְגֹּ֔לֶת מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֨ל הָעֹבֵ֜ר עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה לְשֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: bq' lglglt mchtsyt hshql bshql hqdsh lkhl h'br 'lhpqdym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lshshm'vt 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that passed over to them that are numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מְאַת֙ כִּכַּ֣ר הַכֶּ֔סֶף לָצֶ֗קֶת אֵ֚ת אַדְנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת אַדְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֑כֶת מְאַ֧ת אֲדָנִ֛ים לִמְאַ֥ת הַכִּכָּ֖ר כִּכָּ֥ר לָאָֽדֶן׃
verses.translit: vyhy m't khkhr hkhsf ltsqt 't 'dny hqdsh v't 'dny hprkht m't 'dnym lm't hkhkhr khkhr l'dn
verses.translation: And the hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil: a hundred sockets for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָאֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁבַ֤ע הַמֵּאוֹת֙ וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה וְשִׁבְעִ֔ים עָשָׂ֥ה וָוִ֖ים לָעַמּוּדִ֑ים וְצִפָּ֥ה רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם וְחִשַּׁ֥ק אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th'lf vshb' hm'vt vchmshh vshb'ym 'shh vvym l'mvdym vtsph r'shyhm vchshq 'tm
verses.translation: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֣ים כִּכָּ֑ר וְאַלְפַּ֥יִם וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֖וֹת שָֽׁקֶל׃
verses.translit: vnchsht htnvph shb'ym khkhr v'lpym v'rb'm'vt shql
verses.translation: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּ֗הּ אֶת־אַדְנֵי֙ פֶּ֚תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֥ר הַנְּחֹ֖שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־כְּלֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh bh 't'dny ptch 'hl mv'd v't mzbch hnchsht v'tmkhbr hnchsht 'shrlv v't khlkhly hmzbch
verses.translation: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tent of meeting, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grating for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אַדְנֵ֤י הֶֽחָצֵר֙ סָבִ֔יב וְאֶת־אַדְנֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־יִתְדֹ֧ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־כׇּל־יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: v't'dny hchtsr sbyb v't'dny sh'r hchtsr v't khlytdt hmshkhn v'tkhlytdt hchtsr sbyb
verses.translation: and the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the gate of the court, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי־שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmnhtkhlt vh'rgmn vtvl't hshny 'shv bgdyshrd lshrt bqdsh vy'shv 'tbgdy hqdsh 'shr l'hrn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made plaited garments, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'th'pd zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr
verses.translation: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת־פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּת֤וֹךְ הַתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבְת֣וֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְת֣וֹךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vyrq'v 'tpchy hzhb vqtsts ptylm l'shvt btvkh htkhlt vbtvkh h'rgmn vbtvkh tvl't hshny vbtvkh hshsh m'shh chshb
verses.translation: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into threads, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, the work of the skilful workman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ־ל֖וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י (קצוותו) [קְצוֹתָ֖יו] חֻבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: khtpt 'shvlv chbrt 'lshny (qtsvvtv) [qtsvtyv] chbr
verses.translation: They made shoulder-pieces for it, joined together; at the two ends was it joined together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֒הוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vchshb 'pdtv 'shr 'lyv mmnv hv' khm'shhv zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And the skilfully woven band, that was upon it, wherewith to gird it on, was of the same piece and like the work thereof: of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת־אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל־שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 't'bny hshhm msbt mshbtst zhb mptcht ptvchy chvtm 'lshmvt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And they wrought the onyx stones, inclosed in settings of gold, graven with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshm 'tm 'l khtpt h'pd 'bny zkhrvn lbny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And he put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'thchshn m'shh chshb khm'shh 'pd zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr
verses.translation: And he made the breastplate, the work of the skilful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אׇרְכּ֛וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רׇחְבּ֖וֹ כָּפֽוּל׃
verses.translit: rbv' hyh khpvl 'shv 'thchshn zrt 'rkhv vzrt rchbv khpvl
verses.translation: It was four-square; they made the breastplate double; a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמַ֨לְאוּ־ב֔וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyml'vbv 'rb'h tvry 'bn tvr 'dm ptdh vbrqt htvr h'chd
verses.translation: And they set in it four rows of stones: a row of carnelian, topaz, and smaragd was the first row.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vhtvr hshny npkh spyr vyhlm
verses.translation: And the second row, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and an emerald.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
verses.translit: vhtvr hshlyshy lshm shbv v'chlmh
verses.translation: And the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֥ת זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhtvr hrby'y trshysh shhm vyshph mvsbt mshbtst zhb bml'tm
verses.translation: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; they were inclosed in fittings of gold in their settings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִ֠ים עַל־שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־שְׁמ֔וֹ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: vh'bnym 'lshmt bnyyshr'l hnh shtym 'shrh 'lshmtm ptvchy chtm 'ysh 'lshmv lshnym 'shr shbt
verses.translation: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 'lhchshn shrshrt gblt m'shh 'bt zhb thvr
verses.translation: And they made upon the breastplate plaited chains, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: vy'shv shty mshbtst zhb vshty tb't zhb vytnv 'tshty htb't 'lshny qtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And they made two settings of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל־קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: vytnv shty h'btt hzhb 'lshty htb't 'lqtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל־כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v't shty qtsvt shty h'btt ntnv 'lshty hmshbtst vytnm 'lkhtpt h'pd 'lmvl pnyv
verses.translation: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: vy'shv shty tb't zhb vyshymv 'lshny qtsvt hchshn 'lshptv 'shr 'l'br h'pd byth
verses.translation: And they made two rings of gold, and put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל־שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְּמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מַחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'shv shty tb't zhb vytnm 'lshty khtpt h'pd mlmth mmvl pnyv l'mt mchbrtv mm'l lchshb h'pd
verses.translation: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל־טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל־חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא־יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyrkhsv 'thchshn mtb'tyv 'ltb't h'pd bptyl tkhlt lhyt 'lchshb h'pd vl'yzch hchshn m'l h'pd kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And they did bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a thread of blue, that it might be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'tm'yl h'pd m'shh 'rg khlyl tkhlt
verses.translation: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפִֽי־הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתוֹכ֖וֹ כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vpyhm'yl btvkhv khpy tchr' shph lpyv sbyb l' yqr'
verses.translation: and the hole of the robe in the midst thereof, as the hole of a coat of mail, with a binding round about the hole of it, that it should not be rent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל־שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מׇשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 'lshvly hm'yl rmvny tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny mshzr
verses.translation: And they made upon the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל־שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּת֖וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'shv p'mny zhb thvr vytnv 'thp'mnym btvkh hrmnym 'lshvly hm'yl sbyb btvkh hrmnym
verses.translation: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל־שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: p'mn vrmn p'mn vrmn 'lshvly hm'yl sbyb lshrt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about, to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־הַכׇּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 'thkhtnt shsh m'shh 'rg l'hrn vlbnyv
verses.translation: And they made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת־פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת־מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.translit: v't hmtsnpt shsh v'tp'ry hmgb't shsh v'tmkhnsy hbd shsh mshzr
verses.translation: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th'bnt shsh mshzr vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny m'shh rqm kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the weaver in colours; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 'ttsyts nzrhqdsh zhb thvr vykhtbv 'lyv mkhtb ptvchy chvtm qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like the engravings of a signet: HOLY TO THE LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytnv 'lyv ptyl tkhlt ltt 'lhmtsnpt mlm'lh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And they tied unto it a thread of blue, to fasten it upon the mitre above; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כׇּל־עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtkhl khl'bdt mshkhn 'hl mv'd vy'shv bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shv {p}
verses.translation: Thus was finished all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting; and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו קְרָסָ֣יו קְרָשָׁ֔יו בְּרִיחָ֖ו וְעַמֻּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyby'v 'thmshkhn 'lmshh 'th'hl v'tkhlkhlyv qrsyv qrshyv brychv v'mdyv v'dnyv
verses.translation: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the Tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֞ה עוֹרֹ֤ת הָֽאֵילִם֙ הַמְאׇדָּמִ֔ים וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַתְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'tmkhsh 'vrt h'ylm hm'dmym v'tmkhsh 'rt htchshym v't prkht hmskh
verses.translation: and the covering of rams’skins dyed red, and the covering of sealskins, and the veil of the screen;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן הָעֵדֻ֖ת וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: 't'rvn h'dt v'tbdyv v't hkhprt
verses.translation: the ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the ark-cover;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'thshlchn 'tkhlkhlyv v't lchm hpnym
verses.translation: the table, all the vessels thereof, and the showbread;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֨ה הַטְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֗יהָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'thmnrh hthrh 'tnrtyh nrt hm'rkhh v'tkhlkhlyh v't shmn hm'vr
verses.translation: the pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for the light;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: v't mzbch hzhb v't shmn hmshchh v't qtrt hsmym v't mskh ptch h'hl
verses.translation: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door of the Tent;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת  מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 't  mzbch hnchsht v'tmkhbr hnchsht 'shrlv 'tbdyv v'tkhlkhlyv 'thkhyr v'tkhnv
verses.translation: the brazen altar, and its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֶת־עַמֻּדֶ֣יהָ וְאֶת־אֲדָנֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת־הַמָּסָךְ֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־מֵיתָרָ֖יו וִיתֵדֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֗ת כׇּל־כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: 't ql'y hchtsr 't'mdyh v't'dnyh v'thmskh lsh'r hchtsr 'tmytryv vytdtyh v't khlkhly 'bdt hmshkhn l'hl mv'd
verses.translation: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court, the cords thereof, and the pins thereof, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: 'tbgdy hshrd lshrt bqdsh 'tbgdy hqdsh l'hrn hkhhn v'tbgdy bnyv lkhhn
verses.translation: the plaited garments for ministering in the holy place; the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כׇּל־הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃
verses.translit: khkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l 't khlh'bdh
verses.translation: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־כׇּל־הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyr' mshh 'tkhlhml'khh vhnh 'shv 'th kh'shr tsvh yhvh khn 'shv vybrkh 'tm mshh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses saw all the work, and, behold, they had done it; as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it. And Moses blessed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיוֹם־הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת־מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: byvmhchdsh hr'shvn b'chd lchdsh tqym 'tmshkhn 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: ’On the first day of the first month shalt thou rear up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת־הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: vshmt shm 't 'rvn h'dvt vskht 'lh'rn 'thprkht
verses.translation: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and thou shalt screen the ark with the veil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת־עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vhb't 'thshlchn v'rkht 't'rkhv vhb't 'thmnrh vh'lyt 'tnrtyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the bread that is upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vntth 'tmzbch hzhb lqtrt lpny 'rvn h'dt vshmt 'tmskh hptch lmshkhn
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vntth 't mzbch h'lh lpny ptch mshkhn 'hlmv'd
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vntt 'thkhyr byn'hl mv'd vbyn hmzbch vntt shm mym
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vshmt 'thchtsr sbyb vntt 'tmskh sh'r hchtsr
verses.translation: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tshmn hmshchh vmshcht 'thmshkhn v'tkhl'shrbv vqdsht 'tv v'tkhlkhlyv vhyh qdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the furniture thereof; and it shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vmshcht 'tmzbch h'lh v'tkhlkhlyv vqdsht 'thmzbch vhyh hmzbch qdsh qdshym
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar; and the altar shall be most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmshcht 'thkhyr v'tkhnv vqdsht 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its base, and sanctify it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhqrbt 't'hrn v'tbnyv 'lptch 'hl mv'd vrchtst 'tm bmym
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhlbsht 't'hrn 't bgdy hqdsh vmshcht 'tv vqdsht 'tv vkhhn ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments; and thou shalt anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister unto Me in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
verses.translit: v'tbnyv tqryb vhlbsht 'tm khtnt
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put tunics upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֙חְתָּ֙ אֶת־אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָ֠ה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מׇשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vmshcht 'tm kh'shr mshcht 't'byhm vkhhnv ly vhyth lhyt lhm mshchtm lkhhnt 'vlm ldrtm
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto Me in the priest’s office; and their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv khn 'shh {s}
verses.translation: Thus did Moses; according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhy bchdsh hr'shvn bshnh hshnyt b'chd lchdsh hvqm hmshkhn
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת־בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת־עַמּוּדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyqm mshh 'thmshkhn vytn 't'dnyv vyshm 'tqrshyv vytn 'tbrychyv vyqm 't'mvdyv
verses.translation: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up its pillars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת־הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת־מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyprsh 'th'hl 'lhmshkhn vyshm 'tmkhsh h'hl 'lyv mlm'lh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל־הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vyqch vytn 'th'dt 'lh'rn vyshm 'thbdym 'lh'rn vytn 'thkhprt 'lh'rn mlm'lh
verses.translation: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the ark-cover above upon the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת־הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb' 'th'rn 'lhmshkhn vyshm 't prkht hmskh vyskh 'l 'rvn h'dvt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָה מִח֖וּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: vytn 'thshlchn b'hl mv'd 'l yrkh hmshkhn tspnh mchvts lprkht
verses.translation: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the veil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛יו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'rkh 'lyv 'rkh lchm lpny yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And he set a row of bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: vyshm 'thmnrh b'hl mv'd nkhch hshlchn 'l yrkh hmshkhn ngbh
verses.translation: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל הַנֵּרֹ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'l hnrt lpny yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הַזָּהָ֖ב בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵ֖י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: vyshm 'tmzbch hzhb b'hl mv'd lpny hprkht
verses.translation: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqtr 'lyv qtrt smym kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: and he burnt thereon incense of sweet spices; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyshm 'tmskh hptch lmshkhn
verses.translation: And he put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת־הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't mzbch h'lh shm ptch mshkhn 'hlmv'd vy'l 'lyv 'th'lh v'thmnchh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: And the altar of burnt-offering he set at the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt-offering and the meal-offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרׇחְצָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm 'thkhyr byn'hl mv'd vbyn hmzbch vytn shmh mym lrchtsh
verses.translation: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water therein, wherewith to wash;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vrchtsv mmnv mshh v'hrn vbnyv 'tydyhm v'trglyhm
verses.translation: that Moses and Aaron and his sons might wash their hands and their feet thereat;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקׇרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bb'm 'l'hl mv'd vbqrbtm 'lhmzbch yrchtsv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they came near unto the altar, they should wash; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqm 'thchtsr sbyb lmshkhn vlmzbch vytn 'tmskh sh'r hchtsr vykhl mshh 'thml'khh {p}
verses.translation: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vykhs h'nn 't'hl mv'd vkhbvd yhvh ml' 'thmshkhn
verses.translation: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vl'ykhl mshh lbv' 'l'hl mv'd khyshkhn 'lyv h'nn vkhbvd yhvh ml' 'thmshkhn
verses.translation: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of meeting, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbh'lvt h'nn m'l hmshkhn ys'v bny yshr'l bkhl ms'yhm
verses.translation: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ml' y'lh h'nn vl' ys'v 'dyvm h'ltv
verses.translation: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
