verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֤ה עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כׇל־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכׇל־מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'nn yhvh 'lhmshkhn yvmm v'sh thyh lylh bv l'yny khlbytyshr'l bkhlms'yhm
verses.translation: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and there was fire therein by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו מֵאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lmshh vydbr yhvh 'lyv m'hl mv'd l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spoke unto him out of the tent of meeting, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי־יַקְרִ֥יב מִכֶּ֛ם קׇרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה מִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה מִן־הַבָּקָר֙ וּמִן־הַצֹּ֔אן תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ אֶת־קׇרְבַּנְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'dm khyyqryb mkhm qrbn lyhvh mnhbhmh mnhbqr vmnhts'n tqrybv 'tqrbnkhm
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When any man of you bringeth an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd or of the flock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עֹלָ֤ה קׇרְבָּנוֹ֙ מִן־הַבָּקָ֔ר זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶ֑נּוּ אֶל־פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ יַקְרִ֣יב אֹת֔וֹ לִרְצֹנ֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'm'lh qrbnv mnhbqr zkhr tmym yqrybnv 'lptch 'hl mv'd yqryb 'tv lrtsnv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: If his offering be a burnt-offering of the herd, he shall offer it a male without blemish; he shall bring it to the door of the tent of meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַ֣ךְ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִרְצָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vsmkh ydv 'l r'sh h'lh vnrtsh lv lkhpr 'lyv
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burnt-offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־בֶּ֥ן הַבָּקָ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֠הִקְרִ֠יבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וְזָרְק֨וּ אֶת־הַדָּ֤ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֲשֶׁר־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vshcht 'tbn hbqr lpny yhvh vhqrybv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 'thdm vzrqv 'thdm 'lhmzbch sbyb 'shrptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood, and dash the blood round about against the altar that is at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת־הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִתַּ֥ח אֹתָ֖הּ לִנְתָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vhpshyt 'th'lh vntch 'th lntchyh
verses.translation: And he shall flay the burnt-offering, and cut it into its pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠נָתְנ֠וּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֵ֖שׁ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעָרְכ֥וּ עֵצִ֖ים עַל־הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vntnv bny 'hrn hkhhn 'sh 'lhmzbch v'rkhv 'tsym 'lh'sh
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay wood in order upon the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָרְכ֗וּ בְּנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֵ֚ת הַנְּתָחִ֔ים אֶת־הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְאֶת־הַפָּ֑דֶר עַל־הָעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: v'rkhv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 't hntchym 'thr'sh v'thpdr 'lh'tsym 'shr 'lh'sh 'shr 'lhmzbch
verses.translation: And Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, and the head, and the suet, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִרְבּ֥וֹ וּכְרָעָ֖יו יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־הַכֹּל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיח֖וֹחַ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vqrbv vkhr'yv yrchts bmym vhqtyr hkhhn 'thkhl hmzbchh 'lh 'shh rychnychvch lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: but its inwards and its legs shall he wash with water; and the priest shall make the whole smoke on the altar, for a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מִן־הַצֹּ֨אן קׇרְבָּנ֧וֹ מִן־הַכְּשָׂבִ֛ים א֥וֹ מִן־הָעִזִּ֖ים לְעֹלָ֑ה זָכָ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mmnhts'n qrbnv mnhkhshbym 'v mnh'zym l'lh zkhr tmym yqrybnv
verses.translation: And if his offering be of the flock, whether of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt-offering, he shall offer it a male without blemish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֨ט אֹת֜וֹ עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ צָפֹ֖נָה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vshcht 'tv 'l yrkh hmzbch tspnh lpny yhvh vzrqv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 'tdmv 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall dash its blood against the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִתַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִנְתָחָ֔יו וְאֶת־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת־פִּדְר֑וֹ וְעָרַ֤ךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔ם עַל־הָֽעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vntch 'tv lntchyv v'tr'shv v'tpdrv v'rkh hkhhn 'tm 'lh'tsym 'shr 'lh'sh 'shr 'lhmzbch
verses.translation: And he shall cut it into its pieces; and the priest shall lay them, with its head and its suet, in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַקֶּ֥רֶב וְהַכְּרָעַ֖יִם יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְהִקְרִ֨יב הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־הַכֹּל֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhqrb vhkhr'ym yrchts bmym vhqryb hkhhn 'thkhl vhqtyr hmzbchh 'lh hv' 'shh rych nychch lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: But the inwards and the legs shall he wash with water; and the priest shall offer the whole, and make it smoke upon the altar; it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֧ם מִן־הָע֛וֹף עֹלָ֥ה קׇרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֣יב מִן־הַתֹּרִ֗ים א֛וֹ מִן־בְּנֵ֥י הַיּוֹנָ֖ה אֶת־קׇרְבָּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'm mnh'vf 'lh qrbnv lyhvh vhqryb mnhtrym 'v mnbny hyvnh 'tqrbnv
verses.translation: And if his offering to the LORD be a burnt-offering of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtle-doves, or of young pigeons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיב֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמָלַק֙ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְנִמְצָ֣ה דָמ֔וֹ עַ֖ל קִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vhqrybv hkhhn 'lhmzbch vmlq 'tr'shv vhqtyr hmzbchh vnmtsh dmv 'l qyr hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and pinch off its head, and make it smoke on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be drained out on the side of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵסִ֥יר אֶת־מֻרְאָת֖וֹ בְּנֹצָתָ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜הּ אֵ֤צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֵ֔דְמָה אֶל־מְק֖וֹם הַדָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: vhsyr 'tmr'tv bntsth vhshlykh 'th 'tsl hmzbch qdmh 'lmqvm hdshn
verses.translation: And he shall take away its crop with the feathers thereof, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁסַּ֨ע אֹת֣וֹ בִכְנָפָיו֮ לֹ֣א יַבְדִּיל֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹת֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֑שׁ עֹלָ֣ה ה֗וּא אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshs' 'tv bkhnpyv l' ybdyl vhqtyr 'tv hkhhn hmzbchh 'lh'tsym 'shr 'lh'sh 'lh hv' 'shh rych nychch lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: And he shall rend it by the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder; and the priest shall make it smoke upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire; it is a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תַקְרִ֞יב קׇרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קׇרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְיָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְנָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnpsh khytqryb qrbn mnchh lyhvh slt yhyh qrbnv vytsq 'lyh shmn vntn 'lyh lbnh
verses.translation: And when any one bringeth a meal-offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסׇּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כׇּל־לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhby'h 'lbny 'hrn hkhhnym vqmts mshm ml' qmtsv mslth vmshmnh 'l khllbnth vhqtyr hkhhn 't'zkhrth hmzbchh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests; and he shall take thereout his handful of the fine flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, together with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall make the memorial-part thereof smoke upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhnvtrt mnhmnchh l'hrn vlbnyv qdsh qdshym m'shy yhvh {s}
verses.translation: But that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קׇרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhy tqrb qrbn mnchh m'ph tnvr slt chlvt mtst blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn {s}
verses.translation: And when thou bringest a meal-offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers spread with oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מִנְחָ֥ה עַל־הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת קׇרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mmnchh 'lhmchbt qrbnkh slt blvlh bshmn mtsh thyh
verses.translation: And if thy offering be a meal-offering baked on a griddle, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ptvt 'th ptym vytsqt 'lyh shmn mnchh hv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt break it in pieces, and pour oil thereon; it is a meal-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קׇרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: v'mmncht mrchsht qrbnkh slt bshmn t'shh
verses.translation: And if thy offering be a meal-offering of the stewing-pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vhb't 'thmnchh 'shr y'shh m'lh lyhvh vhqrybh 'lhkhhn vhgyshh 'lhmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the meal-offering that is made of these things unto the LORD; and it shall be presented unto the priest, and he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵרִ֨ים הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhrym hkhhn mnhmnchh 't'zkhrth vhqtyr hmzbchh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take off from the meal-offering the memorial-part thereof, and shall make it smoke upon the altar—an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnvtrt mnhmnchh l'hrn vlbnyv qdsh qdshym m'shy yhvh
verses.translation: But that which is left of the meal-offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כׇל־שְׂאֹר֙ וְכׇל־דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא־תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khlhmnchh 'shr tqrybv lyhvh l' t'shh chmts khy khlsh'r vkhldbsh l'tqtyrv mmnv 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: No meal-offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven; for ye shall make no leaven, nor any honey, smoke as an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא־יַעֲל֖וּ לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃
verses.translit: qrbn r'shyt tqrybv 'tm lyhvh v'lhmzbch l'y'lv lrych nychch
verses.translation: As an offering of first-fruits ye may bring them unto the LORD; but they shall not come up for a sweet savour on the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־קׇרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ל כׇּל־קׇרְבָּנְךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhlqrbn mnchtkh bmlch tmlch vl' tshbyt mlch bryt 'lhykh m'l mnchtkh 'l khlqrbnkh tqryb mlch {s}
verses.translation: And every meal-offering of thine shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meal-offering; with all thy offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהֹוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'mtqryb mncht bkhvrym lyhvh 'byb qlvy b'sh grsh khrml tqryb 't mncht bkhvrykh
verses.translation: And if thou bring a meal-offering of first-fruits unto the LORD, thou shalt bring for the meal-offering of thy first-fruits corn in the ear parched with fire, even groats of the fresh ear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vntt 'lyh shmn vshmt 'lyh lbnh mnchh hv'
verses.translation: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon; it is a meal-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כׇּל־לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhqtyr hkhhn 't'zkhrth mgrshh vmshmnh 'l khllbnth 'shh lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And the priest shall make the memorial-part of it smoke, even of the groats thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים קׇרְבָּנ֑וֹ אִ֤ם מִן־הַבָּקָר֙ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֔יב אִם־זָכָר֙ אִם־נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֥ים יַקְרִיבֶ֖נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mzbch shlmym qrbnv 'm mnhbqr hv' mqryb 'mzkhr 'mnqbh tmym yqrybnv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And if his offering be a sacrifice of peace-offerings: if he offer of the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ קׇרְבָּנ֔וֹ וּשְׁחָט֕וֹ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vsmkh ydv 'lr'sh qrbnv vshchtv ptch 'hl mv'd vzrqv bny 'hrn hkhhnym 'thdm 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons the priests shall dash the blood against the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיב֙ מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה אֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vhqryb mzbch hshlmym 'shh lyhvh 'thchlb hmkhsh 'thqrb v't khlhchlb 'shr 'lhqrb
verses.translation: And he shall present of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto the LORD: the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lhn 'shr 'lhkhslym v'thytrt 'lhkhbd 'lhkhlyvt ysyrnh
verses.translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the lobe above the liver, which he shall take away hard by the kidneys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֨ירוּ אֹת֤וֹ בְנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָאֵ֑שׁ אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhqtyrv 'tv bny'hrn hmzbchh 'lh'lh 'shr 'lh'tsym 'shr 'lh'sh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And Aaron’s sons shall make it smoke on the altar upon the burnt-offering, which is upon the wood that is on the fire; it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מִן־הַצֹּ֧אן קׇרְבָּנ֛וֹ לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהֹוָ֑ה זָכָר֙ א֣וֹ נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mmnhts'n qrbnv lzbch shlmym lyhvh zkhr 'v nqbh tmym yqrybnv
verses.translation: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto the LORD be of the flock, male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־כֶּ֥שֶׂב הֽוּא־מַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־קׇרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mkhshb hv'mqryb 'tqrbnv vhqryb 'tv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: If he bring a lamb for his offering, then shall he present it before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־יָדוֹ֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ קׇרְבָּנ֔וֹ וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ֠זָרְק֠וּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vsmkh 'tydv 'lr'sh qrbnv vshcht 'tv lpny 'hl mv'd vzrqv bny 'hrn 'tdmv 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons shall dash the blood thereof against the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַיהֹוָה֒ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ הָאַלְיָ֣ה תְמִימָ֔ה לְעֻמַּ֥ת הֶעָצֶ֖ה יְסִירֶ֑נָּה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vhqryb mzbch hshlmym 'shh lyhvh chlbv h'lyh tmymh l'mt h'tsh ysyrnh v'thchlb hmkhsh 'thqrb v't khlhchlb 'shr 'lhqrb
verses.translation: And he shall present of the sacrifice of peace-offerings an offering made by fire unto the LORD: the fat thereof, the fat tail entire, which he shall take away hard by the rump-bone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lhn 'shr 'lhkhslym v'thytrt 'lhkhbd 'lhkhlyt ysyrnh
verses.translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the lobe above the liver, which he shall take away by the kidneys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטִיר֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה לֶ֥חֶם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhqtyrv hkhhn hmzbchh lchm 'shh lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And the priest shall make it smoke upon the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֥ם עֵ֖ז קׇרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְהִקְרִיב֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'm 'z qrbnv vhqrybv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall present it before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־יָדוֹ֙ עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ֠זָרְק֠וּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vsmkh 'tydv 'lr'shv vshcht 'tv lpny 'hl mv'd vzrqv bny 'hrn 'tdmv 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall dash the blood thereof against the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ קׇרְבָּנ֔וֹ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה אֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vhqryb mmnv qrbnv 'shh lyhvh 'thchlb hmkhsh 'thqrb v't khlhchlb 'shr 'lhqrb
verses.translation: And he shall present thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD: the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lhn 'shr 'lhkhslym v'thytrt 'lhkhbd 'lhkhlyt ysyrnh
verses.translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the lobe above the liver, which he shall take away by the kidneys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטִירָ֥ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה לֶ֤חֶם אִשֶּׁה֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ כׇּל־חֵ֖לֶב לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqtyrm hkhhn hmzbchh lchm 'shh lrych nychch khlchlb lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall make them smoke upon the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a sweet savour; all the fat is the LORD’S.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם כׇּל־חֵ֥לֶב וְכׇל־דָּ֖ם לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bkhl mvshbtykhm khlchlb vkhldm l' t'khlv {p}
verses.translation: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that ye shall eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לֵאמֹר֒ נֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תֶחֱטָ֤א בִשְׁגָגָה֙ מִכֹּל֙ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְעָשָׂ֕ה מֵאַחַ֖ת מֵהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr npsh khytcht' bshggh mkhl mtsvt yhvh 'shr l' t'shynh v'shh m'cht mhnh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: If any one shall sin through error, in any of the things which the LORD hath commanded not to be done, and shall do any one of them:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ם הַכֹּהֵ֧ן הַמָּשִׁ֛יחַ יֶחֱטָ֖א לְאַשְׁמַ֣ת הָעָ֑ם וְהִקְרִ֡יב עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א פַּ֣ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֥ר תָּמִ֛ים לַיהֹוָ֖ה לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: 'm hkhhn hmshych ycht' l'shmt h'm vhqryb 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' pr bnbqr tmym lyhvh lcht't
verses.translation: if the anointed priest shall sin so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת־הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־יָדוֹ֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּ֔ר וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhby' 'thpr 'lptch 'hl mv'd lpny yhvh vsmkh 'tydv 'lr'sh hpr vshcht 'thpr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tent of meeting before the LORD; and he shall lay his hand upon the head of the bullock, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֛ח הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר וְהֵבִ֥יא אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn hmshych mdm hpr vhby' 'tv 'l'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the anointed priest shall take of the blood of the bullock, and bring it to the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ בַּדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־הַדָּ֜ם שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vtbl hkhhn 't'tsb'v bdm vhzh mnhdm shb' p'mym lpny yhvh 'tpny prkht hqdsh
verses.translation: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַן֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן מִן־הַדָּ֜ם עַל־קַ֠רְנ֠וֹת מִזְבַּ֨ח קְטֹ֤רֶת הַסַּמִּים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת  כׇּל־דַּ֣ם הַפָּ֗ר יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל־יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vntn hkhhn mnhdm 'lqrnvt mzbch qtrt hsmym lpny yhvh 'shr b'hl mv'd v't  khldm hpr yshpkh 'lysvd mzbch h'lh 'shrptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the priest shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tent of meeting; and all the remaining blood of the bullock shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֵ֛לֶב פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה עַל־הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'tkhlchlb pr hcht't yrym mmnv 'thchlb hmkhsh 'lhqrb v't khlhchlb 'shr 'lhqrb
verses.translation: And all the fat of the bullock of the sin-offering he shall take off from it; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lyhn 'shr 'lhkhslym v'thytrt 'lhkhbd 'lhkhlyvt ysyrnh
verses.translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the lobe above the liver, which he shall take away by kidneys,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יוּרַ֔ם מִשּׁ֖וֹר זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְהִקְטִירָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: kh'shr yvrm mshvr zbch hshlmym vhqtyrm hkhhn 'l mzbch h'lh
verses.translation: as it is taken off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall make them smoke upon the altar of burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־ע֤וֹר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־בְּשָׂר֔וֹ עַל־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַל־כְּרָעָ֑יו וְקִרְבּ֖וֹ וּפִרְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: v't'vr hpr v'tkhlbshrv 'lr'shv v'lkhr'yv vqrbv vprshv
verses.translation: But the skin of the bullock, and all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, and its inwards, and its dung,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־כׇּל־הַ֠פָּ֠ר אֶל־מִח֨וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה אֶל־מָק֤וֹם טָהוֹר֙ אֶל־שֶׁ֣פֶךְ הַדֶּ֔שֶׁן וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֹת֛וֹ עַל־עֵצִ֖ים בָּאֵ֑שׁ עַל־שֶׁ֥פֶךְ הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhvtsy' 'tkhlhpr 'lmchvts lmchnh 'lmqvm thvr 'lshpkh hdshn vshrf 'tv 'l'tsym b'sh 'lshpkh hdshn yshrf {p}
verses.translation: even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out shall it be burnt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם כׇּל־עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְנֶעְלַ֣ם דָּבָ֔ר מֵעֵינֵ֖י הַקָּהָ֑ל וְ֠עָשׂ֠וּ אַחַ֨ת מִכׇּל־מִצְוֺ֧ת יְהֹוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁמוּ׃
verses.translit: v'm khl'dt yshr'l yshgv vn'lm dbr m'yny hqhl v'shv 'cht mkhlmtsvt yhvh 'shr l't'shynh v'shmv
verses.translation: And if the whole congregation of Israel shall err, the thing being hid from the eyes of the assembly, and do any of the things which the LORD hath commanded not to be done, and are guilty:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֽוֹדְעָה֙ הַֽחַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטְא֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וְהִקְרִ֨יבוּ הַקָּהָ֜ל פַּ֤ר בֶּן־בָּקָר֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vnvd'h hcht't 'shr cht'v 'lyh vhqrybv hqhl pr bnbqr lcht't vhby'v 'tv lpny 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: when the sin wherein they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bullock for a sin-offering, and bring it before the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠סָמְכ֠וּ זִקְנֵ֨י הָעֵדָ֧ה אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsmkhv zqny h'dh 'tydyhm 'lr'sh hpr lpny yhvh vshcht 'thpr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD; and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֛יא הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר אֶל־אֹ֖הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vhby' hkhhn hmshych mdm hpr 'l'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the anointed priest shall bring of the blood of the bullock to the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ מִן־הַדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֞ה שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: vtbl hkhhn 'tsb'v mnhdm vhzh shb' p'mym lpny yhvh 't pny hprkht
verses.translation: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַדָּ֞ם יִתֵּ֣ן  עַל־קַרְנֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת כׇּל־הַדָּ֗ם יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל־יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vmnhdm ytn  'lqrnt hmzbch 'shr lpny yhvh 'shr b'hl mv'd v't khlhdm yshpkh 'lysvd mzbch h'lh 'shrptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tent of meeting, and all the remaining blood shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering, which is at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.translit: v't khlchlbv yrym mmnv vhqtyr hmzbchh
verses.translation: And all the fat thereof shall he take off from it, and make it smoke upon the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֣ה לַפָּ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְפַ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֔את כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂה־לּ֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֧ר עֲלֵהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shh lpr kh'shr 'shh lpr hcht't khn y'shhlv vkhpr 'lhm hkhhn vnslch lhm
verses.translation: Thus shall he do with the bullock; as he did with the bullock of the sin-offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׂרַ֣ף אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂרַ֔ף אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חַטַּ֥את הַקָּהָ֖ל הֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhvtsy' 'thpr 'lmchvts lmchnh vshrf 'tv kh'shr shrf 't hpr hr'shvn cht't hqhl hv' {p}
verses.translation: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bullock; it is the sin-offering for the assembly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשִׂ֖יא יֶֽחֱטָ֑א וְעָשָׂ֡ה אַחַ֣ת מִכׇּל־מִצְוֺת֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֜יו אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־תֵעָשֶׂ֛ינָה בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'shr nshy' ycht' v'shh 'cht mkhlmtsvt yhvh 'lhyv 'shr l't'shynh bshggh v'shm
verses.translation: When a ruler sinneth, and doeth through error any one of all the things which the LORD his God hath commanded not to be done, and is guilty:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹ־הוֹדַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ חַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְהֵבִ֧יא אֶת־קׇרְבָּנ֛וֹ שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים זָכָ֥ר תָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'vhvd' 'lyv cht'tv 'shr cht' bh vhby' 'tqrbnv sh'yr 'zym zkhr tmym
verses.translation: if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, be known to him, he shall bring for his offering a goat, a male without blemish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֗וֹ בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vsmkh ydv 'lr'sh hsh'yr vshcht 'tv bmqvm 'shryshcht 'th'lh lpny yhvh cht't hv'
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt-offering before the LORD; it is a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־דָּמ֣וֹ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־יְס֖וֹד מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm hcht't b'tsb'v vntn 'lqrnt mzbch h'lh v'tdmv yshpkh 'lysvd mzbch h'lh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering, and the remaining blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar of burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֶלְבּוֹ֙ יַקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה כְּחֵ֖לֶב זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'tkhlchlbv yqtyr hmzbchh khchlb zbch hshlmym vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn mcht'tv vnslch lv {p}
verses.translation: And all the fat thereof shall he make smoke upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־נֶ֧פֶשׁ אַחַ֛ת תֶּחֱטָ֥א בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֠עֲשֹׂתָ֠הּ אַחַ֨ת מִמִּצְוֺ֧ת יְהֹוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: v'mnpsh 'cht tcht' bshggh m'm h'rts b'shth 'cht mmtsvt yhvh 'shr l't'shynh v'shm
verses.translation: And if any one of the common people sin through error, in doing any of the things which the LORD hath commanded not to be done, and be guilty:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֚וֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אֵלָ֔יו חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְהֵבִ֨יא קׇרְבָּנ֜וֹ שְׂעִירַ֤ת עִזִּים֙ תְּמִימָ֣ה נְקֵבָ֔ה עַל־חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'v hvd' 'lyv cht'tv 'shr cht' vhby' qrbnv sh'yrt 'zym tmymh nqbh 'lcht'tv 'shr cht'
verses.translation: if his sin, which he hath sinned, be known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַט֙ אֶת־הַ֣חַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֖וֹם הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsmkh 'tydv 'l r'sh hcht't vshcht 'thcht't bmqvm h'lh
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill the sin-offering in the place of burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִדָּמָהּ֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdmh b'tsb'v vntn 'lqrnt mzbch h'lh v'tkhldmh yshpkh 'lysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering, and all the remaining blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֶלְבָּ֣הּ יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּסַ֣ר חֵ֘לֶב֮ מֵעַ֣ל זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֤יר הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'tkhlchlbh ysyr kh'shr hvsr chlb m'l zbch hshlmym vhqtyr hkhhn hmzbchh lrych nychch lyhvh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn vnslch lv {p}
verses.translation: And all the fat thereof shall he take away, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall make it smoke upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־כֶּ֛בֶשׂ יָבִ֥יא קׇרְבָּנ֖וֹ לְחַטָּ֑את נְקֵבָ֥ה תְמִימָ֖ה יְבִיאֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v'mkhbsh yby' qrbnv lcht't nqbh tmymh yby'nh
verses.translation: And if he bring a lamb as his offering for a sin-offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַ֤ט אֹתָהּ֙ לְחַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsmkh 'tydv 'l r'sh hcht't vshcht 'th lcht't bmqvm 'shr yshcht 'th'lh
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill it for a sin-offering in the place where they kill the burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm hcht't b'tsb'v vntn 'lqrnt mzbch h'lh v'tkhldmh yshpkh 'lysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt-offering, and all the remaining blood thereof shall he pour out at the base of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֶלְבָּ֣הּ יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יוּסַ֥ר חֵֽלֶב־הַכֶּ֘שֶׂב֮ מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֹתָם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַל־חַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־חָטָ֖א וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'tkhlchlbh ysyr kh'shr yvsr chlbhkhshb mzbch hshlmym vhqtyr hkhhn 'tm hmzbchh 'l 'shy yhvh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn 'lcht'tv 'shrcht' vnslch lv {p}
verses.translation: And all the fat thereof shall he take away, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace-offerings; and the priest shall make them smoke on the altar, upon the offerings of the LORD made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תֶחֱטָ֗א וְשָֽׁמְעָה֙ ק֣וֹל אָלָ֔ה וְה֣וּא עֵ֔ד א֥וֹ רָאָ֖ה א֣וֹ יָדָ֑ע אִם־ל֥וֹא יַגִּ֖יד וְנָשָׂ֥א עֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vnpsh khytcht' vshm'h qvl 'lh vhv' 'd 'v r'h 'v yd' 'mlv' ygyd vnsh' 'vnv
verses.translation: And if any one sin, in that he heareth the voice of adjuration, he being a witness, whether he hath seen or known, if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע֮ בְּכׇל־דָּבָ֣ר טָמֵא֒ אוֹ֩ בְנִבְלַ֨ת חַיָּ֜ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּנִבְלַת֙ בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה א֕וֹ בְּנִבְלַ֖ת שֶׁ֣רֶץ טָמֵ֑א וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְה֥וּא טָמֵ֖א וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'v npsh 'shr tg' bkhldbr tm' 'v bnblt chyh tm'h 'v bnblt bhmh tm'h 'v bnblt shrts tm' vn'lm mmnv vhv' tm' v'shm
verses.translation: or if any one touch any unclean thing, whether it be the carcass of an unclean beast, or the carcass of unclean cattle, or the carcass of unclean swarming things, and be guilty, it being hidden from him that he is unclean;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ כִ֤י יִגַּע֙ בְּטֻמְאַ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ טֻמְאָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִטְמָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְה֥וּא יָדַ֖ע וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'v khy yg' btm't 'dm lkhl tm'tv 'shr ytm' bh vn'lm mmnv vhv' yd' v'shm
verses.translation: or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever his uncleanness be wherewith he is unclean, and it be hid from him; and, when he knoweth of it, be guilty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ נֶ֡פֶשׁ כִּ֣י תִשָּׁבַע֩ לְבַטֵּ֨א בִשְׂפָתַ֜יִם לְהָרַ֣ע  א֣וֹ לְהֵיטִ֗יב לְ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְבַטֵּ֧א הָאָדָ֛ם בִּשְׁבֻעָ֖ה וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהוּא־יָדַ֥ע וְאָשֵׁ֖ם לְאַחַ֥ת מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: 'v npsh khy tshb' lbt' bshptym lhr'  'v lhytyb lkhl 'shr ybt' h'dm bshb'h vn'lm mmnv vhv'yd' v'shm l'cht m'lh
verses.translation: or if any one swear clearly with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall utter clearly with an oath, and it be hid from him; and, when he knoweth of it, be guilty in one of these things;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה כִֽי־יֶאְשַׁ֖ם לְאַחַ֣ת מֵאֵ֑לֶּה וְהִ֨תְוַדָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyy'shm l'cht m'lh vhtvdh 'shr cht' 'lyh
verses.translation: and it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that wherein he hath sinned;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמ֣וֹ לַיהֹוָ֡ה עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א נְקֵבָ֨ה מִן־הַצֹּ֥אן כִּשְׂבָּ֛ה אֽוֹ־שְׂעִירַ֥ת עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מֵחַטָּאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhby' 't'shmv lyhvh 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' nqbh mnhts'n khshbh 'vsh'yrt 'zym lcht't vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn mcht'tv
verses.translation: and he shall bring his forfeit unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תַגִּ֣יעַ יָדוֹ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְהֵבִ֨יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמ֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֗א שְׁתֵּ֥י תֹרִ֛ים אֽוֹ־שְׁנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יוֹנָ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה אֶחָ֥ד לְחַטָּ֖את וְאֶחָ֥ד לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ml' tgy' ydv dy shh vhby' 't'shmv 'shr cht' shty trym 'vshny bnyyvnh lyhvh 'chd lcht't v'chd l'lh
verses.translation: And if his means suffice not for a lamb, then he shall bring his forfeit for that wherein he hath sinned, two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD: one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִקְרִ֛יב אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַחַטָּ֖את רִאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּמָלַ֧ק אֶת־רֹאשׁ֛וֹ מִמּ֥וּל עׇרְפּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַבְדִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: vhby' 'tm 'lhkhhn vhqryb 't'shr lcht't r'shvnh vmlq 'tr'shv mmvl 'rpv vl' ybdyl
verses.translation: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin-offering first, and pinch off its head close by its neck, but shall not divide it asunder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֞ה מִדַּ֤ם הַחַטָּאת֙ עַל־קִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָ֣ר בַּדָּ֔ם יִמָּצֵ֖ה אֶל־יְס֣וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vhzh mdm hcht't 'lqyr hmzbch vhnsh'r bdm ymtsh 'lysvd hmzbch cht't hv'
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin-offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַשֵּׁנִ֛י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה עֹלָ֖ה כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מֵחַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־חָטָ֖א וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'thshny y'shh 'lh khmshpt vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn mcht'tv 'shrcht' vnslch lv {s}
verses.translation: And he shall prepare the second for a burnt-offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him as concerning his sin which he hath sinned, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹא֩ תַשִּׂ֨יג יָד֜וֹ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים אוֹ֮ לִשְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵי־יוֹנָה֒ וְהֵבִ֨יא אֶת־קׇרְבָּנ֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֗א עֲשִׂירִ֧ת הָאֵפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְחַטָּ֑את לֹא־יָשִׂ֨ים עָלֶ֜יהָ שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹא־יִתֵּ֤ן עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּ֥י חַטָּ֖את הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: v'ml' tshyg ydv lshty trym 'v lshny bnyyvnh vhby' 'tqrbnv 'shr cht' 'shyrt h'ph slt lcht't l'yshym 'lyh shmn vl'ytn 'lyh lbnh khy cht't hv'
verses.translation: But if his means suffice not for two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his offering for that wherein he hath sinned, the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin-offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon; for it is a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ֮ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְקָמַ֣ץ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן ׀ מִ֠מֶּ֠נָּה מְל֨וֹא קֻמְצ֜וֹ אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vhby'h 'lhkhhn vqmts hkhhn  mmnh mlv' qmtsv 't'zkhrth vhqtyr hmzbchh 'l 'shy yhvh cht't hv'
verses.translation: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial-part thereof, and make it smoke on the altar, upon the offerings of the LORD made by fire; it is a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן עַל־חַטָּאת֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר־חָטָ֛א מֵֽאַחַ֥ת מֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֑וֹ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לַכֹּהֵ֖ן כַּמִּנְחָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn 'lcht'tv 'shrcht' m'cht m'lh vnslch lv vhyth lkhhn khmnchh {s}
verses.translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in any of these things, and he shall be forgiven; and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as the meal-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תִמְעֹ֣ל מַ֔עַל וְחָֽטְאָה֙ בִּשְׁגָגָ֔ה מִקׇּדְשֵׁ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהֵבִיא֩ אֶת־אֲשָׁמ֨וֹ לַֽיהֹוָ֜ה אַ֧יִל תָּמִ֣ים מִן־הַצֹּ֗אן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֛ כֶּֽסֶף־שְׁקָלִ֥ים בְּשֶֽׁקֶל־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: npsh khytm'l m'l vcht'h bshggh mqdshy yhvh vhby' 't'shmv lyhvh 'yl tmym mnhts'n b'rkhkh khsfshqlym bshqlhqdsh l'shm
verses.translation: If any one commit a trespass, and sin through error, in the holy things of the LORD, then he shall bring his forfeit unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy valuation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר֩ חָטָ֨א מִן־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּ֗ם וְאֶת־חֲמִֽישִׁתוֹ֙ יוֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן אֹת֖וֹ לַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֵ֗ן יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו בְּאֵ֥יל הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't 'shr cht' mnhqdsh yshlm v'tchmyshtv yvsf 'lyv vntn 'tv lkhhn vhkhhn ykhpr 'lyv b'yl h'shm vnslch lv {p}
verses.translation: And he shall make restitution for that which he hath done amiss in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt-offering, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ כִּ֣י תֶֽחֱטָ֔א וְעָֽשְׂתָ֗ה אַחַת֙ מִכׇּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֥ע וְאָשֵׁ֖ם וְנָשָׂ֥א עֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mnpsh khy tcht' v'shth 'cht mkhlmtsvt yhvh 'shr l' t'shynh vl'yd' v'shm vnsh' 'vnv
verses.translation: And if any one sin, and do any of the things which the LORD hath commanded not to be done, though he know it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הֵבִ֠יא אַ֣יִל תָּמִ֧ים מִן־הַצֹּ֛אן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ לְאָשָׁ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן עַ֣ל שִׁגְגָת֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁגָ֛ג וְה֥וּא לֹֽא־יָדַ֖ע וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhby' 'yl tmym mnhts'n b'rkhkh l'shm 'lhkhhn vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn 'l shggtv 'shrshgg vhv' l'yd' vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy valuation, for a guilt-offering, unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the error which he committed, though he knew it not, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָשָׁ֖ם ה֑וּא אָשֹׁ֥ם אָשַׁ֖ם לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'shm hv' 'shm 'shm lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: It is a guilt-offering—he is certainly guilty before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ כִּ֣י תֶחֱטָ֔א וּמָעֲלָ֥ה מַ֖עַל בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וְכִחֵ֨שׁ בַּעֲמִית֜וֹ בְּפִקָּד֗וֹן אֽוֹ־בִתְשׂ֤וּמֶת יָד֙ א֣וֹ בְגָזֵ֔ל א֖וֹ עָשַׁ֥ק אֶת־עֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: npsh khy tcht' vm'lh m'l byhvh vkhchsh b'mytv bpqdvn 'vbtshvmt yd 'v bgzl 'v 'shq 't'mytv
verses.translation: If any one sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and deal falsely with his neighbour in a matter of deposit, or of pledge, or of robbery, or have oppressed his neighbour;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹ־מָצָ֧א אֲבֵדָ֛ה וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בָּ֖הּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ע עַל־שָׁ֑קֶר עַל־אַחַ֗ת מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הָאָדָ֖ם לַחֲטֹ֥א בָהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: 'vmts' 'bdh vkhchsh bh vnshb' 'lshqr 'l'cht mkhl 'shry'shh h'dm lcht' bhnh
verses.translation: or have found that which was lost, and deal falsely therein, and swear to a lie; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ כִּֽי־יֶחֱטָ֣א וְאָשֵׁם֒ וְהֵשִׁ֨יב אֶת־הַגְּזֵלָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּזָ֗ל א֤וֹ אֶת־הָעֹ֙שֶׁק֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׁ֔ק א֚וֹ אֶת־הַפִּקָּד֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הׇפְקַ֖ד אִתּ֑וֹ א֥וֹ אֶת־הָאֲבֵדָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָֽא׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyycht' v'shm vhshyb 'thgzlh 'shr gzl 'v 'th'shq 'shr 'shq 'v 'thpqdvn 'shr hpqd 'tv 'v 'th'bdh 'shr mts'
verses.translation: then it shall be, if he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he hath gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was deposited with him, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֠וֹ מִכֹּ֞ל אֲשֶׁר־יִשָּׁבַ֣ע עָלָיו֮ לַשֶּׁ֒קֶר֒ וְשִׁלַּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִׁתָ֖יו יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑יו לַאֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ יִתְּנֶ֖נּוּ בְּי֥וֹם אַשְׁמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'v mkhl 'shryshb' 'lyv lshqr vshlm 'tv br'shv vchmshtyv ysf 'lyv l'shr hv' lv ytnnv byvm 'shmtv
verses.translation: or any thing about which he hath sworn falsely, he shall even restore it in full, and shall add the fifth part more thereto; unto him to whom it appertaineth shall he give it, in the day of his being guilty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אֲשָׁמ֥וֹ יָבִ֖יא לַיהֹוָ֑ה אַ֣יִל תָּמִ֧ים מִן־הַצֹּ֛אן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ לְאָשָׁ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v't'shmv yby' lyhvh 'yl tmym mnhts'n b'rkhkh l'shm 'lhkhhn
verses.translation: And he shall bring his forfeit unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, according to thy valuation, for a guilt-offering, unto the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֑וֹ עַל־אַחַ֛ת מִכֹּ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לְאַשְׁמָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn lpny yhvh vnslch lv 'l'cht mkhl 'shry'shh l'shmh bh {p}
verses.translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he shall be forgiven, concerning whatsoever he doeth so as to be guilty thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֤ו אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָעֹלָ֑ה הִ֣וא הָעֹלָ֡ה עַל֩ מוֹקְדָ֨הֿ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ כׇּל־הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וְאֵ֥שׁ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ תּ֥וּקַד בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tsv 't'hrn v'tbnyv l'mr z't tvrt h'lh hv' h'lh 'l mvqdh 'lhmzbch khlhlylh 'dhbqr v'sh hmzbch tvqd bv
verses.translation: Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the law of the burnt-offering: it is that which goeth up on its firewood upon the altar all night unto the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָבַ֨שׁ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדּ֣וֹ בַ֗ד וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־בַד֮ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וְהֵרִ֣ים אֶת־הַדֶּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֥ל הָאֵ֛שׁ אֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְשָׂמ֕וֹ אֵ֖צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vlbsh hkhhn mdv bd vmkhnsybd ylbsh 'lbshrv vhrym 'thdshn 'shr t'khl h'sh 'th'lh 'lhmzbch vshmv 'tsl hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh; and he shall take up the ashes whereto the fire hath consumed the burnt-offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְלָבַ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֶת־הַדֶּ֙שֶׁן֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה אֶל־מָק֖וֹם טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vpsht 'tbgdyv vlbsh bgdym 'chrym vhvtsy' 'thdshn 'lmchvts lmchnh 'lmqvm thvr
verses.translation: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֵ֨שׁ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ תּֽוּקַד־בּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וּבִעֵ֨ר עָלֶ֧יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עֵצִ֖ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָרַ֤ךְ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הָֽעֹלָ֔ה וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶלְבֵ֥י הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vh'sh 'lhmzbch tvqdbv l' tkhbh vb'r 'lyh hkhhn 'tsym bbqr bbqr v'rkh 'lyh h'lh vhqtyr 'lyh chlby hshlmym
verses.translation: And the fire upon the altar shall be kept burning thereby, it shall not go out; and the priest shall kindle wood on it every morning; and he shall lay the burnt-offering in order upon it, and shall make smoke thereon the fat of the peace-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗שׁ תָּמִ֛יד תּוּקַ֥ד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'sh tmyd tvqd 'lhmzbch l' tkhbh {s}
verses.translation: Fire shall be kept burning upon the altar continually; it shall not go out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַמִּנְחָ֑ה הַקְרֵ֨ב אֹתָ֤הּ בְּנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vz't tvrt hmnchh hqrb 'th bny'hrn lpny yhvh 'lpny hmzbch
verses.translation: And this is the law of the meal-offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, in front of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵרִ֨ים מִמֶּ֜נּוּ בְּקֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסֹּ֤לֶת הַמִּנְחָה֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַלְּבֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ רֵ֧יחַ נִיחֹ֛חַ אַזְכָּרָתָ֖הּ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhrym mmnv bqmtsv mslt hmnchh vmshmnh v't khlhlbnh 'shr 'lhmnchh vhqtyr hmzbch rych nychch 'zkhrth lyhvh
verses.translation: And he shall take up therefrom his handful, of the fine flour of the meal-offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meal-offering, and shall make the memorial-part thereof smoke upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֣רֶת מִמֶּ֔נָּה יֹאכְל֖וּ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו מַצּ֤וֹת תֵּֽאָכֵל֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֔שׁ בַּחֲצַ֥ר אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד יֹאכְלֽוּהָ׃
verses.translit: vhnvtrt mmnh y'khlv 'hrn vbnyv mtsvt t'khl bmqvm qdsh bchtsr 'hlmv'd y'khlvh
verses.translation: And that which is left thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat; it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place; in the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א תֵאָפֶה֙ חָמֵ֔ץ חֶלְקָ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֹתָ֖הּ מֵאִשָּׁ֑י קֹ֤דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁים֙ הִ֔וא כַּחַטָּ֖את וְכָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: l' t'ph chmts chlqm ntty 'th m'shy qdsh qdshym hv' khcht't vkh'shm
verses.translation: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion of My offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as the sin-offering, and as the guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־זָכָ֞ר בִּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ יֹֽאכְלֶ֔נָּה חׇק־עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֥ע בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlzkhr bbny 'hrn y'khlnh chq'vlm ldrtykhm m'shy yhvh khl 'shryg' bhm yqdsh {p}
verses.translation: Every male among the children of Aaron may eat of it, as a due for ever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire; whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֡ה קׇרְבַּן֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֣יבוּ לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ עֲשִׂירִ֨ת הָאֵפָ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת מִנְחָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מַחֲצִיתָ֣הּ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָ֖הּ בָּעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: zh qrbn 'hrn vbnyv 'shryqrybv lyhvh byvm hmshch 'tv 'shyrt h'ph slt mnchh tmyd mchtsyth bbqr vmchtsyth b'rb
verses.translation: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half thereof in the evening.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽל־מַחֲבַ֗ת בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן תֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה מֻרְבֶּ֣כֶת תְּבִיאֶ֑נָּה תֻּפִינֵי֙ מִנְחַ֣ת פִּתִּ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lmchbt bshmn t'shh mrbkht tby'nh tpyny mncht ptym tqryb rychnychch lyhvh
verses.translation: On a griddle it shall be made with oil; when it is soaked, thou shalt bring it in; in broken pieces shalt thou offer the meal-offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַמָּשִׁ֧יחַ תַּחְתָּ֛יו מִבָּנָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ חׇק־עוֹלָ֕ם לַיהֹוָ֖ה כָּלִ֥יל תׇּקְטָֽר׃
verses.translit: vhkhhn hmshych tchtyv mbnyv y'shh 'th chq'vlm lyhvh khlyl tqtr
verses.translation: And the anointed priest that shall be in his stead from among his sons shall offer it, it is a due for ever; it shall be wholly made to smoke unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מִנְחַ֥ת כֹּהֵ֛ן כָּלִ֥יל תִּהְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlmncht khhn khlyl thyh l' t'khl {p}
verses.translation: And every meal-offering of the priest shall be wholly made to smoke; it shall not be eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את בִּמְק֡וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ תִּשָּׁחֵ֨ט הָעֹלָ֜ה תִּשָּׁחֵ֤ט הַֽחַטָּאת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn v'lbnyv l'mr z't tvrt hcht't bmqvm 'shr tshcht h'lh tshcht hcht't lpny yhvh qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the law of the sin-offering: in the place where the burnt-offering is killed shall the sin-offering be killed before the LORD; it is most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַֽמְחַטֵּ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ יֹאכְלֶ֑נָּה בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדֹשׁ֙ תֵּֽאָכֵ֔ל בַּחֲצַ֖ר אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: hkhhn hmcht' 'th y'khlnh bmqvm qdsh t'khl bchtsr 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it; in a holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֥ע בִּבְשָׂרָ֖הּ יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִזֶּ֤ה מִדָּמָהּ֙ עַל־הַבֶּ֔גֶד אֲשֶׁר֙ יִזֶּ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ תְּכַבֵּ֖ס בְּמָק֥וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khl 'shryg' bbshrh yqdsh v'shr yzh mdmh 'lhbgd 'shr yzh 'lyh tkhbs bmqvm qdsh
verses.translation: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy; and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in a holy place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּבֻשַּׁל־בּ֖וֹ יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְאִם־בִּכְלִ֤י נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בֻּשָּׁ֔לָה וּמֹרַ֥ק וְשֻׁטַּ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vkhlychrsh 'shr tbshlbv yshbr v'mbkhly nchsht bshlh vmrq vshtf bmym
verses.translation: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken; and if it be sodden in a brazen vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכַ֣ל אֹתָ֑הּ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: khlzkhr bkhhnym y'khl 'th qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: Every male among the priests may eat thereof; it is most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־חַטָּ֡את אֲשֶׁר֩ יוּבָ֨א מִדָּמָ֜הּ אֶל־אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֣א תֵאָכֵ֑ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlcht't 'shr yvb' mdmh 'l'hl mv'd lkhpr bqdsh l' t'khl b'sh tshrf {p}
verses.translation: And no sin-offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָאָשָׁ֑ם קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vz't tvrt h'shm qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: And this is the law of the guilt-offering: it is most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁחֲטוּ֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה יִשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־הָאָשָׁ֑ם וְאֶת־דָּמ֛וֹ יִזְרֹ֥ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: bmqvm 'shr yshchtv 'th'lh yshchtv 'th'shm v'tdmv yzrq 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: In the place where they kill the burnt-offering shall they kill the guilt-offering: and the blood thereof shall be dashed against the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יַקְרִ֣יב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֵ֚ת הָֽאַלְיָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v't khlchlbv yqryb mmnv 't h'lyh v'thchlb hmkhsh 'thqrb
verses.translation: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof: the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lyhn 'shr 'lhkhslym v'thytrt 'lhkhbd 'lhkhlyt ysyrnh
verses.translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the lobe above the liver, which he shall take away by the kidneys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹתָ֤ם הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה אָשָׁ֖ם הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vhqtyr 'tm hkhhn hmzbchh 'shh lyhvh 'shm hv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall make them smoke upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD; it is a guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכְלֶ֑נּוּ בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: khlzkhr bkhhnym y'khlnv bmqvm qdvsh y'khl qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: Every male among the priests may eat thereof; it shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּֽאָשָׁ֔ם תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לָהֶ֑ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־בּ֖וֹ ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khcht't kh'shm tvrh 'cht lhm hkhhn 'shr ykhprbv lv yhyh
verses.translation: As is the sin-offering, so is the guilt-offering; there is one law for them; the priest that maketh atonement therewith, he shall have it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨כֹּהֵ֔ן הַמַּקְרִ֖יב אֶת־עֹ֣לַת אִ֑ישׁ ע֤וֹר הָֽעֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְרִ֔יב לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhkhhn hmqryb 't'lt 'ysh 'vr h'lh 'shr hqryb lkhhn lv yhyh
verses.translation: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt-offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath offered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מִנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּֽאָפֶה֙ בַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְכׇל־נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בַמַּרְחֶ֖שֶׁת וְעַֽל־מַחֲבַ֑ת לַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַמַּקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ ל֥וֹ תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhlmnchh 'shr t'ph btnvr vkhln'shh bmrchsht v'lmchbt lkhhn hmqryb 'th lv thyh
verses.translation: And every meal-offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the stewing-pan, and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מִנְחָ֥ה בְלוּלָֽה־בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וַחֲרֵבָ֑ה לְכׇל־בְּנֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ כְּאָחִֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlmnchh blvlhbshmn vchrbh lkhlbny 'hrn thyh 'ysh kh'chyv {p}
verses.translation: And every meal-offering, mingled with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as well as another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֖יב לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vz't tvrt zbch hshlmym 'shr yqryb lyhvh
verses.translation: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which one may offer unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ם עַל־תּוֹדָה֮ יַקְרִיבֶ֒נּוּ֒ וְהִקְרִ֣יב  עַל־זֶ֣בַח הַתּוֹדָ֗ה חַלּ֤וֹת מַצּוֹת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וְסֹ֣לֶת מֻרְבֶּ֔כֶת חַלֹּ֖ת בְּלוּלֹ֥ת בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: 'm 'ltvdh yqrybnv vhqryb  'lzbch htvdh chlvt mtsvt blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn vslt mrbkht chlt blvlt bshmn
verses.translation: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour soaked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־חַלֹּת֙ לֶ֣חֶם חָמֵ֔ץ יַקְרִ֖יב קׇרְבָּנ֑וֹ עַל־זֶ֖בַח תּוֹדַ֥ת שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'lchlt lchm chmts yqryb qrbnv 'lzbch tvdt shlmyv
verses.translation: With cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering with the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִמֶּ֤נּוּ אֶחָד֙ מִכׇּל־קׇרְבָּ֔ן תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַזֹּרֵ֛ק אֶת־דַּ֥ם הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqryb mmnv 'chd mkhlqrbn trvmh lyhvh lkhhn hzrq 'tdm hshlmym lv yhyh
verses.translation: And of it he shall present one out of each offering for a gift unto the LORD; it shall be the priest’s that dasheth the blood of the peace-offerings against the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תּוֹדַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔יו בְּי֥וֹם קׇרְבָּנ֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא־יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: vbshr zbch tvdt shlmyv byvm qrbnv y'khl l'ynych mmnv 'dbqr
verses.translation: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־נֶ֣דֶר  א֣וֹ נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קׇרְבָּנ֔וֹ בְּי֛וֹם הַקְרִיב֥וֹ אֶת־זִבְח֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּמִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'mndr  'v ndbh zbch qrbnv byvm hqrybv 'tzbchv y'khl vmmchrt vhnvtr mmnv y'khl
verses.translation: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a freewill-offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offereth his sacrifice; and on the morrow that which remaineth of it may be eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר מִבְּשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑בַח בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vhnvtr mbshr hzbch byvm hshlyshy b'sh yshrf
verses.translation: But that which remaineth of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵ֠ל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜יו בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַמַּקְרִ֣יב אֹת֗וֹ לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב ל֖וֹ פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהַנֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֲוֺנָ֥הּ תִּשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: v'm h'khl y'khl mbshrzbch shlmyv byvm hshlyshy l' yrtsh hmqryb 'tv l' ychshb lv pgvl yhyh vhnpsh h'khlt mmnv 'vnh tsh'
verses.translation: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace-offerings be at all eaten on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it; it shall be an abhorred thing, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֤ע בְּכׇל־טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְהַ֨בָּשָׂ֔ר כׇּל־טָה֖וֹר יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vhbshr 'shryg' bkhltm' l' y'khl b'sh yshrf vhbshr khlthvr y'khl bshr
verses.translation: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire. And as for the flesh, every one that is clean may eat thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִזֶּ֤בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vhnpsh 'shrt'khl bshr mzbch hshlmym 'shr lyhvh vtm'tv 'lyv vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh
verses.translation: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תִגַּ֣ע בְּכׇל־טָמֵ֗א בְּטֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ א֣וֹ  בִּבְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּכׇל־שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְאָכַ֛ל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnpsh khytg' bkhltm' btm't 'dm 'v  bbhmh tm'h 'v bkhlshqts tm' v'khl mbshrzbch hshlmym 'shr lyhvh vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh {p}
verses.translation: And when any one shall touch any unclean thing, whether it be the uncleanness of man, or an unclean beast, or any unclean detestable thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כׇּל־חֵ֜לֶב שׁ֥וֹר וְכֶ֛שֶׂב וָעֵ֖ז לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr khlchlb shvr vkhshb v'z l' t'khlv
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: Ye shall eat no fat, of ox, or sheep, or goat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֵ֤לֶב נְבֵלָה֙ וְחֵ֣לֶב טְרֵפָ֔ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לְכׇל־מְלָאכָ֑ה וְאָכֹ֖ל לֹ֥א תֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vchlb nblh vchlb trph y'shh lkhlml'khh v'khl l' t'khlhv
verses.translation: And the fat of that which dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of beasts, may be used for any other service; but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י כׇּל־אֹכֵ֣ל חֵ֔לֶב מִ֨ן־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֥יב מִמֶּ֛נָּה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֖לֶת מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: khy khl'khl chlb mnhbhmh 'shr yqryb mmnh 'shh lyhvh vnkhrth hnpsh h'khlt m'myh
verses.translation: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men present an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־דָּם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֔וּ בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לָע֖וֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhldm l' t'khlv bkhl mvshbtykhm l'vf vlbhmh
verses.translation: And ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל כׇּל־דָּ֑ם וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlnpsh 'shrt'khl khldm vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh {p}
verses.translation: Whosoever it be that eateth any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַמַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת־זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמָיו֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה יָבִ֧יא אֶת־קׇרְבָּנ֛וֹ לַיהֹוָ֖ה מִזֶּ֥בַח שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr hmqryb 'tzbch shlmyv lyhvh yby' 'tqrbnv lyhvh mzbch shlmyv
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: He that offereth his sacrifice of peace-offerings unto the LORD shall bring his offering unto the LORD out of his sacrifice of peace-offerings.
