verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם  יִרְאֶ֣נָּה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־בַּבַּהֶ֙רֶת֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּשְׁפָלָ֥הֿ אֵינֶ֛נָּה מִן־הָע֖וֹר וְהִ֣וא כֵהָ֑ה וְהִסְגִּיר֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'm  yr'nh hkhhn vhnh 'ynbbhrt sh'r lbn vshplh 'ynnh mnh'vr vhv' khhh vhsgyrv hkhhn shb't ymym
verses.translation: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the skin, but be dim; then the priest shall shut him up seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י אִם־פָּשֹׂ֤ה תִפְשֶׂה֙ בָּע֔וֹר וְטִמֵּ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹת֔וֹ נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vr'hv hkhhn byvm hshby'y 'mpshh tpshh b'vr vtm' hkhhn 'tv ng' tsr't hv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day; if it spread abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־תַּחְתֶּ֩יהָ֩ תַעֲמֹ֨ד הַבַּהֶ֜רֶת לֹא־פָשְׂתָ֤ה בָעוֹר֙ וְהִ֣וא כֵהָ֔ה שְׂאֵ֥ת הַמִּכְוָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְטִֽהֲרוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן כִּֽי־צָרֶ֥בֶת הַמִּכְוָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mtchtyh t'md hbhrt l'pshth b'vr vhv' khhh sh't hmkhvh hv' vthrv hkhhn khytsrbt hmkhvh hv' {p}
verses.translation: And if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread in the skin, but be dim, it is the rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar of the burning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ נָ֑גַע בְּרֹ֖אשׁ א֥וֹ בְזָקָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'v 'shh khyyhyh bv ng' br'sh 'v bzqn
verses.translation: And when a man or woman hath a plague upon the head or upon the beard,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָע֔וֹר וּב֛וֹ שֵׂעָ֥ר צָהֹ֖ב דָּ֑ק וְטִמֵּ֨א אֹת֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ נֶ֣תֶק ה֔וּא צָרַ֧עַת הָרֹ֛אשׁ א֥וֹ הַזָּקָ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'thng' vhnh mr'hv 'mq mnh'vr vbv sh'r tshb dq vtm' 'tv hkhhn ntq hv' tsr't hr'sh 'v hzqn hv'
verses.translation: then the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the appearance thereof be deeper than the skin, and there be in it yellow thin hair, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a scall, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִרְאֶ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־נֶ֣גַע הַנֶּ֗תֶק וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵין־מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָע֔וֹר וְשֵׂעָ֥ר שָׁחֹ֖ר אֵ֣ין בּ֑וֹ וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־נֶ֥גַע הַנֶּ֖תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhyyr'h hkhhn 'tng' hntq vhnh 'ynmr'hv 'mq mnh'vr vsh'r shchr 'yn bv vhsgyr hkhhn 'tng' hntq shb't ymym
verses.translation: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, and there be no black hair in it, then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֘גַע֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔תֶק וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה ב֖וֹ שֵׂעָ֣ר צָהֹ֑ב וּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַנֶּ֔תֶק אֵ֥ין עָמֹ֖ק מִן־הָעֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'thng' byvm hshby'y vhnh l'pshh hntq vl'hyh bv sh'r tshb vmr'h hntq 'yn 'mq mnh'vr
verses.translation: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the scall be not spread, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the appearance of the scall be not deeper than the skin,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִ֨תְגַּלָּ֔ח וְאֶת־הַנֶּ֖תֶק לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְהִסְגִּ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֧ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֛תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vhtglch v'thntq l' yglch vhsgyr hkhhn 'thntq shb't ymym shnyt
verses.translation: then he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֜תֶק בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְ֠הִנֵּ֠ה לֹא־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙תֶק֙ בָּע֔וֹר וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ אֵינֶ֥נּוּ עָמֹ֖ק מִן־הָע֑וֹר וְטִהַ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'thntq byvm hshby'y vhnh l'pshh hntq b'vr vmr'hv 'ynnv 'mq mnh'vr vthr 'tv hkhhn vkhbs bgdyv vthr
verses.translation: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall; and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, and the appearance thereof be not deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֥ה יִפְשֶׂ֛ה הַנֶּ֖תֶק בָּע֑וֹר אַחֲרֵ֖י טׇהֳרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mpshh ypshh hntq b'vr 'chry thrtv
verses.translation: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֙הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖תֶק בָּע֑וֹר לֹֽא־יְבַקֵּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לַשֵּׂעָ֥ר הַצָּהֹ֖ב טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vr'hv hkhhn vhnh pshh hntq b'vr l'ybqr hkhhn lsh'r htshb tm' hv'
verses.translation: then the priest shall look on him; and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for the yellow hair: he is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בְּעֵינָיו֩ עָמַ֨ד הַנֶּ֜תֶק וְשֵׂעָ֨ר שָׁחֹ֧ר צָֽמַח־בּ֛וֹ נִרְפָּ֥א הַנֶּ֖תֶק טָה֣וֹר ה֑וּא וְטִהֲר֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mb'ynyv 'md hntq vsh'r shchr tsmchbv nrp' hntq thvr hv' vthrv hkhhn {s}
verses.translation: But if the scall stay in its appearance, and black hair be grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרָ֖ם בֶּהָרֹ֑ת בֶּהָרֹ֖ת לְבָנֹֽת׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'v'shh khyyhyh b'vrbshrm bhrt bhrt lbnt
verses.translation: And if a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֧ה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרָ֛ם בֶּהָרֹ֖ת כֵּה֣וֹת לְבָנֹ֑ת בֹּ֥הַק ה֛וּא פָּרַ֥ח בָּע֖וֹר טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn vhnh b'vrbshrm bhrt khhvt lbnt bhq hv' prch b'vr thvr hv' {s}
verses.translation: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin: he is clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשׁ֑וֹ קֵרֵ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khy ymrt r'shv qrch hv' thvr hv'
verses.translation: And if a man’s hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֙ מִפְּאַ֣ת פָּנָ֔יו יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשׁ֑וֹ גִּבֵּ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'm mp't pnyv ymrt r'shv gbch hv' thvr hv'
verses.translation: And if his hair be fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead-bald; yet is he clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בַקָּרַ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַגַּבַּ֔חַת נֶ֖גַע לָבָ֣ן אֲדַמְדָּ֑ם צָרַ֤עַת פֹּרַ֙חַת֙ הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֥וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhyyhyh bqrcht 'v bgbcht ng' lbn 'dmdm tsr't prcht hv' bqrchtv 'v bgbchtv
verses.translation: But if there be in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה אֹת֜וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֔מֶת בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֣וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּ֑וֹ כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה צָרַ֖עַת ע֥וֹר בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vr'h 'tv hkhhn vhnh sh'thng' lbnh 'dmdmt bqrchtv 'v bgbchtv khmr'h tsr't 'vr bshr
verses.translation: Then the priest shall look upon him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague be reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִישׁ־צָר֥וּעַ ה֖וּא טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא טַמֵּ֧א יְטַמְּאֶ֛נּוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בְּרֹאשׁ֥וֹ נִגְעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'yshtsrv' hv' tm' hv' tm' ytm'nv hkhhn br'shv ng'v
verses.translation: he is a leprous man, he is unclean; the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean: his plague is in his head. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַצָּר֜וּעַ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ הַנֶּ֗גַע בְּגָדָ֞יו יִהְי֤וּ פְרֻמִים֙ וְרֹאשׁוֹ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה פָר֔וּעַ וְעַל־שָׂפָ֖ם יַעְטֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א ׀ טָמֵ֖א יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: vhtsrv' 'shrbv hng' bgdyv yhyv prmym vr'shv yhyh prv' v'lshpm y'th vtm'  tm' yqr'
verses.translation: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and the hair of his head shall go loose, and he shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry: ‘Unclean, unclean.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יְמֵ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַנֶּ֥גַע בּ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא בָּדָ֣ד יֵשֵׁ֔ב מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה מוֹשָׁבֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlymy 'shr hng' bv ytm' tm' hv' bdd yshb mchvts lmchnh mvshbv {s}
verses.translation: All the days wherein the plague is in him he shall be unclean; he is unclean; he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his dwelling be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבֶּ֕גֶד כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת בְּבֶ֣גֶד צֶ֔מֶר א֖וֹ בְּבֶ֥גֶד פִּשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vhbgd khyyhyh bv ng' tsr't bbgd tsmr 'v bbgd pshtym
verses.translation: And when the plague of leprosy is in a garment, whether it be a woolen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֤וֹ בִֽשְׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ בְעֵ֔רֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּ֖ים וְלַצָּ֑מֶר א֣וֹ בְע֔וֹר א֖וֹ בְּכׇל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'v bshty 'v b'rb lpshtym vltsmr 'v b'vr 'v bkhlml'kht 'vr
verses.translation: or in the warp, or in the woof, whether they be of linen, or of wool; or in a skin, or in any thing made of skin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַנֶּ֜גַע יְרַקְרַ֣ק  א֣וֹ אֲדַמְדָּ֗ם בַּבֶּ֩גֶד֩ א֨וֹ בָע֜וֹר אֽוֹ־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אוֹ־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְכׇל־כְּלִי־ע֔וֹר נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְהׇרְאָ֖ה אֶת־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vhyh hng' yrqrq  'v 'dmdm bbgd 'v b'vr 'vbshty 'vb'rb 'v bkhlkhly'vr ng' tsr't hv' vhr'h 'thkhhn
verses.translation: If the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin, it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown unto the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'thng' vhsgyr 'thng' shb't ymym
verses.translation: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up that which hath the plague seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־הַנֶּ֜גַע בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י כִּֽי־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּ֠בֶּ֠גֶד אֽוֹ־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בָע֔וֹר לְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה הָע֖וֹר לִמְלָאכָ֑ה צָרַ֧עַת מַמְאֶ֛רֶת הַנֶּ֖גַע טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vr'h 'thng' byvm hshby'y khypshh hng' bbgd 'vbshty 'vb'rb 'v b'vr lkhl 'shry'shh h'vr lml'khh tsr't mm'rt hng' tm' hv'
verses.translation: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever service skin is used for, the plague is a malignant leprosy: it is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂרַ֨ף אֶת־הַבֶּ֜גֶד א֥וֹ אֶֽת־הַשְּׁתִ֣י  א֣וֹ אֶת־הָעֵ֗רֶב בַּצֶּ֙מֶר֙ א֣וֹ בַפִּשְׁתִּ֔ים א֚וֹ אֶת־כׇּל־כְּלִ֣י הָע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ הַנָּ֑גַע כִּֽי־צָרַ֤עַת מַמְאֶ֙רֶת֙ הִ֔וא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vshrf 'thbgd 'v 'thshty  'v 'th'rb btsmr 'v bpshtym 'v 'tkhlkhly h'vr 'shryhyh bv hng' khytsr't mm'rt hv' b'sh tshrf
verses.translation: And he shall burn the garment, or the warp, or the woof, whether it be of wool or of linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is; for it is a malignant leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֮ יִרְאֶ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע בַּבֶּ֕גֶד א֥וֹ בַשְּׁתִ֖י א֣וֹ בָעֵ֑רֶב א֖וֹ בְּכׇל־כְּלִי־עֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: v'm yr'h hkhhn vhnh l'pshh hng' bbgd 'v bshty 'v b'rb 'v bkhlkhly'vr
verses.translation: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִ֨בְּס֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּיר֥וֹ שִׁבְעַת־יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vkhbsv 't 'shrbv hng' vhsgyrv shb'tymym shnyt
verses.translation: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אַחֲרֵ֣י  הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְ֠הִנֵּ֠ה לֹֽא־הָפַ֨ךְ הַנֶּ֤גַע אֶת־עֵינוֹ֙ וְהַנֶּ֣גַע לֹֽא־פָשָׂ֔ה טָמֵ֣א ה֔וּא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֑נּוּ פְּחֶ֣תֶת הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֥וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'chry  hkhbs 'thng' vhnh l'hpkh hng' 't'ynv vhng' l'pshh tm' hv' b'sh tshrpnv pchtt hv' bqrchtv 'v bgbchtv
verses.translation: And the priest shall look, after that the plague is washed; and, behold, if the plague have not changed its colour, and the plague be not spread, it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is a fret, whether the bareness be within or without.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֮ רָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע אַחֲרֵ֖י הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֹת֑וֹ וְקָרַ֣ע אֹת֗וֹ מִן־הַבֶּ֙גֶד֙ א֣וֹ מִן־הָע֔וֹר א֥וֹ מִן־הַשְּׁתִ֖י א֥וֹ מִן־הָעֵֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'm r'h hkhhn vhnh khhh hng' 'chry hkhbs 'tv vqr' 'tv mnhbgd 'v mnh'vr 'v mnhshty 'v mnh'rb
verses.translation: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be dim after the washing thereof, then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־תֵּרָאֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד בַּ֠בֶּ֠גֶד אֽוֹ־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְכׇל־כְּלִי־ע֔וֹר פֹּרַ֖חַת הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֣שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ הַנָּֽגַע׃
verses.translit: v'mtr'h 'vd bbgd 'vbshty 'vb'rb 'v bkhlkhly'vr prcht hv' b'sh tshrpnv 't 'shrbv hng'
verses.translation: And if it appear still in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin, it is breaking out, thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבֶּ֡גֶד אֽוֹ־הַשְּׁתִ֨י אוֹ־הָעֵ֜רֶב אֽוֹ־כׇל־כְּלִ֤י הָעוֹר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּכַבֵּ֔ס וְסָ֥ר מֵהֶ֖ם הַנָּ֑גַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס שֵׁנִ֖ית וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vhbgd 'vhshty 'vh'rb 'vkhlkhly h'vr 'shr tkhbs vsr mhm hng' vkhbs shnyt vthr
verses.translation: And the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֠את תּוֹרַ֨ת נֶֽגַע־צָרַ֜עַת בֶּ֥גֶד הַצֶּ֣מֶר  א֣וֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּ֗ים א֤וֹ הַשְּׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ הָעֵ֔רֶב א֖וֹ כׇּל־כְּלִי־ע֑וֹר לְטַהֲר֖וֹ א֥וֹ לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't tvrt ng'tsr't bgd htsmr  'v hpshtym 'v hshty 'v h'rb 'v khlkhly'vr lthrv 'v ltm'v {p}
verses.translation: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of wool or linen, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֤את תִּֽהְיֶה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת הַמְּצֹרָ֔ע בְּי֖וֹם טׇהֳרָת֑וֹ וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: z't thyh tvrt hmtsr' byvm thrtv vhvb' 'lhkhhn
verses.translation: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought unto the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נִרְפָּ֥א נֶֽגַע־הַצָּרַ֖עַת מִן־הַצָּרֽוּעַ׃
verses.translit: vyts' hkhhn 'lmchvts lmchnh vr'h hkhhn vhnh nrp' ng'htsr't mnhtsrv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלָקַ֧ח לַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר שְׁתֵּֽי־צִפֳּרִ֥ים חַיּ֖וֹת טְהֹר֑וֹת וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vlqch lmthr shtytsprym chyvt thrvt v'ts 'rz vshny tvl't v'zb
verses.translation: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar-wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־הַצִּפּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־כְּלִי־חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vshcht 'thtspvr h'cht 'lkhlychrsh 'lmym chyym
verses.translation: And the priest shall command to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֤ר הַֽחַיָּה֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת־עֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וְאֶת־שְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֶת־הָאֵזֹ֑ב וְטָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת  הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּ֗ה בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחֻטָ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'thtspr hchyh yqch 'th v't'ts h'rz v'tshny htvl't v'th'zb vtbl 'vtm v't  htspr hchyh bdm htspr hshchth 'l hmym hchyym
verses.translation: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar-wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן־הַצָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִ֣הֲר֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽחַיָּ֖ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhzh 'l hmthr mnhtsr't shb' p'mym vthrv vshlch 'thtspr hchyh 'lpny hshdh
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let go the living bird into the open field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִבֶּס֩ הַמִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת־בְּגָדָ֜יו וְגִלַּ֣ח אֶת־כׇּל־שְׂעָר֗וֹ וְרָחַ֤ץ בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָשַׁ֛ב מִח֥וּץ לְאׇהֳל֖וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhbs hmthr 'tbgdyv vglch 'tkhlsh'rv vrchts bmym vthr v'chr ybv' 'lhmchnh vyshb mchvts l'hlv shb't ymym
verses.translation: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water, and he shall be clean; and after that he may come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת־כׇּל־שְׂעָר֗וֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֤וֹ וְאֶת־זְקָנוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔יו וְאֶת־כׇּל־שְׂעָר֖וֹ יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְכִבֶּ֣ס אֶת־בְּגָדָ֗יו וְרָחַ֧ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hshby'y yglch 'tkhlsh'rv 'tr'shv v'tzqnv v't gbt 'ynyv v'tkhlsh'rv yglch vkhbs 'tbgdyv vrchts 'tbshrv bmym vthr
verses.translation: And it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off; and he shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִקַּ֤ח שְׁנֵֽי־כְבָשִׂים֙ תְּמִימִ֔ם וְכַבְשָׂ֥ה אַחַ֛ת בַּת־שְׁנָתָ֖הּ תְּמִימָ֑ה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְלֹ֥ג אֶחָ֖ד שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny yqch shnykhbshym tmymm vkhbshh 'cht btshnth tmymh vshlshh 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn vlg 'chd shmn
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs without blemish, and one ewe-lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱמִ֞יד הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽמְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְאֹתָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vh'myd hkhhn hmthr 't h'ysh hmthr v'tm lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the priest that cleanseth him shall set the man that is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֗ד וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛וֹ לְאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֥יף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 'thkhbsh h'chd vhqryb 'tv l'shm v'tlg hshmn vhnyf 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take one of the he-lambs, and offer him for a guilt-offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֶת־הַכֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠מְק֠וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת־הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֡י כַּ֠חַטָּ֠את הָאָשָׁ֥ם הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vshcht 'thkhbsh bmqvm 'shr yshcht 'thcht't v'th'lh bmqvm hqdsh khy khcht't h'shm hv' lkhhn qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: And he shall kill the he-lamb in the place where they kill the sin-offering and the burnt-offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin-offering is the priest’s, so is the guilt-offering; it is most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵן֮ מִדַּ֣ם הָאָשָׁם֒ וְנָתַן֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַל־תְּנ֛וּךְ אֹ֥זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm h'shm vntn hkhhn 'ltnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'lbhn ydv hymnyt v'lbhn rglv hymnyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the guilt-offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מִלֹּ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְיָצַ֛ק עַל־כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mlg hshmn vytsq 'lkhf hkhhn hshm'lyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטָבַ֤ל הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־אֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־הַשֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtbl hkhhn 't'tsb'v hymnyt mnhshmn 'shr 'lkhpv hshm'lyt vhzh mnhshmn b'tsb'v shb' p'mym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִיֶּ֨תֶר הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כַּפּ֗וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַכֹּהֵן֙ עַל־תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַ֖ל דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vmytr hshmn 'shr 'lkhpv ytn hkhhn 'ltnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'lbhn ydv hymnyt v'lbhn rglv hymnyt 'l dm h'shm
verses.translation: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר בַּשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnvtr bshmn 'shr 'lkhf hkhhn ytn 'lr'sh hmthr vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַ֣חַטָּ֔את וְכִפֶּ֕ר עַל־הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִטֻּמְאָת֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shh hkhhn 'thcht't vkhpr 'lhmthr mtm'tv v'chr yshcht 'th'lh
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the sin-offering, and make atonement for him that is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱלָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vh'lh hkhhn 'th'lh v'thmnchh hmzbchh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn vthr {s}
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the burnt-offering and the meal-offering upon the altar; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־דַּ֣ל ה֗וּא וְאֵ֣ין יָדוֹ֮ מַשֶּׂ֒גֶת֒ וְ֠לָקַ֠ח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִתְנוּפָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְעִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן לְמִנְחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: v'mdl hv' v'yn ydv mshgt vlqch khbsh 'chd 'shm ltnvph lkhpr 'lyv v'shrvn slt 'chd blvl bshmn lmnchh vlg shmn
verses.translation: And if he be poor, and his means suffice not, then he shall take one he-lamb for a guilt-offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering, and a log of oil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה אֶחָד֙ חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshty trym 'v shny bny yvnh 'shr tshyg ydv vhyh 'chd cht't vh'chd 'lh
verses.translation: and two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, such as his means suffice for; and the one shall be a sin-offering, and the other a burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜ם בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י לְטׇהֳרָת֖וֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhby' 'tm byvm hshmyny lthrtv 'lhkhhn 'lptch 'hlmv'd lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tent of meeting, before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֨יף אֹתָ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 'tkhbsh h'shm v'tlg hshmn vhnyf 'tm hkhhn tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take the lamb of the guilt-offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַט֮ אֶת־כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָֽאָשָׁם֒ וְלָקַ֤ח הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִדַּ֣ם הָֽאָשָׁ֔ם וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vshcht 'tkhbsh h'shm vlqch hkhhn mdm h'shm vntn 'ltnvkh 'znhmthr hymnyt v'lbhn ydv hymnyt v'lbhn rglv hymnyt
verses.translation: And he shall kill the lamb of the guilt-offering, and the priest shall take of the blood of the guilt-offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יִצֹ֣ק הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃
verses.translit: vmnhshmn ytsq hkhhn 'lkhf hkhhn hshm'lyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhzh hkhhn b'tsb'v hymnyt mnhshmn 'shr 'lkhpv hshm'lyt shb' p'mym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־הַשֶּׁ֣מֶן  אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כַּפּ֗וֹ עַל־תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַל־מְק֖וֹם דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vntn hkhhn mnhshmn  'shr 'lkhpv 'ltnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'lbhn ydv hymnyt v'lbhn rglv hymnyt 'lmqvm dm h'shm
verses.translation: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר מִן־הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnvtr mnhshmn 'shr 'lkhf hkhhn ytn 'lr'sh hmthr lkhpr 'lyv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־הָֽאֶחָד֙ מִן־הַתֹּרִ֔ים א֖וֹ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י הַיּוֹנָ֑ה מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shh 'th'chd mnhtrym 'v mnbny hyvnh m'shr tshyg ydv
verses.translation: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, such as his means suffice for;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־תַּשִּׂ֞יג יָד֗וֹ אֶת־הָאֶחָ֥ד חַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֥ד עֹלָ֖ה עַל־הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַ֥ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 't 'shrtshyg ydv 'th'chd cht't v'th'chd 'lh 'lhmnchh vkhpr hkhhn 'l hmthr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: even such as his means suffice for, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, with the meal-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֔ת אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־תַשִּׂ֥יג יָד֖וֹ בְּטׇהֳרָתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't tvrt 'shrbv ng' tsr't 'shr l'tshyg ydv bthrtv {p}
verses.translation: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose means suffice not for that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh v'l'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י תָבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה וְנָתַתִּי֙ נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת בְּבֵ֖ית אֶ֥רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy tb'v 'l'rts khn'n 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm l'chzh vntty ng' tsr't bbyt 'rts 'chztkhm
verses.translation: When ye are come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַבַּ֔יִת וְהִגִּ֥יד לַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּנֶ֕גַע נִרְאָ֥ה לִ֖י בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vb' 'shrlv hbyt vhgyd lkhhn l'mr khng' nr'h ly bbyt
verses.translation: then he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying: ‘There seemeth to me to be as it were a plague in the house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וּפִנּ֣וּ אֶת־הַבַּ֗יִת בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָבֹ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִרְא֣וֹת אֶת־הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹ֥א יִטְמָ֖א כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּבָּ֑יִת וְאַ֥חַר כֵּ֛ן יָבֹ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vpnv 'thbyt btrm yb' hkhhn lr'vt 'thng' vl' ytm' khl'shr bbyt v'chr khn yb' hkhhn lr'vt 'thbyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go in to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean; and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בְּקִירֹ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת שְׁקַֽעֲרוּרֹת֙ יְרַקְרַקֹּ֔ת א֖וֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּ֑ת וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֥ן שָׁפָ֖ל מִן־הַקִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: vr'h 'thng' vhnh hng' bqyrt hbyt shq'rvrt yrqrqt 'v 'dmdmt vmr'yhn shpl mnhqyr
verses.translation: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and the appearance thereof be lower than the wall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֧א הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מִן־הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־פֶּ֣תַח הַבָּ֑יִת וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyts' hkhhn mnhbyt 'lptch hbyt vhsgyr 'thbyt shb't ymym
verses.translation: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֥ב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בְּקִירֹ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vshb hkhhn byvm hshby'y vr'h vhnh pshh hng' bqyrt hbyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְחִלְּצוּ֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֲבָנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִשְׁלִ֤יכוּ אֶתְהֶן֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vchltsv 'th'bnym 'shr bhn hng' vhshlykhv 'thn 'lmchvts l'yr 'lmqvm tm'
verses.translation: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which the plague is, and cast them into an unclean place without the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַבַּ֛יִת יַקְצִ֥עַ מִבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֑יב וְשָׁפְכ֗וּ אֶת־הֶֽעָפָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְצ֔וּ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃
verses.translit: v'thbyt yqts' mbyt sbyb vshpkhv 'th'pr 'shr hqtsv 'lmchvts l'yr 'lmqvm tm'
verses.translation: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקְחוּ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים אֲחֵר֔וֹת וְהֵבִ֖יאוּ אֶל־תַּ֣חַת הָאֲבָנִ֑ים וְעָפָ֥ר אַחֵ֛ר יִקַּ֖ח וְטָ֥ח אֶת־הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vlqchv 'bnym 'chrvt vhby'v 'ltcht h'bnym v'pr 'chr yqch vtch 'thbyt
verses.translation: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־יָשׁ֤וּב הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ וּפָרַ֣ח בַּבַּ֔יִת אַחַ֖ר חִלֵּ֣ץ אֶת־הָאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵ֛י הִקְצ֥וֹת אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת וְאַחֲרֵ֥י הִטּֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: v'myshvb hng' vprch bbyt 'chr chlts 'th'bnym v'chry hqtsvt 'thbyt v'chry htvch
verses.translation: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that the stones have been taken out, and after the house hath been scraped, and after it is plastered;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בַּבָּ֑יִת צָרַ֨עַת מַמְאֶ֥רֶת הִ֛וא בַּבַּ֖יִת טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vb' hkhhn vr'h vhnh pshh hng' bbyt tsr't mm'rt hv' bbyt tm' hv'
verses.translation: then the priest shall come in and look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a malignant leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ץ אֶת־הַבַּ֗יִת אֶת־אֲבָנָיו֙ וְאֶת־עֵצָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־עֲפַ֣ר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהוֹצִיא֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vntts 'thbyt 't'bnyv v't'tsyv v't khl'pr hbyt vhvtsy' 'lmchvts l'yr 'lmqvm tm'
verses.translation: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבָּא֙ אֶל־הַבַּ֔יִת כׇּל־יְמֵ֖י הִסְגִּ֣יר אֹת֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vhb' 'lhbyt khlymy hsgyr 'tv ytm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשֹּׁכֵ֣ב בַּבַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת־בְּגָדָ֑יו וְהָאֹכֵ֣ל בַּבַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת־בְּגָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhshkhb bbyt ykhbs 'tbgdyv vh'khl bbyt ykhbs 'tbgdyv
verses.translation: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בֹּ֨א יָבֹ֜א הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָאָה֙ וְ֠הִנֵּ֠ה לֹא־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת אַחֲרֵ֖י הִטֹּ֣חַ אֶת־הַבָּ֑יִת וְטִהַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת כִּ֥י נִרְפָּ֖א הַנָּֽגַע׃
verses.translit: v'mb' yb' hkhhn vr'h vhnh l'pshh hng' bbyt 'chry htch 'thbyt vthr hkhhn 'thbyt khy nrp' hng'
verses.translation: And if the priest shall come in, and look, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered; then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֛ח לְחַטֵּ֥א אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת שְׁתֵּ֣י צִפֳּרִ֑ים וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vlqch lcht' 'thbyt shty tsprym v'ts 'rz vshny tvl't v'zb
verses.translation: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar-wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־כְּלִי־חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vshcht 'thtspr h'cht 'lkhlychrsh 'lmym chyym
verses.translation: And he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח אֶת־עֵֽץ־הָ֠אֶ֠רֶז וְאֶת־הָ֨אֵזֹ֜ב וְאֵ֣ת  שְׁנִ֣י הַתּוֹלַ֗עַת וְאֵת֮ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּה֒ וְטָבַ֣ל אֹתָ֗ם בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחוּטָ֔ה וּבַמַּ֖יִם הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וְהִזָּ֥ה אֶל־הַבַּ֖יִת שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vlqch 't'tsh'rz v'th'zb v't  shny htvl't v't htspr hchyh vtbl 'tm bdm htspr hshchvth vbmym hchyym vhzh 'lhbyt shb' p'mym
verses.translation: And he shall take the cedar-wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִטֵּ֣א אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפּ֔וֹר וּבַמַּ֖יִם הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וּבַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַחַיָּ֗ה וּבְעֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וּבָאֵזֹ֖ב וּבִשְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: vcht' 'thbyt bdm htspvr vbmym hchyym vbtspr hchyh vb'ts h'rz vb'zb vbshny htvl't
verses.translation: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar-wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֞ח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֧ר הַֽחַיָּ֛ה אֶל־מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עַל־הַבַּ֖יִת וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vshlch 'thtspr hchyh 'lmchvts l'yr 'lpny hshdh vkhpr 'lhbyt vthr
verses.translation: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open field; so shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה לְכׇל־נֶ֥גַע הַצָּרַ֖עַת וְלַנָּֽתֶק׃
verses.translit: z't htvrh lkhlng' htsr't vlntq
verses.translation: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and for a scall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְצָרַ֥עַת הַבֶּ֖גֶד וְלַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vltsr't hbgd vlbyt
verses.translation: and for the leprosy of a garment, and for a house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַשְׂאֵ֥ת וְלַסַּפַּ֖חַת וְלַבֶּהָֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vlsh't vlspcht vlbhrt
verses.translation: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהוֹרֹ֕ת בְּי֥וֹם הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבְי֣וֹם הַטָּהֹ֑ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַצָּרָֽעַת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lhvrt byvm htm' vbyvm hthr z't tvrt htsr't {p}
verses.translation: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean; this is the law of leprosy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh v'l'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and to Aaron, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ זוֹב֖וֹ טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: dbrv 'lbny yshr'l v'mrtm 'lhm 'ysh 'ysh khy yhyh zb mbshrv zvbv tm' hv'
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, his issue is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָת֖וֹ בְּזוֹב֑וֹ רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת־זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ־הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ טֻמְאָת֖וֹ הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vz't thyh tm'tv bzvbv rr bshrv 'tzvbv 'vhchtym bshrv mzvbv tm'tv hv'
verses.translation: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכׇֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.translit: khlhmshkhb 'shr yshkhb 'lyv hzb ytm' vkhlhkhly 'shryshb 'lyv ytm'
verses.translation: Every bed whereon he that hath the issue lieth shall be unclean; and every thing whereon he sitteth shall be unclean. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yg' bmshkhbv ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vhyshb 'lhkhly 'shryshb 'lyv hzb ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vhng' bbshr hzb ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָרֹ֥ק הַזָּ֖ב בַּטָּה֑וֹר וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhyyrq hzb bthvr vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.translit: vkhlhmrkhb 'shr yrkhb 'lyv hzb ytm'
verses.translation: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhlhng' bkhl 'shr yhyh tchtyv ytm' 'dh'rb vhnvsh' 'vtm ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even; and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע־בּוֹ֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא־שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr yg'bv hzb vydyv l'shtf bmym vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And whomsoever he that hath the issue toucheth, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע־בּ֥וֹ הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכׇ֨ל־כְּלִי־עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vkhlychrsh 'shryg'bv hzb yshbr vkhlkhly'ts yshtf bmym
verses.translation: And the earthen vessel, which he that hath the issue toucheth, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטׇהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhyythr hzb mzvbv vspr lv shb't ymym lthrtv vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bshrv bmym chyym vthr
verses.translation: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue, then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח־לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א  לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny yqchlv shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh vb'  lpny yhvh 'lptch 'hl mv'd vntnm 'lhkhhn
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shh 'tm hkhhn 'chd cht't vh'chd 'lh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn lpny yhvh mzvbv {s}
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־כׇּל־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khytts' mmnv shkhbtzr' vrchts bmym 'tkhlbshrv vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And if the flow of seed go out from a man, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־בֶּ֣גֶד וְכׇל־ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhlbgd vkhl'vr 'shryhyh 'lyv shkhbtzr' vkhbs bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the flow of seed, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'shh 'shr yshkhb 'ysh 'th shkhbtzr' vrchtsv bmym vtm'v 'dh'rb {p}
verses.translation: The woman also with whom a man shall lie carnally, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי־תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכׇל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'shh khythyh zbh dm yhyh zbh bbshrh shb't ymym thyh bndth vkhlhng' bh ytm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days; and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr tshkhb 'lyv bndth ytm' vkhl 'shrtshb 'lyv ytm'
verses.translation: And every thing that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean; every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhlhng' bmshkhbh ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇ֨ל־הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכׇל־כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhlhng' bkhlkhly 'shrtshb 'lyv ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־עָלָ֖יו בְּנׇגְעוֹ־ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'm 'lhmshkhb hv' 'v 'lhkhly 'shrhv' yshbt'lyv bng'vbv ytm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And if he be on the bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכׇל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'm shkhb yshkhb 'ysh 'th vthy ndth 'lyv vtm' shb't ymym vkhlhmshkhb 'shryshkhb 'lyv ytm' {s}
verses.translation: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי־תָז֖וּב עַל־נִדָּתָ֑הּ כׇּל־יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: v'shh khyyzvb zvb dmh ymym rbym bl' 'tndth 'v khytzvb 'lndth khlymy zvb tm'th khymy ndth thyh tm'h hv'
verses.translation: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑הּ וְכׇֽל־הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khlhmshkhb 'shrtshkhb 'lyv khlymy zvbh khmshkhb ndth yhyhlh vkhlhkhly 'shr tshb 'lyv tm' yhyh khtm't ndth
verses.translation: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity; and every thing whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vkhlhnvg' bm ytm' vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִֽם־טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'mthrh mzvbh vsprh lh shb't ymym v'chr tthr
verses.translation: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח־לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny tqchlh shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh vhby'h 'vtm 'lhkhhn 'lptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה מִזּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'shh hkhhn 'th'chd cht't v'th'chd 'lh vkhpr 'lyh hkhhn lpny yhvh mzvb tm'th
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֙תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhzrtm 'tbnyyshr'l mtm'tm vl' ymtv btm'tm btm'm 'tmshkhny 'shr btvkhm
verses.translation: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile My tabernacle that is in the midst of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֖רַע לְטׇמְאָה־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: z't tvrt hzb v'shr tts' mmnv shkhbtzr' ltm'hbh
verses.translation: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him from whom the flow of seed goeth out, so that he is unclean thereby;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת־זוֹב֔וֹ לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם־טְמֵאָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhdvh bndth vhzb 'tzvbv lzkhr vlnqbh vl'ysh 'shr yshkhb 'mtm'h {p}
verses.translation: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of them that have an issue, whether it be a man, or a woman; and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּקׇרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵי־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh 'chry mvt shny bny 'hrn bqrbtm lpnyyhvh vymtv
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before the LORD, and died;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֒יךָ֒ וְאַל־יָבֹ֤א בְכׇל־עֵת֙ אֶל־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַכַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל־הָאָרֹן֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת כִּ֚י בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן אֵרָאֶ֖ה עַל־הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh dbr 'l'hrn 'chykh v'lyb' bkhl't 'lhqdsh mbyt lprkht 'lpny hkhprt 'shr 'lh'rn vl' ymvt khy b'nn 'r'h 'lhkhprt
verses.translation: and the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the ark-cover which is upon the ark; that he die not; for I appear in the cloud upon the ark-cover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּזֹ֛את יָבֹ֥א אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּפַ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר לְחַטָּ֖את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: bz't yb' 'hrn 'lhqdsh bpr bnbqr lcht't v'yl l'lh
verses.translation: Herewith shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּתֹֽנֶת־בַּ֨ד קֹ֜דֶשׁ יִלְבָּ֗שׁ וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־בַד֮ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וּבְאַבְנֵ֥ט בַּד֙ יַחְגֹּ֔ר וּבְמִצְנֶ֥פֶת בַּ֖ד יִצְנֹ֑ף בִּגְדֵי־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔ם וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וּלְבֵשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: khtntbd qdsh ylbsh vmkhnsybd yhyv 'lbshrv vb'bnt bd ychgr vbmtsnpt bd ytsnf bgdyqdsh hm vrchts bmym 'tbshrv vlbshm
verses.translation: He shall put on the holy linen tunic, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired; they are the holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵאֵ֗ת עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִקַּ֛ח שְׁנֵֽי־שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַ֥יִל אֶחָ֖ד לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vm't 'dt bny yshr'l yqch shnysh'yry 'zym lcht't v'yl 'chd l'lh
verses.translation: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־פַּ֥ר הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhqryb 'hrn 'tpr hcht't 'shrlv vkhpr b'dv vb'd bytv
verses.translation: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֖ח אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י הַשְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vlqch 'tshny hsh'yrm vh'myd 'tm lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׂעִירִ֖ם גֹּרָל֑וֹת גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְגוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַעֲזָאזֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vntn 'hrn 'lshny hsh'yrm grlvt gvrl 'chd lyhvh vgvrl 'chd l'z'zl
verses.translation: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for Azazel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛יו הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֖הוּ חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vhqryb 'hrn 'thsh'yr 'shr 'lh 'lyv hgvrl lyhvh v'shhv cht't
verses.translation: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤יו הַגּוֹרָל֙ לַעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יׇֽעֳמַד־חַ֛י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו לְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֹת֛וֹ לַעֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃
verses.translit: vhsh'yr 'shr 'lh 'lyv hgvrl l'z'zl y'mdchy lpny yhvh lkhpr 'lyv lshlch 'tv l'z'zl hmdbrh
verses.translation: But the goat, on which the lot fell for Azazel, shall be set alive before the LORD, to make atonement over him, to send him away for Azazel into the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־פַּ֤ר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֑וֹ וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhqryb 'hrn 'tpr hcht't 'shrlv vkhpr b'dv vb'd bytv vshcht 'tpr hcht't 'shrlv
verses.translation: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא־הַ֠מַּחְתָּ֠ה גַּֽחֲלֵי־אֵ֞שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמְלֹ֣א חׇפְנָ֔יו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְהֵבִ֖יא מִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: vlqch ml'hmchth gchly'sh m'l hmzbch mlpny yhvh vml' chpnyv qtrt smym dqh vhby' mbyt lprkht
verses.translation: And he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֧ן אֶֽת־הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל־הָאֵ֖שׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכִסָּ֣ה  עֲנַ֣ן הַקְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָעֵד֖וּת וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vntn 'thqtrt 'lh'sh lpny yhvh vkhsh  'nn hqtrt 'thkhprt 'shr 'lh'dvt vl' ymvt
verses.translation: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the ark-cover that is upon the testimony, that he die not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַח֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֧ה בְאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָה וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע־פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן־הַדָּ֖ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vlqch mdm hpr vhzh b'tsb'v 'lpny hkhprt qdmh vlpny hkhprt yzh shb'p'mym mnhdm b'tsb'v
verses.translation: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the ark-cover on the east; and before the ark-cover shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֞ט אֶת־שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וְהֵבִיא֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ אֶל־מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶת־דָּמ֗וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְדַ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vshcht 'tsh'yr hcht't 'shr l'm vhby' 'tdmv 'lmbyt lprkht v'shh 'tdmv kh'shr 'shh ldm hpr vhzh 'tv 'lhkhprt vlpny hkhprt
verses.translation: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin-offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the ark-cover, and before the ark-cover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַל־הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכׇל־חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְכֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַשֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhpr 'lhqdsh mtm't bny yshr'l vmpsh'yhm lkhlcht'tm vkhn y'shh l'hl mv'd hshkhn 'tm btvkh tm'tm
verses.translation: And he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so shall he do for the tent of meeting, that dwelleth with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־אָדָ֞ם לֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה  בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד בְּבֹא֛וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד־צֵאת֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲדוֹ֙ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֔וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כׇּל־קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vkhl'dm l'yhyh  b'hl mv'd bb'v lkhpr bqdsh 'dts'tv vkhpr b'dv vb'd bytv vb'd khlqhl yshr'l
verses.translation: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֗א אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵֽי־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְלָקַ֞ח מִדַּ֤ם הַפָּר֙ וּמִדַּ֣ם הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־קַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lhmzbch 'shr lpnyyhvh vkhpr 'lyv vlqch mdm hpr vmdm hsh'yr vntn 'lqrnvt hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧יו מִן־הַדָּ֛ם בְּאֶצְבָּע֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִהֲר֣וֹ וְקִדְּשׁ֔וֹ מִטֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhzh 'lyv mnhdm b'tsb'v shb' p'mym vthrv vqdshv mtm't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִלָּה֙ מִכַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְהִקְרִ֖יב אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֥יר הֶחָֽי׃
verses.translit: vkhlh mkhpr 'thqdsh v't'hl mv'd v'thmzbch vhqryb 'thsh'yr hchy
verses.translation: And when he hath made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֗ו עַ֣ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר֮ הַחַי֒ וְהִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗יו אֶת־כׇּל־עֲוֺנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־כׇּל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכׇל־חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְנָתַ֤ן אֹתָם֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשִׁלַּ֛ח בְּיַד־אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃
verses.translit: vsmkh 'hrn 'tshty ydv 'l r'sh hsh'yr hchy vhtvdh 'lyv 'tkhl'vnt bny yshr'l v'tkhlpsh'yhm lkhlcht'tm vntn 'tm 'lr'sh hsh'yr vshlch byd'ysh 'ty hmdbrh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of an appointed man into the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֨א הַשָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אֶת־כׇּל־עֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֖יר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vnsh' hsh'yr 'lyv 'tkhl'vntm 'l'rts gzrh vshlch 'thsh'yr bmdbr
verses.translation: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land which is cut off; and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֤א אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבַ֖שׁ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vb' 'hrn 'l'hl mv'd vpsht 'tbgdy hbd 'shr lbsh bb'v 'lhqdsh vhnychm shm
verses.translation: And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָחַ֨ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֤וֹ בַמַּ֙יִם֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָד֔וֹשׁ וְלָבַ֖שׁ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֑יו וְיָצָ֗א וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־עֹלַ֣ת הָעָ֔ם וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vrchts 'tbshrv bmym bmqvm qdvsh vlbsh 'tbgdyv vyts' v'shh 't'ltv v't'lt h'm vkhpr b'dv vb'd h'm
verses.translation: And he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place and put on his other vestments, and come forth, and offer his burnt-offering and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת חֵ֥לֶב הַֽחַטָּ֖את יַקְטִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.translit: v't chlb hcht't yqtyr hmzbchh
verses.translation: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he make smoke upon the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֤חַ אֶת־הַשָּׂעִיר֙ לַֽעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhmshlch 'thsh'yr l'z'zl ykhbs bgdyv vrchts 'tbshrv bmym v'chrykhn ybv' 'lhmchnh
verses.translation: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ פַּ֨ר הַֽחַטָּ֜את וְאֵ֣ת  שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽחַטָּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּבָ֤א אֶת־דָּמָם֙ לְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יוֹצִ֖יא אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְשָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ אֶת־עֹרֹתָ֥ם וְאֶת־בְּשָׂרָ֖ם וְאֶת־פִּרְשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: v't pr hcht't v't  sh'yr hcht't 'shr hvb' 'tdmm lkhpr bqdsh yvtsy' 'lmchvts lmchnh vshrpv b'sh 't'rtm v'tbshrm v'tprshm
verses.translation: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhshrf 'tm ykhbs bgdyv vrchts 'tbshrv bmym v'chrykhn ybv' 'lhmchnh
verses.translation: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִ֠י בֶּֽעָשׂ֨וֹר לַחֹ֜דֶשׁ תְּעַנּ֣וּ אֶת־נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֗ם וְכׇל־מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyth lkhm lchqt 'vlm bchdsh hshby'y b'shvr lchdsh t'nv 'tnpshtykhm vkhlml'khh l' t'shv h'zrch vhgr hgr btvkhkhm
verses.translation: And it shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and shall do no manner of work, the home-born, or the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה יְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְטַהֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם מִכֹּל֙ חַטֹּ֣אתֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה תִּטְהָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: khybyvm hzh ykhpr 'lykhm lthr 'tkhm mkhl cht'tykhm lpny yhvh tthrv
verses.translation: For on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הִיא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֖ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: shbt shbtvn hy' lkhm v'nytm 'tnpshtykhm chqt 'vlm
verses.translation: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲשֶׁר־יִמְשַׁ֣ח אֹת֗וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יְמַלֵּא֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ לְכַהֵ֖ן תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑יו וְלָבַ֛שׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד בִּגְדֵ֥י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vkhpr hkhhn 'shrymshch 'tv v'shr yml' 'tydv lkhhn tcht 'byv vlbsh 'tbgdy hbd bgdy hqdsh
verses.translation: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר֙ אֶת־מִקְדַּ֣שׁ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יְכַפֵּ֑ר וְעַ֧ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְעַל־כׇּל־עַ֥ם הַקָּהָ֖ל יְכַפֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhpr 'tmqdsh hqdsh v't'hl mv'd v'thmzbch ykhpr v'l hkhhnym v'lkhl'm hqhl ykhpr
verses.translation: And he shall make atonement for the most holy place, and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽיְתָה־זֹּ֨את לָכֶ֜ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֗ם לְכַפֵּ֞ר עַל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִכׇּל־חַטֹּאתָ֔ם אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhythz't lkhm lchqt 'vlm lkhpr 'lbny yshr'l mkhlcht'tm 'cht bshnh vy'sh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year.’ And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כׇּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn v'lbnyv v'l khlbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lyhm zh hdbr 'shrtsvh yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֜ט שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ־כֶ֛שֶׂב אוֹ־עֵ֖ז בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה א֚וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁחַ֔ט מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l 'shr yshcht shvr 'vkhshb 'v'z bmchnh 'v 'shr yshcht mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לֹ֣א הֱבִיאוֹ֒ לְהַקְרִ֤יב קׇרְבָּן֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֑ה דָּ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֞ב לָאִ֤ישׁ הַהוּא֙ דָּ֣ם שָׁפָ֔ךְ וְנִכְרַ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lptch 'hl mv'd l' hby'v lhqryb qrbn lyhvh lpny mshkhn yhvh dm ychshb l'ysh hhv' dm shpkh vnkhrt h'ysh hhv' mqrb 'mv
verses.translation: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to present it as an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD, blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֩עַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶֽת־זִבְחֵיהֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֣ם זֹבְחִים֮ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶה֒ וֶֽהֱבִיאֻ֣ם לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְזָ֨בְח֜וּ זִבְחֵ֧י שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: lm'n 'shr yby'v bny yshr'l 'tzbchyhm 'shr hm zbchym 'lpny hshdh vhby'm lyhvh 'lptch 'hl mv'd 'lhkhhn vzbchv zbchy shlmym lyhvh 'vtm
