verses.translation: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָרַ֨ק הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־הַדָּם֙ עַל־מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַחֵ֔לֶב לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vzrq hkhhn 'thdm 'lmzbch yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd vhqtyr hchlb lrych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall dash the blood against the altar of the LORD at the door of the tent of meeting, and make the fat smoke for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִזְבְּח֥וּ עוֹד֙ אֶת־זִבְחֵיהֶ֔ם לַשְּׂעִירִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶה־זֹּ֥את לָהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vl'yzbchv 'vd 'tzbchyhm lsh'yrm 'shr hm znym 'chryhm chqt 'vlm thyhz't lhm ldrtm
verses.translation: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the satyrs, after whom they go astray. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲלֵהֶ֣ם תֹּאמַ֔ר אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־יָג֣וּר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲלֶ֥ה עֹלָ֖ה אוֹ־זָֽבַח׃
verses.translit: v'lhm t'mr 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmnhgr 'shrygvr btvkhm 'shry'lh 'lh 'vzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them: Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לֹ֣א יְבִיאֶ֔נּוּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹת֖וֹ לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְנִכְרַ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא מֵעַמָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'lptch 'hl mv'd l' yby'nv l'shvt 'tv lyhvh vnkhrt h'ysh hhv' m'myv
verses.translation: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto the LORD, even that man shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמִן־הַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאכַ֖ל כׇּל־דָּ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֣י פָנַ֗י בַּנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ הָאֹכֶ֣לֶת אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmnhgr hgr btvkhm 'shr y'khl khldm vntty pny bnpsh h'khlt 'thdm vhkhrty 'th mqrb 'mh
verses.translation: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set My face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר֮ בַּדָּ֣ם הִוא֒ וַאֲנִ֞י נְתַתִּ֤יו לָכֶם֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־הַדָּ֥ם ה֖וּא בַּנֶּ֥פֶשׁ יְכַפֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: khy npsh hbshr bdm hv' v'ny nttyv lkhm 'lhmzbch lkhpr 'lnpshtykhm khyhdm hv' bnpsh ykhpr
verses.translation: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֤ן אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כׇּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ מִכֶּ֖ם לֹא־תֹ֣אכַל דָּ֑ם וְהַגֵּ֛ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶ֖ם לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל דָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'mrty lbny yshr'l khlnpsh mkhm l't'khl dm vhgr hgr btvkhkhm l'y'khl dm
verses.translation: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel: No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמִן־הַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצ֜וּד צֵ֥יד חַיָּ֛ה אוֹ־ע֖וֹף אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֑ל וְשָׁפַךְ֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ וְכִסָּ֖הוּ בֶּעָפָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'ysh mbny yshr'l vmnhgr hgr btvkhm 'shr ytsvd tsyd chyh 'v'vf 'shr y'khl vshpkh 'tdmv vkhshv b'pr
verses.translation: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that taketh in hunting any beast or fowl that may be eaten, he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נֶ֣פֶשׁ כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֗ר דָּמ֣וֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ֮ הוּא֒ וָֽאֹמַר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּ֥ם כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֖ר לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ כִּ֣י נֶ֤פֶשׁ כׇּל־בָּשָׂר֙ דָּמ֣וֹ הִ֔וא כׇּל־אֹכְלָ֖יו יִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.translit: khynpsh khlbshr dmv bnpshv hv' v'mr lbny yshr'l dm khlbshr l' t'khlv khy npsh khlbshr dmv hv' khl'khlyv ykhrt
verses.translation: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is all one with the life thereof; therefore I said unto the children of Israel: Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof; whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֤ל נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה בָּאֶזְרָ֖ח וּבַגֵּ֑ר וְכִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhlnpsh 'shr t'khl nblh vtrph b'zrch vbgr vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'dh'rb vthr
verses.translation: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a stranger, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even; then shall he be clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַבֵּ֔ס וּבְשָׂר֖וֹ לֹ֣א יִרְחָ֑ץ וְנָשָׂ֖א עֲוֺנֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'm l' ykhbs vbshrv l' yrchts vnsh' 'vnv {p}
verses.translation: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֧ה אֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּם־בָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶתְכֶ֥ם שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: khm'shh 'rtsmtsrym 'shr yshbtmbh l' t'shv vkhm'shh 'rtskhn'n 'shr 'ny mby' 'tkhm shmh l' t'shv vbchqtyhm l' tlkhv
verses.translation: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do; and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֧י תַּעֲשׂ֛וּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'tmshpty t'shv v'tchqty tshmrv llkht bhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and My statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tchqty v'tmshpty 'shr y'shh 'tm h'dm vchy bhm 'ny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore keep My statutes, and Mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live by them: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אֶל־כׇּל־שְׁאֵ֣ר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִקְרְב֖וּ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָ֑ה אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ysh 'lkhlsh'r bshrv l' tqrbv lglvt 'rvh 'ny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness. I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛יךָ וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'bykh v'rvt 'mkh l' tglh 'mkh hv' l' tglh 'rvth {s}
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy father, and the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'sht'bykh l' tglh 'rvt 'bykh hv' {s}
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲחֽוֹתְךָ֤ בַת־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת בַּ֔יִת א֖וֹ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת ח֑וּץ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chvtkh bt'bykh 'v bt'mkh mvldt byt 'v mvldt chvts l' tglh 'rvtn {s}
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֤ת בַּת־בִּנְךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַֽת־בִּתְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָ֑ן כִּ֥י עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ הֵֽנָּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt btbnkh 'v btbtkh l' tglh 'rvtn khy 'rvtkh hnh {s}
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover; for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת בַּת־אֵ֤שֶׁת אָבִ֙יךָ֙ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת אָבִ֔יךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ֖ הִ֑וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt bt'sht 'bykh mvldt 'bykh 'chvtkh hv' l' tglh 'rvth {s}
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחוֹת־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה שְׁאֵ֥ר אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chvt'bykh l' tglh sh'r 'bykh hv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחֽוֹת־אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּֽי־שְׁאֵ֥ר אִמְּךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chvt'mkh l' tglh khysh'r 'mkh hv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister; for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחִֽי־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְרָ֔ב דֹּדָֽתְךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chy'bykh l' tglh 'l'shtv l' tqrb ddtkh hv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy fathers brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת כַּלָּֽתְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֵ֤שֶׁת בִּנְךָ֙ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt khltkh l' tglh 'sht bnkh hv' l' tglh 'rvth {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־אָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rvt 'sht'chykh l' tglh 'rvt 'chykh hv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אִשָּׁ֛ה וּבִתָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶֽת־בַּת־בְּנָ֞הּ וְאֶת־בַּת־בִּתָּ֗הּ לֹ֤א תִקַּח֙ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֔הּ שַׁאֲרָ֥ה הֵ֖נָּה זִמָּ֥ה הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: 'rvt 'shh vbth l' tglh 'tbtbnh v'tbtbth l' tqch lglvt 'rvth sh'rh hnh zmh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness: they are near kinswomen; it is lewdness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח לִצְרֹ֗ר לְגַלּ֧וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֛הּ עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּחַיֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'shh 'l'chth l' tqch ltsrr lglvt 'rvth 'lyh bchyyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt not take a woman to her sister, to be a rival to her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her lifetime.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּנִדַּ֣ת טֻמְאָתָ֑הּ לֹ֣א תִקְרַ֔ב לְגַלּ֖וֹת עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'l'shh bndt tm'th l' tqrb lglvt 'rvth
verses.translation: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־אֵ֙שֶׁת֙ עֲמִֽיתְךָ֔ לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכׇבְתְּךָ֖ לְזָ֑רַע לְטׇמְאָה־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'l'sht 'mytkh l'ttn shkhbtkh lzr' ltm'hbh
verses.translation: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֥ לֹא־תִתֵּ֖ן לְהַעֲבִ֣יר לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֧א תְחַלֵּ֛ל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmzr'kh l'ttn lh'byr lmlkh vl' tchll 'tshm 'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to set them apart to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶ֨ת־זָכָ֔ר לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֑ה תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: v'tzkhr l' tshkhb mshkhby 'shh tv'bh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind; it is abomination.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־בְּהֵמָ֛ה לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכׇבְתְּךָ֖ לְטׇמְאָה־בָ֑הּ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה לֹֽא־תַעֲמֹ֞ד לִפְנֵ֧י בְהֵמָ֛ה לְרִבְעָ֖הּ תֶּ֥בֶל הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vbkhlbhmh l'ttn shkhbtkh ltm'hbh v'shh l't'md lpny bhmh lrb'h tbl hv'
verses.translation: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto; it is perversion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בְּכׇל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֤י בְכׇל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ נִטְמְא֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lttm'v bkhl'lh khy bkhl'lh ntm'v hgvym 'shr'ny mshlch mpnykhm
verses.translation: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations are defiled, which I cast out from before you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּטְמָ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֶפְקֹ֥ד עֲוֺנָ֖הּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַתָּקִ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vttm' h'rts v'pqd 'vnh 'lyh vtq' h'rts 'tyshbyh
verses.translation: And the land was defiled, therefore I did visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אַתֶּ֗ם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tm 'tchqty v'tmshpty vl' t'shv mkhl htv'bt h'lh h'zrch vhgr hgr btvkhkhm
verses.translation: Ye therefore shall keep My statutes and Mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י אֶת־כׇּל־הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔ל עָשׂ֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַתִּטְמָ֖א הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khy 'tkhlhtv'bt h'l 'shv 'nshyh'rts 'shr lpnykhm vttm' h'rts
verses.translation: for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־תָקִ֤יא הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּטַֽמַּאֲכֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָאָ֛ה אֶת־הַגּ֖וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vl'tqy' h'rts 'tkhm btm'khm 'th kh'shr q'h 'thgvy 'shr lpnykhm
verses.translation: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְנִכְרְת֛וּ הַנְּפָשׁ֥וֹת הָעֹשֹׂ֖ת מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy khl'shr y'shh mkhl htv'bt h'lh vnkhrtv hnpshvt h'sht mqrb 'mm
verses.translation: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י לְבִלְתִּ֨י עֲשׂ֜וֹת מֵחֻקּ֤וֹת הַתּֽוֹעֵבֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשׂ֣וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tmshmrty lblty 'shvt mchqvt htv'bt 'shr n'shv lpnykhm vl' ttm'v bhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm {p}
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye keep My charge, that ye do not any of these abominable customs, which were done before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־כׇּל־עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵהֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּהְי֑וּ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lkhl'dt bnyyshr'l v'mrt 'lhm qdshym thyv khy qdvsh 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them: Ye shall be holy; for I the LORD your God am holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אִמּ֤וֹ וְאָבִיו֙ תִּירָ֔אוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'mv v'byv tyr'v v'tshbtty tshmrv 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and ye shall keep My sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלִילִ֔ם וֵֽאלֹהֵי֙ מַסֵּכָ֔ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltpnv 'lh'lylm v'lhy mskhh l' t'shv lkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Turn ye not unto the idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהֹוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhy tzbchv zbch shlmym lyhvh lrtsnkhm tzbchhv
verses.translation: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֧וֹם זִבְחֲכֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּמִֽמׇּחֳרָ֑ת וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ עַד־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.translit: byvm zbchkhm y'khl vmmchrt vhnvtr 'dyvm hshlyshy b'sh yshrf
verses.translation: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow; and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'm h'khl y'khl byvm hshlyshy pgvl hv' l' yrtsh
verses.translation: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is a vile thing; it shall not be accepted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֹֽכְלָיו֙ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי־אֶת־קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהֹוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'khlyv 'vnv ysh' khy'tqdsh yhvh chll vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh
verses.translation: But every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם֙ אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְךָ֖ לִקְצֹ֑ר וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט׃
verses.translit: vbqtsrkhm 'tqtsyr 'rtskhm l' tkhlh p't shdkh lqtsr vlqt qtsyrkh l' tlqt
verses.translation: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corner of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַרְמְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּפֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhrmkh l' t'vll vprt khrmkh l' tlqt l'ny vlgr t'zb 'tm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְלֹא־תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l' tgnbv vl'tkhchshv vl'tshqrv 'ysh b'mytv
verses.translation: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'tshb'v bshmy lshqr vchllt 'tshm 'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall not swear by My name falsely, so that thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת־רֵֽעֲךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא־תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: l't'shq 'tr'kh vl' tgzl l'tlyn p'lt shkhyr 'tkh 'dbqr
verses.translation: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbour, nor rob him; the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְלִפְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'tqll chrsh vlpny 'vr l' ttn mkhshl vyr't m'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling-block before the blind, but thou shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֙וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: l't'shv 'vl bmshpt l'tsh' pnydl vl' thdr pny gdvl btsdq tshpt 'mytkh
verses.translation: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment; thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor favour the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'tlkh rkhyl b'mykh l' t'md 'ldm r'kh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people; neither shalt thou stand idly by the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֙יחַ֙ אֶת־עֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖יו חֵֽטְא׃
verses.translit: l'tshn' 't'chykh blbbkh hvkhch tvkhych 't'mytkh vl'tsh' 'lyv cht'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart; thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbour, and not bear sin because of him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'tqm vl'ttr 'tbny 'mkh v'hbt lr'kh khmvkh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽת־חֻקֹּתַי֮ תִּשְׁמֹ֒רוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְךָ֖ לֹא־תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּבֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֙יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'tchqty tshmrv bhmtkh l'trby' khl'ym shdkh l'tzr' khl'ym vbgd khl'ym sh'tnz l' y'lh 'lykh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep My statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind; thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed; neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אִ֠ישׁ כִּֽי־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ וְהׇפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖הֿ לֹ֣א נִתַּן־לָ֑הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyyshkhb 't'shh shkhbtzr' vhv' shpchh nchrpt l'ysh vhpdh l' npdth 'v chpshh l' ntnlh bqrt thyh l' yvmtv khyl' chpshh
verses.translation: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, designated for a man, and not at all redeemed, nor was freedom given her; there shall be inquisition; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vhby' 't'shmv lyhvh 'lptch 'hl mv'd 'yl 'shm
verses.translation: And he shall bring his forfeit unto the LORD, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן בְּאֵ֤יל הָֽאָשָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֔וֹ מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn b'yl h'shm lpny yhvh 'lcht'tv 'shr cht' vnslch lv mcht'tv 'shr cht' {p}
verses.translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt-offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned; and he shall be forgiven for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם֙ כׇּל־עֵ֣ץ מַאֲכָ֔ל וַעֲרַלְתֶּ֥ם עׇרְלָת֖וֹ אֶת־פִּרְי֑וֹ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם עֲרֵלִ֖ים לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vkhytb'v 'lh'rts vnt'tm khl'ts m'khl v'rltm 'rltv 'tpryv shlsh shnym yhyh lkhm 'rlym l' y'khl
verses.translation: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as forbidden; three years shall it be as forbidden unto you; it shall not be eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה כׇּל־פִּרְי֑וֹ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִלּוּלִ֖ים לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbshnh hrby't yhyh khlpryv qdsh hlvlym lyhvh
verses.translation: And in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֗ת תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶת־פִּרְי֔וֹ לְהוֹסִ֥יף לָכֶ֖ם תְּבוּאָת֑וֹ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbshnh hchmysht t'khlv 'tpryv lhvsyf lkhm tbv'tv 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: But in the fifth year may ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you more richly the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּ עַל־הַדָּ֑ם לֹ֥א תְנַחֲשׁ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תְעוֹנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: l' t'khlv 'lhdm l' tnchshv vl' t'vnnv
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat with the blood; neither shall ye practise divination nor soothsaying.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַקִּ֔פוּ פְּאַ֖ת רֹאשְׁכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁחִ֔ית אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת זְקָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: l' tqpv p't r'shkhm vl' tshchyt 't p't zqnkh
verses.translation: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶׂ֣רֶט לָנֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וּכְתֹ֣בֶת קַֽעֲקַ֔ע לֹ֥א תִתְּנ֖וּ בָּכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshrt lnpsh l' ttnv bbshrkhm vkhtbt q'q' l' ttnv bkhm 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor imprint any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּחַלֵּ֥ל אֶֽת־בִּתְּךָ֖ לְהַזְנוֹתָ֑הּ וְלֹא־תִזְנֶ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ זִמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ltchll 'tbtkh lhznvth vl'tznh h'rts vml'h h'rts zmh
verses.translation: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot, lest the land fall into harlotry, and the land become full of lewdness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'tshbtty tshmrv vmqdshy tyr'v 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep My sabbaths, and reverence My sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּפְנ֤וּ אֶל־הָאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים אַל־תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ לְטׇמְאָ֣ה בָהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltpnv 'lh'bt v'lhyd'nym 'ltbqshv ltm'h bhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Turn ye not unto the ghosts, nor unto familiar spirits; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְהָדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mpny shybh tqvm vhdrt pny zqn vyr't m'lhykh 'ny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָג֧וּר אִתְּךָ֛ גֵּ֖ר בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תוֹנ֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhyygvr 'tkh gr b'rtskhm l' tvnv 'tv
verses.translation: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּאֶזְרָ֣ח מִכֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם הַגֵּ֣ר  הַגָּ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֗ם וְאָהַבְתָּ֥ לוֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹךָ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: kh'zrch mkhm yhyh lkhm hgr  hgr 'tkhm v'hbt lv khmvkh khygrym hyytm b'rts mtsrym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֖וֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּמִּדָּ֕ה בַּמִּשְׁקָ֖ל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: l't'shv 'vl bmshpt bmdh bmshql vbmshvrh
verses.translation: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: m'zny tsdq 'bnytsdq 'ypt tsdq vhyn tsdq yhyh lkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shrhvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־כׇּל־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tkhlchqty v'tkhlmshpty v'shytm 'tm 'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And ye shall observe all My statutes, and all Mine ordinances, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ תֹּאמַר֒ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר  הַגָּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן מִזַּרְע֛וֹ לַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת עַ֥ם הָאָ֖רֶץ יִרְגְּמֻ֥הוּ בָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.translit: v'lbny yshr'l t'mr 'ysh 'ysh mbny yshr'l vmnhgr  hgr byshr'l 'shr ytn mzr'v lmlkh mvt yvmt 'm h'rts yrgmhv b'bn
verses.translation: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel: Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתֵּ֤ן אֶת־פָּנַי֙ בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ נָתַ֣ן לַמֹּ֔לֶךְ לְמַ֗עַן טַמֵּא֙ אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וּלְחַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: v'ny 'tn 'tpny b'ysh hhv' vhkhrty 'tv mqrb 'mv khy mzr'v ntn lmlkh lm'n tm' 'tmqdshy vlchll 'tshm qdshy
verses.translation: I also will set My face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people, because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile My sanctuary, and to profane My holy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם הַעְלֵ֣ם יַעְלִ֩ימֽוּ֩ עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ מִן־הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא בְּתִתּ֥וֹ מִזַּרְע֖וֹ לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הָמִ֥ית אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'm h'lm y'lymv 'm h'rts 't'ynyhm mnh'ysh hhv' bttv mzr'v lmlkh lblty hmyt 'tv
verses.translation: And if the people of the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־פָּנַ֛י בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑וֹ וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י אֹת֜וֹ וְאֵ֣ת  כׇּל־הַזֹּנִ֣ים אַחֲרָ֗יו לִזְנ֛וֹת אַחֲרֵ֥י הַמֹּ֖לֶךְ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmty 'ny 'tpny b'ysh hhv' vbmshpchtv vhkhrty 'tv v't  khlhznym 'chryv lznvt 'chry hmlkh mqrb 'mm
verses.translation: then I will set My face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go astray after him, to go astray after Molech, from among their people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפְנֶ֤ה אֶל־הָֽאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים לִזְנֹ֖ת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־פָּנַי֙ בַּנֶּ֣פֶשׁ הַהִ֔וא וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhnpsh 'shr tpnh 'lh'bt v'lhyd'nym lznt 'chryhm vntty 'tpny bnpsh hhv' vhkhrty 'tv mqrb 'mv
verses.translation: And the soul that turneth unto the ghosts, and unto the familiar spirits, to go astray after them, I will even set My face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִ֨תְקַדִּשְׁתֶּ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֑ים כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhtqdshtm vhyytm qdshym khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tchqty v'shytm 'tm 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: And keep ye My statutes, and do them: I am the LORD who sanctify you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְקַלֵּ֧ל אֶת־אָבִ֛יו וְאֶת־אִמּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת אָבִ֧יו וְאִמּ֛וֹ קִלֵּ֖ל דָּמָ֥יו בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy'ysh 'ysh 'shr yqll 't'byv v't'mv mvt yvmt 'byv v'mv qll dmyv bv
verses.translation: For whatsoever man there be that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנְאַף֙ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנְאַ֖ף אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ מֽוֹת־יוּמַ֥ת הַנֹּאֵ֖ף וְהַנֹּאָֽפֶת׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yn'f 't'sht 'ysh 'shr yn'f 't'sht r'hv mvtyvmt hn'f vhn'pt
verses.translation: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יו גִּלָּ֑ה מֽוֹת־יוּמְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 't'sht 'byv 'rvt 'byv glh mvtyvmtv shnyhm dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife—he hath uncovered his father’s nakedness—both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־כַּלָּת֔וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמְת֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם תֶּ֥בֶל עָשׂ֖וּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 'tkhltv mvt yvmtv shnyhm tbl 'shv dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death; they have wrought corruption; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֤ב אֶת־זָכָר֙ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֔ה תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 'tzkhr mshkhby 'shh tv'bh 'shv shnyhm mvt yvmtv dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקַּ֧ח אֶת־אִשָּׁ֛ה וְאֶת־אִמָּ֖הּ זִמָּ֣ה הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֞שׁ יִשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶתְהֶ֔ן וְלֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה זִמָּ֖ה בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yqch 't'shh v't'mh zmh hv' b'sh yshrpv 'tv v'thn vl'thyh zmh btvkhkhm
verses.translation: And if a man take with his wife also her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁכׇבְתּ֛וֹ בִּבְהֵמָ֖ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה תַּהֲרֹֽגוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr ytn shkhbtv bbhmh mvt yvmt v'thbhmh thrgv
verses.translation: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death; and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּקְרַ֤ב אֶל־כׇּל־בְּהֵמָה֙ לְרִבְעָ֣הֿ אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָרַגְתָּ֥ אֶת־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shh 'shr tqrb 'lkhlbhmh lrb'h 'th vhrgt 'th'shh v'thbhmh mvt yvmtv dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִקַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲחֹת֡וֹ בַּת־אָבִ֣יו א֣וֹ בַת־אִ֠מּ֠וֹ וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָ֜הּ וְהִֽיא־תִרְאֶ֤ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתוֹ֙ חֶ֣סֶד ה֔וּא וְנִ֨כְרְת֔וּ לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמָּ֑ם עֶרְוַ֧ת אֲחֹת֛וֹ גִּלָּ֖ה עֲוֺנ֥וֹ יִשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shryqch 't'chtv bt'byv 'v bt'mv vr'h 't'rvth vhy'tr'h 't'rvtv chsd hv' vnkhrtv l'yny bny 'mm 'rvt 'chtv glh 'vnv ysh'
verses.translation: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness: it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אִ֠ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה דָּוָ֗ה וְגִלָּ֤ה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ֙ אֶת־מְקֹרָ֣הּ הֶֽעֱרָ֔ה וְהִ֕וא גִּלְּתָ֖ה אֶת־מְק֣וֹר דָּמֶ֑יהָ וְנִכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shryshkhb 't'shh dvh vglh 't'rvth 'tmqrh h'rh vhv' glth 'tmqvr dmyh vnkhrtv shnyhm mqrb 'mm
verses.translation: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness—he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood—both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֶרְוַ֨ת אֲח֧וֹת אִמְּךָ֛ וַאֲח֥וֹת אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּ֧י אֶת־שְׁאֵר֛וֹ הֶעֱרָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
verses.translit: v'rvt 'chvt 'mkh v'chvt 'bykh l' tglh khy 'tsh'rv h'rh 'vnm ysh'v
verses.translation: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister; for he hath made naked his near kin; they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־דֹּ֣דָת֔וֹ עֶרְוַ֥ת דֹּד֖וֹ גִּלָּ֑ה חֶטְאָ֥ם יִשָּׂ֖אוּ עֲרִירִ֥ים יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 'tddtv 'rvt ddv glh cht'm ysh'v 'ryrym ymtv
verses.translation: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife—he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness—they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִקַּ֛ח אֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יו נִדָּ֣ה הִ֑וא עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֛יו גִּלָּ֖ה עֲרִירִ֥ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yqch 't'sht 'chyv ndh hv' 'rvt 'chyv glh 'ryrym yhyv
verses.translation: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־כׇּל־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־תָקִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖מָּה לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tkhlchqty v'tkhlmshpty v'shytm 'tm vl'tqy' 'tkhm h'rts 'shr 'ny mby' 'tkhm shmh lshbt bh
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore keep all My statutes, and all Mine ordinances, and do them, that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ בְּחֻקֹּ֣ת הַגּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ עָשׂ֔וּ וָאָקֻ֖ץ בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vl' tlkhv bchqt hgvy 'shr'ny mshlch mpnykhm khy 'tkhl'lh 'shv v'qts bm
verses.translation: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר לָכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֮ תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אַדְמָתָם֒ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶתְּנֶ֤נָּה לָכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֹתָ֔הּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֲנִי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִן־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'mr lkhm 'tm tyrshv 't'dmtm v'ny 'tnnh lkhm lrsht 'th 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shrhbdlty 'tkhm mnh'mym
verses.translation: But I have said unto you: ‘Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.’ I am the LORD your God, who have set you apart from the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּ֞ם בֵּֽין־הַבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּהֹרָה֙ לַטְּמֵאָ֔ה וּבֵין־הָע֥וֹף הַטָּמֵ֖א לַטָּהֹ֑ר וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת־נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֜ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּבָע֗וֹף וּבְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי לָכֶ֖ם לְטַמֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: vhbdltm bynhbhmh hthrh ltm'h vbynh'vf htm' lthr vl'tshqtsv 'tnpshtykhm bbhmh vb'vf vbkhl 'shr trmsh h'dmh 'shrhbdlty lkhm ltm'
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore separate between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean; and ye shall not make your souls detestable by beast, or by fowl, or by any thing wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have set apart for you to hold unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וָאַבְדִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִן־הָֽעַמִּ֖ים לִהְי֥וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyytm ly qdshym khy qdvsh 'ny yhvh v'bdl 'tkhm mnh'mym lhyvt ly
verses.translation: And ye shall be holy unto Me; for I the LORD am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be Mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּי־יִהְיֶ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ בָּאֶ֛בֶן יִרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם דְּמֵיהֶ֥ם בָּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ysh 'v'shh khyyhyh bhm 'vb 'v yd'ny mvt yvmtv b'bn yrgmv 'tm dmyhm bm {p}
verses.translation: A man also or a woman that divineth by a ghost or a familiar spirit, shall surely be put to death; they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא־יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּעַמָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh 'mr 'lhkhhnym bny 'hrn v'mrt 'lhm lnpsh l'ytm' b'myv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them: There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: khy 'mlsh'rv hqrb 'lyv l'mv vl'byv vlbnv vlbtv vl'chyv
verses.translation: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַבְּתוּלָה֙ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הָיְתָ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vl'chtv hbtvlh hqrvbh 'lyv 'shr l'hyth l'ysh lh ytm'
verses.translation: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband, for her may he defile himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּ֖א בַּ֣עַל בְּעַמָּ֑יו לְהֵ֖חַלּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l' ytm' b'l b'myv lhchlv
verses.translation: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־[יִקְרְח֤וּ] (יקרחה) קׇרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃
verses.translit: l'[yqrchv] (yqrchh) qrchh br'shm vp't zqnm l' yglchv vbbshrm l' yshrtv shrtt
verses.translation: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corners of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: qdshym yhyv l'lhyhm vl' ychllv shm 'lhyhm khy 't'shy yhvh lchm 'lhyhm hm mqrybm vhyv qdsh
verses.translation: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer; therefore they shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי־קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'shh znh vchllh l' yqchv v'shh grvshh m'yshh l' yqchv khyqdsh hv' l'lhyv
verses.translation: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profaned; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband; for he is holy unto his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִ֨דַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vqdshtv khy'tlchm 'lhykh hv' mqryb qdsh yhyhlkh khy qdvsh 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God; he shall be holy unto thee; for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־אָבִ֙יהָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbt 'ysh khhn khy tchl lznvt 't'byh hy' mchllt b'sh tshrf {s}
verses.translation: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲֽשֶׁר־יוּצַ֥ק עַל־רֹאשׁ֣וֹ  שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vhkhhn hgdvl m'chyv 'shryvtsq 'lr'shv  shmn hmshchh vml' 'tydv llbsh 'thbgdym 'tr'shv l' ypr' vbgdyv l' yprm
verses.translation: And the priest that is highest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֛ל כׇּל־נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.translit: v'l khlnpsht mt l' yb' l'byv vl'mv l' ytm'
verses.translation: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmnhmqdsh l' yts' vl' ychll 't mqdsh 'lhyv khy nzr shmn mshcht 'lhyv 'lyv 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֕וּא אִשָּׁ֥ה בִבְתוּלֶ֖יהָ יִקָּֽח׃
verses.translit: vhv' 'shh bbtvlyh yqch
verses.translation: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 'lmnh vgrvshh vchllh znh 't'lh l' yqch khy 'mbtvlh m'myv yqch 'shh
verses.translation: A widow, or one divorced, or a profaned woman, or a harlot, these shall he not take; but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl'ychll zr'v b'myv khy 'ny yhvh mqdshv {s}
verses.translation: And he shall not profane his seed among his people; for I am the LORD who sanctify him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרַ֔ב לְהַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn l'mr 'ysh mzr'kh ldrtm 'shr yhyh bv mvm l' yqrb lhqryb lchm 'lhyv
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, saying: Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י כׇל־אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ א֣וֹ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ׃
verses.translit: khy khl'ysh 'shrbv mvm l' yqrb 'ysh 'vr 'v psch 'v chrm 'v shrv'
verses.translation: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath any thing maimed, or anything too long,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד׃
verses.translit: 'v 'ysh 'shryhyh bv shbr rgl 'v shbr yd
verses.translation: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹ־גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ־דַ֔ק א֖וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל בְּעֵינ֑וֹ א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: 'vgbn 'vdq 'v tbll b'ynv 'v grb 'v ylpt 'v mrvch 'shkh
verses.translation: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath his eye overspread, or is scabbed, or scurvy, or hath his stones crushed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א יִגַּ֔שׁ לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ אֵ֚ת לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְהַקְרִֽיב׃
verses.translit: khl'ysh 'shrbv mvm mzr' 'hrn hkhhn l' ygsh lhqryb 't'shy yhvh mvm bv 't lchm 'lhyv l' ygsh lhqryb
verses.translation: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire; he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִקׇּדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּמִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lchm 'lhyv mqdshy hqdshym vmnhqdshym y'khl
verses.translation: He may eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי־מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת־מִקְדָּשַׁ֔י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'lhprkht l' yb' v'lhmzbch l' ygsh khymvm bv vl' ychll 'tmqdshy khy 'ny yhvh mqdshm
verses.translation: Only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not My holy places; for I am the LORD who sanctify them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶֽל־כׇּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l'hrn v'lbnyv v'lkhlbny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: So Moses spoke unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְיִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִקׇּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn v'lbnyv vynzrv mqdshy bnyyshr'l vl' ychllv 'tshm qdshy 'shr hm mqdshym ly 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto Me, and that they profane not My holy name: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם לְדֹרֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם כׇּל־אִ֣ישׁ  אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרַ֣ב מִכׇּל־זַרְעֲכֶ֗ם אֶל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַהִ֛וא מִלְּפָנַ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'lhm ldrtykhm khl'ysh  'shryqrb mkhlzr'khm 'lhqdshym 'shr yqdyshv bnyyshr'l lyhvh vtm'tv 'lyv vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' mlpny 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Say unto them: Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before Me: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא צָר֙וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים֙ לֹ֣א יֹאכַ֔ל עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְהָ֑ר וְהַנֹּגֵ֙עַ֙ בְּכׇל־טְמֵא־נֶ֔פֶשׁ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָֽרַע׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ysh mzr' 'hrn vhv' tsrv' 'v zb bqdshym l' y'khl 'd 'shr ythr vhng' bkhltm'npsh 'v 'ysh 'shrtts' mmnv shkhbtzr'
verses.translation: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue, he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any one that is unclean by the dead; or from whomsoever the flow of seed goeth out;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹ־אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגַּ֔ע בְּכׇל־שֶׁ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ל֑וֹ א֤וֹ בְאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ל֔וֹ לְכֹ֖ל טֻמְאָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'v'ysh 'shr yg' bkhlshrts 'shr ytm'lv 'v b'dm 'shr ytm'lv lkhl tm'tv
verses.translation: or whosoever toucheth any swarming thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע־בּ֔וֹ וְטָמְאָ֖ה עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְלֹ֤א יֹאכַל֙ מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֛י אִם־רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: npsh 'shr tg'bv vtm'h 'dh'rb vl' y'khl mnhqdshym khy 'mrchts bshrv bmym
verses.translation: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְטָהֵ֑ר וְאַחַר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י לַחְמ֖וֹ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vb' hshmsh vthr v'chr y'khl mnhqdshym khy lchmv hv'
verses.translation: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he may eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְבֵלָ֧ה וּטְרֵפָ֛ה לֹ֥א יֹאכַ֖ל לְטׇמְאָה־בָ֑הּ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: nblh vtrph l' y'khl ltm'hbh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י וְלֹֽא־יִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא וּמֵ֥תוּ ב֖וֹ כִּ֣י יְחַלְּלֻ֑הוּ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vshmrv 'tmshmrty vl'ysh'v 'lyv cht' vmtv bv khy ychllhv 'ny yhvh mqdshm
verses.translation: They shall therefore keep My charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am the LORD who sanctify them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־זָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֣אכַל קֹ֑דֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁ֥ב כֹּהֵ֛ן וְשָׂכִ֖יר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vkhlzr l'y'khl qdsh tvshb khhn vshkhyr l'y'khl qdsh
verses.translation: There shall no common man eat of the holy thing; a tenant of a priest, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹהֵ֗ן כִּֽי־יִקְנֶ֥ה נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ קִנְיַ֣ן כַּסְפּ֔וֹ ה֖וּא יֹ֣אכַל בּ֑וֹ וִילִ֣יד בֵּית֔וֹ הֵ֖ם יֹאכְל֥וּ בְלַחְמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhhn khyyqnh npsh qnyn khspv hv' y'khl bv vylyd bytv hm y'khlv blchmv
verses.translation: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he may eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they may eat of his bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַ֨ת־כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר הִ֕וא בִּתְרוּמַ֥ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbtkhhn khy thyh l'ysh zr hv' btrvmt hqdshym l' t'khl
verses.translation: And if a priest’s daughter be married unto a common man, she shall not eat of that which is set apart from the holy things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַת־כֹּהֵן֩ כִּ֨י תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְזֶ֘רַע֮ אֵ֣ין לָהּ֒ וְשָׁבָ֞ה אֶל־בֵּ֤ית אָבִ֙יהָ֙ כִּנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ מִלֶּ֥חֶם אָבִ֖יהָ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וְכׇל־זָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbtkhhn khy thyh 'lmnh vgrvshh vzr' 'yn lh vshbh 'lbyt 'byh khn'vryh mlchm 'byh t'khl vkhlzr l'y'khl bv
verses.translation: But if a priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but there shall no common man eat thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יֹאכַ֥ל קֹ֖דֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְיָסַ֤ף חֲמִֽשִׁיתוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyy'khl qdsh bshggh vysf chmshytv 'lyv vntn lkhhn 'thqdsh
verses.translation: And if a man eat of the holy thing through error, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ אֶת־קׇדְשֵׁ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יָרִ֖ימוּ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl' ychllv 'tqdshy bny yshr'l 't 'shryrymv lyhvh
verses.translation: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they set apart unto the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשִּׂ֤יאוּ אוֹתָם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אַשְׁמָ֔ה בְּאׇכְלָ֖ם אֶת־קׇדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhshy'v 'vtm 'vn 'shmh b'khlm 'tqdshyhm khy 'ny yhvh mqdshm {p}
verses.translation: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctify them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כׇּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קׇרְבָּנוֹ֙ לְכׇל־נִדְרֵיהֶם֙ וּלְכׇל־נִדְבוֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn v'lbnyv v'l khlbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmnhgr byshr'l 'shr yqryb qrbnv lkhlndryhm vlkhlndbvtm 'shryqrybv lyhvh l'lh
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that bringeth his offering, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their free-will-offerings, which are brought unto the LORD for a burnt-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם תָּמִ֣ים זָכָ֔ר בַּבָּקָ֕ר בַּכְּשָׂבִ֖ים וּבָֽעִזִּֽים׃
verses.translit: lrtsnkhm tmym zkhr bbqr bkhshbym vb'zym
verses.translation: that ye may be accepted, ye shall offer a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א לְרָצ֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khl 'shrbv mvm l' tqrybv khyl' lrtsvn yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not bring; for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח־שְׁלָמִים֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִנְדָבָ֔ה בַּבָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַצֹּ֑אן תָּמִ֤ים יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְרָצ֔וֹן כׇּל־מ֖וּם לֹ֥א יִהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyyqryb zbchshlmym lyhvh lpl'ndr 'v lndbh bbqr 'v bts'n tmym yhyh lrtsvn khlmvm l' yhyhbv
verses.translation: And whosoever bringeth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto the LORD in fulfilment of a vow clearly uttered, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַוֶּ֩רֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא־תַקְרִ֥יבוּ אֵ֖לֶּה לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְאִשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵהֶ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'vrt 'v shbvr 'vchrvts 'vyblt 'v grb 'v ylpt l'tqrybv 'lh lyhvh v'shh l'ttnv mhm 'lhmzbch lyhvh
verses.translation: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scabbed, or scurvy, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְקָל֑וּט נְדָבָה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וּלְנֵ֖דֶר לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vshvr vshh shrv' vqlvt ndbh t'shh 'tv vlndr l' yrtsh
verses.translation: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing too long or too short, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָע֤וּךְ וְכָתוּת֙ וְנָת֣וּק וְכָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vm'vkh vkhtvt vntvq vkhrvt l' tqrybv lyhvh vb'rtskhm l' t'shv
verses.translation: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or torn, or cut, ye shall not offer unto the LORD; neither shall ye do thus in your land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִיַּ֣ד בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכׇּל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י מׇשְׁחָתָ֤ם בָּהֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔ם לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmyd bnnkhr l' tqrybv 'tlchm 'lhykhm mkhl'lh khy mshchtm bhm mvm bm l' yrtsv lkhm {s}
verses.translation: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these, because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them; they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ־עֵז֙ כִּ֣י יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֛ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑וֹ וּמִיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ וָהָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה לְקׇרְבַּ֥ן אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shvr 'vkhshb 'v'z khy yvld vhyh shb't ymym tcht 'mv vmyvm hshmyny vhl'h yrtsh lqrbn 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; but from the eighth day and thenceforth it may be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשׁ֖וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vshvr 'vshh 'tv v'tbnv l' tshchtv byvm 'chd
verses.translation: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח־תּוֹדָ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhytzbchv zbchtvdh lyhvh lrtsnkhm tzbchv
verses.translation: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' y'khl l'tvtyrv mmnv 'dbqr 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm mtsvty v'shytm 'tm 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall keep My commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vl' tchllv 'tshm qdshy vnqdshty btvkh bny yshr'l 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall not profane My holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD who hallow you,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמּוֹצִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hmvtsy' 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym lhyvt lkhm l'lhym 'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: that brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽי׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm mv'dy yhvh 'shrtqr'v 'tm mqr'y qdsh 'lh hm mv'dy
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: The appointed seasons of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are My appointed seasons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ מִקְרָא־קֹ֔דֶשׁ כׇּל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ שַׁבָּ֥ת הִוא֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'shh ml'khh vbyvm hshby'y shbt shbtvn mqr'qdsh khlml'khh l' t'shv shbt hv' lyhvh bkhl mvshbtykhm {p}
verses.translation: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work; it is a sabbath unto the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה מִקְרָאֵ֖י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בְּמוֹעֲדָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh mv'dy yhvh mqr'y qdsh 'shrtqr'v 'tm bmv'dm
verses.translation: These are the appointed seasons of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bchdsh hr'shvn b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh byn h'rbym psch lyhvh
verses.translation: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at dusk, is the LORD’S passover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַצּ֥וֹת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vbchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hzh chg hmtsvt lyhvh shb't ymym mtsvt t'khlv
verses.translation: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD; seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן מִקְרָא־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: byvm hr'shvn mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ מִקְרָא־קֹ֔דֶשׁ כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh shb't ymym byvm hshby'y mqr'qdsh khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv {p}
verses.translation: And ye shall bring an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days; in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וּקְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־קְצִירָ֑הּ וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֶת־עֹ֛מֶר רֵאשִׁ֥ית קְצִירְכֶ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khytb'v 'lh'rts 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm vqtsrtm 'tqtsyrh vhb'tm 't'mr r'shyt qtsyrkhm 'lhkhhn
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵנִ֧יף אֶת־הָעֹ֛מֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם מִֽמׇּחֳרַת֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת יְנִיפֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vhnyf 'th'mr lpny yhvh lrtsnkhm mmchrt hshbt ynypnv hkhhn
verses.translation: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you; on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֕ם בְּי֥וֹם הֲנִֽיפְכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָעֹ֑מֶר כֶּ֣בֶשׂ תָּמִ֧ים בֶּן־שְׁנָת֛וֹ לְעֹלָ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shytm byvm hnypkhm 'th'mr khbsh tmym bnshntv l'lh lyhvh
verses.translation: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתוֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֑חַ וְנִסְכֹּ֥ה יַ֖יִן רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃
verses.translit: vmnchtv shny 'shrnym slt blvlh bshmn 'shh lyhvh rych nychch vnskhh yyn rby't hhyn
verses.translation: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֶ֩חֶם֩ וְקָלִ֨י וְכַרְמֶ֜ל לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ עַד־עֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַ֚ד הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־קׇרְבַּ֖ן אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlchm vqly vkhrml l' t'khlv 'd'tsm hyvm hzh 'd hby'khm 'tqrbn 'lhykhm chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bkhl mshbtykhm {s}
verses.translation: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the offering of your God; it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּסְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָכֶם֙ מִמׇּחֳרַ֣ת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת מִיּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־עֹ֖מֶר הַתְּנוּפָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שַׁבָּת֖וֹת תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: vsprtm lkhm mmchrt hshbt myvm hby'khm 't'mr htnvph shb' shbtvt tmymt thyynh
verses.translation: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the day of rest, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the waving; seven weeks shall there be complete;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
