verses.original: עַ֣ד מִֽמׇּחֳרַ֤ת הַשַּׁבָּת֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ת תִּסְפְּר֖וּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֛ם מִנְחָ֥ה חֲדָשָׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'd mmchrt hshbt hshby't tsprv chmshym yvm vhqrbtm mnchh chdshh lyhvh
verses.translation: even unto the morrow after the seventh week shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall present a new meal-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם תָּבִ֣יאּוּ  לֶ֣חֶם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁ֚תַּיִם שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים סֹ֣לֶת תִּהְיֶ֔ינָה חָמֵ֖ץ תֵּאָפֶ֑ינָה בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mmvshbtykhm tby'v  lchm tnvph shtym shny 'shrnym slt thyynh chmts t'pynh bkhvrym lyhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall bring out of your dwellings two wave-loaves of two tenth parts of an ephah; they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baked with leaven, for first-fruits unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם עַל־הַלֶּ֗חֶם שִׁבְעַ֨ת כְּבָשִׂ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד וְאֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם יִהְי֤וּ עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָתָם֙ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lhlchm shb't khbshym tmymm bny shnh vpr bnbqr 'chd v'ylm shnym yhyv 'lh lyhvh vmnchtm vnskhyhm 'shh rychnychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams; they shall be a burnt-offering unto the LORD, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּ֑את וּשְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'shytm sh'yr'zym 'chd lcht't vshny khbshym bny shnh lzbch shlmym
verses.translation: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵנִ֣יף הַכֹּהֵ֣ן ׀ אֹתָ֡ם עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַבִּכֻּרִ֤ים תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י כְּבָשִׂ֑ים קֹ֛דֶשׁ יִהְי֥וּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vhnyf hkhhn  'tm 'l lchm hbkhrym tnvph lpny yhvh 'lshny khbshym qdsh yhyv lyhvh lkhhn
verses.translation: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before the LORD, with the two lambs; they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּעֶ֣צֶם  הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם בְּכׇל־מוֹשְׁבֹ֥תֵיכֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vqr'tm b'tsm  hyvm hzh mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv chqt 'vlm bkhlmvshbtykhm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no manner of servile work; it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶ֞ם אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֗ם לֹֽא־תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְךָ֙ בְּקֻצְרֶ֔ךָ וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִירְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbqtsrkhm 'tqtsyr 'rtskhm l'tkhlh p't shdkh bqtsrkh vlqt qtsyrkh l' tlqt l'ny vlgr t'zb 'tm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm {p}
verses.translation: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corner of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest; thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן זִכְר֥וֹן תְּרוּעָ֖ה מִקְרָא־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr bchdsh hshby'y b'chd lchdsh yhyh lkhm shbtvn zkhrvn trv'h mqr'qdsh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial proclaimed with the blast of horns, a holy convocation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: Ye shall do no manner of servile work; and ye shall bring an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֩דֶשׁ֩ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה י֧וֹם הַכִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'kh b'shvr lchdsh hshby'y hzh yvm hkhprym hv' mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm v'nytm 'tnpshtykhm vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement; there shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall bring an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י י֤וֹם כִּפֻּרִים֙ ה֔וּא לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhlml'khh l' t'shv b'tsm hyvm hzh khy yvm khprym hv' lkhpr 'lykhm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כׇל־הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תְעֻנֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: khy khlhnpsh 'shr l't'nh b'tsm hyvm hzh vnkhrth m'myh
verses.translation: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ כׇּל־מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּ֛י אֶת־הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vkhlhnpsh 'shr t'shh khlml'khh b'tsm hyvm hzh vh'bdty 'thnpsh hhv' mqrb 'mh
verses.translation: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khlml'khh l' t'shv chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bkhl mshbtykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall do no manner of work; it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּתִשְׁעָ֤ה לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב מֵעֶ֣רֶב עַד־עֶ֔רֶב תִּשְׁבְּת֖וּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shbt shbtvn hv' lkhm v'nytm 'tnpshtykhm btsh'h lchdsh b'rb m'rb 'd'rb tshbtv shbtkhm {p}
verses.translation: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls; in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֜ר י֗וֹם לַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֧ג הַסֻּכּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshby'y hzh chg hskhvt shb't ymym lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־קֹ֑דֶשׁ כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: byvm hr'shvn mqr'qdsh khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: On the first day shall be a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֡י מִקְרָא־קֹ֩דֶשׁ֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עֲצֶ֣רֶת הִ֔וא כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: shb't ymym tqrybv 'shh lyhvh byvm hshmyny mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh 'tsrt hv' khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: Seven days ye shall bring an offering made by fire unto the LORD; on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall bring an offering made by fire unto the LORD; it is a day of solemn assembly; ye shall do no manner of servile work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ לְהַקְרִ֨יב אִשֶּׁ֜ה לַיהֹוָ֗ה עֹלָ֧ה וּמִנְחָ֛ה זֶ֥בַח וּנְסָכִ֖ים דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lh mv'dy yhvh 'shrtqr'v 'tm mqr'y qdsh lhqryb 'shh lyhvh 'lh vmnchh zbch vnskhym dbryvm byvmv
verses.translation: These are the appointed seasons of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to bring an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt-offering, and a meal-offering, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, each on its own day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִלְּבַ֖ד שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִלְּבַ֣ד מַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּמִלְּבַ֤ד כׇּל־נִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וּמִלְּבַד֙ כׇּל־נִדְבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mlbd shbtt yhvh vmlbd mtnvtykhm vmlbd khlndrykhm vmlbd khlndbtykhm 'shr ttnv lyhvh
verses.translation: beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill-offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּאׇסְפְּכֶם֙ אֶת־תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֶת־חַג־יְהֹוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י שַׁבָּתֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'kh bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshby'y b'spkhm 'ttbv't h'rts tchgv 'tchgyhvh shb't ymym byvm hr'shvn shbtvn vbyvm hshmyny shbtvn
verses.translation: Howbeit on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruits of the land, ye shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days; on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן פְּרִ֨י עֵ֤ץ הָדָר֙ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים וַעֲנַ֥ף עֵץ־עָבֹ֖ת וְעַרְבֵי־נָ֑חַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vlqchtm lkhm byvm hr'shvn pry 'ts hdr khpt tmrym v'nf 'ts'bt v'rbynchl vshmchtm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm shb't ymym
verses.translation: And ye shall take you on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm-trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook, and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַגֹּתֶ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ חַ֣ג לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vchgtm 'tv chg lyhvh shb't ymym bshnh chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bchdsh hshby'y tchgv 'tv
verses.translation: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year; it is a statute for ever in your generations; ye shall keep it in the seventh month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כׇּל־הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃
verses.translit: bskht tshbv shb't ymym khlh'zrch byshr'l yshbv bskht
verses.translation: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are home-born in Israel shall dwell in booths;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֘עַן֮ יֵדְע֣וּ דֹרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י בַסֻּכּ֗וֹת הוֹשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lm'n yd'v drtykhm khy bskhvt hvshbty 'tbny yshr'l bhvtsy'y 'vtm m'rts mtsrym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽת־מֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'tm'dy yhvh 'lbny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the appointed seasons of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֞ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: tsv 'tbny yshr'l vyqchv 'lykh shmn zyt zkh khtyt lm'vr lh'lt nr tmyd
verses.translation: ’Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִחוּץ֩ לְפָרֹ֨כֶת הָעֵדֻ֜ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֜ן מֵעֶ֧רֶב עַד־בֹּ֛קֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mchvts lprkht h'dt b'hl mv'd y'rkh 'tv 'hrn m'rb 'dbqr lpny yhvh tmyd chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron order it from evening to morning before the LORD continually; it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֚ל הַמְּנֹרָ֣ה הַטְּהֹרָ֔ה יַעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־הַנֵּר֑וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'l hmnrh hthrh y'rkh 'thnrvt lpny yhvh tmyd {p}
verses.translation: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ סֹ֔לֶת וְאָפִיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔הּ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה חַלּ֑וֹת שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֖ה הַֽחַלָּ֥ה הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: vlqcht slt v'pyt 'th shtym 'shrh chlvt shny 'shrnym yhyh hchlh h'cht
verses.translation: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת עַ֛ל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן הַטָּהֹ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmt 'vtm shtym m'rkhvt shsh hm'rkht 'l hshlchn hthr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six in a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֤ה לַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ לְאַזְכָּרָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vntt 'lhm'rkht lbnh zkhh vhyth llchm l'zkhrh 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put pure frankincense with each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial-part, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: byvm hshbt byvm hshbt y'rkhnv lpny yhvh tmyd m't bnyyshr'l bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually; it is from the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֔יו וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ כִּ֡י קֹ֩דֶשׁ֩ קׇֽדָשִׁ֨ים ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה חׇק־עוֹלָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyth l'hrn vlbnyv v'khlhv bmqvm qdsh khy qdsh qdshym hv' lv m'shy yhvh chq'vlm {s}
verses.translation: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, a perpetual due.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ בֶּן־אִשָּׁ֣ה יִשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְהוּא֙ בֶּן־אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּנָּצוּ֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה בֶּ֚ן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְאִ֖ישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyts' bn'shh yshr'lyt vhv' bn'ysh mtsry btvkh bny yshr'l vyntsv bmchnh bn hyshr'lyt v'ysh hyshr'ly
verses.translation: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּקֹּ֠ב בֶּן־הָֽאִשָּׁ֨ה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֤ית אֶת־הַשֵּׁם֙ וַיְקַלֵּ֔ל וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֛וֹ שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בַּת־דִּבְרִ֖י לְמַטֵּה־דָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyqb bnh'shh hyshr'lyt 'thshm vyqll vyby'v 'tv 'lmshh vshm 'mv shlmyt btdbry lmthdn
verses.translation: And the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּנִּיחֻ֖הוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר לִפְרֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vynychhv bmshmr lprsh lhm 'lpy yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹצֵ֣א אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ כׇֽל־הַשֹּׁמְעִ֛ים אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְרָגְמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ כׇּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvts' 'thmqll 'lmchvts lmchnh vsmkhv khlhshm'ym 'tydyhm 'lr'shv vrgmv 'tv khlh'dh
verses.translation: ’Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ כִּֽי־יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖יו וְנָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lbny yshr'l tdbr l'mr 'ysh 'ysh khyyqll 'lhyv vnsh' cht'v
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying: Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם־יְהֹוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־ב֖וֹ כׇּל־הָעֵדָ֑ה כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח בְּנׇקְבוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vnqb shmyhvh mvt yvmt rgvm yrgmvbv khlh'dh khgr kh'zrch bnqbvshm yvmt
verses.translation: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him; as well the stranger, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the Name, shall be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַכֶּ֖ה כׇּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khy ykhh khlnpsh 'dm mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vmkhh npshbhmh yshlmnh npsh tcht npsh
verses.translation: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good: life for life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּעֲמִית֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyytn mvm b'mytv kh'shr 'shh khn y'shh lv
verses.translation: And if a man maim his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽאָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shbr tcht shbr 'yn tcht 'yn shn tcht shn kh'shr ytn mvm b'dm khn yntn bv
verses.translation: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath maimed a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vmkhh bhmh yshlmnh vmkhh 'dm yvmt
verses.translation: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֶחָד֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כַּגֵּ֥ר כָּאֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mshpt 'chd yhyh lkhm khgr kh'zrch yhyh khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for the home-born; for I am the LORD your God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'lbny yshr'l vyvtsy'v 'thmqll 'lmchvts lmchnh vyrgmv 'tv 'bn vbnyyshr'l 'shv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh bhr syny l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֤י תָבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וְשָׁבְתָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy tb'v 'lh'rts 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm vshbth h'rts shbt lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ תִּזְרַ֣ע שָׂדֶ֔ךָ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְמֹ֣ר כַּרְמֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: shsh shnym tzr' shdkh vshsh shnym tzmr khrmkh v'spt 'ttbv'th
verses.translation: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the produce thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗ת שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָאָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהֹוָ֑ה שָֽׂדְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔ע וְכַרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִזְמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vbshnh hshby't shbt shbtvn yhyh l'rts shbt lyhvh shdkh l' tzr' vkhrmkh l' tzmr
verses.translation: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto the LORD; thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת סְפִ֤יחַ קְצִֽירְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְצ֔וֹר וְאֶת־עִנְּבֵ֥י נְזִירֶ֖ךָ לֹ֣א תִבְצֹ֑ר שְׁנַ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 't spych qtsyrkh l' tqtsvr v't'nby nzyrkh l' tbtsr shnt shbtvn yhyh l'rts
verses.translation: That which groweth of itself of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thy undressed vine thou shalt not gather; it shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיְתָ֠ה שַׁבַּ֨ת הָאָ֤רֶץ לָכֶם֙ לְאׇכְלָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וְלַאֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְלִשְׂכִֽירְךָ֙ וּלְתוֹשָׁ֣בְךָ֔ הַגָּרִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhyth shbt h'rts lkhm l'khlh lkh vl'bdkh vl'mtkh vlshkhyrkh vltvshbkh hgrym 'mkh
verses.translation: And the sabbath-produce of the land shall be for food for you: for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for the settler by thy side that sojourn with thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִ֨בְהֶמְתְּךָ֔ וְלַֽחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאַרְצֶ֑ךָ תִּהְיֶ֥ה כׇל־תְּבוּאָתָ֖הּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbhmtkh vlchyh 'shr b'rtskh thyh khltbv'th l'khl {s}
verses.translation: and for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָפַרְתָּ֣ לְךָ֗ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת שָׁנִ֔ים שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְהָי֣וּ לְךָ֗ יְמֵי֙ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת הַשָּׁנִ֔ים תֵּ֥שַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsprt lkh shb' shbtt shnym shb' shnym shb' p'mym vhyv lkh ymy shb' shbtt hshnym tsh' v'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֞ שׁוֹפַ֤ר תְּרוּעָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י בֶּעָשׂ֖וֹר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּיוֹם֙ הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּכׇל־אַרְצְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'brt shvpr trv'h bchdsh hshb'y b'shvr lchdsh byvm hkhprym t'byrv shvpr bkhl'rtskhm
verses.translation: Then shalt thou make proclamation with the blast of the horn on the tenth day of the seventh month; in the day of atonement shall ye make proclamation with the horn throughout all your land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּ֗ם אֵ֣ת שְׁנַ֤ת הַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּקְרָאתֶ֥ם דְּר֛וֹר בָּאָ֖רֶץ לְכׇל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ יוֹבֵ֥ל הִוא֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ תָּשֻֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: vqdshtm 't shnt hchmshym shnh vqr'tm drvr b'rts lkhlyshbyh yvbl hv' thyh lkhm vshbtm 'ysh 'l'chztv v'ysh 'lmshpchtv tshbv
verses.translation: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof; it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֗וא שְׁנַ֛ת הַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔עוּ וְלֹ֤א תִקְצְרוּ֙ אֶת־סְפִיחֶ֔יהָ וְלֹ֥א תִבְצְר֖וּ אֶת־נְזִרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: yvbl hv' shnt hchmshym shnh thyh lkhm l' tzr'v vl' tqtsrv 'tspychyh vl' tbtsrv 'tnzryh
verses.translation: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you; ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of the undressed vines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֔וא קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם מִ֨ן־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה תֹּאכְל֖וּ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy yvbl hv' qdsh thyh lkhm mnhshdh t'khlv 'ttbv'th
verses.translation: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you; ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֥ת הַיּוֹבֵ֖ל הַזֹּ֑את תָּשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bshnt hyvbl hz't tshbv 'ysh 'l'chztv
verses.translation: In this year of jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־תִמְכְּר֤וּ מִמְכָּר֙ לַעֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ א֥וֹ קָנֹ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ אַל־תּוֹנ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vkhytmkhrv mmkhr l'mytkh 'v qnh myd 'mytkh 'ltvnv 'ysh 't'chyv
verses.translation: And if thou sell aught unto thy neighbour, or buy of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not wrong one another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שָׁנִים֙ אַחַ֣ר הַיּוֹבֵ֔ל תִּקְנֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁנֵֽי־תְבוּאֹ֖ת יִמְכׇּר־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: bmspr shnym 'chr hyvbl tqnh m't 'mytkh bmspr shnytbv't ymkhrlkh
verses.translation: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the crops he shall sell unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְפִ֣י  רֹ֣ב הַשָּׁנִ֗ים תַּרְבֶּה֙ מִקְנָת֔וֹ וּלְפִי֙ מְעֹ֣ט הַשָּׁנִ֔ים תַּמְעִ֖יט מִקְנָת֑וֹ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר תְּבוּאֹ֔ת ה֥וּא מֹכֵ֖ר לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lpy  rb hshnym trbh mqntv vlpy m't hshnym tm'yt mqntv khy mspr tbv't hv' mkhr lkh
verses.translation: According to the multitude of the years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of the years thou shalt diminish the price of it; for the number of crops doth he sell unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א תוֹנוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־עֲמִית֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vl' tvnv 'ysh 't'mytv vyr't m'lhykh khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God; for I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֙ אֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֔י וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֹתָ֑ם וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.translit: v'shytm 'tchqty v'tmshpty tshmrv v'shytm 'tm vyshbtm 'lh'rts lbtch
verses.translation: Wherefore ye shall do My statutes, and keep Mine ordinances and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ פִּרְיָ֔הּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם לָשֹׂ֑בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vntnh h'rts pryh v'khltm lshb' vyshbtm lbtch 'lyh
verses.translation: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat until ye have enough, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ מַה־נֹּאכַ֖ל בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑ת הֵ֚ן לֹ֣א נִזְרָ֔ע וְלֹ֥א נֶאֱסֹ֖ף אֶת־תְּבוּאָתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhy t'mrv mhn'khl bshnh hshby't hn l' nzr' vl' n'sf 'ttbv'tnv
verses.translation: And if ye shall say: ‘What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we may not sow, nor gather in our increase’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוִּ֤יתִי אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי֙ לָכֶ֔ם בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑ית וְעָשָׂת֙ אֶת־הַתְּבוּאָ֔ה לִשְׁלֹ֖שׁ הַשָּׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtsvyty 'tbrkhty lkhm bshnh hshshyt v'sht 'thtbv'h lshlsh hshnym
verses.translation: then I will command My blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth produce for the three years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְרַעְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁמִינִ֔ת וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם מִן־הַתְּבוּאָ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ן עַ֣ד  הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַתְּשִׁיעִ֗ת עַד־בּוֹא֙ תְּב֣וּאָתָ֔הּ תֹּאכְל֖וּ יָשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vzr'tm 't hshnh hshmynt v'khltm mnhtbv'h yshn 'd  hshnh htshy't 'dbv' tbv'th t'khlv yshn
verses.translation: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the produce, the old store; until the ninth year, until her produce come in, ye shall eat the old store.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִצְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי־לִ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֧ים וְתוֹשָׁבִ֛ים אַתֶּ֖ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vh'rts l' tmkhr ltsmtt khyly h'rts khygrym vtvshbym 'tm 'mdy
verses.translation: And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity; for the land is Mine; for ye are strangers and settlers with Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶ֑ם גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּתְּנ֥וּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbkhl 'rts 'chztkhm g'lh ttnv l'rts {s}
verses.translation: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָכַ֖ר מֵאֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ וּבָ֤א גֹֽאֲלוֹ֙ הַקָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֔יו וְגָאַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מִמְכַּ֥ר אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: khyymvkh 'chykh vmkhr m'chztv vb' g'lv hqrb 'lyv vg'l 't mmkhr 'chyv
verses.translation: If thy brother be waxen poor, and sell some of his possession, then shall his kinsman that is next unto him come, and shall redeem that which his brother hath sold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ גֹּאֵ֑ל וְהִשִּׂ֣יגָה יָד֔וֹ וּמָצָ֖א כְּדֵ֥י גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khy l' yhyhlv g'l vhshygh ydv vmts' khdy g'ltv
verses.translation: And if a man have no one to redeem it, and he be waxen rich and find sufficient means to redeem it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִשַּׁב֙ אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י מִמְכָּר֔וֹ וְהֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֹדֵ֔ף לָאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽכַר־ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vchshb 'tshny mmkhrv vhshyb 'th'df l'ysh 'shr mkhrlv vshb l'chztv
verses.translation: then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם לֹֽא־מָצְאָ֜ה יָד֗וֹ דֵּי֮ הָשִׁ֣יב לוֹ֒ וְהָיָ֣ה מִמְכָּר֗וֹ בְּיַד֙ הַקֹּנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיּוֹבֵ֑ל וְיָצָא֙ בַּיֹּבֵ֔ל וְשָׁ֖ב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'm l'mts'h ydv dy hshyb lv vhyh mmkhrv byd hqnh 'tv 'd shnt hyvbl vyts' bybl vshb l'chztv {s}
verses.translation: But if he have not sufficient means to get it back for himself, then that which he hath sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee; and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יִמְכֹּ֤ר בֵּית־מוֹשַׁב֙ עִ֣יר חוֹמָ֔ה וְהָיְתָה֙ גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ עַד־תֹּ֖ם שְׁנַ֣ת מִמְכָּר֑וֹ יָמִ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyymkhr bytmvshb 'yr chvmh vhyth g'ltv 'dtm shnt mmkhrv ymym thyh g'ltv
verses.translation: And if a man sell a dwelling-house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; for a full year shall he have the right of redemption.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם לֹֽא־יִגָּאֵ֗ל עַד־מְלֹ֣את לוֹ֮ שָׁנָ֣ה תְמִימָה֒ וְ֠קָ֠ם הַבַּ֨יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִ֜יר אֲשֶׁר־[ל֣וֹ] (לא) חֹמָ֗ה לַצְּמִיתֻ֛ת לַקֹּנֶ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָ֑יו לֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א בַּיֹּבֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'm l'yg'l 'dml't lv shnh tmymh vqm hbyt 'shrb'yr 'shr[lv] (l') chmh ltsmytt lqnh 'tv ldrtyv l' yts' bybl
verses.translation: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him that bought it, throughout his generations; it shall not go out in the jubilee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָתֵּ֣י הַחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵין־לָהֶ֤ם חֹמָה֙ סָבִ֔יב עַל־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב גְּאֻלָּה֙ תִּהְיֶה־לּ֔וֹ וּבַיֹּבֵ֖ל יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vbty hchtsrym 'shr 'ynlhm chmh sbyb 'lshdh h'rts ychshb g'lh thyhlv vbybl yts'
verses.translation: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country; they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָרֵי֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בָּתֵּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אֲחֻזָּתָ֑ם גְּאֻלַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ry hlvym bty 'ry 'chztm g'lt 'vlm thyh llvym
verses.translation: But as for the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, the Levites shall have a perpetual right of redemption.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגְאַל֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְיָצָ֧א מִמְכַּר־בַּ֛יִת וְעִ֥יר אֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ בַּיֹּבֵ֑ל כִּ֣י בָתֵּ֞י עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֗ם הִ֚וא אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'shr yg'l mnhlvym vyts' mmkhrbyt v'yr 'chztv bybl khy bty 'ry hlvym hv' 'chztm btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold in the city of his possession, shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽשְׂדֵ֛ה מִגְרַ֥שׁ עָרֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יִמָּכֵ֑ר כִּֽי־אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ה֖וּא לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshdh mgrsh 'ryhm l' ymkhr khy'chzt 'vlm hv' lhm {s}
verses.translation: But the fields of the open land about their cities may not be sold; for that is their perpetual possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָ֥טָה יָד֖וֹ עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהֶֽחֱזַ֣קְתָּ בּ֔וֹ גֵּ֧ר וְתוֹשָׁ֛ב וָחַ֖י עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vkhyymvkh 'chykh vmth ydv 'mkh vhchzqt bv gr vtvshb vchy 'mkh
verses.translation: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and his means fail with thee; then thou shalt uphold him: as a stranger and a settler shall he live with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽאִתּוֹ֙ נֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּ֔ית וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְחֵ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'ltqch m'tv nshkh vtrbyt vyr't m'lhykh vchy 'chykh 'mkh
verses.translation: Take thou no interest of him or increase; but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֨ת־כַּסְפְּךָ֔ לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן ל֖וֹ בְּנֶ֑שֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּ֖ית לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן אׇכְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'tkhspkh l'ttn lv bnshkh vbmrbyt l'ttn 'khlkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon interest, nor give him thy victuals for increase.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֗י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָתֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shrhvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym ltt lkhm 't'rts khn'n lhyvt lkhm l'lhym {s}
verses.translation: I am the LORD your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, to be your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָמ֥וּךְ אָחִ֛יךָ עִמָּ֖ךְ וְנִמְכַּר־לָ֑ךְ לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ד בּ֖וֹ עֲבֹ֥דַת עָֽבֶד׃
verses.translit: vkhyymvkh 'chykh 'mkh vnmkhrlkh l't'bd bv 'bdt 'bd
verses.translation: And if thy brother be waxen poor with thee, and sell himself unto thee, thou shalt not make him to serve as a bondservant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשָׂכִ֥יר כְּתוֹשָׁ֖ב יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֑ךְ עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַעֲבֹ֥ד עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khshkhyr khtvshb yhyh 'mkh 'dshnt hybl y'bd 'mkh
verses.translation: As a hired servant, and as a settler, he shall be with thee; he shall serve with thee unto the year of jubilee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָא֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ ה֖וּא וּבָנָ֣יו עִמּ֑וֹ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ וְאֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖יו יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: vyts' m'mkh hv' vbnyv 'mv vshb 'lmshpchtv v'l'chzt 'btyv yshvb
verses.translation: Then shall he go out from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עֲבָדַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לֹ֥א יִמָּכְר֖וּ מִמְכֶּ֥רֶת עָֽבֶד׃
verses.translit: khy'bdy hm 'shrhvts'ty 'tm m'rts mtsrym l' ymkhrv mmkhrt 'bd
verses.translation: For they are My servants, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖וֹ בְּפָ֑רֶךְ וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: l'trdh bv bprkh vyr't m'lhykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיוּ־לָ֑ךְ מֵאֵ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵהֶ֥ם תִּקְנ֖וּ עֶ֥בֶד וְאָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'bdkh v'mtkh 'shr yhyvlkh m't hgvym 'shr sbybtykhm mhm tqnv 'bd v'mh
verses.translation: And as for thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, whom thou mayest have: of the nations that are round about you, of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠גַ֠ם מִבְּנֵ֨י הַתּוֹשָׁבִ֜ים הַגָּרִ֤ים עִמָּכֶם֙ מֵהֶ֣ם תִּקְנ֔וּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹלִ֖ידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לַֽאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vgm mbny htvshbym hgrym 'mkhm mhm tqnv vmmshpchtm 'shr 'mkhm 'shr hvlydv b'rtskhm vhyv lkhm l'chzh
verses.translation: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them may ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they have begotten in your land; and they may be your possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֜ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֤ם אַחֲרֵיכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֲחֻזָּ֔ה לְעֹלָ֖ם בָּהֶ֣ם תַּעֲבֹ֑דוּ וּבְאַ֨חֵיכֶ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לֹא־תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖וֹ בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhtnchltm 'tm lbnykhm 'chrykhm lrsht 'chzh l'lm bhm t'bdv vb'chykhm bnyyshr'l 'ysh b'chyv l'trdh bv bprkh {s}
verses.translation: And ye may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession: of them may ye take your bondmen for ever; but over your brethren the children of Israel ye shall not rule, one over another, with rigour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֣י תַשִּׂ֗יג יַ֣ד גֵּ֤ר וְתוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ וּמָ֥ךְ אָחִ֖יךָ עִמּ֑וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֗ר לְגֵ֤ר תּוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ א֥וֹ לְעֵ֖קֶר מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת גֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhy tshyg yd gr vtvshb 'mkh vmkh 'chykh 'mv vnmkhr lgr tvshb 'mkh 'v l'qr mshpcht gr
verses.translation: And if a stranger who is a settler with thee be waxen rich, and thy brother be waxen poor beside him, and sell himself unto the stranger who is a settler with thee, or to the offshoot of a stranger’s family,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י נִמְכַּ֔ר גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶה־לּ֑וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מֵאֶחָ֖יו יִגְאָלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'chry nmkhr g'lh thyhlv 'chd m'chyv yg'lnv
verses.translation: after that he is sold he may be redeemed; one of his brethren may redeem him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹ־דֹד֞וֹ א֤וֹ בֶן־דֹּדוֹ֙ יִגְאָלֶ֔נּוּ אֽוֹ־מִשְּׁאֵ֧ר בְּשָׂר֛וֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ יִגְאָלֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־הִשִּׂ֥יגָה יָד֖וֹ וְנִגְאָֽל׃
verses.translit: 'vddv 'v bnddv yg'lnv 'vmsh'r bshrv mmshpchtv yg'lnv 'vhshygh ydv vng'l
verses.translation: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be waxen rich, he may redeem himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִשַּׁב֙ עִם־קֹנֵ֔הוּ מִשְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְרוֹ ל֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְהָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vchshb 'mqnhv mshnt hmkhrv lv 'd shnt hybl vhyh khsf mmkhrv bmspr shnym khymy shkhyr yhyh 'mv
verses.translation: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he sold himself to him unto the year of jubilee; and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־ע֥וֹד רַבּ֖וֹת בַּשָּׁנִ֑ים לְפִיהֶן֙ יָשִׁ֣יב גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ מִכֶּ֖סֶף מִקְנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'm'vd rbvt bshnym lpyhn yshyb g'ltv mkhsf mqntv
verses.translation: If there be yet many years, according unto them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מְעַ֞ט נִשְׁאַ֧ר בַּשָּׁנִ֛ים עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל וְחִשַּׁב־ל֑וֹ כְּפִ֣י שָׁנָ֔יו יָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mm't nsh'r bshnym 'dshnt hybl vchshblv khpy shnyv yshyb 'tg'ltv
verses.translation: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according unto his years shall he give back the price of his redemption.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּשְׂכִ֥יר שָׁנָ֛ה בְּשָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יִרְדֶּ֥נּֽוּ בְּפֶ֖רֶךְ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khshkhyr shnh bshnh yhyh 'mv l'yrdnv bprkh l'ynykh
verses.translation: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him; he shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל בְּאֵ֑לֶּה וְיָצָא֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֔ל ה֖וּא וּבָנָ֥יו עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'ml' yg'l b'lh vyts' bshnt hybl hv' vbnyv 'mv
verses.translation: And if he be not redeemed by any of these means, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he, and his children with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לִ֤י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבָדִ֔ים עֲבָדַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khyly bnyyshr'l 'bdym 'bdy hm 'shrhvts'ty 'vtm m'rts mtsrym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: For unto Me the children of Israel are servants; they are My servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l't'shv lkhm 'lylm vpsl vmtsbh l'tqymv lkhm v'bn mshkhyt l' ttnv b'rtskhm lhshtchvt 'lyh khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall make you no idols, neither shall ye rear you up a graven image, or a pillar, neither shall ye place any figured stone in your land, to bow down unto it; for I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'tshbtty tshmrv vmqdshy tyr'v 'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Ye shall keep My sabbaths, and reverence My sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mbchqty tlkhv v'tmtsvty tshmrv v'shytm 'tm
verses.translation: If ye walk in My statutes, and keep My commandments, and do them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vntty gshmykhm b'tm vntnh h'rts ybvlh v'ts hshdh ytn pryv
verses.translation: then I will give your rains in their season, and the land shall yield her produce, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֙יִשׁ֙ אֶת־בָּצִ֔יר וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhshyg lkhm dysh 'tbtsyr vbtsyr yshyg 'tzr' v'khltm lchmkhm lshb' vyshbtm lbtch b'rtskhm
verses.translation: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time; and ye shall eat your bread until ye have enough, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty shlvm b'rts vshkhbtm v'yn mchryd vhshbty chyh r'h mnh'rts vchrb l't'br b'rtskhm
verses.translation: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid; and I will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָפְל֥וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vrdptm 't'ybykhm vnplv lpnykhm lchrb
verses.translation: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָדְפ֨וּ מִכֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּמֵאָ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְנָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vrdpv mkhm chmshh m'h vm'h mkhm rbbh yrdpv vnplv 'ybykhm lpnykhm lchrb
verses.translation: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vpnyty 'lykhm vhpryty 'tkhm vhrbyty 'tkhm vhqymty 'tbryty 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you; and will establish My covenant with you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃
verses.translit: v'khltm yshn nvshn vyshn mpny chdsh tvtsy'v
verses.translation: And ye shall eat old store long kept, and ye shall bring forth the old from before the new.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty mshkhny btvkhkhm vl'tg'l npshy 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will set My tabernacle among you, and My soul shall not abhor you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhthlkhty btvkhkhm vhyyty lkhm l'lhym v'tm thyvly l'm
verses.translation: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be My people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym mhyt lhm 'bdym v'shbr mtt 'lkhm v'vlkh 'tkhm qvmmyvt {p}
verses.translation: I am the LORD your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'ml' tshm'v ly vl' t'shv 't khlhmtsvt h'lh
verses.translation: But if ye will not hearken unto Me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְאִ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י לְהַפְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־בְּרִיתִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mbchqty tm'sv v'm 'tmshpty tg'l npshkhm lblty 'shvt 'tkhlmtsvty lhprkhm 'tbryty
verses.translation: and if ye shall reject My statutes, and if your soul abhor Mine ordinances, so that ye will not do all My commandments, but break My covenant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֗ם וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְאֶת־הַקַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּמְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָרִיק֙ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'f'ny ''shhz't lkhm vhpqdty 'lykhm bhlh 'thshchpt v'thqdcht mkhlvt 'ynym vmdybt npsh vzr'tm lryq zr'khm v'khlhv 'ybykhm
verses.translation: I also will do this unto you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall make the eyes to fail, and the soul to languish; and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י פָנַי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְנִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין־רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty pny bkhm vngptm lpny 'ybykhm vrdv bkhm shn'ykhm vnstm v'ynrdf 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will set My face against you, and ye shall be smitten before your enemies; they that hate you shall rule over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־עַד־אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּי֙ לְיַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'm'd'lh l' tshm'v ly vyspty lysrh 'tkhm shb' 'lcht'tykhm
verses.translation: And if ye will not yet for these things hearken unto Me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־שְׁמֵיכֶם֙ כַּבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶֽת־אַרְצְכֶ֖ם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vshbrty 'tg'vn 'zkhm vntty 'tshmykhm khbrzl v't'rtskhm khnchshh
verses.translation: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתַ֥ם לָרִ֖יק כֹּחֲכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְכֶם֙ אֶת־יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֣ץ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtm lryq khchkhm vl'ttn 'rtskhm 'tybvlh v'ts h'rts l' ytn pryv
verses.translation: And your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield her produce, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּי֙ קֶ֔רִי וְלֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mtlkhv 'my qry vl' t'bv lshm' ly vyspty 'lykhm mkhh shb' khcht'tykhm
verses.translation: And if ye walk contrary unto Me, and will not hearken unto Me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָכֶ֜ם אֶת־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְשִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִכְרִ֙יתָה֙ אֶת־בְּהֶמְתְּכֶ֔ם וְהִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhshlchty bkhm 'tchyt hshdh vshkhlh 'tkhm vhkhryth 'tbhmtkhm vhm'yth 'tkhm vnshmv drkhykhm
verses.translation: And I will send the beast of the field among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your ways shall become desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־בְּאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י קֶֽרִי׃
verses.translit: v'mb'lh l' tvsrv ly vhlkhtm 'my qry
verses.translation: And if in spite of these things ye will not be corrected unto Me, but will walk contrary unto Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף־אֲנִ֛י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֑רִי וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ גַּם־אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhlkhty 'f'ny 'mkhm bqry vhkhyty 'tkhm gm'ny shb' 'lcht'tykhm
verses.translation: then will I also walk contrary unto you; and I will smite you, even I, seven times for your sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֙מֶת֙ נְקַם־בְּרִ֔ית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל־עָרֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֙בֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְנִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּיַד־אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'lykhm chrb nqmt nqmbryt vn'sptm 'l'rykhm vshlchty dbr btvkhkhm vnttm byd'vyb
verses.translation: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute the vengeance of the covenant; and ye shall be gathered together within your cities; and I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשִׁבְרִ֣י לָכֶם֮ מַטֵּה־לֶ֒חֶם֒ וְ֠אָפ֠וּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְכֶם֙ בְּתַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְהֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְכֶ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bshbry lkhm mthlchm v'pv 'shr nshym lchmkhm btnvr 'chd vhshybv lchmkhm bmshql v'khltm vl' tshb'v {s}
verses.translation: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight; and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־בְּזֹ֔את לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃
verses.translit: v'mbz't l' tshm'v ly vhlkhtm 'my bqry
verses.translation: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto Me, but walk contrary unto Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָלַכְתִּ֥י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בַּחֲמַת־קֶ֑רִי וְיִסַּרְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אַף־אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhlkhty 'mkhm bchmtqry vysrty 'tkhm 'f'ny shb' 'lcht'tykhm
verses.translation: then I will walk contrary unto you in fury; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וּבְשַׂ֥ר בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: v'khltm bshr bnykhm vbshr bntykhm t'khlv
verses.translation: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֞י אֶת־בָּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִכְרַתִּי֙ אֶת־חַמָּ֣נֵיכֶ֔ם וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־פִּגְרֵיכֶ֔ם עַל־פִּגְרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וְגָעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhshmdty 'tbmtykhm vhkhrty 'tchmnykhm vntty 'tpgrykhm 'lpgry glvlykhm vg'lh npshy 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your sun-pillars, and cast your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols; and My soul shall abhor you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־עָֽרֵיכֶם֙ חׇרְבָּ֔ה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אָרִ֔יחַ בְּרֵ֖יחַ נִיחֹֽחֲכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty 't'rykhm chrbh vhshmvty 'tmqdshykhm vl' 'rych brych nychchkhm
verses.translation: And I will make your cities a waste, and will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָֽׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֹֽיְבֵיכֶ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhshmty 'ny 'th'rts vshmmv 'lyh 'ybykhm hyshbym bh
verses.translation: And I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ אֱזָרֶ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם חָ֑רֶב וְהָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצְכֶם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְעָרֵיכֶ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ חׇרְבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tkhm 'zrh bgvym vhryqty 'chrykhm chrb vhyth 'rtskhm shmmh v'rykhm yhyv chrbh
verses.translation: And you will I scatter among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you; and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָז֩ תִּרְצֶ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י הׇשַּׁמָּ֔הֿ וְאַתֶּ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם אָ֚ז תִּשְׁבַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְצָ֖ת אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'z trtsh h'rts 'tshbttyh khl ymy hshmh v'tm b'rts 'ybykhm 'z tshbt h'rts vhrtst 'tshbttyh
verses.translation: Then shall the land be paid her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye are in your enemies’land; even then shall the land rest, and repay her sabbaths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י הׇשַּׁמָּ֖הֿ תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־שָׁבְתָ֛ה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: khlymy hshmh tshbt 't 'shr l'shbth bshbttykhm bshbtkhm 'lyh
verses.translation: As long as it lieth desolate it shall have rest; even the rest which it had not in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵבֵ֤אתִי מֹ֙רֶךְ֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְרָדַ֣ף אֹתָ֗ם ק֚וֹל עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֔ף וְנָס֧וּ מְנֻֽסַת־חֶ֛רֶב וְנָפְל֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין רֹדֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vhnsh'rym bkhm vhb'ty mrkh blbbm b'rtst 'ybyhm vrdf 'tm qvl 'lh ndf vnsv mnstchrb vnplv v'yn rdf
verses.translation: And as for them that are left of you, I will send a faintness into their heart in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as one fleeth from the sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָשְׁל֧וּ אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֛יו כְּמִפְּנֵי־חֶ֖רֶב וְרֹדֵ֣ף אָ֑יִן וְלֹא־תִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ תְּקוּמָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹֽיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhshlv 'yshb'chyv khmpnychrb vrdf 'yn vl'thyh lkhm tqvmh lpny 'ybykhm
verses.translation: And they shall stumble one upon another, as it were before the sword, when none pursueth; and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְאָכְלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'bdtm bgvym v'khlh 'tkhm 'rts 'ybykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֗ם יִמַּ֙קּוּ֙ בַּֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַ֛ף בַּעֲוֺנֹ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖ם אִתָּ֥ם יִמָּֽקּוּ׃
verses.translit: vhnsh'rym bkhm ymqv b'vnm b'rtst 'ybykhm v'f b'vnt 'btm 'tm ymqv
verses.translation: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְוַדּ֤וּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָם֙ וְאֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־בִ֑י וְאַ֕ף אֲשֶׁר־הָֽלְכ֥וּ עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃
verses.translit: vhtvdv 't'vnm v't'vn 'btm bm'lm 'shr m'lvby v'f 'shrhlkhv 'my bqry
verses.translation: And they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their treachery which they committed against Me, and also that they have walked contrary unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־אֲנִ֗י אֵלֵ֤ךְ עִמָּם֙ בְּקֶ֔רִי וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם בְּאֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם אוֹ־אָ֣ז יִכָּנַ֗ע לְבָבָם֙ הֶֽעָרֵ֔ל וְאָ֖ז יִרְצ֥וּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'f'ny 'lkh 'mm bqry vhb'ty 'tm b'rts 'ybyhm 'v'z ykhn' lbbm h'rl v'z yrtsv 't'vnm
verses.translation: I also will walk contrary unto them, and bring them into the land of their enemies; if then perchance their uncircumcised heart be humbled, and they then be paid the punishment of their iniquity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י יַעֲק֑וֹב וְאַף֩ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֨י יִצְחָ֜ק וְאַ֨ף אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.translit: vzkhrty 'tbryty y'qvb v'f 'tbryty ytschq v'f 'tbryty 'brhm 'zkhr vh'rts 'zkhr
verses.translation: then will I remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֩רֶץ֩ תֵּעָזֵ֨ב מֵהֶ֜ם וְתִ֣רֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ בׇּהְשַׁמָּהֿ֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְהֵ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָ֑ם יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֔עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֖י גָּעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vh'rts t'zb mhm vtrts 'tshbttyh bhshmh mhm vhm yrtsv 't'vnm y'n vby'n bmshpty m'sv v'tchqty g'lh npshm
verses.translation: For the land shall lie forsaken without them, and shall be paid her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them; and they shall be paid the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected Mine ordinances, and their soul abhorred My statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַף־גַּם־זֹ֠את בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֞ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֗ם לֹֽא־מְאַסְתִּ֤ים וְלֹֽא־גְעַלְתִּים֙ לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'fgmz't bhyvtm b'rts 'ybyhm l'm'stym vl'g'ltym lkhltm lhpr bryty 'tm khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵֽאתִי־אֹתָם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֗ם לִהְי֥וֹת לָהֶ֛ם לֵאלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vzkhrty lhm bryt r'shnym 'shr hvts'ty'tm m'rts mtsrym l'yny hgvym lhyvt lhm l'lhym 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ וְהַתּוֹרֹת֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן יְהֹוָ֔ה בֵּינ֕וֹ וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hchqym vhmshptym vhtvrt 'shr ntn yhvh bynv vbyn bny yshr'l bhr syny bydmshh {p}
verses.translation: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws, which the LORD made between Him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh khy ypl' ndr b'rkhkh npsht lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When a man shall clearly utter a vow of persons unto the LORD, according to thy valuation,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר מִבֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֗ חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'rkhkh hzkhr mbn 'shrym shnh v'd bnshshym shnh vhyh 'rkhkh chmshym shql khsf bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: then thy valuation shall be for the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־נְקֵבָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל׃
verses.translit: v'mnqbh hv' vhyh 'rkhkh shlshym shql
verses.translation: And if it be a female, then thy valuation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם מִבֶּן־חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים וְעַד֙ בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה עֶרְכְּךָ֛ הַזָּכָ֖ר עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'm mbnchmsh shnym v'd bn'shrym shnh vhyh 'rkhkh hzkhr 'shrym shqlym vlnqbh 'shrt shqlym
verses.translation: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy valuation shall be for the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם מִבֶּן־חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן־חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'm mbnchdsh v'd bnchmsh shnym vhyh 'rkhkh hzkhr chmshh shqlym khsf vlnqbh 'rkhkh shlsht shqlym khsf
verses.translation: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy valuation shall be for the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אִ֠ם מִבֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ אִם־זָכָ֔ר וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'm mbnshshym shnh vm'lh 'mzkhr vhyh 'rkhkh chmshh 'shr shql vlnqbh 'shrh shqlym
verses.translation: And if it be from sixty years old and upward: if it be a male, then thy valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מָ֥ךְ הוּא֙ מֵֽעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהֶֽעֱמִידוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹת֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד הַנֹּדֵ֔ר יַעֲרִיכֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mmkh hv' m'rkhkh vh'mydv lpny hkhhn vh'rykh 'tv hkhhn 'lpy 'shr tshyg yd hndr y'rykhnv hkhhn {s}
verses.translation: But if he be too poor for thy valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the means of him that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קׇרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מִמֶּ֛נּוּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'mbhmh 'shr yqrybv mmnh qrbn lyhvh khl 'shr ytn mmnv lyhvh yhyhqdsh
verses.translation: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמִ֥יר אֹת֛וֹ ט֥וֹב בְּרָ֖ע אוֹ־רַ֣ע בְּט֑וֹב וְאִם־הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־ה֥וּא וּתְמוּרָת֖וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: l' ychlypnv vl'ymyr 'tv tvb br' 'vr' btvb v'mhmr ymyr bhmh bbhmh vhyhhv' vtmvrtv yhyhqdsh
verses.translation: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֙ כׇּל־בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹא־יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קׇרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱמִ֥יד אֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v'm khlbhmh tm'h 'shr l'yqrybv mmnh qrbn lyhvh vh'myd 'thbhmh lpny hkhhn
verses.translation: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they may not bring an offering unto the LORD, then he shall set the beast before the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱרִ֤יךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔הּ בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'rykh hkhhn 'th byn tvb vbyn r' kh'rkhkh hkhhn khn yhyh
verses.translation: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad; as thou the priest valuest it, so shall it be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑נָּה וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ עַל־עֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'mg'l yg'lnh vysf chmyshtv 'l'rkhkh
verses.translation: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part thereof unto thy valuation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת־בֵּית֥וֹ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyyqdsh 'tbytv qdsh lyhvh vh'rykhv hkhhn byn tvb vbyn r' kh'shr y'rykh 'tv hkhhn khn yqvm
verses.translation: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad; as the priest shall value it, so shall it stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת־בֵּית֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַ֠ף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mhmqdysh yg'l 'tbytv vysf chmyshyt khsf'rkhkh 'lyv vhyh lv
verses.translation: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy valuation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם  מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֗וֹ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ לְפִ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ זֶ֚רַע חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'm  mshdh 'chztv yqdysh 'ysh lyhvh vhyh 'rkhkh lpy zr'v zr' chmr sh'rym bchmshym shql khsf
verses.translation: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD part of the field of his possession, then thy valuation shall be according to the sowing thereof; the sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖ יָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: 'mmshnt hybl yqdysh shdhv kh'rkhkh yqvm
verses.translation: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy valuation it shall stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֒הוּ֒ וְחִשַּׁב־ל֨וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל־פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'm'chr hybl yqdysh shdhv vchshblv hkhhn 'thkhsf 'lpy hshnym hnvtrt 'd shnt hybl vngr' m'rkhkh
verses.translation: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain unto the year of jubilee, and an abatement shall be made from thy valuation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַ֠ף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְקָ֥ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mg'l yg'l 'thshdh hmqdysh 'tv vysf chmshyt khsf'rkhkh 'lyv vqm lv
verses.translation: And if he that sanctified the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy valuation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם־מָכַ֥ר אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: v'ml' yg'l 'thshdh v'mmkhr 'thshdh l'ysh 'chr l' yg'l 'vd
verses.translation: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
