verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאת֣וֹ בַיֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַכֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh hshdh bts'tv bybl qdsh lyhvh khshdh hchrm lkhhn thyh 'chztv
verses.translation: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֙ אֶת־שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'm 'tshdh mqntv 'shr l' mshdh 'chztv yqdysh lyhvh
verses.translation: And if he sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the field of his possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִשַּׁב־ל֣וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת־הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vchshblv hkhhn 't mkhst h'rkhkh 'd shnt hybl vntn 'th'rkhkh byvm hhv' qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy valuation unto the year of jubilee; and he shall give thy valuation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיּוֹבֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לַאֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: bshnt hyvbl yshvb hshdh l'shr qnhv m'tv l'shrlv 'chzt h'rts
verses.translation: In the year of jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇ֨ל־עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃
verses.translit: vkhl'rkhkh yhyh bshql hqdsh 'shrym grh yhyh hshql
verses.translation: And all thy valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary; twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בְּכ֞וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהֹוָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ אִם־שׁ֣וֹר אִם־שֶׂ֔ה לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: 'khbkhvr 'shrybkhr lyhvh bbhmh l'yqdysh 'ysh 'tv 'mshvr 'mshh lyhvh hv'
verses.translation: Howbeit the firstling among beasts, which is born as a firstling to the LORD, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox or sheep, it is the LORD’S.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'm bbhmh htm'h vpdh b'rkhkh vysf chmshtv 'lyv v'ml' yg'l vnmkhr b'rkhkh
verses.translation: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall ransom it according to thy valuation, and shall add unto it the fifth part thereof; or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy valuation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־כׇּל־חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהֹוָ֜ה מִכׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כׇּל־חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קׇדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'khkhlchrm 'shr ychrm 'ysh lyhvh mkhl'shrlv m'dm vbhmh vmshdh 'chztv l' ymkhr vl' yg'l khlchrm qdshqdshym hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man may devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, whether of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יׇחֳרַ֛ם מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: khlchrm 'shr ychrm mnh'dm l' ypdh mvt yvmt
verses.translation: None devoted, that may be devoted of men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהֹוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhlm'shr h'rts mzr' h'rts mpry h'ts lyhvh hv' qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’S; it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'mg'l yg'l 'ysh mm'shrv chmshytv ysf 'lyv
verses.translation: And if a man will redeem aught of his tithe, he shall add unto it the fifth part thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhlm'shr bqr vts'n khl 'shry'br tcht hshbt h'shyry yhyhqdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And all the tithe of the herd or the flock, whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין־ט֥וֹב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה־ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: l' ybqr byntvb lr' vl' ymyrnv v'mhmr ymyrnv vhyhhv' vtmvrtv yhyhqdsh l' yg'l
verses.translation: He shall not inquire whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it; and if he change it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lh hmtsvt 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh 'lbny yshr'l bhr syny
verses.translation: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּאֶחָד֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְצֵאתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh bmdbr syny b'hl mv'd b'chd lchdsh hshny bshnh hshnyt lts'tm m'rts mtsrym l'mr
verses.translation: AND THE LORD spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ כׇּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת כׇּל־זָכָ֖ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: sh'v 'tr'sh khl'dt bnyyshr'l lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt khlzkhr lglgltm
verses.translation: ’Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, every male, by their polls;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כׇּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛ם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם אַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khlyts' tsb' byshr'l tpqdv 'tm ltsb'tm 'th v'hrn
verses.translation: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: ye shall number them by their hosts, even thou and Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִתְּכֶ֣ם יִהְי֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַמַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖יו הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'tkhm yhyv 'ysh 'ysh lmth 'ysh r'sh lbyt'btyv hv'
verses.translation: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe, every one head of his fathers’house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם לִרְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt h'nshym 'shr y'mdv 'tkhm lr'vbn 'lytsvr bnshdy'vr
verses.translation: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשִׁמְע֕וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.translit: lshm'vn shlmy'l bntsvryshdy
verses.translation: Of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.translit: lyhvdh nchshvn bn'myndb
verses.translation: Of Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃
verses.translit: lyshshkhr ntn'l bntsv'r
verses.translation: Of Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.translit: lzbvln 'ly'b bnchln
verses.translation: Of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיה֑וּד לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.translit: lbny yvsf l'prym 'lyshm' bn'myhvd lmnshh gmly'l bnpdhtsvr
verses.translation: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: lbnymn 'bydn bngd'ny
verses.translation: Of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.translit: ldn 'chy'zr bn'myshdy
verses.translation: Of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עׇכְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: l'shr pg'y'l bn'khrn
verses.translation: Of Asher, Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְגָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lgd 'lysf bnd'v'l
verses.translation: Of Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃
verses.translit: lnptly 'chyr' bn'ynn
verses.translation: Of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה (קריאי) [קְרוּאֵ֣י] הָעֵדָ֔ה נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטּ֣וֹת אֲבוֹתָ֑ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh (qry'y) [qrv'y] h'dh nshy'y mtvt 'bvtm r'shy 'lpy yshr'l hm
verses.translation: These were the elect of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh v'hrn 't h'nshym h'lh 'shr nqbv bshmt
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron took these men that are pointed out by name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־הָעֵדָ֜ה הִקְהִ֗ילוּ בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל־מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v't khlh'dh hqhylv b'chd lchdsh hshny vytyldv 'lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lglgltm
verses.translation: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh vypqdm bmdbr syny {s}
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so did he number them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כׇּל־זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnyr'vbn bkhr yshr'l tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt lglgltm khlzkhr mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s first-born, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth r'vbn shshh v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם פְּקֻדָ֗יו בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כׇּל־זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny shm'vn tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm pqdyv bmspr shmvt lglgltm khlzkhr mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, those that were numbered thereof, according to the number of names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth shm'vn tsh'h vchmshym 'lf vshlsh m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny gd tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה גָ֑ד חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth gd chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt vchmshym {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny yhvdh tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth yhvdh 'rb'h vshb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny yshshkhr tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth yshshkhr 'rb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny zbvln tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth zbvln shb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny yvsf lbny 'prym tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֶפְרָ֑יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth 'prym 'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny mnshh tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth mnshh shnym vshlshym 'lf vm'tym {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny bnymn tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֑ן חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth bnymn chmshh vshlshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny dn tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה דָ֑ן שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth dn shnym vshshym 'lf vshb' m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: lbny 'shr tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth 'shr 'chd v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: bny nptly tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth nptly shlshh vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt {p}
verses.translation: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וּנְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אִ֑ישׁ אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖יו הָיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lh hpqdym 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn vnshy'y yshr'l shnym 'shr 'ysh 'ysh'chd lbyt'btyv hyv
verses.translation: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men; they were each one for his fathers’house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ כׇּל־פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כׇּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhyv khlpqvdy bnyyshr'l lbyt 'btm mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khlyts' tsb' byshr'l
verses.translation: And all those that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyhyv khlhpqdym shshm'vt 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: even all those that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑ם לֹ֥א הׇתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּתוֹכָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhlvym lmth 'btm l' htpqdv btvkhm {p}
verses.translation: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְאֶת־רֹאשָׁ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'tmth lvy l' tpqd v'tr'shm l' tsh' btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: ’Howbeit the tribe of Levi thou shalt not number, neither shalt thou take the sum of them among the children of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֩ עַל־מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָעֵדֻ֜ת וְעַ֣ל כׇּל־כֵּלָיו֮ וְעַ֣ל כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְהֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑הוּ וְסָבִ֥יב לַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th hpqd 'thlvym 'lmshkhn h'dt v'l khlkhlyv v'l khl'shrlv hmh ysh'v 'thmshkhn v'tkhlkhlyv vhm yshrthv vsbyb lmshkhn ychnv
verses.translation: but appoint thou the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all the furniture thereof, and over all that belongeth to it; they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the furniture thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִנְסֹ֣עַ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּבַחֲנֹת֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖וֹ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vbns' hmshkhn yvrydv 'tv hlvym vbchnt hmshkhn yqymv 'tv hlvym vhzr hqrb yvmt
verses.translation: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up; and the common man that draweth nigh shall be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־דִּגְל֖וֹ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vchnv bny yshr'l 'ysh 'lmchnhv v'ysh 'ldglv ltsb'tm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man with his own camp, and every man with his own standard, according to their hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vhlvym ychnv sbyb lmshkhn h'dt vl'yhyh qtsf 'l'dt bny yshr'l vshmrv hlvym 'tmshmrt mshkhn h'dvt
verses.translation: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of the testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shv {p}
verses.translation: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh v'l'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ עַל־דִּגְל֤וֹ בְאֹתֹת֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִנֶּ֕גֶד סָבִ֥יב לְאֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ldglv b'tt lbyt 'btm ychnv bny yshr'l mngd sbyb l'hlmv'd ychnv
verses.translation: ’The children of Israel shall pitch by their fathers’houses; every man with his own standard, according to the ensigns; a good way off shall they pitch round about the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִים֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.translit: vhchnym qdmh mzrchh dgl mchnh yhvdh ltsb'tm vnshy' lbny yhvdh nchshvn bn'myndb
verses.translation: Now those that pitch on the east side toward the sunrising shall be they of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Judah being Nahshon the son of Amminadab,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm 'rb'h vshb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃
verses.translit: vhchnym 'lyv mth yshshkhr vnshy' lbny yshshkhr ntn'l bntsv'r
verses.translation: and those that pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar; the prince of the children of Issachar being Nethanel the son of Zuar,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyv 'rb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty and four thousand and four hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַטֵּ֖ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.translit: mth zbvln vnshy' lbny zbvln 'ly'b bnchln
verses.translation: and the tribe of Zebulun; the prince of the children of Zebulun being Eliab the son of Helon,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyv shb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered thereof, fifty and seven thousand and four hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוּדָ֗ה מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת־אֲלָפִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֖וֹת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlhpqdym lmchnh yhvdh m't 'lf vshmnym 'lf vshsht'lpym v'rb'm'vt ltsb'tm r'shnh ys'v {s}
verses.translation: all that were numbered of the camp of Judah being a hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, according to their hosts; they shall set forth first.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה רְאוּבֵ֛ן תֵּימָ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.translit: dgl mchnh r'vbn tymnh ltsb'tm vnshy' lbny r'vbn 'lytsvr bnshdy'vr
verses.translation: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Reuben being Elizur the son of Shedeur,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyv shshh v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered thereof, forty and six thousand and five hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחוֹנִ֥ם עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.translit: vhchvnm 'lyv mth shm'vn vnshy' lbny shm'vn shlmy'l bntsvryshdy
verses.translation: and those that pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Simeon; the prince of the children of Simeon being Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm tsh'h vchmshym 'lf vshlsh m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and nine thousand and three hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה גָּ֑ד וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־רְעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vmth gd vnshy' lbny gd 'lysf bnr'v'l
verses.translation: and the tribe of Gad; the prince of the children of Gad being Eliasaph the son of Reuel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֗ן מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וְאֶחָ֨ד וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁנִיִּ֖ם יִסָּֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlhpqdym lmchnh r'vbn m't 'lf v'chd vchmshym 'lf v'rb'm'vt vchmshym ltsb'tm vshnym ys'v {s}
verses.translation: all that were numbered of the camp of Reuben being a hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts; and they shall set forth second.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֧ע אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֛ד מַחֲנֵ֥ה הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲנוּ֙ כֵּ֣ן יִסָּ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־יָד֖וֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vns' 'hlmv'd mchnh hlvym btvkh hmchnt kh'shr ychnv khn ys'v 'ysh 'lydv ldglyhm {s}
verses.translation: Then the tent of meeting, with the camp of the Levites, shall set forward in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place, by their standards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם יָ֑מָּה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.translit: dgl mchnh 'prym ltsb'tm ymh vnshy' lbny 'prym 'lyshm' bn'myhvd
verses.translation: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Ephraim being Elishama the son of Ammihud,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm 'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.translit: v'lyv mth mnshh vnshy' lbny mnshh gmly'l bnpdhtsvr
verses.translation: and next unto him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; the prince of the children of Manasseh being Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm shnym vshlshym 'lf vm'tym
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and two hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vmth bnymn vnshy' lbny bnymn 'bydn bngd'ny
verses.translation: and the tribe of Benjamin; the prince of the children of Benjamin being Abidan the son of Gideoni,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm chmshh vshlshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, thirty and five thousand and four hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֗יִם מְאַ֥ת אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁמֹֽנַת־אֲלָפִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים יִסָּֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlhpqdym lmchnh 'prym m't 'lf vshmnt'lpym vm'h ltsb'tm vshlshym ys'v {s}
verses.translation: all that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim being a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, according to their hosts; and they shall set forth third.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה דָ֛ן צָפֹ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.translit: dgl mchnh dn tspnh ltsb'tm vnshy' lbny dn 'chy'zr bn'myshdy
verses.translation: On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their hosts; the prince of the children of Dan being Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm shnym vshshym 'lf vshb' m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, threescore and two thousand and seven hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עׇכְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: vhchnym 'lyv mth 'shr vnshy' lbny 'shr pg'y'l bn'khrn
verses.translation: and those that pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher; the prince of the children of Asher being Pagiel the son of Ochran,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm 'chd v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty and one thousand and five hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃
verses.translit: vmth nptly vnshy' lbny nptly 'chyr' bn'ynn
verses.translation: and the tribe of Naphtali; the prince of the children of Naphtali being Ahira the son of Enan,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm shlshh vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: and his host, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַפְּקֻדִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲנֵה דָ֔ן מְאַ֣ת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָ֥ה יִסְע֖וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlhpqdym lmchnh dn m't 'lf vshb'h vchmshym 'lf vshsh m'vt l'chrnh ys'v ldglyhm {p}
verses.translation: all that were numbered of the camp of Dan being a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred; they shall set forth hindmost by their standards.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כׇּל־פְּקוּדֵ֤י הַֽמַּחֲנֹת֙ לְצִבְאֹתָ֔ם שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy bnyyshr'l lbyt 'btm khlpqvdy hmchnt ltsb'tm shshm'vt 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’houses; all that were numbered of the camps according to their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹ֣א הׇתְפָּקְד֔וּ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vhlvym l' htpqdv btvkh bny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֵּֽן־חָנ֤וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם֙ וְכֵ֣ן נָסָ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖יו עַל־בֵּ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l khkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh khnchnv ldglyhm vkhn ns'v 'ysh lmshpchtyv 'lbyt 'btyv {p}
verses.translation: Thus did the children of Israel: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, each one according to its families, and according to its fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt 'hrn vmshh byvm dbr yhvh 'tmshh bhr syny
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַבְּכֹ֣ר ׀ נָדָ֑ב וַאֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny'hrn hbkhr  ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt bny 'hrn hkhhnym hmshchym 'shrml' ydm lkhhn
verses.translation: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests that were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇת נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל־פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt ndb v'byhv' lpny yhvh bhqrbm 'sh zrh lpny yhvh bmdbr syny vbnym l'hyv lhm vykhhn 'l'zr v'ytmr 'lpny 'hrn 'byhm {p}
verses.translation: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְרֵב֙ אֶת־מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְשֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hqrb 'tmth lvy vh'mdt 'tv lpny 'hrn hkhhn vshrtv 'tv
verses.translation: ’Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vshmrv 'tmshmrtv v'tmshmrt khlh'dh lpny 'hl mv'd l'bd 't'bdt hmshkhn
verses.translation: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת־כׇּל־כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vshmrv 'tkhlkhly 'hl mv'd v'tmshmrt bny yshr'l l'bd 't'bdt hmshkhn
verses.translation: And they shall keep all the furniture of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֙מָּה֙ ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vntth 'thlvym l'hrn vlbnyv ntvnm ntvnm hmh lv m't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons; they are wholly given unto him from the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't'hrn v'tbnyv tpqd vshmrv 'tkhhntm vhzr hqrb yvmt {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, that they may keep their priesthood; and the common man that draweth nigh shall be put to death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִתּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כׇּל־בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ny hnh lqchty 'thlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l tcht khlbkhvr ptr rchm mbny yshr'l vhyv ly hlvym
verses.translation: ’And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of every first-born that openeth the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be Mine;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לִי֮ כׇּל־בְּכוֹר֒ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כׇל־בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כׇל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד־בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy ly khlbkhvr byvm hkhty khlbkhvr b'rts mtsrym hqdshty ly khlbkhvr byshr'l m'dm 'dbhmh ly yhyv 'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: for all the first-born are Mine: on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto Me all the first-born in Israel, both man and beast, Mine they shall be: I am the LORD.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh bmdbr syny l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כׇּל־זָכָ֛ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה תִּפְקְדֵֽם׃
verses.translit: pqd 'tbny lvy lbyt 'btm lmshpchtm khlzkhr mbnchdsh vm'lh tpqdm
verses.translation: ’Number the children of Levi by their fathers’houses, by their families; every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vypqd 'tm mshh 'lpy yhvh kh'shr tsvh
verses.translation: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhyv'lh bnylvy bshmtm grshvn vqht vmrry
verses.translation: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bnygrshvn lmshpchtm lbny vshm'y
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbny qht lmshpchtm 'mrm vytshr chbrvn v'zy'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny mrry lmshpchtm mchly vmvshy 'lh hm mshpcht hlvy lbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַלִּבְנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃
verses.translit: lgrshvn mshpcht hlbny vmshpcht hshm'y 'lh hm mshpcht hgrshny
verses.translation: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites; these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כׇּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: pqdyhm bmspr khlzkhr mbnchdsh vm'lh pqdyhm shb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: mshpcht hgrshny 'chry hmshkhn ychnv ymh
verses.translation: The families of the Gershonites were to pitch behind the tabernacle westward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־לָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vnshy' byt'b lgrshny 'lysf bnl'l
verses.translation: the prince of the fathers’house of the Gershonites being Eliasaph the son of Lael,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vmshmrt bnygrshvn b'hl mv'd hmshkhn vh'hl mkhshv vmskh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: and the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting the tabernacle, and the Tent, the covering thereof, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת־מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vql'y hchtsr v'tmskh ptch hchtsr 'shr 'lhmshkhn v'lhmzbch sbyb v't mytryv lkhl 'bdtv {s}
verses.translation: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court—which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar, round about—and the cords of it, even whatsoever pertaineth to the service thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָעׇזִּֽיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vlqht mshpcht h'mrmy vmshpcht hytshry vmshpcht hchbrny vmshpcht h'zy'ly 'lh hm mshpcht hqhty
verses.translation: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these are the families of the Kohathites:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כׇּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: bmspr khlzkhr mbnchdsh vm'lh shmnt 'lpym vshsh m'vt shmry mshmrt hqdsh
verses.translation: according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, eight thousand and six hundred, keepers of the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָה׃
verses.translit: mshpcht bnyqht ychnv 'l yrkh hmshkhn tymnh
verses.translation: The families of the sons of Kohath were to pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־אָ֖ב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י אֱלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vnshy' byt'b lmshpcht hqhty 'lytspn bn'zy'l
verses.translation: the prince of the fathers’house of the families of the Kohathites being Elizaphan the son of Uzziel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmshmrtm h'rn vhshlchn vhmnrh vhmzbcht vkhly hqdsh 'shr yshrtv bhm vhmskh vkhl 'bdtv
verses.translation: and their charge the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith the priests minister, and the screen, and all that pertaineth to the service thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vnshy' nshy'y hlvy 'l'zr bn'hrn hkhhn pqdt shmry mshmrt hqdsh
verses.translation: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest being prince of the princes of the Levites, and having the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmrry mshpcht hmchly vmshpcht hmvshy 'lh hm mshpcht mrry
verses.translation: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites; these are the families of Merari.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כׇּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vpqdyhm bmspr khlzkhr mbnchdsh vm'lh shsht 'lpym vm'tym
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית־אָב֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְרָרִ֔י צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־אֲבִיחָ֑יִל עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ צָפֹֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vnshy' byt'b lmshpcht mrry tsvry'l bn'bychyl 'l yrkh hmshkhn ychnv tspnh
verses.translation: the prince of the fathers’house of the families of Merari being Zuriel the son of Abihail; they were to pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקֻדַּ֣ת מִשְׁמֶ֘רֶת֮ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו וַאֲדָנָ֑יו וְכׇ֨ל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vpqdt mshmrt bny mrry qrshy hmshkhn vbrychyv v'mdyv v'dnyv vkhlkhlyv vkhl 'bdtv
verses.translation: the appointed charge of the sons of Merari being the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the instruments thereof, and all that pertaineth to the service thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמֻּדֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֑ם וִיתֵדֹתָ֖ם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mdy hchtsr sbyb v'dnyhm vytdtm vmytryhm
verses.translation: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִ֣ים לִפְנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֡ן קֵ֣דְמָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֨ד ׀ מִזְרָ֜חָה מֹשֶׁ֣ה  וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vhchnym lpny hmshkhn qdmh lpny 'hlmv'd  mzrchh mshh  v'hrn vbnyv shmrym mshmrt hmqdsh lmshmrt bny yshr'l vhzr hqrb yvmt
verses.translation: And those that were to pitch before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, were Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary, even the charge for the children of Israel; and the common man that drew nigh was to be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַלְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄאַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כׇּל־זָכָר֙ מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמַ֔עְלָה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlpqvdy hlvym 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'lpy yhvh lmshpchtm khlzkhr mbnchdsh vm'lh shnym v'shrym 'lf {s}
verses.translation: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כׇּל־בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh pqd khlbkhr zkhr lbny yshr'l mbnchdsh vm'lh vsh' 't mspr shmtm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֨ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֥ם לִי֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת כׇּל־בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵת֙ בֶּהֱמַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֣חַת כׇּל־בְּכ֔וֹר בְּבֶהֱמַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'thlvym ly 'ny yhvh tcht khlbkhr bbny yshr'l v't bhmt hlvym tcht khlbkhvr bbhmt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the Levites for Me, even the LORD, instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ אֶֽת־כׇּל־בְּכ֖וֹר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vypqd mshh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv 'tkhlbkhvr bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כׇל־בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמֹ֛ת מִבֶּן־חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy khlbkhvr zkhr bmspr shmt mbnchdsh vm'lh lpqdyhm shnym v'shrym 'lf shlshh vshb'ym vm'tym {p}
verses.translation: And all the first-born males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַ֣ח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כׇּל־בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑ם וְהָיוּ־לִ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: qch 'thlvym tcht khlbkhvr bbny yshr'l v'tbhmt hlvym tcht bhmtm vhyvly hlvym 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: ’Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be Mine, even the LORD’S.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְהַשִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְהַמָּאתָ֑יִם הָעֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v't pdvyy hshlshh vhshb'ym vhm'tym h'dpym 'lhlvym mbkhvr bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And as for the redemption of the two hundred and three score and thirteen of the first-born of the children of Israel, that are over and above the number of the Levites,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַגֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת בְּשֶׁ֤קֶל הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃
verses.translit: vlqcht chmsht chmsht shqlym lglglt bshql hqdsh tqch 'shrym grh hshql
verses.translation: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll; after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them—the shekel is twenty gerahs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֔סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָעֹדְפִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntth hkhsf l'hrn vlbnyv pdvyy h'dpym bhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt give the money wherewith they that remain over of them are redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף הַפִּדְי֑וֹם מֵאֵת֙ הָעֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't khsf hpdyvm m't h'dpym 'l pdvyy hlvym
verses.translation: And Moses took the redemption-money from them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת־הַכָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָאֶ֖לֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: m't bkhvr bny yshr'l lqch 'thkhsf chmshh vshshym vshlsh m'vt v'lf bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money: a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־כֶּ֧סֶף הַפְּדֻיִ֛ם לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן וּלְבָנָ֖יו עַל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytn mshh 'tkhsf hpdym l'hrn vlbnyv 'lpy yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh v'l'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: nsh' 'tr'sh bny qht mtvkh bny lvy lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm
verses.translation: ’Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’houses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כׇּל־בָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bnchmshym shnh khlb' ltsb' l'shvt ml'khh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do work in the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֛את עֲבֹדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: z't 'bdt bnyqht b'hl mv'd qdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, about the most holy things:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֨א אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהוֹרִ֕דוּ אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֑ךְ וְכִ֨סּוּ־בָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
verses.translit: vb' 'hrn vbnyv bns' hmchnh vhvrdv 't prkht hmskh vkhsvbh 't 'rn h'dt
verses.translation: when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the testimony with it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּסוּי֙ ע֣וֹר תַּ֔חַשׁ וּפָרְשׂ֧וּ בֶֽגֶד־כְּלִ֛יל תְּכֵ֖לֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂמ֖וּ בַּדָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vntnv 'lyv khsvy 'vr tchsh vprshv bgdkhlyl tkhlt mlm'lh vshmv bdyv
verses.translation: and shall put thereon a covering of sealskin, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall set the staves thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  שֻׁלְחַ֣ן הַפָּנִ֗ים יִפְרְשׂוּ֮ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֒לֶת֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָ֠יו אֶת־הַקְּעָרֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַכַּפֹּת֙ וְאֶת־הַמְּנַקִּיֹּ֔ת וְאֵ֖ת קְשׂ֣וֹת הַנָּ֑סֶךְ וְלֶ֥חֶם הַתָּמִ֖יד עָלָ֥יו יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'l  shlchn hpnym yprshv bgd tkhlt vntnv 'lyv 'thq'rt v'thkhpt v'thmnqyt v't qshvt hnskh vlchm htmyd 'lyv yhyh
verses.translation: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the pans, and the bowls, and the jars wherewith to pour out; and the continual bread shall remain thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם בֶּ֚גֶד תּוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת־בַּדָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vprshv 'lyhm bgd tvl't shny vkhsv 'tv bmkhsh 'vr tchsh vshmv 'tbdyv
verses.translation: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall set the staves thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקְח֣וּ  בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֗לֶת וְכִסּ֞וּ אֶת־מְנֹרַ֤ת הַמָּאוֹר֙ וְאֶת־נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־מַלְקָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־מַחְתֹּתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־כְּלֵ֣י שַׁמְנָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְתוּ־לָ֖הּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vlqchv  bgd tkhlt vkhsv 'tmnrt hm'vr v'tnrtyh v'tmlqchyh v'tmchttyh v't khlkhly shmnh 'shr yshrtvlh bhm
verses.translation: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתְנ֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלֶ֔יהָ אֶל־מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל־הַמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: vntnv 'th v'tkhlkhlyh 'lmkhsh 'vr tchsh vntnv 'lhmvt
verses.translation: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֗ב יִפְרְשׂוּ֙ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת־בַּדָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'l  mzbch hzhb yprshv bgd tkhlt vkhsv 'tv bmkhsh 'vr tchsh vshmv 'tbdyv
verses.translation: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall set the staves thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקְחוּ֩ אֶת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֨י הַשָּׁרֵ֜ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ־בָ֣ם בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ וְנָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶל־בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל־הַמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: vlqchv 'tkhlkhly hshrt 'shr yshrtvbm bqdsh vntnv 'lbgd tkhlt vkhsv 'vtm bmkhsh 'vr tchsh vntnv 'lhmvt
verses.translation: And they shall take all the vessels of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on a bar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִשְּׁנ֖וּ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֔יו בֶּ֖גֶד אַרְגָּמָֽן׃
verses.translit: vdshnv 'thmzbch vprshv 'lyv bgd 'rgmn
verses.translation: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָ֠יו אֶֽת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֞יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְֽשָׁרְת֧וּ עָלָ֣יו בָּהֶ֗ם אֶת־הַמַּחְתֹּ֤ת אֶת־הַמִּזְלָגֹת֙ וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּס֛וּי ע֥וֹר תַּ֖חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֥וּ בַדָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vntnv 'lyv 'tkhlkhlyv 'shr yshrtv 'lyv bhm 'thmchtt 'thmzlgt v'thy'ym v'thmzrqt khl khly hmzbch vprshv 'lyv khsvy 'vr tchsh vshmv bdyv
verses.translation: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the fire-pans, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of sealskin, and set the staves thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִלָּ֣ה אַֽהֲרֹן־וּ֠בָנָ֠יו לְכַסֹּ֨ת אֶת־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֘דֶשׁ֮ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֒ וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן יָבֹ֤אוּ בְנֵי־קְהָת֙ לָשֵׂ֔את וְלֹֽא־יִגְּע֥וּ אֶל־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵ֑תוּ אֵ֛לֶּה מַשָּׂ֥א בְנֵֽי־קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vkhlh 'hrnvbnyv lkhst 'thqdsh v'tkhlkhly hqdsh bns' hmchnh v'chrykhn yb'v bnyqht lsh't vl'yg'v 'lhqdsh vmtv 'lh msh' bnyqht b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the holy furniture, and all the holy vessels, as the camp is to set forward—after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear them; but they shall not touch the holy things, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקֻדַּ֞ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר  בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמָּאוֹר֙ וּקְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֔ים וּמִנְחַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה פְּקֻדַּ֗ת כׇּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֔וֹ בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vpqdt 'l'zr  bn'hrn hkhhn shmn hm'vr vqtrt hsmym vmncht htmyd vshmn hmshchh pqdt khlhmshkhn vkhl'shrbv bqdsh vbkhlyv {p}
verses.translation: And the charge of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the continual meal-offering, and the anointing oil: he shall have the charge of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, whether it be the sanctuary, or the furniture thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh v'l'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּכְרִ֕יתוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֖בֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י מִתּ֖וֹךְ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltkhrytv 'tshbt mshpcht hqhty mtvkh hlvym
verses.translation: ’Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֣את  עֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם וְחָיוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֔תוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּ֖ם אֶת־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ יָבֹ֔אוּ וְשָׂמ֣וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל־עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְאֶל־מַשָּׂאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vz't  'shv lhm vchyv vl' ymtv bgshtm 'tqdsh hqdshym 'hrn vbnyv yb'v vshmv 'vtm 'ysh 'ysh 'l'bdtv v'lmsh'v
verses.translation: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יָבֹ֧אוּ לִרְא֛וֹת כְּבַלַּ֥ע אֶת־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵֽתוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'yb'v lr'vt khbl' 'thqdsh vmtv {p}
verses.translation: but they shall not go in to see the holy things as they are being covered, lest they die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן גַּם־הֵ֑ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: nsh' 'tr'sh bny grshvn gmhm lbyt 'btm lmshpchtm
verses.translation: ’Take the sum of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’houses, by their families;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה עַ֛ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקֹ֣ד אוֹתָ֑ם כׇּל־הַבָּא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֥ד עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh 'd bnchmshym shnh tpqd 'vtm khlhb' ltsb' tsb' l'bd 'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them: all that enter in to wait upon the service, to do service in the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י לַעֲבֹ֖ד וּלְמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: z't 'bdt mshpcht hgrshny l'bd vlmsh'
verses.translation: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָ֨שְׂא֜וּ אֶת־יְרִיעֹ֤ת הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמִכְסֵ֛ה הַתַּ֥חַשׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶ֨ת־מָסַ֔ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vnsh'v 'tyry't hmshkhn v't'hl mv'd mkhshv vmkhsh htchsh 'shr'lyv mlm'lh v'tmskh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above upon it, and the screen for the door of the tent of meeting;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר וְאֶת־מָסַ֣ךְ  פֶּ֣תַח  שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֤ן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתְרֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶֽת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֖י עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם וְעָבָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: v't ql'y hchtsr v'tmskh  ptch  sh'r hchtsr 'shr 'lhmshkhn v'lhmzbch sbyb v't mytryhm v'tkhlkhly 'bdtm v't khl'shr y'shh lhm v'bdv
verses.translation: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatsoever there may be to do with them, therein shall they serve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פִּי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו תִּהְיֶ֗ה כׇּל־עֲבֹדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֔י לְכׇ֨ל־מַשָּׂאָ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וּפְקַדְתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵהֶם֙ בְּמִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת אֵ֖ת כׇּל־מַשָּׂאָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lpy 'hrn vbnyv thyh khl'bdt bny hgrshny lkhlmsh'm vlkhl 'bdtm vpqdtm 'lhm bmshmrt 't khlmsh'm
verses.translation: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּמִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: z't 'bdt mshpcht bny hgrshny b'hl mv'd vmshmrtm byd 'ytmr bn'hrn hkhhn {s}
verses.translation: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting; and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֥ם לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖ם תִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: bny mrry lmshpchtm lbyt'btm tpqd 'tm
