verses.translation: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them by their families, by their fathers’houses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה וְעַ֛ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקְדֵ֑ם כׇּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bnchmshym shnh tpqdm khlhb' ltsb' l'bd 't'bdt 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹאת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת מַשָּׂאָ֔ם לְכׇל־עֲבֹדָתָ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמּוּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vz't mshmrt msh'm lkhl'bdtm b'hl mv'd qrshy hmshkhn vbrychyv v'mvdyv v'dnyv
verses.translation: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמּוּדֵי֩ הֶחָצֵ֨ר סָבִ֜יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֗ם וִיתֵֽדֹתָם֙ וּמֵ֣יתְרֵיהֶ֔ם לְכׇ֨ל־כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וּבְשֵׁמֹ֣ת תִּפְקְד֔וּ אֶת־כְּלֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת מַשָּׂאָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mvdy hchtsr sbyb v'dnyhm vytdtm vmytryhm lkhlkhlyhm vlkhl 'bdtm vbshmt tpqdv 'tkhly mshmrt msh'm
verses.translation: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, even all their appurtenance, and all that pertaineth to their service; and by name ye shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י לְכׇל־עֲבֹדָתָ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: z't 'bdt mshpcht bny mrry lkhl'bdtm b'hl mv'd byd 'ytmr bn'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vypqd mshh v'hrn vnshy'y h'dh 'tbny hqhty lmshpchtm vlbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’houses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כׇּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bnchmshym shnh khlhb' ltsb' l'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for service in the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm lmshpchtm 'lpym shb' m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה פְקוּדֵי֙ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֔י כׇּל־הָעֹבֵ֖ד בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshpcht hqhty khlh'bd b'hl mv'd 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'lpy yhvh bydmshh {s}
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, of all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקוּדֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vpqvdy bny grshvn lmshpchvtm vlbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’houses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כׇּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bnchmshym shnh khlhb' ltsb' l'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for service in the tent of meeting,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm 'lpym vshsh m'vt vshlshym
verses.translation: even those that were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’houses, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֗י מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֔וֹן כׇּל־הָעֹבֵ֖ד בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshpcht bny grshvn khlh'bd b'hl mv'd 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'lpy yhvh
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that did serve in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְקוּדֵ֕י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vpqvdy mshpcht bny mrry lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’houses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כׇּל־הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bnchmshym shnh khlhb' ltsb' l'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered upon the service, for service in the tent of meeting,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm lmshpchtm shlsht 'lpym vm'tym
verses.translation: even those that were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֔י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshpcht bny mrry 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'lpy yhvh bydmshh
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khlhpqdym 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn vnshy'y yshr'l 'thlvym lmshpchtm vlbyt 'btm
verses.translation: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’houses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כׇּל־הַבָּ֗א לַעֲבֹ֨ד עֲבֹדַ֧ת עֲבֹדָ֛ה וַעֲבֹדַ֥ת מַשָּׂ֖א בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bnchmshym shnh khlhb' l'bd 'bdt 'bdh v'bdt msh' b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the tent of meeting,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁמֹנַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm shmnt 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vshmnym
verses.translation: even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פִּ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה פָּקַ֤ד אוֹתָם֙ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל־עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְעַל־מַשָּׂא֑וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֕יו אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lpy yhvh pqd 'vtm bydmshh 'ysh 'ysh 'l'bdtv v'lmsh'v vpqdyv 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: According to the commandment of the LORD they were appointed by the hand of Moses, every one to his service, and to his burden; they were also numbered, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כׇּל־צָר֖וּעַ וְכׇל־זָ֑ב וְכֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָנָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: tsv 'tbny yshr'l vyshlchv mnhmchnh khltsrv' vkhlzb vkhl tm' lnpsh
verses.translation: ’Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is unclean by the dead;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזָּכָ֤ר עַד־נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל־מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּם וְלֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־מַ֣חֲנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: mzkhr 'dnqbh tshlchv 'lmchvts lmchnh tshlchvm vl' ytm'v 'tmchnyhm 'shr 'ny shkhn btvkhm
verses.translation: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camp, in the midst whereof I dwell.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְשַׁלְּח֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'shvkhn bny yshr'l vyshlchv 'vtm 'lmchvts lmchnh kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lmshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp; as the LORD spoke unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִכׇּל־חַטֹּ֣את הָֽאָדָ֔ם לִמְעֹ֥ל מַ֖עַל בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וְאָֽשְׁמָ֖ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִֽוא׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l 'ysh 'v'shh khy y'shv mkhlcht't h'dm lm'l m'l byhvh v'shmh hnpsh hhv'
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel: When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to commit a trespass against the LORD, and that soul be guilty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת־חַטָּאתָם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַחֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַ֕ן לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhtvdv 'tcht'tm 'shr 'shv vhshyb 't'shmv br'shv vchmyshtv ysf 'lyv vntn l'shr 'shm lv
verses.translation: then they shall confess their sin which they have done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אֵ֨ין לָאִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְהָשִׁ֤יב הָאָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔יו הָאָשָׁ֛ם הַמּוּשָׁ֥ב לַיהֹוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִלְּבַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־בּ֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'm'yn l'ysh g'l lhshyb h'shm 'lyv h'shm hmvshb lyhvh lkhhn mlbd 'yl hkhprym 'shr ykhprbv 'lyv
verses.translation: But if the man have no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made shall be the LORD’S, even the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, whereby atonement shall be made for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־תְּרוּמָ֞ה לְכׇל־קׇדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhltrvmh lkhlqdshy bnyyshr'l 'shryqrybv lkhhn lv yhyh
verses.translation: And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־קֳדָשָׁ֖יו ל֣וֹ יִהְי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִתֵּ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ysh 'tqdshyv lv yhyv 'ysh 'shrytn lkhhn lv yhyh {p}
verses.translation: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ כִּֽי־תִשְׂטֶ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וּמָעֲלָ֥ה ב֖וֹ מָֽעַל׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh 'ysh khytshth 'shtv vm'lh bv m'l
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: If any man’s wife go aside, and act unfaithfully against him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁכַ֨ב אִ֣ישׁ אֹתָהּ֮ שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֒רַע֒ וְנֶעְלַם֙ מֵעֵינֵ֣י אִישָׁ֔הּ וְנִסְתְּרָ֖ה וְהִ֣יא נִטְמָ֑אָה וְעֵד֙ אֵ֣ין בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א נִתְפָּֽשָׂה׃
verses.translit: vshkhb 'ysh 'th shkhbtzr' vn'lm m'yny 'yshh vnstrh vhy' ntm'h v'd 'yn bh vhv' l' ntpshh
verses.translation: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, she being defiled secretly, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken in the act;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧יו רֽוּחַ־קִנְאָ֛ה וְקִנֵּ֥א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְהִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה אוֹ־עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֤יו רֽוּחַ־קִנְאָה֙ וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהִ֖יא לֹ֥א נִטְמָֽאָה׃
verses.translit: v'br 'lyv rvchqn'h vqn' 't'shtv vhv' ntm'h 'v'br 'lyv rvchqn'h vqn' 't'shtv vhy' l' ntm'h
verses.translation: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he warned his wife, and she be defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he warned his wife, and she be not defiled;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֨יא הָאִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ֮ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־קׇרְבָּנָהּ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ עֲשִׂירִ֥ת הָאֵיפָ֖ה קֶ֣מַח שְׂעֹרִ֑ים לֹֽא־יִצֹ֨ק עָלָ֜יו שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹֽא־יִתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּֽי־מִנְחַ֤ת קְנָאֹת֙ ה֔וּא מִנְחַ֥ת זִכָּר֖וֹן מַזְכֶּ֥רֶת עָוֺֽן׃
verses.translit: vhby' h'ysh 't'shtv 'lhkhhn vhby' 'tqrbnh 'lyh 'shyrt h'yph qmch sh'rym l'ytsq 'lyv shmn vl'ytn 'lyv lbnh khymncht qn't hv' mncht zkhrvn mzkhrt 'vn
verses.translation: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is a meal-offering of jealousy, a meal-offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהֶֽעֱמִדָ֖הּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqryb 'th hkhhn vh'mdh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מַ֥יִם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים בִּכְלִי־חָ֑רֶשׂ וּמִן־הֶֽעָפָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנָתַ֥ן אֶל־הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mym qdshym bkhlychrsh vmnh'pr 'shr yhyh bqrq' hmshkhn yqch hkhhn vntn 'lhmym
verses.translation: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱמִ֨יד הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־הָאִשָּׁה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָה֒ וּפָרַע֙ אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנָתַ֣ן עַל־כַּפֶּ֗יהָ אֵ֚ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַזִּכָּר֔וֹן מִנְחַ֥ת קְנָאֹ֖ת הִ֑וא וּבְיַ֤ד הַכֹּהֵן֙ יִהְי֔וּ מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vh'myd hkhhn 'th'shh lpny yhvh vpr' 'tr'sh h'shh vntn 'lkhpyh 't mncht hzkhrvn mncht qn't hv' vbyd hkhhn yhyv my hmrym hm'rrym
verses.translation: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal-offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal-offering of jealousy; and the priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that causeth the curse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אֹתָ֜הּ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַ֤ר אֶל־הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אִם־לֹ֨א שָׁכַ֥ב אִישׁ֙ אֹתָ֔ךְ וְאִם־לֹ֥א שָׂטִ֛ית טֻמְאָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת אִישֵׁ֑ךְ הִנָּקִ֕י מִמֵּ֛י הַמָּרִ֥ים הַֽמְאָרְרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vhshby' 'th hkhhn v'mr 'lh'shh 'ml' shkhb 'ysh 'tkh v'ml' shtyt tm'h tcht 'yshkh hnqy mmy hmrym hm'rrym h'lh
verses.translation: And the priest shall cause her to swear, and shall say unto the woman: ‘If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness, being under thy husband, be thou free from this water of bitterness that causeth the curse;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֗תְּ כִּ֥י שָׂטִ֛ית תַּ֥חַת אִישֵׁ֖ךְ וְכִ֣י נִטְמֵ֑את וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אִ֥ישׁ בָּךְ֙ אֶת־שְׁכׇבְתּ֔וֹ מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֖י אִישֵֽׁךְ׃
verses.translit: v't khy shtyt tcht 'yshkh vkhy ntm't vytn 'ysh bkh 'tshkhbtv mbl'dy 'yshkh
verses.translation: but if thou hast gone aside, being under thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee besides thy husband—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־הָאִשָּׁה֮ בִּשְׁבֻעַ֣ת הָאָלָה֒ וְאָמַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה יִתֵּ֨ן יְהֹוָ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ךְ לְאָלָ֥ה וְלִשְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑ךְ בְּתֵ֨ת יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־יְרֵכֵךְ֙ נֹפֶ֔לֶת וְאֶת־בִּטְנֵ֖ךְ צָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhshby' hkhhn 'th'shh bshb't h'lh v'mr hkhhn l'shh ytn yhvh 'vtkh l'lh vlshb'h btvkh 'mkh btt yhvh 'tyrkhkh nplt v'tbtnkh tsbh
verses.translation: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman—the LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to fall away, and thy belly to swell;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠בָ֠אוּ הַמַּ֨יִם הַמְאָרְרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּֽמֵעַ֔יִךְ לַצְבּ֥וֹת בֶּ֖טֶן וְלַנְפִּ֣ל יָרֵ֑ךְ וְאָמְרָ֥ה הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אָמֵ֥ן ׀ אָמֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vb'v hmym hm'rrym h'lh bm'ykh ltsbvt btn vlnpl yrkh v'mrh h'shh 'mn  'mn
verses.translation: and this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, and make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to fall away’; and the woman shall say: ‘Amen, Amen.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠כָתַ֠ב אֶת־הָאָלֹ֥ת הָאֵ֛לֶּה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּסֵּ֑פֶר וּמָחָ֖ה אֶל־מֵ֥י הַמָּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhtb 'th'lt h'lh hkhhn bspr vmchh 'lmy hmrym
verses.translation: And the priest shall write these curses in a scroll, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקָה֙ אֶת־הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרְרִ֑ים וּבָ֥אוּ בָ֛הּ הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽמְאָרְרִ֖ים לְמָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhshqh 'th'shh 'tmy hmrym hm'rrym vb'v bh hmym hm'rrym lmrym
verses.translation: And he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causeth the curse; and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֤ח הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִיַּ֣ד הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת וְהֵנִ֤יף אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn myd h'shh 't mncht hqn't vhnyf 'thmnchh lpny yhvh vhqryb 'th 'lhmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall take the meal-offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal-offering before the LORD, and bring it unto the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָמַ֨ץ הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן־הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְאַחַ֛ר יַשְׁקֶ֥ה אֶת־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vqmts hkhhn mnhmnchh 't'zkhrth vhqtyr hmzbchh v'chr yshqh 'th'shh 'thmym
verses.translation: And the priest shall take a handful of the meal-offering, as the memorial-part thereof, and make it smoke upon the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקָ֣הּ אֶת־הַמַּ֗יִם וְהָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם־נִטְמְאָה֮ וַתִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּאִישָׁהּ֒ וּבָ֨אוּ בָ֜הּ הַמַּ֤יִם הַמְאָֽרְרִים֙ לְמָרִ֔ים וְצָבְתָ֣ה בִטְנָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה יְרֵכָ֑הּ וְהָיְתָ֧ה הָאִשָּׁ֛ה לְאָלָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhshqh 'thmym vhyth 'mntm'h vtm'l m'l b'yshh vb'v bh hmym hm'rrym lmrym vtsbth btnh vnplh yrkhh vhyth h'shh l'lh bqrb 'mh
verses.translation: And when he hath made her drink the water, then it shall come to pass, if she be defiled, and have acted unfaithfully against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away; and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֤א נִטְמְאָה֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וּטְהֹרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְנִקְּתָ֖ה וְנִזְרְעָ֥ה זָֽרַע׃
verses.translit: v'ml' ntm'h h'shh vthrh hv' vnqth vnzr'h zr'
verses.translation: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be cleared, and shall conceive seed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׂטֶ֥ה אִשָּׁ֛ה תַּ֥חַת אִישָׁ֖הּ וְנִטְמָֽאָה׃
verses.translit: z't tvrt hqn't 'shr tshth 'shh tcht 'yshh vntm'h
verses.translation: This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goeth aside, and is defiled;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תַּעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֛יו ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֶת־הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְעָ֤שָׂה לָהּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: 'v 'ysh 'shr t'br 'lyv rvch qn'h vqn' 't'shtv vh'myd 'th'shh lpny yhvh v'shh lh hkhhn 't khlhtvrh hz't
verses.translation: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon a man, and he be jealous over his wife; then shall he set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִקָּ֥ה הָאִ֖ישׁ מֵעָוֺ֑ן וְהָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַהִ֔וא תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת־עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnqh h'ysh m'vn vh'shh hhv' tsh' 't'vnh {p}
verses.translation: And the man shall be clear from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַפְלִא֙ לִנְדֹּר֙ נֶ֣דֶר נָזִ֔יר לְהַזִּ֖יר לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh 'v'shh khy ypl' lndr ndr nzyr lhzyr lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When either man or woman shall clearly utter a vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to consecrate himself unto the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיַּ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ יַזִּ֔יר חֹ֥מֶץ יַ֛יִן וְחֹ֥מֶץ שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְכׇל־מִשְׁרַ֤ת עֲנָבִים֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַעֲנָבִ֛ים לַחִ֥ים וִיבֵשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: myyn vshkhr yzyr chmts yyn vchmts shkhr l' yshth vkhlmshrt 'nbym l' yshth v'nbym lchym vybshym l' y'khl
verses.translation: he shall abstain from wine and strong drink: he shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ מִכֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה מִגֶּ֣פֶן הַיַּ֗יִן מֵחַרְצַנִּ֛ים וְעַד־זָ֖ג לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khl ymy nzrv mkhl 'shr y'shh mgpn hyyn mchrtsnym v'dzg l' y'khl
verses.translation: All the days of his Naziriteship shall he eat nothing that is made of the grape-vine, from the pressed grapes even to the grapestone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יְמֵי֙ נֶ֣דֶר נִזְר֔וֹ תַּ֖עַר לֹא־יַעֲבֹ֣ר עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ עַד־מְלֹ֨את הַיָּמִ֜ם אֲשֶׁר־יַזִּ֤יר לַיהֹוָה֙ קָדֹ֣שׁ יִהְיֶ֔ה גַּדֵּ֥ל פֶּ֖רַע שְׂעַ֥ר רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: khlymy ndr nzrv t'r l'y'br 'lr'shv 'dml't hymm 'shryzyr lyhvh qdsh yhyh gdl pr' sh'r r'shv
verses.translation: All the days of his vow of Naziriteship there shall no razor come upon his head; until the days be fulfilled, in which he consecrateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י הַזִּיר֖וֹ לַיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ מֵ֖ת לֹ֥א יָבֹֽא׃
verses.translit: khlymy hzyrv lyhvh 'lnpsh mt l' yb'
verses.translation: All the days that he consecrateth himself unto the LORD he shall not come near to a dead body.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאָבִ֣יו וּלְאִמּ֗וֹ לְאָחִיו֙ וּלְאַ֣חֹת֔וֹ לֹא־יִטַּמָּ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בְּמֹתָ֑ם כִּ֛י נֵ֥זֶר אֱלֹהָ֖יו עַל־רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'byv vl'mv l'chyv vl'chtv l'ytm' lhm bmtm khy nzr 'lhyv 'lr'shv
verses.translation: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his consecration unto God is upon his head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khl ymy nzrv qdsh hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: All the days of his Naziriteship he is holy unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָמ֨וּת מֵ֤ת עָלָיו֙ בְּפֶ֣תַע פִּתְאֹ֔ם וְטִמֵּ֖א רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְגִלַּ֤ח רֹאשׁוֹ֙ בְּי֣וֹם טׇהֳרָת֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י יְגַלְּחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhyymvt mt 'lyv bpt' pt'm vtm' r'sh nzrv vglch r'shv byvm thrtv byvm hshby'y yglchnv
verses.translation: And if any man die very suddenly beside him, and he defile his consecrated head, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יָבִא֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה אֶ֨ל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny yb' shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh 'lhkhhn 'lptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶחָ֤ד לְחַטָּאת֙ וְאֶחָ֣ד לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֔יו מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עַל־הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְקִדַּ֥שׁ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'shh hkhhn 'chd lcht't v'chd l'lh vkhpr 'lyv m'shr cht' 'lhnpsh vqdsh 'tr'shv byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall prepare one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make atonement for him, for that he sinned by reason of the dead; and he shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִזִּ֤יר לַֽיהֹוָה֙ אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ וְהֵבִ֛יא כֶּ֥בֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְאָשָׁ֑ם וְהַיָּמִ֤ים הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ יִפְּל֔וּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhzyr lyhvh 'tymy nzrv vhby' khbsh bnshntv l'shm vhymym hr'shnym yplv khy tm' nzrv
verses.translation: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his Naziriteship, and shall bring a he-lamb of the first year for a guilt-offering; but the former days shall be void, because his consecration was defiled. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַנָּזִ֑יר בְּי֗וֹם מְלֹאת֙ יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ יָבִ֣יא אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vz't tvrt hnzyr byvm ml't ymy nzrv yby' 'tv 'lptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And this is the law of the Nazirite, when the days of his consecration are fulfilled: he shall abring it unto the door of the tent of meeting;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֶת־קׇרְבָּנ֣וֹ לַיהֹוָ֡ה כֶּ֩בֶשׂ֩ בֶּן־שְׁנָת֨וֹ תָמִ֤ים אֶחָד֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכַבְשָׂ֨ה אַחַ֧ת בַּת־שְׁנָתָ֛הּ תְּמִימָ֖ה לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַֽיִל־אֶחָ֥ד תָּמִ֖ים לִשְׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhqryb 'tqrbnv lyhvh khbsh bnshntv tmym 'chd l'lh vkhbshh 'cht btshnth tmymh lcht't v'yl'chd tmym lshlmym
verses.translation: and he shall present his offering unto the LORD, one he-lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for peace-offerings,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסַ֣ל מַצּ֗וֹת סֹ֤לֶת חַלֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וּמִנְחָתָ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vsl mtsvt slt chlt blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn vmnchtm vnskhyhm
verses.translation: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, and their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֥יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־חַטָּאת֖וֹ וְאֶת־עֹלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhqryb hkhhn lpny yhvh v'shh 'tcht'tv v't'ltv
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָאַ֜יִל יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמִים֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה עַ֖ל סַ֣ל הַמַּצּ֑וֹת וְעָשָׂה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־מִנְחָת֖וֹ וְאֶת־נִסְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th'yl y'shh zbch shlmym lyhvh 'l sl hmtsvt v'shh hkhhn 'tmnchtv v'tnskhv
verses.translation: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall offer also the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגִלַּ֣ח הַנָּזִ֗יר פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְלָקַ֗ח אֶת־שְׂעַר֙ רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֔וֹ וְנָתַן֙ עַל־הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֖חַת זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vglch hnzyr ptch 'hl mv'd 'tr'sh nzrv vlqch 'tsh'r r'sh nzrv vntn 'lh'sh 'shrtcht zbch hshlmym
verses.translation: And the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the door of the tent of meeting, and shall take the hair of his consecrated head, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַזְּרֹ֣עַ בְּשֵׁלָה֮ מִן־הָאַ֒יִל֒ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ מִן־הַסַּ֔ל וּרְקִ֥יק מַצָּ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד וְנָתַן֙ עַל־כַּפֵּ֣י הַנָּזִ֔יר אַחַ֖ר הִֽתְגַּלְּח֥וֹ אֶת־נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 'thzr' bshlh mnh'yl vchlt mtsh 'cht mnhsl vrqyq mtsh 'chd vntn 'lkhpy hnzyr 'chr htglchv 'tnzrv
verses.translation: And the priest shall take the shoulder of the ram when it is sodden, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazirite, after he hath shaven his consecrated head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵנִיף֩ אוֹתָ֨ם הַכֹּהֵ֥ן ׀ תְּנוּפָה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָה֒ קֹ֤דֶשׁ הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֚ל חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֑ה וְאַחַ֛ר יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה הַנָּזִ֖יר יָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: vhnyf 'vtm hkhhn  tnvph lpny yhvh qdsh hv' lkhhn 'l chzh htnvph v'l shvq htrvmh v'chr yshth hnzyr yyn
verses.translation: And the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD; this is holy for the priest, together with the breast of waving and the thigh of heaving; and after that the Nazirite may drink wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַנָּזִיר֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּר֒ קׇרְבָּנ֤וֹ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עַל־נִזְר֔וֹ מִלְּבַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־תַּשִּׂ֣יג יָד֑וֹ כְּפִ֤י נִדְרוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּ֔ר כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה עַ֖ל תּוֹרַ֥ת נִזְרֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't tvrt hnzyr 'shr ydr qrbnv lyhvh 'lnzrv mlbd 'shrtshyg ydv khpy ndrv 'shr ydr khn y'shh 'l tvrt nzrv {p}
verses.translation: This is the law of the Nazirite who voweth, and of his offering unto the LORD for his Naziriteship, beside that for which his means suffice; according to his vow which he voweth, so he must do after the law of his Naziriteship.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה תְבָרְכ֖וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמ֖וֹר לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn v'lbnyv l'mr khh tbrkhv 'tbny yshr'l 'mvr lhm {s}
verses.translation: ’Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying: On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel; ye shall say unto them:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ybrkhkh yhvh vyshmrkh {s}
verses.translation: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָאֵ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה ׀ פָּנָ֛יו אֵלֶ֖יךָ וִֽיחֻנֶּֽךָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: y'r yhvh  pnyv 'lykh vychnkh {s}
verses.translation: The LORD make His face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ysh' yhvh  pnyv 'lykh vyshm lkh shlvm {s}
verses.translation: The LORD lift up His countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂמ֥וּ אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י עַל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲנִ֖י אֲבָרְכֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshmv 'tshmy 'lbny yshr'l v'ny 'brkhm {s}
verses.translation: So shall they put My name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י בְּיוֹם֩ כַּלּ֨וֹת מֹשֶׁ֜ה לְהָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֹת֜וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵ֖ם וַיְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy byvm khlvt mshh lhqym 'thmshkhn vymshch 'tv vyqdsh 'tv v'tkhlkhlyv v'thmzbch v'tkhlkhlyv vymshchm vyqdsh 'tm
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had made an end of setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, and all the furniture thereof, and the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them and sanctified them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם הֵ֚ם נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַמַּטֹּ֔ת הֵ֥ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־הַפְּקֻדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqrybv nshy'y yshr'l r'shy byt 'btm hm nshy'y hmtt hm h'mdym 'lhpqdym
verses.translation: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’houses, offered—these were the princes of the tribes, these are they that were over them that were numbered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־קׇרְבָּנָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּשְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר עֲגָלָ֛ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וֹר לְאֶחָ֑ד וַיַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אוֹתָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyby'v 'tqrbnm lpny yhvh shsh'glt tsb vshny 'shr bqr 'glh 'lshny hnsh'ym vshvr l'chd vyqrybv 'vtm lpny hmshkhn
verses.translation: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen: a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox; and they presented them before the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַ֚ח מֵֽאִתָּ֔ם וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִ֥י עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: qch m'tm vhyv l'bd 't'bdt 'hl mv'd vntth 'vtm 'lhlvym 'ysh khpy 'bdtv
verses.translation: ’Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tent of meeting; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־הָעֲגָלֹ֖ת וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֑ר וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 'th'glt v'thbqr vytn 'vtm 'lhlvym
verses.translation: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת  שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲגָל֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ אַרְבַּ֣עַת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן כְּפִ֖י עֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 't  shty h'glvt v't 'rb't hbqr ntn lbny grshvn khpy 'bdtm
verses.translation: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת  אַרְבַּ֣ע הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י כְּפִי֙ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v't  'rb' h'glt v't shmnt hbqr ntn lbny mrry khpy 'bdtm byd 'ytmr bn'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לֹ֣א נָתָ֑ן כִּֽי־עֲבֹדַ֤ת הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם בַּכָּתֵ֖ף יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
verses.translit: vlbny qht l' ntn khy'bdt hqdsh 'lhm bkhtf ysh'v
verses.translation: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the holy things belonged unto them: they bore them upon their shoulders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ הַנְּשִׂאִ֗ים אֵ֚ת חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּקְרִ֧יבוּ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֛ם אֶת־קׇרְבָּנָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vyqrybv hnsh'ym 't chnkht hmzbch byvm hmshch 'tv vyqrybv hnshy'm 'tqrbnm lpny hmzbch
verses.translation: And the princes brought the dedication-offering of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes brought their offering before the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד לַיּ֗וֹם נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לַיּ֔וֹם יַקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ אֶת־קׇרְבָּנָ֔ם לַחֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh nshy' 'chd lyvm nshy' 'chd lyvm yqrybv 'tqrbnm lchnkht hmzbch {s}
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘They shall present their offering each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י הַמַּקְרִ֛יב בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן אֶת־קׇרְבָּנ֑וֹ נַחְשׁ֥וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָ֖ב לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy hmqryb byvm hr'shvn 'tqrbnv nchshvn bn'myndb lmth yhvdh
verses.translation: And he that presented his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah;

verses.translation: one golden pan of ten shekels, full of incense;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: pr 'chd bnbqr 'yl 'chd khbsh'chd bnshntv l'lh
verses.translation: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burnt-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: sh'yr'zym 'chd lcht't
verses.translation: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְזֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ בָּקָ֣ר שְׁנַ֒יִם֒ אֵילִ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה זֶ֛ה קׇרְבַּ֥ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlzbch hshlmym bqr shnym 'ylm chmshh 'tdym chmshh khbshym bnyshnh chmshh zh qrbn 'chy'zr bn'myshdy {p}
verses.translation: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיוֹם֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר י֔וֹם נָשִׂ֖יא לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֑ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עׇכְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: byvm 'shty 'shr yvm nshy' lbny 'shr pg'y'l bn'khrn
verses.translation: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒ מִזְרָ֤ק אֶחָד֙ כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם  מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: qrbnv q'rtkhsf 'cht shlshym vm'h mshqlh mzrq 'chd khsf shb'ym shql bshql hqdsh shnyhm  ml'ym slt blvlh bshmn lmnchh
verses.translation: his offering was one silver dish, the weight thereof was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver basin of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: khf 'cht 'shrh zhb ml'h qtrt
verses.translation: one golden pan of ten shekels, full of incense;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: pr 'chd bnbqr 'yl 'chd khbsh'chd bnshntv l'lh
verses.translation: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burnt-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: sh'yr'zym 'chd lcht't
verses.translation: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְזֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ בָּקָ֣ר שְׁנַ֒יִם֒ אֵילִ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה זֶ֛ה קׇרְבַּ֥ן פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עׇכְרָֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlzbch hshlmym bqr shnym 'ylm chmshh 'tdym chmshh khbshym bnyshnh chmshh zh qrbn pg'y'l bn'khrn {p}
verses.translation: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיוֹם֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר י֔וֹם נָשִׂ֖יא לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֑י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃
verses.translit: byvm shnym 'shr yvm nshy' lbny nptly 'chyr' bn'ynn
verses.translation: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒ מִזְרָ֤ק אֶחָד֙ כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם  מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: qrbnv q'rtkhsf 'cht shlshym vm'h mshqlh mzrq 'chd khsf shb'ym shql bshql hqdsh shnyhm  ml'ym slt blvlh bshmn lmnchh
verses.translation: his offering was one silver dish, the weight thereof was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver basin of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: khf 'cht 'shrh zhb ml'h qtrt
verses.translation: one golden pan of ten shekels, full of incense;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: pr 'chd bnbqr 'yl 'chd khbsh'chd bnshntv l'lh
verses.translation: one young bullock, one ram, one he-lamb of the first year, for a burnt-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: sh'yr'zym 'chd lcht't
verses.translation: one male of the goats for a sin-offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְזֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ בָּקָ֣ר שְׁנַ֒יִם֒ אֵילִ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה זֶ֛ה קׇרְבַּ֥ן אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlzbch hshlmym bqr shnym 'ylm chmshh 'tdym chmshh khbshym bnyshnh chmshh zh qrbn 'chyr' bn'ynn {p}
verses.translation: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את  חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל קַעֲרֹ֨ת כֶּ֜סֶף שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֗ה מִֽזְרְקֵי־כֶ֙סֶף֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ר כַּפּ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃
verses.translit: z't  chnkht hmzbch byvm hmshch 'tv m't nshy'y yshr'l q'rt khsf shtym 'shrh mzrqykhsf shnym 'shr khpvt zhb shtym 'shrh
verses.translation: This was the dedication-offering of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, at the hands of the princes of Israel: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver basins, twelve golden pans;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֗ה הַקְּעָרָ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים הַמִּזְרָ֣ק הָאֶחָ֑ד כֹּ֚ל כֶּ֣סֶף הַכֵּלִ֔ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: shlshym vm'h hq'rh h'cht khsf vshb'ym hmzrq h'chd khl khsf hkhlym 'lpym v'rb'm'vt bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: each silver dish weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and each basin seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּפּ֨וֹת זָהָ֤ב שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מְלֵאֹ֣ת קְטֹ֔רֶת עֲשָׂרָ֧ה עֲשָׂרָ֛ה הַכַּ֖ף בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כׇּל־זְהַ֥ב הַכַּפּ֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּמֵאָֽה׃
verses.translit: khpvt zhb shtym'shrh ml't qtrt 'shrh 'shrh hkhf bshql hqdsh khlzhb hkhpvt 'shrym vm'h
verses.translation: twelve golden pans, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the pans a hundred and twenty shekels;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם וּשְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: khlhbqr l'lh shnym 'shr prym 'ylm shnym'shr khbshym bnyshnh shnym 'shr vmnchtm vsh'yry 'zym shnym 'shr lcht't
verses.translation: all the oxen for the burnt-offering twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the he-lambs of the first year twelve, and their meal-offering; and the males of the goats for a sin-offering twelve;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר  זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁים֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֔ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֑ים זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhl bqr  zbch hshlmym 'shrym v'rb'h prym 'ylm shshym 'tdym shshym khbshym bnyshnh shshym z't chnkht hmzbch 'chry hmshch 'tv
verses.translation: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace-offerings twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication-offering of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbb' mshh 'l'hl mv'd ldbr 'tv vyshm' 'thqvl mdbr 'lyv m'l hkhprt 'shr 'l'rn h'dt mbyn shny hkhrbym vydbr 'lyv {p}
verses.translation: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting that He might speak with him, then he heard the Voice speaking unto him from above the ark-cover that was upon the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim; and He spoke unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֵלָ֑יו בְּהַעֲלֹֽתְךָ֙ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֔ת אֶל־מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה יָאִ֖ירוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת הַנֵּרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: dbr 'l'hrn v'mrt 'lyv bh'ltkh 'thnrt 'lmvl pny hmnvrh y'yrv shb't hnrvt
verses.translation: ’Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him: When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the candlestick.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל־מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה הֶעֱלָ֖ה נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh khn 'hrn 'lmvl pny hmnvrh h'lh nrtyh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: And Aaron did so: he lighted the lamps thereof so as to give light in front of the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֨ה מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה הַמְּנֹרָה֙ מִקְשָׁ֣ה זָהָ֔ב עַד־יְרֵכָ֥הּ עַד־פִּרְחָ֖הּ מִקְשָׁ֣ה הִ֑וא כַּמַּרְאֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vzh m'shh hmnrh mqshh zhb 'dyrkhh 'dprchh mqshh hv' khmr'h 'shr hr'h yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shh 'thmnrh {p}
verses.translation: And this was the work of the candlestick, beaten work of gold; unto the base thereof, and unto the flowers thereof, it was beaten work; according unto the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַ֚ח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְטִהַרְתָּ֖ אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: qch 'thlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l vthrt 'tm
verses.translation: ’Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹֽה־תַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְטַֽהֲרָ֔ם הַזֵּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֵ֣י חַטָּ֑את וְהֶעֱבִ֤ירוּ תַ֙עַר֙ עַל־כׇּל־בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכִבְּס֥וּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִטֶּהָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhht'shh lhm lthrm hzh 'lyhm my cht't vh'byrv t'r 'lkhlbshrm vkhbsv bgdyhm vhthrv
verses.translation: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification upon them, and let them cause a razor to pass over all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֔ר וּמִ֨נְחָת֔וֹ סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן וּפַר־שֵׁנִ֥י בֶן־בָּקָ֖ר תִּקַּ֥ח לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vlqchv pr bnbqr vmnchtv slt blvlh bshmn vprshny bnbqr tqch lcht't
verses.translation: Then let them take a young bullock, and its meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִ֨קְהַלְתָּ֔ אֶֽת־כׇּל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhqrbt 'thlvym lpny 'hl mv'd vhqhlt 'tkhl'dt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt present the Levites before the tent of meeting; and thou shalt assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhqrbt 'thlvym lpny yhvh vsmkhv bnyyshr'l 'tydyhm 'lhlvym
verses.translation: And thou shalt present the Levites before the LORD; and the children of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵנִיף֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֤ם תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnyf 'hrn 'thlvym tnvph lpny yhvh m't bny yshr'l vhyv l'bd 't'bdt yhvh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave-offering from the children of Israel, that they may be to do the service of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ יִסְמְכ֣וּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּרִ֑ים וַ֠עֲשֵׂ֠ה אֶת־הָאֶחָ֨ד חַטָּ֜את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֤ד עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhlvym ysmkhv 'tydyhm 'l r'sh hprym v'shh 'th'chd cht't v'th'chd 'lh lyhvh lkhpr 'lhlvym
verses.translation: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks; and offer thou the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, unto the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'mdt 'thlvym lpny 'hrn vlpny bnyv vhnpt 'tm tnvph lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for a wave-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhbdlt 'thlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l vhyv ly hlvym
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְטִֽהַרְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם תְּנוּפָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chrykhn yb'v hlvym l'bd 't'hl mv'd vthrt 'tm vhnpt 'tm tnvph
verses.translation: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tent of meeting; and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for a wave-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ נְתֻנִ֨ים נְתֻנִ֥ים הֵ֙מָּה֙ לִ֔י מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תַּ֩חַת֩ פִּטְרַ֨ת כׇּל־רֶ֜חֶם בְּכ֥וֹר כֹּל֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָקַ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy ntnym ntnym hmh ly mtvkh bny yshr'l tcht ptrt khlrchm bkhvr khl mbny yshr'l lqchty 'tm ly
verses.translation: For they are wholly given unto Me from among the children of Israel; instead of all that openeth the womb, even the first-born of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לִ֤י כׇל־בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם הַכֹּתִ֤י כׇל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם הִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy ly khlbkhvr bbny yshr'l b'dm vbbhmh byvm hkhty khlbkhvr b'rts mtsrym hqdshty 'tm ly
verses.translation: For all the first-born among the children of Israel are Mine, both man and beast; on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for Myself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֖ח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם תַּ֥חַת כׇּל־בְּכ֖וֹר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'qch 'thlvym tcht khlbkhvr bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And I have taken the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֨ה אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים  לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֗יו מִתּוֹךְ֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַעֲבֹ֞ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּלְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶ֔גֶף בְּגֶ֥שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'tnh 'thlvym ntnym  l'hrn vlbnyv mtvkh bny yshr'l l'bd 't'bdt bnyyshr'l b'hl mv'd vlkhpr 'lbny yshr'l vl' yhyh bbny yshr'l ngf bgsht bnyyshr'l 'lhqdsh
verses.translation: And I have given the Levites— they are given to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, that there be no plague among the children of Israel, through the children of Israel coming nigh unto the sanctuary.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וְכׇל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַלְוִיִּ֑ם כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּן־עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh v'hrn vkhl'dt bnyyshr'l llvym khkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh llvym khn'shv lhm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Thus did Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the Levites; according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses touching the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְחַטְּא֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ֙ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּ֨נֶף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיְכַפֵּ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְטַהֲרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vytcht'v hlvym vykhbsv bgdyhm vynf 'hrn 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh vykhpr 'lyhm 'hrn lthrm
verses.translation: And the Levites purified themselves, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a sacred gift before the LORD; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן בָּ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם לַעֲבֹ֤ד אֶת־עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה֙ עַל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּ֖ן עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chrykhn b'v hlvym l'bd 't'bdtm b'hl mv'd lpny 'hrn vlpny bnyv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh 'lhlvym khn 'shv lhm {s}
verses.translation: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron, and before his sons; as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִבֶּן֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יָבוֹא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: z't 'shr llvym mbn chmsh v'shrym shnh vm'lh ybv' ltsb' tsb' b'bdt 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: ’This is that which pertaineth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to perform the service in the work of the tent of meeting;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִצְּבָ֣א הָעֲבֹדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲבֹ֖ד עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vmbn chmshym shnh yshvb mtsb' h'bdh vl' y'bd 'vd
verses.translation: and from the age of fifty years they shall return from the service of the work, and shall serve no more;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת־אֶחָ֜יו בְּאֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וַעֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshrt 't'chyv b'hl mv'd lshmr mshmrt v'bdh l' y'bd khkhh t'shh llvym bmshmrtm {p}
verses.translation: but shall minister with their brethren in the tent of meeting, to keep the charge, but they shall do no manner of service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charges.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה בְמִדְבַּר־סִ֠ינַ֠י בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הַשֵּׁנִ֜ית לְצֵאתָ֨ם מֵאֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh bmdbrsyny bshnh hshnyt lts'tm m'rts mtsrym bchdsh hr'shvn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־הַפָּ֖סַח בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'shv bnyyshr'l 'thpsch bmv'dv
verses.translation: ’Let the children of Israel keep the passover in its appointed season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאַרְבָּעָ֣ה עָשָֽׂר־י֠וֹם בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֜ה בֵּ֧ין הָֽעַרְבַּ֛יִם תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲד֑וֹ כְּכׇל־חֻקֹּתָ֥יו וּכְכׇל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: b'rb'h 'shryvm bchdsh hzh byn h'rbym t'shv 'tv bm'dv khkhlchqtyv vkhkhlmshptyv t'shv 'tv
verses.translation: In the fourteenth day of this month, at dusk, ye shall keep it in its appointed season; according to all the statutes of it, and according to all the ordinances thereof, shall ye keep it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת הַפָּֽסַח׃
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'lbny yshr'l l'sht hpsch
verses.translation: And Moses spoke unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הַפֶּ֡סַח בָּרִאשׁ֡וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַחֹ֛דֶשׁ בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'shv 'thpsch br'shvn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh byn h'rbym bmdbr syny khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And they kept the passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at dusk, in the wilderness of Sinai; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ טְמֵאִים֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם וְלֹא־יָכְל֥וּ לַעֲשֹׂת־הַפֶּ֖סַח בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'nshym 'shr hyv tm'ym lnpsh 'dm vl'ykhlv l'shthpsch byvm hhv' vyqrbv lpny mshh vlpny 'hrn byvm hhv'
verses.translation: But there were certain men, who were unclean by the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the passover on that day; and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמְר֠וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָהֵ֙מָּה֙ אֵלָ֔יו אֲנַ֥חְנוּ טְמֵאִ֖ים לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה נִגָּרַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֨י הַקְרִ֜יב אֶת־קׇרְבַּ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ בְּמֹ֣עֲד֔וֹ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'nshym hhmh 'lyv 'nchnv tm'ym lnpsh 'dm lmh ngr' lblty hqryb 'tqrbn yhvh bm'dv btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And those men said unto him: ‘We are unclean by the dead body of a man; wherefore are we to be kept back, so as not to bring the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה עִמְד֣וּ וְאֶשְׁמְעָ֔ה מַה־יְצַוֶּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה לָכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm mshh 'mdv v'shm'h mhytsvh yhvh lkhm {p}
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them: ‘Stay ye, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ כִּי־יִהְיֶֽה־טָמֵ֣א ׀ לָנֶ֡פֶשׁ אוֹ֩ בְדֶ֨רֶךְ רְחֹקָ֜הׄ לָכֶ֗ם א֚וֹ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָ֥שָׂה פֶ֖סַח לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr 'ysh 'ysh khyyhyhtm'  lnpsh 'v bdrkh rchqh lkhm 'v ldrtykhm v'shh psch lyhvh
verses.translation: ’Speak unto the children of Israel, saying: If any man of you or of your generations shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם יַעֲשׂ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ עַל־מַצּ֥וֹת וּמְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: bchdsh hshny b'rb'h 'shr yvm byn h'rbym y'shv 'tv 'lmtsvt vmrrym y'khlhv
verses.translation: in the second month on the fourteenth day at dusk they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יַשְׁאִ֤ירוּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עַד־בֹּ֔קֶר וְעֶ֖צֶם לֹ֣א יִשְׁבְּרוּ־ב֑וֹ כְּכׇל־חֻקַּ֥ת הַפֶּ֖סַח יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'ysh'yrv mmnv 'dbqr v'tsm l' yshbrvbv khkhlchqt hpsch y'shv 'tv
verses.translation: they shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break a bone thereof; according to all the statute of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁר־ה֨וּא טָה֜וֹר וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־הָיָ֗ה וְחָדַל֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔סַח וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵֽעַמֶּ֑יהָ כִּ֣י  קׇרְבַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹ֤א הִקְרִיב֙ בְּמֹ֣עֲד֔וֹ חֶטְא֥וֹ יִשָּׂ֖א הָאִ֥ישׁ הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vh'ysh 'shrhv' thvr vbdrkh l'hyh vchdl l'shvt hpsch vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh khy  qrbn yhvh l' hqryb bm'dv cht'v ysh' h'ysh hhv'
verses.translation: But the man that is clean, and is not on a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people; because he brought not the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָג֨וּר אִתְּכֶ֜ם גֵּ֗ר וְעָ֤שָֽׂה פֶ֙סַח֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה כְּחֻקַּ֥ת הַפֶּ֛סַח וּכְמִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה חֻקָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר וּלְאֶזְרַ֥ח הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhyygvr 'tkhm gr v'shh psch lyhvh khchqt hpsch vkhmshptv khn y'shh chqh 'cht yhyh lkhm vlgr vl'zrch h'rts {s}
verses.translation: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD: according to the statute of the passover, and according to the ordinance thereof, so shall he do; ye shall have one statute, both for the stranger, and for him that is born in the land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֙ הָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן כִּסָּ֤ה הֶֽעָנָן֙ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לְאֹ֖הֶל הָעֵדֻ֑ת וּבָעֶ֜רֶב יִהְיֶ֧ה עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵ֖שׁ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hqym 'thmshkhn khsh h'nn 'thmshkhn l'hl h'dt vb'rb yhyh 'lhmshkhn khmr'h'sh 'dbqr
verses.translation: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the tent of the testimony; and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה תָמִ֔יד הֶעָנָ֖ן יְכַסֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַרְאֵה־אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: khn yhyh tmyd h'nn ykhsnv vmr'h'sh lylh
verses.translation: So it was alway: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְפִ֞י הֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְאַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבִמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכׇּן־שָׁם֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן שָׁ֥ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vlpy h'lvt h'nn m'l h'hl v'chry khn ys'v bny yshr'l vbmqvm 'shr yshkhnshm h'nn shm ychnv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel journeyed; and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel encamped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה יִסְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה יַחֲנ֑וּ כׇּל־יְמֵ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכֹּ֧ן הֶעָנָ֛ן עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lpy yhvh ys'v bny yshr'l v'lpy yhvh ychnv khlymy 'shr yshkhn h'nn 'lhmshkhn ychnv
verses.translation: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they remained encamped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַאֲרִ֧יךְ הֶֽעָנָ֛ן עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְשָׁמְר֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vbh'rykh h'nn 'lhmshkhn ymym rbym vshmrv bnyyshr'l 'tmshmrt yhvh vl' ys'v
verses.translation: And when the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֧ה הֶֽעָנָ֛ן יָמִ֥ים מִסְפָּ֖ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַל־פִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְעַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vysh 'shr yhyh h'nn ymym mspr 'lhmshkhn 'lpy yhvh ychnv v'lpy yhvh ys'v
verses.translation: And sometimes the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֤ה הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעֶ֣רֶב עַד־בֹּ֔קֶר וְנַעֲלָ֧ה הֶֽעָנָ֛ן בַּבֹּ֖קֶר וְנָסָ֑עוּ א֚וֹ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה וְנַעֲלָ֥ה הֶעָנָ֖ן וְנָסָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vysh 'shryhyh h'nn m'rb 'dbqr vn'lh h'nn bbqr vns'v 'v yvmm vlylh vn'lh h'nn vns'v
verses.translation: And sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they journeyed; or if it continued by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹ־יֹמַ֜יִם אוֹ־חֹ֣דֶשׁ אוֹ־יָמִ֗ים בְּהַאֲרִ֨יךְ הֶעָנָ֤ן עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ לִשְׁכֹּ֣ן עָלָ֔יו יַחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְלֹ֣א יִסָּ֑עוּ וּבְהֵעָלֹת֖וֹ יִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: 'vymym 'vchdsh 'vymym bh'rykh h'nn 'lhmshkhn lshkhn 'lyv ychnv bnyyshr'l vl' ys'v vbh'ltv ys'v
verses.translation: Whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, abiding thereon, the children of Israel remained encamped, and journeyed not; but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְעַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה יִסָּ֑עוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת יְהֹוָה֙ שָׁמָ֔רוּ עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lpy yhvh ychnv v'lpy yhvh ys'v 'tmshmrt yhvh shmrv 'lpy yhvh bydmshh {p}
verses.translation: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed; they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְךָ֗ שְׁתֵּי֙ חֲצֽוֹצְרֹ֣ת כֶּ֔סֶף מִקְשָׁ֖ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לְךָ֙ לְמִקְרָ֣א הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וּלְמַסַּ֖ע אֶת־הַֽמַּחֲנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'shh lkh shty chtsvtsrt khsf mqshh t'shh 'tm vhyv lkh lmqr' h'dh vlms' 'thmchnvt
verses.translation: ’Make thee two trumpets of silver; of beaten work shalt thou make them; and they shall be unto thee for the calling of the congregation, and for causing the camps to set forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָקְע֖וּ בָּהֵ֑ן וְנֽוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vtq'v bhn vnv'dv 'lykh khlh'dh 'lptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And when they shall blow with them, all the congregation shall gather themselves unto thee at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בְּאַחַ֖ת יִתְקָ֑עוּ וְנוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'mb'cht ytq'v vnv'dv 'lykh hnshy'ym r'shy 'lpy yshr'l
verses.translation: And if they blow but with one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֑ה וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים קֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.translit: vtq'tm trv'h vns'v hmchnvt hchnym qdmh
verses.translation: And when ye blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall take their journey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֤ם תְּרוּעָה֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים תֵּימָ֑נָה תְּרוּעָ֥ה יִתְקְע֖וּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtq'tm trv'h shnyt vns'v hmchnvt hchnym tymnh trv'h ytq'v lms'yhm
verses.translation: And when ye blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall set forward; they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַקְהִ֖יל אֶת־הַקָּהָ֑ל תִּתְקְע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָרִֽיעוּ׃
verses.translit: vbhqhyl 'thqhl ttq'v vl' try'v
verses.translation: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּחֲצֹֽצְר֑וֹת וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny 'hrn hkhhnym ytq'v bchtstsrvt vhyv lkhm lchqt 'vlm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for a statute for ever throughout your generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־תָבֹ֨אוּ מִלְחָמָ֜ה בְּאַרְצְכֶ֗ם עַל־הַצַּר֙ הַצֹּרֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֔ם וַהֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם בַּחֲצֹצְרֹ֑ת וְנִזְכַּרְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְנוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֖ם מֵאֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhytb'v mlchmh b'rtskhm 'lhtsr htsrr 'tkhm vhr'tm bchtstsrt vnzkhrtm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm vnvsh'tm m'ybykhm
