verses.translation: And when ye go to war in your land against the adversary that oppresseth you, then ye shall sound an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְי֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֥ם וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮ וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י חׇדְשֵׁיכֶם֒ וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbyvm shmchtkhm vbmv'dykhm vbr'shy chdshykhm vtq'tm bchtstsrt 'l 'ltykhm v'l zbchy shlmykhm vhyv lkhm lzkhrvn lpny 'lhykhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm {p}
verses.translation: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your appointed seasons, and in your new moons, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt-offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּשָּׁנָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ נַעֲלָה֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן מֵעַ֖ל מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hshnyt bchdsh hshny b'shrym bchdsh n'lh h'nn m'l mshkhn h'dt
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן הֶעָנָ֖ן בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃
verses.translit: vys'v bnyyshr'l lms'yhm mmdbr syny vyshkhn h'nn bmdbr p'rn
verses.translation: And the children of Israel set forward by their stages out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud abode in the wilderness of Paran.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vys'v br'shnh 'lpy yhvh bydmshh
verses.translation: And they took their first journey, according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֞ע דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֛ה בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַ֨ל־צְבָא֔וֹ נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.translit: vys' dgl mchnh bnyyhvdh br'shnh ltsb'tm v'ltsb'v nchshvn bn'myndb
verses.translation: And in the first place the standard of the camp of the children of Judah set forward according to their hosts; and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny yshshkhr ntn'l bntsv'r
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֑ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny zbvln 'ly'b bnchln
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּרַ֖ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן וְנָסְע֤וּ בְנֵֽי־גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ וּבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vhvrd hmshkhn vns'v bnygrshvn vbny mrry nsh'y hmshkhn
verses.translation: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, set forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַ֨ל־צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vns' dgl mchnh r'vbn ltsb'tm v'ltsb'v 'lytsvr bnshdy'vr
verses.translation: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their hosts; and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן שְׁלֻֽמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny shm'vn shlmy'l bntsvryshdy
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־צְבָ֖א מַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי־גָ֑ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bnygd 'lysf bnd'v'l
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסְעוּ֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְהֵקִ֥ימוּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עַד־בֹּאָֽם׃
verses.translit: vns'v hqhtym nsh'y hmqdsh vhqymv 'thmshkhn 'db'm
verses.translation: And the Kohathites the bearers of the sanctuary set forward, that the tabernacle might be set up against their coming.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַ֨ל־צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.translit: vns' dgl mchnh bny'prym ltsb'tm v'ltsb'v 'lyshm' bn'myhvd
verses.translation: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their hosts; and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny mnshh gmly'l bnpdhtsvr
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעוֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny bnymn 'bydn bngd'vny
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֚גֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי־דָ֔ן מְאַסֵּ֥ף לְכׇל־הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֖ת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַ֨ל־צְבָא֔וֹ אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.translit: vns' dgl mchnh bnydn m'sf lkhlhmchnt ltsb'tm v'ltsb'v 'chy'zr bn'myshdy
verses.translation: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rearward of all the camps, set forward according to their hosts; and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֑ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עׇכְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny 'shr pg'y'l bn'khrn
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֑י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'ltsb' mth bny nptly 'chyr' bn'ynn
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מַסְעֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וַיִּסָּֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh ms'y bnyyshr'l ltsb'tm vys'v {s}
verses.translation: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their hosts.—And they set forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ֠חֹבָ֠ב בֶּן־רְעוּאֵ֣ל הַמִּדְיָנִי֮ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֒ נֹסְעִ֣ים  אֲנַ֗חְנוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֹת֖וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם לְכָ֤ה אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ וְהֵטַ֣בְנוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה דִּבֶּר־ט֖וֹב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lchbb bnr'v'l hmdyny chtn mshh ns'ym  'nchnv 'lhmqvm 'shr 'mr yhvh 'tv 'tn lkhm lkhh 'tnv vhtbnv lkh khyyhvh dbrtvb 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’father-in-law: ‘We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said: I will give it you; come thou with us, and we will do thee good; for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו לֹ֣א אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּ֧י אִם־אֶל־אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv l' 'lkh khy 'm'l'rtsy v'lmvldty 'lkh
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַל־נָ֖א תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י  עַל־כֵּ֣ן יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֲנֹתֵ֙נוּ֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְעֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ln' t'zb 'tnv khy  'lkhn yd't chntnv bmdbr vhyyt lnv l'ynym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou shalt be to us instead of eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה כִּי־תֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיָ֣ה  הַטּ֣וֹב הַה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵיטִ֧יב יְהֹוָ֛ה עִמָּ֖נוּ וְהֵטַ֥בְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khytlkh 'mnv vhyh  htvb hhv' 'shr yytyb yhvh 'mnv vhtbnv lkh
verses.translation: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what good soever the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵהַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַאֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֜ה נֹסֵ֣עַ לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים לָת֥וּר לָהֶ֖ם מְנוּחָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mhr yhvh drkh shlsht ymym v'rvn brytyhvh ns' lpnyhm drkh shlsht ymym ltvr lhm mnvchh
verses.translation: And they set forward from the mount of the LORD three days’journey; and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them three days’journey, to seek out a resting-place for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲנַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם בְּנׇסְעָ֖ם מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'nn yhvh 'lyhm yvmm bns'm mnhmchnh {s}
verses.translation: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ וַיְהִ֛י בִּנְסֹ֥עַ הָאָרֹ֖ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣ה  יְהֹוָ֗ה וְיָפֻ֙צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔יךָ וְיָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyhy bns' h'rn vy'mr mshh qvmh  yhvh vyptsv 'ybykh vynsv mshn'ykh mpnykh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said: ‘Rise up, O LORD, and let Thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate Thee flee before Thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֻחֹ֖ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה רִֽבְב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ׆ {פ}
verses.translit: vbnchh y'mr shvbh yhvh rbbvt 'lpy yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And when it rested, he said: ‘Return, O LORD, unto the ten thousands of the families of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הָעָם֙ כְּמִתְאֹ֣נְנִ֔ים רַ֖ע בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ וַיִּ֣חַר אַפּ֔וֹ וַתִּבְעַר־בָּם֙ אֵ֣שׁ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֖אכַל בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy h'm khmt'nnym r' b'zny yhvh vyshm' yhvh vychr 'pv vtb'rbm 'sh yhvh vt'khl bqtsh hmchnh
verses.translation: And the people were as murmurers, speaking evil in the ears of the LORD; and when the LORD heard it, His anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and devoured in the uttermost part of the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֖ם אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַתִּשְׁקַ֖ע הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyts'q h'm 'lmshh vytpll mshh 'lyhvh vtshq' h'sh
verses.translation: And the people cried unto Moses; and Moses prayed unto the LORD, and the fire abated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא תַּבְעֵרָ֑ה כִּֽי־בָעֲרָ֥ה בָ֖ם אֵ֥שׁ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqr' shmhmqvm hhv' tb'rh khyb'rh bm 'sh yhvh
verses.translation: And the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽאסַפְסֻף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ הִתְאַוּ֖וּ תַּאֲוָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַיִּבְכּ֗וּ גַּ֚ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י יַאֲכִלֵ֖נוּ בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vh'spsf 'shr bqrbv ht'vv t'vh vyshbv vybkhv gm bny yshr'l vy'mrv my y'khlnv bshr
verses.translation: And the mixed multitude that was among them fell a lusting; and the children of Israel also wept on their part, and said: ‘Would that we were given flesh to eat!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָכַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־הַדָּגָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נֹאכַ֥ל בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם חִנָּ֑ם אֵ֣ת הַקִּשֻּׁאִ֗ים וְאֵת֙ הָֽאֲבַטִּחִ֔ים וְאֶת־הֶחָצִ֥יר וְאֶת־הַבְּצָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַשּׁוּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: zkhrnv 'thdgh 'shrn'khl bmtsrym chnm 't hqsh'ym v't h'btchym v'thchtsyr v'thbtslym v'thshvmym
verses.translation: We remember the fish, which we were wont to eat in Egypt for nought; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה נַפְשֵׁ֥נוּ יְבֵשָׁ֖ה אֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל בִּלְתִּ֖י אֶל־הַמָּ֥ן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th npshnv ybshh 'yn khl blty 'lhmn 'ynynv
verses.translation: but now our soul is dried away; there is nothing at all; we have nought save this manna to look to.’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמָּ֕ן כִּזְרַע־גַּ֖ד ה֑וּא וְעֵינ֖וֹ כְּעֵ֥ין הַבְּדֹֽלַח׃
verses.translit: vhmn khzr'gd hv' v'ynv kh'yn hbdlch
verses.translation: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and the appearance thereof as the appearance of bdellium.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֩טוּ֩ הָעָ֨ם וְלָֽקְט֜וּ וְטָחֲנ֣וּ בָרֵחַ֗יִם א֤וֹ דָכוּ֙ בַּמְּדֹכָ֔ה וּבִשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּפָּר֔וּר וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ עֻג֑וֹת וְהָיָ֣ה טַעְמ֔וֹ כְּטַ֖עַם לְשַׁ֥ד הַשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: shtv h'm vlqtv vtchnv brchym 'v dkhv bmdkhh vbshlv bprvr v'shv 'tv 'gvt vhyh t'mv kht'm lshd hshmn
verses.translation: The people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and seethed it in pots, and made cakes of it; and the taste of it was as the taste of a cake baked with oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְרֶ֧דֶת הַטַּ֛ל עַל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה יֵרֵ֥ד הַמָּ֖ן עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vbrdt htl 'lhmchnh lylh yrd hmn 'lyv
verses.translation: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־הָעָ֗ם בֹּכֶה֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔יו אִ֖ישׁ לְפֶ֣תַח אׇהֳל֑וֹ וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וּבְעֵינֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה רָֽע׃
verses.translit: vyshm' mshh 'th'm bkhh lmshpchtyv 'ysh lptch 'hlv vychr'f yhvh m'd vb'yny mshh r'
verses.translation: And Moses heard the people weeping, family by family, every man at the door of his tent; and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֗ה לָמָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֙תָ֙ לְעַבְדֶּ֔ךָ וְלָ֛מָּה לֹא־מָצָ֥תִי חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ לָשׂ֗וּם אֶת־מַשָּׂ֛א כׇּל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'lyhvh lmh hr't l'bdkh vlmh l'mtsty chn b'ynykh lshvm 'tmsh' khlh'm hzh 'ly
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD: ‘Wherefore hast Thou dealt ill with Thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in Thy sight, that Thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶאָנֹכִ֣י הָרִ֗יתִי אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אִם־אָנֹכִ֖י יְלִדְתִּ֑יהוּ כִּֽי־תֹאמַ֨ר אֵלַ֜י שָׂאֵ֣הוּ בְחֵיקֶ֗ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשָּׂ֤א הָאֹמֵן֙ אֶת־הַיֹּנֵ֔ק עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתָּ לַאֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: h'nkhy hryty 't khlh'm hzh 'm'nkhy yldtyhv khyt'mr 'ly sh'hv bchyqkh kh'shr ysh' h'mn 'thynq 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb't l'btyv
verses.translation: Have I conceived all this people? have I brought them forth, that Thou shouldest say unto me: Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing-father carrieth the sucking child, unto the land which Thou didst swear unto their fathers?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאַ֤יִן לִי֙ בָּשָׂ֔ר לָתֵ֖ת לְכׇל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־יִבְכּ֤וּ עָלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנָה־לָּ֥נוּ בָשָׂ֖ר וְנֹאכֵֽלָה׃
verses.translit: m'yn ly bshr ltt lkhlh'm hzh khyybkhv 'ly l'mr tnhlnv bshr vn'khlh
verses.translation: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they trouble me with their weeping, saying: Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־אוּכַ֤ל אָנֹכִי֙ לְבַדִּ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־כׇּל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֥י כָבֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: l''vkhl 'nkhy lbdy lsh't 'tkhlh'm hzh khy khbd mmny
verses.translation: I am not able to bear all this people myself alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־כָּ֣כָה  אַתְּ־עֹ֣שֶׂה לִּ֗י הׇרְגֵ֤נִי נָא֙ הָרֹ֔ג אִם־מָצָ֥אתִי חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וְאַל־אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּרָעָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mkhkhh  't'shh ly hrgny n' hrg 'mmts'ty chn b'ynykh v'l'r'h br'ty {p}
verses.translation: And if Thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray Thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in Thy sight; and let me not look upon my wretchedness.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶסְפָה־לִּ֞י שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִישׁ֮ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּי־הֵ֛ם זִקְנֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרָ֑יו וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ שָׁ֖ם עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh 'sphly shb'ym 'ysh mzqny yshr'l 'shr yd't khyhm zqny h'm vshtryv vlqcht 'tm 'l'hl mv'd vhtytsbv shm 'mkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Gather unto Me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרַדְתִּ֗י וְדִבַּרְתִּ֣י עִמְּךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְאָצַלְתִּ֗י מִן־הָר֛וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖יךָ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֤וּ אִתְּךָ֙ בְּמַשָּׂ֣א הָעָ֔ם וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vyrdty vdbrty 'mkh shm v'tslty mnhrvch 'shr 'lykh vshmty 'lyhm vnsh'v 'tkh bmsh' h'm vl'tsh' 'th lbdkh
verses.translation: And I will come down and speak with thee there; and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הָעָ֨ם תֹּאמַ֜ר הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְמָחָר֮ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֣ם בָּשָׂר֒ כִּ֡י בְּכִיתֶם֩ בְּאׇזְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֤י יַאֲכִלֵ֙נוּ֙ בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּי־ט֥וֹב לָ֖נוּ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְנָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וַאֲכַלְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lh'm t'mr htqdshv lmchr v'khltm bshr khy bkhytm b'zny yhvh l'mr my y'khlnv bshr khytvb lnv bmtsrym vntn yhvh lkhm bshr v'khltm
verses.translation: And say thou unto the people: Sanctify yourselves against to-morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying: Would that we were given flesh to eat! for it was well with us in Egypt; therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א י֥וֹם אֶחָ֛ד תֹּאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֣א יוֹמָ֑יִם וְלֹ֣א  חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה יָמִ֗ים וְלֹא֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה יָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֖א עֶשְׂרִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: l' yvm 'chd t'khlvn vl' yvmym vl'  chmshh ymym vl' 'shrh ymym vl' 'shrym yvm
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ד  חֹ֣דֶשׁ יָמִ֗ים עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא֙ מֵֽאַפְּכֶ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְזָרָ֑א יַ֗עַן כִּֽי־מְאַסְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם וַתִּבְכּ֤וּ לְפָנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה יָצָ֥אנוּ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'd  chdsh ymym 'd 'shryts' m'pkhm vhyh lkhm lzr' y'n khym'stm 'tyhvh 'shr bqrbkhm vtbkhv lpnyv l'mr lmh zh yts'nv mmtsrym
verses.translation: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have troubled Him with weeping, saying: Why, now, came we forth out of Egypt?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ רַגְלִ֔י הָעָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֗רְתָּ בָּשָׂר֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם וְאָכְל֖וּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh shshm'vt 'lf rgly h'm 'shr 'nkhy bqrbv v'th 'mrt bshr 'tn lhm v'khlv chdsh ymym
verses.translation: And Moses said: ‘The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and yet Thou hast said: I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲצֹ֧אן וּבָקָ֛ר יִשָּׁחֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם וּמָצָ֣א לָהֶ֑ם אִ֣ם אֶֽת־כׇּל־דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֛ם יֵאָסֵ֥ף לָהֶ֖ם וּמָצָ֥א לָהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hts'n vbqr yshcht lhm vmts' lhm 'm 'tkhldgy hym y'sf lhm vmts' lhm {p}
verses.translation: If flocks and herds be slain for them, will they suffice them? or if all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, will they suffice them?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הֲיַ֥ד יְהֹוָ֖ה תִּקְצָ֑ר עַתָּ֥ה תִרְאֶ֛ה הֲיִקְרְךָ֥ דְבָרִ֖י אִם־לֹֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh hyd yhvh tqtsr 'th tr'h hyqrkh dbry 'ml'
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Is the LORD’S hand waxed short? now shalt thou see whether My word shall come to pass unto thee or not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיְדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֶּאֱסֹ֞ף שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲמֵ֥ד אֹתָ֖ם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: vyts' mshh vydbr 'lh'm 't dbry yhvh vy'sf shb'ym 'ysh mzqny h'm vy'md 'tm sbybt h'hl
verses.translation: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the Tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨רֶד יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ בֶּעָנָן֮ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָיו֒ וַיָּ֗אצֶל מִן־הָר֙וּחַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֕ן עַל־שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ הַזְּקֵנִ֑ים וַיְהִ֗י כְּנ֤וֹחַ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָר֔וּחַ וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יָסָֽפוּ׃
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh  b'nn vydbr 'lyv vy'tsl mnhrvch 'shr 'lyv vytn 'lshb'ym 'ysh hzqnym vyhy khnvch 'lyhm hrvch vytnb'v vl' yspv
verses.translation: And the LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy elders; and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁאֲר֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־אֲנָשִׁ֣ים ׀ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֡ה שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֣ד ׀ אֶלְדָּ֡ד וְשֵׁם֩ הַשֵּׁנִ֨י מֵידָ֜ד וַתָּ֧נַח עֲלֵהֶ֣ם הָר֗וּחַ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ בַּכְּתֻבִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָצְא֖וּ הָאֹ֑הֱלָה וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vysh'rv shny'nshym  bmchnh shm h'chd  'ldd vshm hshny mydd vtnch 'lhm hrvch vhmh bkhtbym vl' yts'v h'hlh vytnb'v bmchnh
verses.translation: But there remained two men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were recorded, but had not gone out unto the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רׇץ הַנַּ֔עַר וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לְמֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֶלְדָּ֣ד וּמֵידָ֔ד מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyrts hn'r vygd lmshh vy'mr 'ldd vmydd mtnb'ym bmchnh
verses.translation: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said: ‘Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַן יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִבְּחֻרָ֖יו וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנִ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה כְּלָאֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'n yhvsh' bnnvn mshrt mshh mbchryv vy'mr 'dny mshh khl'm
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun, the minister of Moses from his youth up, answered and said: ‘My lord Moses, shut them in.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַֽמְקַנֵּ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לִ֑י וּמִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן כׇּל־עַ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ נְבִיאִ֔ים כִּי־יִתֵּ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־רוּח֖וֹ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv mshh hmqn' 'th ly vmy ytn khl'm yhvh nby'ym khyytn yhvh 'trvchv 'lyhm
verses.translation: And Moses said unto him: ‘Art thou jealous for my sake? would that all the LORD’S people were prophets, that the LORD would put His spirit upon them! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּאָסֵ֥ף מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה ה֖וּא וְזִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'sf mshh 'lhmchnh hv' vzqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses withdrew into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְר֜וּחַ נָסַ֣ע  מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֗ה וַיָּ֣גׇז שַׂלְוִים֮ מִן־הַיָּם֒ וַיִּטֹּ֨שׁ עַל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה כְּדֶ֧רֶךְ י֣וֹם כֹּ֗ה וּכְדֶ֤רֶךְ יוֹם֙ כֹּ֔ה סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּכְאַמָּתַ֖יִם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vrvch ns'  m't yhvh vygz shlvym mnhym vytsh 'lhmchnh khdrkh yvm khh vkhdrkh yvm khh sbybvt hmchnh vkh'mtym 'lpny h'rts
verses.translation: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought across quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם הָעָ֡ם כׇּל־הַיּוֹם֩ הַה֨וּא וְכׇל־הַלַּ֜יְלָה וְכֹ֣ל  י֣וֹם הַֽמׇּחֳרָ֗ת וַיַּֽאַסְפוּ֙ אֶת־הַשְּׂלָ֔ו הַמַּמְעִ֕יט אָסַ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֳמָרִ֑ים וַיִּשְׁטְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ שָׁט֔וֹחַ סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqm h'm khlhyvm hhv' vkhlhlylh vkhl  yvm hmchrt vy'spv 'thshlv hmm'yt 'sf 'shrh chmrym vyshtchv lhm shtvch sbybvt hmchnh
verses.translation: And the people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails; he that gathered least gathered ten heaps; and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבָּשָׂ֗ר עוֹדֶ֙נּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנֵּיהֶ֔ם טֶ֖רֶם יִכָּרֵ֑ת וְאַ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ חָרָ֣ה בָעָ֔ם וַיַּ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ בָּעָ֔ם מַכָּ֖ה רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: hbshr 'vdnv byn shnyhm trm ykhrt v'f yhvh chrh b'm vykh yhvh b'm mkhh rbh m'd
verses.translation: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the anger of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא קִבְר֣וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁם֙ קָֽבְר֔וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם הַמִּתְאַוִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'tshmhmqvm hhv' qbrvt ht'vh khyshm qbrv 'th'm hmt'vym
verses.translation: And the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקִּבְר֧וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֛ה נָסְע֥וּ הָעָ֖ם חֲצֵר֑וֹת וַיִּהְי֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mqbrvt ht'vh ns'v h'm chtsrvt vyhyv bchtsrvt {p}
verses.translation: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed unto Hazeroth; and they abode at Hazeroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּדַבֵּ֨ר מִרְיָ֤ם וְאַהֲרֹן֙ בְּמֹשֶׁ֔ה עַל־אֹד֛וֹת הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַכֻּשִׁ֖ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקָ֑ח כִּֽי־אִשָּׁ֥ה כֻשִׁ֖ית לָקָֽח׃
verses.translit: vtdbr mrym v'hrn bmshh 'l'dvt h'shh hkhshyt 'shr lqch khy'shh khshyt lqch
verses.translation: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ הֲרַ֤ק אַךְ־בְּמֹשֶׁה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הֲלֹ֖א גַּם־בָּ֣נוּ דִבֵּ֑ר וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv hrq 'khbmshh dbr yhvh hl' gmbnv dbr vyshm' yhvh
verses.translation: And they said: ‘Hath the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? hath He not spoken also with us?’ And the LORD heard it.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עָנָ֣ו מְאֹ֑ד מִכֹּל֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vh'ysh mshh 'nv m'd mkhl h'dm 'shr 'lpny h'dmh {s}
verses.translation: Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men that were upon the face of the earth.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה פִּתְאֹ֗ם אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־מִרְיָ֔ם צְא֥וּ שְׁלׇשְׁתְּכֶ֖ם אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁלׇשְׁתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh pt'm 'lmshh v'l'hrn v'lmrym ts'v shlshtkhm 'l'hl mv'd vyts'v shlshtm
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam: ‘Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting.’ And they three came out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וַיִּקְרָא֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּמִרְיָ֔ם וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh b'mvd 'nn vy'md ptch h'hl vyqr' 'hrn vmrym vyts'v shnyhm
verses.translation: And the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֣א דְבָרָ֑י אִם־יִֽהְיֶה֙ נְבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם יְהֹוָ֗ה בַּמַּרְאָה֙ אֵלָ֣יו אֶתְוַדָּ֔ע בַּחֲל֖וֹם אֲדַבֶּר־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shm'vn' dbry 'myhyh nby'khm yhvh bmr'h 'lyv 'tvd' bchlvm 'dbrbv
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Hear now My words: if there be a prophet among you, I the LORD do make Myself known unto him in a vision, I do speak with him in a dream.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־כֵ֖ן עַבְדִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּכׇל־בֵּיתִ֖י נֶאֱמָ֥ן הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: l'khn 'bdy mshh bkhlbyty n'mn hv'
verses.translation: My servant Moses is not so; he is trusted in all My house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּ֣ה אֶל־פֶּ֞ה אֲדַבֶּר־בּ֗וֹ וּמַרְאֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א בְחִידֹ֔ת וּתְמֻנַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה יַבִּ֑יט וּמַדּ֙וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א יְרֵאתֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּ֖ר בְּעַבְדִּ֥י בְמֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: ph 'lph 'dbrbv vmr'h vl' bchydt vtmnt yhvh ybyt vmdv' l' yr'tm ldbr b'bdy bmshh
verses.translation: with him do I speak mouth to mouth, even manifestly, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD doth he behold; wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against My servant, against Moses?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּ֖ם וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vychr'f yhvh bm vylkh
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and He departed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעָנָ֗ן סָ֚ר מֵעַ֣ל הָאֹ֔הֶל וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִרְיָ֖ם מְצֹרַ֣עַת כַּשָּׁ֑לֶג וַיִּ֧פֶן אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶל־מִרְיָ֖ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְצֹרָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: vh'nn sr m'l h'hl vhnh mrym mtsr't khshlg vypn 'hrn 'lmrym vhnh mtsr't
verses.translation: And when the cloud was removed from over the Tent, behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow; and Aaron looked upon Miriam; and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י אַל־נָ֨א תָשֵׁ֤ת עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ חַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹאַ֖לְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'hrn 'lmshh by 'dny 'ln' tsht 'lynv cht't 'shr nv'lnv v'shr cht'nv
verses.translation: And Aaron said unto Moses: ‘Oh my lord, lay not, I pray thee, sin upon us, for that we have done foolishly, and for that we have sinned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־נָ֥א תְהִ֖י כַּמֵּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּצֵאתוֹ֙ מֵרֶ֣חֶם אִמּ֔וֹ וַיֵּאָכֵ֖ל חֲצִ֥י בְשָׂרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ln' thy khmt 'shr bts'tv mrchm 'mv vy'khl chtsy bshrv
verses.translation: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵ֕ל נָ֛א רְפָ֥א נָ֖א לָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyts'q mshh 'lyhvh l'mr 'l n' rp' n' lh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying: ‘Heal her now, O God, I beseech Thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְאָבִ֙יהָ֙ יָרֹ֤ק יָרַק֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יהָ הֲלֹ֥א תִכָּלֵ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים תִּסָּגֵ֞ר שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh v'byh yrq yrq bpnyh hl' tkhlm shb't ymym tsgr shb't ymym mchvts lmchnh v'chr t'sf
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘If her father had but spit in her face, should she not hide in shame seven days? let her be shut up without the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּסָּגֵ֥ר מִרְיָ֛ם מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְהָעָם֙ לֹ֣א נָסַ֔ע עַד־הֵאָסֵ֖ף מִרְיָֽם׃
verses.translit: vtsgr mrym mchvts lmchnh shb't ymym vh'm l' ns' 'dh'sf mrym
verses.translation: And Miriam was shut up without the camp seven days; and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַ֛ר נָסְע֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מֵחֲצֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'chr ns'v h'm mchtsrvt vychnv bmdbr p'rn {p}
verses.translation: And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלַח־לְךָ֣ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וְיָתֻ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָד֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד לְמַטֵּ֤ה אֲבֹתָיו֙ תִּשְׁלָ֔חוּ כֹּ֖ל נָשִׂ֥יא בָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shlchlkh 'nshym vytrv 't'rts khn'n 'shr'ny ntn lbny yshr'l 'ysh 'chd 'ysh 'chd lmth 'btyv tshlchv khl nshy' bhm
verses.translation: ’Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel; of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן עַל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כֻּלָּ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tm mshh mmdbr p'rn 'lpy yhvh khlm 'nshym r'shy bnyyshr'l hmh
verses.translation: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD; all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֑ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן שַׁמּ֖וּעַ בֶּן־זַכּֽוּר׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvtm lmth r'vbn shmv' bnzkhvr
verses.translation: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֔וֹן שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־חוֹרִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth shm'vn shpt bnchvry
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: lmth yhvdh khlb bnypnh
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר יִגְאָ֖ל בֶּן־יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: lmth yshshkhr yg'l bnyvsf
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה אֶפְרָ֖יִם הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃
verses.translit: lmth 'prym hvsh' bnnvn
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן פַּלְטִ֖י בֶּן־רָפֽוּא׃
verses.translit: lmth bnymn plty bnrpv'
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן גַּדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־סוֹדִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth zbvln gdy'l bnsvdy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּדִּ֖י בֶּן־סוּסִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth yvsf lmth mnshh gdy bnsvsy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה דָ֔ן עַמִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־גְּמַלִּֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth dn 'my'l bngmly
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר סְת֖וּר בֶּן־מִיכָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lmth 'shr stvr bnmykh'l
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֔י נַחְבִּ֖י בֶּן־וׇפְסִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth nptly nchby bnvpsy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה גָ֔ד גְּאוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־מָכִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth gd g'v'l bnmkhy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־נ֖וּן יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt h'nshym 'shrshlch mshh ltvr 'th'rts vyqr' mshh lhvsh' bnnvn yhvsh'
verses.translation: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֹתָם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָת֖וּר אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם עֲל֥וּ זֶה֙ בַּנֶּ֔גֶב וַעֲלִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־הָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tm mshh ltvr 't'rts khn'n vy'mr 'lhm 'lv zh bngb v'lytm 'thhr
verses.translation: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them: ‘Get you up here into the South, and go up into the mountains;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ מַה־הִ֑וא וְאֶת־הָעָם֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב עָלֶ֔יהָ הֶחָזָ֥ק הוּא֙ הֲרָפֶ֔ה הַמְעַ֥ט ה֖וּא אִם־רָֽב׃
verses.translit: vr'ytm 'th'rts mhhv' v'th'm hyshb 'lyh hchzq hv' hrph hm't hv' 'mrb
verses.translation: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ הֲטוֹבָ֥ה הִ֖וא אִם־רָעָ֑ה וּמָ֣ה הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־הוּא֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּהֵ֔נָּה הַבְּמַֽחֲנִ֖ים אִ֥ם בְּמִבְצָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmh h'rts 'shrhv' yshb bh htvbh hv' 'mr'h vmh h'rym 'shrhv' yvshb bhnh hbmchnym 'm bmbtsrym
verses.translation: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה הָ֠אָ֠רֶץ הַשְּׁמֵנָ֨ה הִ֜וא אִם־רָזָ֗ה הֲיֵֽשׁ־בָּ֥הּ עֵץ֙ אִם־אַ֔יִן וְהִ֨תְחַזַּקְתֶּ֔ם וּלְקַחְתֶּ֖ם מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨יָּמִ֔ים יְמֵ֖י בִּכּוּרֵ֥י עֲנָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmh h'rts hshmnh hv' 'mrzh hyshbh 'ts 'm'yn vhtchzqtm vlqchtm mpry h'rts vhymym ymy bkhvry 'nbym
verses.translation: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land.’—Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ וַיָּתֻ֣רוּ אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר־צִ֥ן עַד־רְחֹ֖ב לְבֹ֥א חֲמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vy'lv vytrv 'th'rts mmdbrtsn 'drchb lb' chmt
verses.translation: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, at the entrance to Hamath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בַנֶּ֘גֶב֮ וַיָּבֹ֣א עַד־חֶבְרוֹן֒ וְשָׁ֤ם אֲחִימַן֙ שֵׁשַׁ֣י וְתַלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָ֑ק וְחֶבְר֗וֹן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ נִבְנְתָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י צֹ֥עַן מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'lv bngb vyb' 'dchbrvn vshm 'chymn shshy vtlmy ylydy h'nq vchbrvn shb' shnym nbnth lpny ts'n mtsrym
verses.translation: And they went up into the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there.—Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד־נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֗ל וַיִּכְרְת֨וּ מִשָּׁ֤ם זְמוֹרָה֙ וְאֶשְׁכּ֤וֹל עֲנָבִים֙ אֶחָ֔ד וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֥הוּ בַמּ֖וֹט בִּשְׁנָ֑יִם וּמִן־הָרִמֹּנִ֖ים וּמִן־הַתְּאֵנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'dnchl 'shkhl vykhrtv mshm zmvrh v'shkhvl 'nbym 'chd vysh'hv bmvt bshnym vmnhrmnym vmnht'nym
verses.translation: And they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it upon a pole between two; they took also of the pomegranates, and of the figs.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קָרָ֖א נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹל עַ֚ל אֹד֣וֹת הָֽאֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־כָּרְת֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lmqvm hhv' qr' nchl 'shkhvl 'l 'dvt h'shkhvl 'shrkhrtv mshm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִתּ֣וּר הָאָ֑רֶץ מִקֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyshbv mtvr h'rts mqts 'rb'ym yvm
verses.translation: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֡וּ וַיָּבֹ֩אוּ֩ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־כׇּל־עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן קָדֵ֑שָׁה וַיָּשִׁ֨יבוּ אֹתָ֤ם דָּבָר֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּרְא֖וּם אֶת־פְּרִ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vylkhv vyb'v 'lmshh v'l'hrn v'lkhl'dt bnyyshr'l 'lmdbr p'rn qdshh vyshybv 'tm dbr v'tkhlh'dh vyr'vm 'tpry h'rts
verses.translation: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בָּ֕אנוּ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְ֠גַ֠ם זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֥ב וּדְבַ֛שׁ הִ֖וא וְזֶה־פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vysprvlv vy'mrv b'nv 'lh'rts 'shr shlchtnv vgm zbt chlb vdbsh hv' vzhpryh
verses.translation: And they told him, and said: ‘We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֚פֶס כִּֽי־עַ֣ז הָעָ֔ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים בְּצֻר֤וֹת גְּדֹלֹת֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְגַם־יְלִדֵ֥י הָֽעֲנָ֖ק רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'ps khy'z h'm hyshb b'rts vh'rym btsrvt gdlt m'd vgmyldy h'nq r'ynv shm
verses.translation: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are fierce, and the cities are fortified, and very great; and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲמָלֵ֥ק יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַנֶּ֑גֶב וְ֠הַֽחִתִּ֠י וְהַיְבוּסִ֤י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֔ר וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל־הַיָּ֔ם וְעַ֖ל יַ֥ד הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: 'mlq yvshb b'rts hngb vhchty vhybvsy vh'mry yvshb bhr vhkhn'ny yvshb 'lhym v'l yd hyrdn
verses.translation: Amalek dwelleth in the land of the South; and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the mountains; and the Canaanite dwelleth by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧הַס כָּלֵ֛ב אֶת־הָעָ֖ם אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר עָלֹ֤ה נַעֲלֶה֙ וְיָרַ֣שְׁנוּ אֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי־יָכ֥וֹל נוּכַ֖ל לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyhs khlb 'th'm 'lmshh vy'mr 'lh n'lh vyrshnv 'th khyykhvl nvkhl lh
verses.translation: And Caleb stilled the people toward Moses, and said: ‘We should go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֨אֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־עָל֤וּ עִמּוֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לַעֲל֣וֹת אֶל־הָעָ֑ם כִּֽי־חָזָ֥ק ה֖וּא מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vh'nshym 'shr'lv 'mv 'mrv l' nvkhl l'lvt 'lh'm khychzq hv' mmnv
verses.translation: But the men that went up with him said: ‘We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּצִ֜יאוּ דִּבַּ֤ת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבַ֨רְנוּ בָ֜הּ לָת֣וּר אֹתָ֗הּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֹכֶ֤לֶת יוֹשְׁבֶ֙יהָ֙ הִ֔וא וְכׇל־הָעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֥ינוּ בְתוֹכָ֖הּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִדּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vytsy'v dbt h'rts 'shr trv 'th 'lbny yshr'l l'mr h'rts 'shr 'brnv bh ltvr 'th 'rts 'khlt yvshbyh hv' vkhlh'm 'shrr'ynv btvkhh 'nshy mdvt
verses.translation: And they spread an evil report of the land which they had spied out unto the children of Israel, saying: ‘The land, through which we have passed to spy it out, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣ם רָאִ֗ינוּ אֶת־הַנְּפִילִ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ק מִן־הַנְּפִלִ֑ים וַנְּהִ֤י בְעֵינֵ֙ינוּ֙ כַּֽחֲגָבִ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן הָיִ֖ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshm r'ynv 'thnpylym bny 'nq mnhnplym vnhy b'ynynv khchgbym vkhn hyynv b'ynyhm
verses.translation: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim; and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂא֙ כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ אֶת־קוֹלָ֑ם וַיִּבְכּ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vtsh' khlh'dh vytnv 'tqvlm vybkhv h'm blylh hhv'
verses.translation: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלֹּ֙נוּ֙ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵהֶ֜ם כׇּל־הָעֵדָ֗ה לוּ־מַ֙תְנוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם א֛וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה לוּ־מָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vylnv 'lmshh v'l'hrn khl bny yshr'l vy'mrv 'lhm khlh'dh lvmtnv b'rts mtsrym 'v bmdbr hzh lvmtnv
verses.translation: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron; and the whole congregation said unto them: ‘Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would we had died in this wilderness!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָמָ֣ה יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה מֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜נוּ אֶל־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לִנְפֹּ֣ל בַּחֶ֔רֶב נָשֵׁ֥ינוּ וְטַפֵּ֖נוּ יִהְי֣וּ לָבַ֑ז הֲל֧וֹא ט֦וֹב לָ֖נוּ שׁ֥וּב מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vlmh yhvh mby' 'tnv 'lh'rts hz't lnpl bchrb nshynv vtpnv yhyv lbz hlv' tvb lnv shvb mtsrymh
verses.translation: And wherefore doth the LORD bring us unto this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey; were it not better for us to return into Egypt?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו נִתְּנָ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְנָשׁ֥וּבָה מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l'chyv ntnh r'sh vnshvbh mtsrymh
verses.translation: And they said one to another: ‘Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם לִפְנֵ֕י כׇּל־קְהַ֥ל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vypl mshh v'hrn 'lpnyhm lpny khlqhl 'dt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן וְכָלֵב֙ בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה מִן־הַתָּרִ֖ים אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ קָרְע֖וּ בִּגְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhvsh' bnnvn vkhlb bnypnh mnhtrym 'th'rts qr'v bgdyhm
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of them that spied out the land, rent their clothes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל־כׇּל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבַ֤רְנוּ בָהּ֙ לָת֣וּר אֹתָ֔הּ טוֹבָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lkhl'dt bnyyshr'l l'mr h'rts 'shr 'brnv bh ltvr 'th tvbh h'rts m'd m'd
verses.translation: And they spoke unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying: ‘The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־חָפֵ֥ץ בָּ֙נוּ֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהֵבִ֤יא אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וּנְתָנָ֖הּ לָ֑נוּ אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הִ֛וא זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'mchpts bnv yhvh vhby' 'tnv 'lh'rts hz't vntnh lnv 'rts 'shrhv' zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: If the LORD delight in us, then He will bring us into this land, and give it unto us—a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּיהֹוָה֮ אַל־תִּמְרֹ֒דוּ֒ וְאַתֶּ֗ם אַל־תִּֽירְאוּ֙ אֶת־עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י לַחְמֵ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם סָ֣ר צִלָּ֧ם מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֛ם וַֽיהֹוָ֥ה אִתָּ֖נוּ אַל־תִּירָאֻֽם׃
verses.translit: 'kh byhvh 'ltmrdv v'tm 'ltyr'v 't'm h'rts khy lchmnv hm sr tslm m'lyhm vyhvh 'tnv 'ltyr'm
verses.translation: Only rebel not against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us; their defence is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us; fear them not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִרְגּ֥וֹם אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וּכְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֗ה נִרְאָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֶֽל־כׇּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mrv khlh'dh lrgvm 'tm b'bnym vkhbvd yhvh nr'h b'hl mv'd 'lkhlbny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones, when the glory of the LORD appeared in the tent of meeting unto all the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד־אָ֥נָה יְנַאֲצֻ֖נִי הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַד־אָ֙נָה֙ לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ בִ֔י בְּכֹל֙ הָֽאֹת֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh 'd'nh yn'tsny h'm hzh v'd'nh l'y'mynv by bkhl h'tvt 'shr 'shyty bqrbv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘How long will this people despise Me? and how long will they not believe in Me, for all the signs which I have wrought among them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַדֶּ֖בֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁ֑נּוּ וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֹֽתְךָ֔ לְגוֹי־גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'khnv bdbr v'vrshnv v''shh 'tkh lgvygdvl v'tsvm mmnv
verses.translation: I will smite them with the pestilence, and destroy them, and will make of thee a nation greater and mightier than they.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְשָׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּֽי־הֶעֱלִ֧יתָ בְכֹחֲךָ֛ אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה מִקִּרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'lyhvh vshm'v mtsrym khyh'lyt bkhchkh 'th'm hzh mqrbv
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD: ‘When the Egyptians shall hear—for Thou broughtest up this people in Thy might from among them—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ אֶל־יוֹשֵׁב֮ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּאת֒ שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּקֶ֖רֶב הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־עַ֨יִן בְּעַ֜יִן נִרְאָ֣ה  אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֗ה וַעֲנָֽנְךָ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עֲלֵהֶ֔ם וּבְעַמֻּ֣ד עָנָ֗ן אַתָּ֨ה הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּבְעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: v'mrv 'lyvshb h'rts hz't shm'v khy'th yhvh bqrb h'm hzh 'shr'yn b'yn nr'h  'th yhvh v'nnkh 'md 'lhm vb'md 'nn 'th hlkh lpnyhm yvmm vb'mvd 'sh lylh
verses.translation: they will say to the inhabitants of this land, who have heard that Thou LORD art in the midst of this people; inasmuch as Thou LORD art seen face to face, and Thy cloud standeth over them, and Thou goest before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵמַתָּ֛ה אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶֽת־שִׁמְעֲךָ֖ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vhmth 'th'm hzh kh'ysh 'chd v'mrv hgvym 'shrshm'v 'tshm'kh l'mr
verses.translation: now if Thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of Thee will speak, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבִּלְתִּ֞י יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהֹוָ֗ה לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לָהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: mblty ykhlt yhvh lhby' 'th'm hzh 'lh'rts 'shrnshb' lhm vyshchtm bmdbr
verses.translation: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which He swore unto them, therefore He hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה יִגְדַּל־נָ֖א כֹּ֣חַ אֲדֹנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'th ygdln' khch 'dny kh'shr dbrt l'mr
verses.translation: And now, I pray Thee, let the power of the Lord be great, according as Thou hast spoken, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וְרַב־חֶ֔סֶד נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֖ן וָפָ֑שַׁע וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֞ד עֲוֺ֤ן אָבוֹת֙ עַל־בָּנִ֔ים עַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִֽים׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'rkh 'pym vrbchsd nsh' 'vn vpsh' vnqh l' ynqh pqd 'vn 'bvt 'lbnym 'lshlshym v'lrb'ym
verses.translation: The LORD is slow to anger, and plenteous in lovingkindness, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סְלַֽח־נָ֗א לַעֲוֺ֛ן הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּגֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: slchn' l'vn h'm hzh khgdl chsdkh vkh'shr nsh'th l'm hzh mmtsrym v'dhnh
verses.translation: Pardon, I pray Thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of Thy lovingkindness, and according as Thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה סָלַ֖חְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh slchty khdbrkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘I have pardoned according to thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֖ם חַי־אָ֑נִי וְיִמָּלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'vlm chy'ny vyml' khbvdyhvh 'tkhlh'rts
verses.translation: But in very deed, as I live—and all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כׇל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָרֹאִ֤ים אֶת־כְּבֹדִי֙ וְאֶת־אֹ֣תֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתִי בְמִצְרַ֖יִם וּבַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֹתִ֗י זֶ֚ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּקוֹלִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy khlh'nshym hr'ym 'tkhbdy v't'tty 'shr'shyty bmtsrym vbmdbr vynsv 'ty zh 'shr p'mym vl' shm'v bqvly
verses.translation: surely all those men that have seen My glory, and My signs, which I wrought in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have put Me to proof these ten times, and have not hearkened to My voice;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֑ם וְכׇל־מְנַאֲצַ֖י לֹ֥א יִרְאֽוּהָ׃
verses.translit: 'myr'v 'th'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'btm vkhlmn'tsy l' yr'vh
verses.translation: surely they shall not see the land which I swore unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that despised Me see it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַבְדִּ֣י כָלֵ֗ב עֵ֣קֶב הָֽיְתָ֞ה ר֤וּחַ אַחֶ֙רֶת֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַיְמַלֵּ֖א אַחֲרָ֑י וַהֲבִֽיאֹתִ֗יו אֶל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣א שָׁ֔מָּה וְזַרְע֖וֹ יוֹרִשֶֽׁנָּה׃
verses.translit: v'bdy khlb 'qb hyth rvch 'chrt 'mv vyml' 'chry vhby'tyv 'lh'rts 'shrb' shmh vzr'v yvrshnh
verses.translation: But My servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed Me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעֲמָלֵקִ֥י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּעֵ֑מֶק מָחָ֗ר פְּנ֨וּ וּסְע֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־סֽוּף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vh'mlqy vhkhn'ny yvshb b'mq mchr pnv vs'v lkhm hmdbr drkh ymsvf {p}
verses.translation: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the Vale; tomorrow turn ye, and get you into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh v'l'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֗י לָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה מַלִּינִ֖ים עָלָ֑י אֶת־תְּלֻנּ֞וֹת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧מָּה מַלִּינִ֛ים עָלַ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.translit: 'dmty l'dh hr'h hz't 'shr hmh mlynym 'ly 'ttlnvt bny yshr'l 'shr hmh mlynym 'ly shm'ty
verses.translation: ’How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that keep murmuring against Me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they keep murmuring against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם חַי־אָ֙נִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה אִם־לֹ֕א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם בְּאׇזְנָ֑י כֵּ֖ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'lhm chy'ny n'myhvh 'ml' kh'shr dbrtm b'zny khn ''shh lkhm
verses.translation: Say unto them: As I live, saith the LORD, surely as ye have spoken in Mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ֠זֶּ֠ה יִפְּל֨וּ פִגְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְכׇל־פְּקֻדֵיכֶם֙ לְכׇל־מִסְפַּרְכֶ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲלִֽינֹתֶ֖ם עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: bmdbr hzh yplv pgrykhm vkhlpqdykhm lkhlmsprkhm mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh 'shr hlyntm 'ly
verses.translation: your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness, and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, ye that have murmured against Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אַתֶּם֙ תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־יָדִ֔י לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּ֑הּ כִּ֚י אִם־כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'm'tm tb'v 'lh'rts 'shr nsh'ty 'tydy lshkhn 'tkhm bh khy 'mkhlb bnypnh vyhvsh' bnnvn
verses.translation: surely ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I lifted up My hand that I would make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטַ֨פְּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהֵבֵיאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְאַסְתֶּ֖ם בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtpkhm 'shr 'mrtm lbz yhyh vhby'ty 'tm vyd'v 'th'rts 'shr m'stm bh
verses.translation: But your little ones, that ye said would be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have rejected.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפִגְרֵיכֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֑ם יִפְּל֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vpgrykhm 'tm yplv bmdbr hzh
verses.translation: But as for you, your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠בְנֵיכֶ֠ם יִהְי֨וּ רֹעִ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־זְנוּתֵיכֶ֑ם עַד־תֹּ֥ם פִּגְרֵיכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vbnykhm yhyv r'ym bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh vnsh'v 'tznvtykhm 'dtm pgrykhm bmdbr
verses.translation: And your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your strayings, until your carcasses be consumed in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמִסְפַּ֨ר הַיָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־תַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֘רֶץ֮ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים יוֹם֒ י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֞ה י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֗ה תִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־תְּנוּאָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: bmspr hymym 'shrtrtm 'th'rts 'rb'ym yvm yvm lshnh yvm lshnh tsh'v 't'vntykhm 'rb'ym shnh vyd'tm 'ttnv'ty
verses.translation: After the number of the days in which ye spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know My displeasure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָה֮ דִּבַּ֒רְתִּי֒ אִם־לֹ֣א  זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֗ה לְכׇל־הָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את הַנּוֹעָדִ֖ים עָלָ֑י בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה יִתַּ֖מּוּ וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh dbrty 'ml'  z't ''shh lkhlh'dh hr'h hz't hnv'dym 'ly bmdbr hzh ytmv vshm ymtv
verses.translation: I the LORD have spoken, surely this will I do unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against Me; in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּשֻׁ֗בוּ (וילונו) [וַיַּלִּ֤ינוּ] עָלָיו֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לְהוֹצִ֥יא דִבָּ֖ה עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vh'nshym 'shrshlch mshh ltvr 'th'rts vyshbv (vylvnv) [vylynv] 'lyv 'tkhlh'dh lhvtsy' dbh 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, and who, when they returned, made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּמֻ֙תוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים מוֹצִאֵ֥י דִבַּת־הָאָ֖רֶץ רָעָ֑ה בַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymtv h'nshym mvts'y dbth'rts r'h bmgph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: even those men that did bring up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן וְכָלֵ֖ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֑ה חָיוּ֙ מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הַהֹלְכִ֖ים לָת֥וּר אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyhvsh' bnnvn vkhlb bnypnh chyv mnh'nshym hhm hhlkhym ltvr 'th'rts
verses.translation: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men that went to spy out the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל־כׇּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽתְאַבְּל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'thdbrym h'lh 'lkhlbny yshr'l vyt'blv h'm m'd
verses.translation: And Moses told these words unto all the children of Israel; and the people mourned greatly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּֽעֲל֥וּ אֶל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֶּ֗נּוּ וְעָלִ֛ינוּ אֶל־הַמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshkhmv bbqr vy'lv 'lr'shhhr l'mr hnnv v'lynv 'lhmqvm 'shr'mr yhvh khy cht'nv
verses.translation: And they rose up early in the morning, and got them up to the top of the mountain, saying: ‘Lo, we are here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised; for we have sinned.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֛ה אַתֶּ֥ם עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶת־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א תִצְלָֽח׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lmh zh 'tm 'brym 'tpy yhvh vhv' l' ttslch
verses.translation: And Moses said: ‘Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD, seeing it shall not prosper?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תַּעֲל֔וּ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּ֣גְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lt'lv khy 'yn yhvh bqrbkhm vl' tngpv lpny 'ybykhm
verses.translation: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten down before your enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָעֲמָלֵקִ֨י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וּנְפַלְתֶּ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־עַל־כֵּ֤ן שַׁבְתֶּם֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy h'mlqy vhkhn'ny shm lpnykhm vnpltm bchrb khy'lkhn shbtm m'chry yhvh vl'yhyh yhvh 'mkhm
verses.translation: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and ye shall fall by the sword; forasmuch as ye are turned back from following the LORD, and the LORD will not be with you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעְפִּ֕לוּ לַעֲל֖וֹת אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַאֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה֙ וּמֹשֶׁ֔ה לֹא־מָ֖שׁוּ מִקֶּ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'plv l'lvt 'lr'sh hhr v'rvn brytyhvh vmshh l'mshv mqrb hmchnh
verses.translation: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain; nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּהָ֣ר הַה֑וּא וַיַּכּ֥וּם וַֽיַּכְּת֖וּם עַד־הַֽחׇרְמָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyrd h'mlqy vhkhn'ny hyshb bhr hhv' vykhvm vykhtvm 'dhchrmh {p}
verses.translation: Then the Amalekite and the Canaanite, who dwelt in that hill-country, came down, and smote them and beat them down, even unto Hormah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy tb'v 'l'rts mvshbtykhm 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye are come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִנְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה מִן־הַבָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן־הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.translit: v'shytm 'shh lyhvh 'lh 'vzbch lpl'ndr 'v bndbh 'v bm'dykhm l'shvt rych nychch lyhvh mnhbqr 'v mnhts'n
verses.translation: and will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice, in fulfilment of a vow clearly uttered, or as a freewill-offering, or in your appointed seasons, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֛יב הַמַּקְרִ֥יב קׇרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂר֔וֹן בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: vhqryb hmqryb qrbnv lyhvh mnchh slt 'shrvn blvl brb'yt hhyn shmn
verses.translation: then shall he that bringeth his offering present unto the LORD a meal-offering of a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֙סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל־הָעֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַזָּ֑בַח לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyyn lnskh rby'yt hhyn t'shh 'lh'lh 'v lzbch lkhbsh h'chd
verses.translation: and wine for the drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin, shalt thou prepare with the burnt-offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֤וֹ לָאַ֙יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'v l'yl t'shh mnchh slt shny 'shrnym blvlh bshmn shlshyt hhyn
verses.translation: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal-offering two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyyn lnskh shlshyt hhyn tqryb rychnychch lyhvh
verses.translation: and for the drink-offering thou shalt present the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן־בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ־שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhyt'shh bnbqr 'lh 'vzbch lpl'ndr 'vshlmym lyhvh
verses.translation: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, in fulfilment of a vow clearly uttered, or for peace-offerings unto the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל־בֶּן־הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין׃
verses.translit: vhqryb 'lbnhbqr mnchh slt shlshh 'shrnym blvl bshmn chtsy hhyn
verses.translation: then shall there be presented with the bullock a meal-offering of three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyyn tqryb lnskh chtsy hhyn 'shh rychnychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt present for the drink-offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַשּׁוֹר֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד א֖וֹ לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ־לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָעִזִּֽים׃
verses.translit: khkhh y'shh lshvr h'chd 'v l'yl h'chd 'vlshh bkhbshym 'v b'zym
verses.translation: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃
verses.translit: khmspr 'shr t'shv khkhh t'shv l'chd khmsprm
verses.translation: According to the number that ye may prepare, so shall ye do for every one according to their number.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה־כָּ֖כָה אֶת־אֵ֑לֶּה לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khlh'zrch y'shhkhkhh 't'lh lhqryb 'shh rychnychch lyhvh
verses.translation: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יָגוּר֩ אִתְּכֶ֨ם גֵּ֜ר א֤וֹ אֲשֶׁר־בְּתֽוֹכְכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vkhyygvr 'tkhm gr 'v 'shrbtvkhkhm ldrtykhm v'shh 'shh rychnychch lyhvh kh'shr t'shv khn y'shh
verses.translation: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever may be among you, throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָכֶ֖ם וְלַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כָּכֶ֛ם כַּגֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hqhl chqh 'cht lkhm vlgr hgr chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm khkhm khgr yhyh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: As for the congregation, there shall be one statute both for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you, a statute for ever throughout your generations; as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר אִתְּכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tvrh 'cht vmshpt 'chd yhyh lkhm vlgr hgr 'tkhm {p}
verses.translation: One law and one ordinance shall be both for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בְּבֹֽאֲכֶם֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm bb'khm 'lh'rts 'shr 'ny mby' 'tkhm shmh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה בַּאֲכׇלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh b'khlkhm mlchm h'rts trymv trvmh lyhvh
verses.translation: then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall set apart a portion for a gift unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: r'shyt 'rstkhm chlh trymv trvmh khtrvmt grn khn trymv 'th
verses.translation: Of the first of your dough ye shall set apart a cake for a gift; as that which is set apart of the threshing-floor, so shall ye set it apart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵרֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֖תֵיכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mr'shyt 'rstykhm ttnv lyhvh trvmh ldrtykhm {s}
verses.translation: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD a portion for a gift throughout your generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vkhy tshgv vl' t'shv 't khlhmtsvt h'lh 'shrdbr yhvh 'lmshh
verses.translation: And when ye shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
