verses.translit: bny zbvln lmshpchtm lsrd mshpcht hsrdy l'lvn mshpcht h'lny lychl'l mshpcht hychl'ly
verses.translation: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַזְּבוּלֹנִ֖י לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht hzbvlny lpqdyhm shshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt {s}
verses.translation: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: bny yvsf lmshpchtm mnshh v'prym
verses.translation: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לְמָכִיר֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמָּכִירִ֔י וּמָכִ֖יר הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־גִּלְעָ֑ד לְגִלְעָ֕ד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגִּלְעָדִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny mnshh lmkhyr mshpcht hmkhyry vmkhyr hvlyd 'tgl'd lgl'd mshpcht hgl'dy
verses.translation: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites—and Machir begot Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד אִיעֶ֕זֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאִֽיעֶזְרִ֑י לְחֵ֕לֶק מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶלְקִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lh bny gl'd 'y'zr mshpcht h'y'zry lchlq mshpcht hchlqy
verses.translation: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֨שְׂרִיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאַשְׂרִֽאֵלִ֑י וְשֶׁ֕כֶם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁכְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'shry'l mshpcht h'shr'ly vshkhm mshpcht hshkhmy
verses.translation: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמִידָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִ֑י וְחֵ֕פֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶפְרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vshmyd' mshpcht hshmyd'y vchpr mshpcht hchpry
verses.translation: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְלׇפְחָ֣ד בֶּן־חֵ֗פֶר לֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וְשֵׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צְלׇפְחָ֔ד מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חׇגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtslpchd bnchpr l'hyv lv bnym khy 'mbnvt vshm bnvt tslpchd mchlh vn'h chglh mlkhh vtrtsh
verses.translation: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht mnshh vpqdyhm shnym vchmshym 'lf vshb' m'vt {s}
verses.translation: These are the families of Manasseh; and they that were numbered of them were fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַ֘יִם֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְשׁוּתֶ֗לַח מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַשֻּׁ֣תַלְחִ֔י לְבֶ֕כֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַבַּכְרִ֑י לְתַ֕חַן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽתַּחֲנִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lh bny'prym lmshpchtm lshvtlch mshpcht hshtlchy lbkhr mshpcht hbkhry ltchn mshpcht htchny
verses.translation: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י שׁוּתָ֑לַח לְעֵרָ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָעֵרָנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny shvtlch l'rn mshpcht h'rny
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֤ת בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לִפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bny'prym lpqdyhm shnym vshlshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt 'lh bnyyvsf lmshpchtm {s}
verses.translation: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְבֶ֗לַע מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַבַּלְעִ֔י לְאַשְׁבֵּ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽאַשְׁבֵּלִ֑י לַאֲחִירָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֲחִירָמִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny bnymn lmshpchtm lbl' mshpcht hbl'y l'shbl mshpcht h'shbly l'chyrm mshpcht h'chyrmy
verses.translation: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁפוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּפָמִ֑י לְחוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַחוּפָמִֽי׃
verses.translit: lshpvpm mshpcht hshvpmy lchvpm mshpcht hchvpmy
verses.translation: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־בֶ֖לַע אַ֣רְדְּ וְנַעֲמָ֑ן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הָֽאַרְדִּ֔י לְנַֽעֲמָ֔ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽנַּעֲמִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnybl' 'rd vn'mn mshpcht h'rdy ln'mn mshpcht hn'my
verses.translation: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman; [of Ard,] the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh bnybnymn lmshpchtm vpqdyhm chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt {s}
verses.translation: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־דָן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לְשׁוּחָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּחָמִ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת דָּ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh bnydn lmshpchtm lshvchm mshpcht hshvchmy 'lh mshpcht dn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַשּׁוּחָמִ֖י לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlmshpcht hshvchmy lpqdyhm 'rb'h vshshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt {s}
verses.translation: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁר֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְיִמְנָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַיִּמְנָ֔ה לְיִשְׁוִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיִּשְׁוִ֑י לִבְרִיעָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַבְּרִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny 'shr lmshpchtm lymnh mshpcht hymnh lyshvy mshpcht hyshvy lbry'h mshpcht hbry'y
verses.translation: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה לְחֶ֕בֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶבְרִ֑י לְמַ֨לְכִּיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִֽי׃
verses.translit: lbny bry'h lchbr mshpcht hchbry lmlkhy'l mshpcht hmlkhy'ly
verses.translation: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֥ם בַּת־אָשֵׁ֖ר שָֽׂרַח׃
verses.translit: vshm bt'shr shrch
verses.translation: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־אָשֵׁ֖ר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bny'shr lpqdyhm shlshh vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt {s}
verses.translation: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י נַפְתָּלִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לְיַ֨חְצְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיַּחְצְאֵלִ֑י לְגוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגּוּנִֽי׃
verses.translit: bny nptly lmshpchtm lychts'l mshpcht hychts'ly lgvny mshpcht hgvny
verses.translation: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְיֵ֕צֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיִּצְרִ֑י לְשִׁלֵּ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִֽי׃
verses.translit: lytsr mshpcht hytsry lshlm mshpcht hshlmy
verses.translation: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וּפְקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht nptly lmshpchtm vpqdyhm chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה פְּקוּדֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וָאָ֑לֶף שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy bny yshr'l shshm'vt 'lf v'lf shb' m'vt vshlshym {p}
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָאֵ֗לֶּה תֵּחָלֵ֥ק הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: l'lh tchlq h'rts bnchlh bmspr shmvt
verses.translation: ’Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָרַ֗ב תַּרְבֶּה֙ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ וְלַמְעַ֕ט תַּמְעִ֖יט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י פְקֻדָ֔יו יֻתַּ֖ן נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lrb trbh nchltv vlm't tm'yt nchltv 'ysh lpy pqdyv ytn nchltv
verses.translation: To the more thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance; to each one according to those that were numbered of it shall its inheritance be given.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בְּגוֹרָ֕ל יֵחָלֵ֖ק אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ לִשְׁמ֥וֹת מַטּוֹת־אֲבֹתָ֖ם יִנְחָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'khbgvrl ychlq 'th'rts lshmvt mtvt'btm ynchlv
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot; according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פִּי֙ הַגּוֹרָ֔ל תֵּחָלֵ֖ק נַחֲלָת֑וֹ בֵּ֥ין רַ֖ב לִמְעָֽט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lpy hgvrl tchlq nchltv byn rb lm't {s}
verses.translation: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֣י הַלֵּוִי֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְגֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י לִקְהָ֕ת מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקְּהָתִ֑י לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמְּרָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'lh pqvdy hlvy lmshpchtm lgrshvn mshpcht hgrshny lqht mshpcht hqhty lmrry mshpcht hmrry
verses.translation: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה  מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת לֵוִ֗י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת הַלִּבְנִ֜י מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽחֶבְרֹנִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַמַּחְלִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקׇּרְחִ֑י וּקְהָ֖ת הוֹלִ֥ד אֶת־עַמְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh  mshpcht lvy mshpcht hlbny mshpcht hchbrny mshpcht hmchly mshpcht hmvshy mshpcht hqrchy vqht hvld 't'mrm
verses.translation: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath begot Amram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֣ם  אֵ֣שֶׁת עַמְרָ֗ם יוֹכֶ֙בֶד֙ בַּת־לֵוִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֥ה אֹתָ֛הּ לְלֵוִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעַמְרָ֗ם אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת מִרְיָ֥ם אֲחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vshm  'sht 'mrm yvkhbd btlvy 'shr yldh 'th llvy bmtsrym vtld l'mrm 't'hrn v'tmshh v't mrym 'chtm
verses.translation: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶת־נָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֲבִיה֑וּא אֶת־אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־אִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyvld l'hrn 'tndb v't'byhv' 't'l'zr v't'ytmr
verses.translation: And unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥מׇת נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִיה֑וּא בְּהַקְרִיבָ֥ם אֵשׁ־זָרָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymt ndb v'byhv' bhqrybm 'shzrh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כׇּל־זָכָ֖ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה כִּ֣י  לֹ֣א הׇתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא־נִתַּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm shlshh v'shrym 'lf khlzkhr mbnchdsh vm'lh khy  l' htpqdv btvkh bny yshr'l khy l'ntn lhm nchlh btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And they that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 'shr pqdv 'tbny yshr'l b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ לֹא־הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.translit: vb'lh l'hyh 'ysh mpqvdy mshh v'hrn hkhhn 'shr pqdv 'tbny yshr'l bmdbr syny
verses.translation: But among these there was not a man of them that were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם מ֥וֹת יָמֻ֖תוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְלֹא־נוֹתַ֤ר מֵהֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֚י אִם־כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy'mr yhvh lhm mvt ymtv bmdbr vl'nvtr mhm 'ysh khy 'mkhlb bnypnh vyhvsh' bnnvn {s}
verses.translation: For the LORD had said of them: ‘They shall surely die in the wilderness.’ And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרַ֜בְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלׇפְחָ֗ד בֶּן־חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֑ף וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה נֹעָ֔ה וְחׇגְלָ֥ה וּמִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtqrbnh bnvt tslpchd bnchpr bngl'd bnmkhyr bnmnshh lmshpcht mnshh bnyvsf v'lh shmvt bntyv mchlh n'h vchglh vmlkhh vtrtsh
verses.translation: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְלִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֖ם וְכׇל־הָעֵדָ֑ה פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vt'mdnh lpny mshh vlpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny hnshy'm vkhlh'dh ptch 'hlmv'd l'mr
verses.translation: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the tent of meeting, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבִ֘ינוּ֮ מֵ֣ת בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ וְה֨וּא לֹא־הָיָ֜ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֗ה הַנּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּעֲדַת־קֹ֑רַח כִּֽי־בְחֶטְא֣וֹ מֵ֔ת וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'bynv mt bmdbr vhv' l'hyh btvkh h'dh hnv'dym 'lyhvh b'dtqrch khybcht'v mt vbnym l'hyv lv
verses.translation: ’Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה יִגָּרַ֤ע שֵׁם־אָבִ֙ינוּ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בֵּ֑ן תְּנָה־לָּ֣נוּ אֲחֻזָּ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: lmh ygr' shm'bynv mtvkh mshpchtv khy 'yn lv bn tnhlnv 'chzh btvkh 'chy 'bynv
verses.translation: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he had no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqrb mshh 'tmshptn lpny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן בְּנ֣וֹת צְלׇפְחָד֮ דֹּבְרֹת֒ נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ן לָהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: khn bnvt tslpchd dbrt ntn ttn lhm 'chzt nchlh btvkh 'chy 'byhm vh'brt 'tnchlt 'byhn lhn
verses.translation: ’The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ כִּֽי־יָמ֗וּת וּבֵן֙ אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וְהַֽעֲבַרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְבִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lbny yshr'l tdbr l'mr 'ysh khyymvt vbn 'yn lv vh'brtm 'tnchltv lbtv
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying: If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בַּ֑ת וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְאֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'm'yn lv bt vnttm 'tnchltv l'chyv
verses.translation: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ אַחִ֑ים וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לַאֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'm'yn lv 'chym vnttm 'tnchltv l'chy 'byv
verses.translation: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אֵ֣ין אַחִים֮ לְאָבִיו֒ וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת־נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לִשְׁאֵר֞וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛יו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ וְיָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֻקַּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֔ט כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'm'yn 'chym l'byv vnttm 'tnchltv lsh'rv hqrb 'lyv mmshpchtv vyrsh 'th vhyth lbny yshr'l lchqt mshpt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. And it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל־הַ֥ר הָעֲבָרִ֖ים הַזֶּ֑ה וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh 'lh 'lhr h'brym hzh vr'h 'th'rts 'shr ntty lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, and behold the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֣יתָה אֹתָ֔הּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֥ אֶל־עַמֶּ֖יךָ גַּם־אָ֑תָּה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱסַ֖ף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vr'yth 'th vn'spt 'l'mykh gm'th kh'shr n'sf 'hrn 'chykh
verses.translation: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ מְרִיתֶ֨ם פִּ֜י בְּמִדְבַּר־צִ֗ן בִּמְרִיבַת֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה לְהַקְדִּישֵׁ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם הֵ֛ם מֵֽי־מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־צִֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: kh'shr mrytm py bmdbrtsn bmrybt h'dh lhqdyshny bmym l'ynyhm hm mymrybt qdsh mdbrtsn {s}
verses.translation: because ye rebelled against My commandment in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify Me at the waters before their eyes.’—These are the waters of Meribath-kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'lyhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses spoke unto the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהֹוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכׇל־בָּשָׂ֑ר אִ֖ישׁ עַל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: ypqd yhvh 'lhy hrvcht lkhlbshr 'ysh 'lh'dh
verses.translation: ’Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵ֣א לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹצִיאֵ֖ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְבִיאֵ֑ם וְלֹ֤א תִהְיֶה֙ עֲדַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּצֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־לָהֶ֖ם רֹעֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shryts' lpnyhm v'shr yb' lpnyhm v'shr yvtsy'm v'shr yby'm vl' thyh 'dt yhvh khts'n 'shr 'ynlhm r'h
verses.translation: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח־לְךָ֙ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ר֣וּחַ בּ֑וֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ֥ אֶת־יָדְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh qchlkh 'tyhvsh' bnnvn 'ysh 'shrrvch bv vsmkht 'tydkh 'lyv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כׇּל־הָעֵדָ֑ה וְצִוִּיתָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'mdt 'tv lpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny khlh'dh vtsvyth 'tv l'ynyhm
verses.translation: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ה מֵהֽוֹדְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו לְמַ֣עַן יִשְׁמְע֔וּ כׇּל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vntth mhvdkh 'lyv lm'n yshm'v khl'dt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt put of thy honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may hearken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְשָׁ֥אַל ל֛וֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָאוּרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה עַל־פִּ֨יו יֵצְא֜וּ וְעַל־פִּ֣יו יָבֹ֗אוּ ה֛וּא וְכׇל־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖וֹ וְכׇל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlpny 'l'zr hkhhn y'md vsh'l lv bmshpt h'vrym lpny yhvh 'lpyv yts'v v'lpyv yb'v hv' vkhlbnyyshr'l 'tv vkhlh'dh
verses.translation: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD; at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיַּֽעֲמִדֵ֙הוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כׇּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv vyqch 'tyhvsh' vy'mdhv lpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny khlh'dh
verses.translation: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְמֹ֧ךְ אֶת־יָדָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו וַיְצַוֵּ֑הוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vysmkh 'tydyv 'lyv vytsvhv kh'shr dbr yhvh bydmshh {p}
verses.translation: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD spoke by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֶת־קׇרְבָּנִ֨י לַחְמִ֜י לְאִשַּׁ֗י רֵ֚יחַ נִֽיחֹחִ֔י תִּשְׁמְר֕וּ לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִ֖י בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tsv 'tbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'tqrbny lchmy l'shy rych nychchy tshmrv lhqryb ly bmv'dv
verses.translation: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them: My food which is presented unto Me for offerings made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Me, shall ye observe to offer unto Me in its due season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם זֶ֚ה הָֽאִשֶּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ לַיהֹוָ֑ה כְּבָשִׂ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֧ה תְמִימִ֛ם שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם עֹלָ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: v'mrt lhm zh h'shh 'shr tqrybv lyhvh khbshym bnyshnh tmymm shnym lyvm 'lh tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them: This is the offering made by fire which ye shall bring unto the LORD: he-lambs of the first year without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'thkhbsh 'chd t'shh bbqr v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym
verses.translation: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at dusk;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָאֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְמִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃
verses.translit: v'shyryt h'yph slt lmnchh blvlh bshmn khtyt rby't hhyn
verses.translation: and the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹלַ֖ת תָּמִ֑יד הָעֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lt tmyd h'shyh bhr syny lrych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was offered in mount Sinai, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִסְכּוֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַהִ֔ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnskhv rby't hhyn lkhbsh h'chd bqdsh hskh nskh shkhr lyhvh
verses.translation: And the drink-offering thereof shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb; in the holy place shalt thou pour out a drink-offering of strong drink unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym khmncht hbqr vkhnskhv t'shh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And the other lamb shalt thou present at dusk; as the meal-offering of the morning, and as the drink-offering thereof, thou shalt present it, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת שְׁנֵֽי־כְבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshbt shnykhbshym bnyshnh tmymm vshny 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn vnskhv
verses.translation: And on the sabbath day two he-lambs of the first year without blemish, and two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ עַל־עֹלַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lt shbt bshbtv 'l'lt htmyd vnskhh {p}
verses.translation: This is the burnt-offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְרָאשֵׁי֙ חׇדְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹלָ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה פָּרִ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־בָקָ֤ר שְׁנַ֙יִם֙ וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֔ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbr'shy chdshykhm tqrybv 'lh lyhvh prym bnybqr shnym v'yl 'chd khbshym bnyshnh shb'h tmymm
verses.translation: And in your new moons ye shall present a burnt-offering unto the LORD: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַפָּ֖ר הָאֶחָ֑ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vshlshh 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn lpr h'chd vshny 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn l'yl h'chd
verses.translation: and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for each bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal-offering, mingled with oil, for the one ram;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד עֹלָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shrn 'shrvn slt mnchh blvlh bshmn lkhbsh h'chd 'lh rych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: and a several tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil for a meal-offering unto every lamb; for a burnt-offering of a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בְּחׇדְשׁ֔וֹ לְחׇדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnskhyhm chtsy hhyn yhyh lpr vshlysht hhyn l'yl vrby't hhyn lkhbsh yyn z't 'lt chdsh bchdshv lchdshy hshnh
verses.translation: And their drink-offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt-offering of every new moon throughout the months of the year.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֛ד לְחַטָּ֖את לַיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr 'zym 'chd lcht't lyhvh 'l'lt htmyd y'shh vnskhv {s}
verses.translation: And one he-goat for a sin-offering unto the LORD; it shall be offered beside the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ פֶּ֖סַח לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbchdsh hr'shvn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh psch lyhvh
verses.translation: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’S passover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hzh chg shb't ymym mtsvt y'khl
verses.translation: And on the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast; seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־קֹ֑דֶשׁ כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: byvm hr'shvn mqr'qdsh khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: In the first day shall be a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'shh 'lh lyhvh prym bnybqr shnym v'yl 'chd vshb'h khbshym bny shnh tmymm yhyv lkhm
verses.translation: but ye shall present an offering made by fire, a burnt-offering unto the LORD: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven he-lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr vshny 'shrnym l'yl t'shv
verses.translation: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil; three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: 'shrvn 'shrvn t'shh lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: a several tenth part shalt thou offer for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֑יד תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: mlbd 'lt hbqr 'shr l'lt htmyd t'shv 't'lh
verses.translation: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּאֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־עוֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: kh'lh t'shv lyvm shb't ymym lchm 'shh rychnychch lyhvh 'l'vlt htmyd y'shh vnskhv
verses.translation: After this manner ye shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; it shall be offered beside the continual burnt-offering, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbyvm hshby'y mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv {s}
verses.translation: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hbkhvrym bhqrybkhm mnchh chdshh lyhvh bshb'tykhm mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: Also in the day of the first-fruits, when ye bring a new meal-offering unto the LORD in your feast of weeks, ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no manner of servile work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'vlh lrych nychch lyhvh prym bnybqr shnym 'yl 'chd shb'h khbshym bny shnh
verses.translation: but ye shall present a burnt-offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD: two young bullocks, one ram, seven he-lambs of the first year;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֔ד שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr h'chd shny 'shrnym l'yl h'chd
verses.translation: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for each bullock, two tenth parts for the one ram,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: 'shrvn 'shrvn lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: a several tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: sh'yr 'zym 'chd lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: one he-goat, to make atonement for you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִלְּבַ֞ד עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד וּמִנְחָת֖וֹ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיוּ־לָכֶ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchtv t'shv tmymm yhyvlkhm vnskhyhm {p}
verses.translation: Beside the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, ye shall offer them—they shall be unto you without blemish—and their drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbchdsh hshby'y b'chd lchdsh mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv yvm trv'h yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no manner of servile work; it is a day of blowing the horn unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shytm 'lh lrych nychch lyhvh pr bnbqr 'chd 'yl 'chd khbshym bnyshnh shb'h tmymm
verses.translation: And ye shall prepare a burnt-offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD: one young bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵ֥י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֖ים לָאָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr shny 'shrnym l'yl
verses.translation: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth part for the ram,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: v'shrvn 'chd lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vsh'yr'zym 'chd cht't lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mlbd 'lt hchdsh vmnchth v'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhyhm khmshptm lrych nychch 'shh lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: beside the burnt-offering of the new moon, and the meal-offering thereof, and the continual burnt-offering and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings, according unto their ordinance, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כׇּל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vb'shvr lchdsh hshby'y hzh mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm v'nytm 'tnpshtykhm khlml'khh l' t'shv
verses.translation: And on the tenth day of this seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls; ye shall do no manner of work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֤ה לַֽיהֹוָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lh lyhvh rych nychch pr bnbqr 'chd 'yl 'chd khbshym bnyshnh shb'h tmymm yhyv lkhm
verses.translation: but ye shall present a burnt-offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour: one young bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr shny 'shrnym l'yl h'chd
verses.translation: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the one ram,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: 'shrvn 'shrvn lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: a several tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַכִּפֻּרִים֙ וְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: sh'yr'zym 'chd cht't mlbd cht't hkhprym v'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhyhm {s}
verses.translation: one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the sin-offering of atonement, and the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם חַ֛ג לַיהֹוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshby'y mqr'qdsh yhyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv vchgtm chg lyhvh shb't ymym
verses.translation: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no manner of servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh prym bnybqr shlshh 'shr 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm yhyv
verses.translation: and ye shall present a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָאַ֣יִל הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לִשְׁנֵ֖י הָאֵילִֽם׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr h'chd lshlshh 'shr prym shny 'shrnym l'yl h'chd lshny h'ylm
verses.translation: and their meal-offering, fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂרוֹׄן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כְּבָשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: v'shrvn 'shrvn lkhbsh h'chd l'rb'h 'shr khbshym
verses.translation: and a several tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr'zym 'chd cht't mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhh {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering beside the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshny prym bnybqr shnym 'shr 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the second day ye shall present twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִ֠ים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr'zym 'chd cht't mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhyhm {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and their drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshlyshy prym 'shty'shr 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִ֠ים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhh {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hrby'y prym 'shrh 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִ֠ים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: mnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr'zym 'chd cht't mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhh {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים תִּשְׁעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hchmyshy prym tsh'h 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִ֠ים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhh {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshshy prym shmnh 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִ֠ים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וּנְסָכֶֽיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhyh {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offerings thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שִׁבְעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshby'y prym shb'h 'ylm shnym khbshym bnyshnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִ֠ים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshptm
verses.translation: and their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhh {s}
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י עֲצֶ֖רֶת תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: byvm hshmyny 'tsrt thyh lkhm khlml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no manner of servile work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה פַּ֥ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh pr 'chd 'yl 'chd khbshym bnyshnh shb'h tmymm
verses.translation: but ye shall present a burnt-offering, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven he-lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם לַפָּ֨ר לָאַ֧יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: mnchtm vnskhyhm lpr l'yl vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: their meal-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; beside the continual burnt-offering, and the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לְבַ֨ד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּלְמִנְחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶ֖ם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh t'shv lyhvh bmv'dykhm lbd mndrykhm vndbtykhm l'ltykhm vlmnchtykhm vlnskhykhm vlshlmykhm
verses.translation: These ye shall offer unto the LORD in your appointed seasons, beside your vows, and your freewill-offerings, whether they be your burnt-offerings, or your meal-offerings, or your drink-offerings, or your peace-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'lbny yshr'l khkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמַּטּ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'lr'shy hmtvt lbny yshr'l l'mr zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses spoke unto the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִישׁ֩ כִּֽי־יִדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה אֽוֹ־הִשָּׁ֤בַע שְׁבֻעָה֙ לֶאְסֹ֤ר אִסָּר֙ עַל־נַפְשׁ֔וֹ לֹ֥א יַחֵ֖ל דְּבָר֑וֹ כְּכׇל־הַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: 'ysh khyydr ndr lyhvh 'vhshb' shb'h l'sr 'sr 'lnpshv l' ychl dbrv khkhlhyts' mpyv y'shh
verses.translation: When a man voweth a vow unto the LORD, or sweareth an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה כִּֽי־תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֖דֶר לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְאָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר בְּבֵ֥ית אָבִ֖יהָ בִּנְעֻרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'shh khytdr ndr lyhvh v'srh 'sr bbyt 'byh bn'ryh
verses.translation: Also when a woman voweth a vow unto the LORD, and bindeth herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַ֨ע אָבִ֜יהָ אֶת־נִדְרָ֗הּ וֶֽאֱסָרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽסְרָ֣ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֔הּ וְהֶחֱרִ֥ישׁ לָ֖הּ אָבִ֑יהָ וְקָ֙מוּ֙ כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְכׇל־אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vshm' 'byh 'tndrh v'srh 'shr 'srh 'lnpshh vhchrysh lh 'byh vqmv khlndryh vkhl'sr 'shr'srh 'lnpshh yqvm
verses.translation: and her father heareth her vow, or her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father holdeth his peace at her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־הֵנִ֨יא אָבִ֣יהָ אֹתָהּ֮ בְּי֣וֹם שׇׁמְעוֹ֒ כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם וַֽיהֹוָה֙ יִֽסְלַח־לָ֔הּ כִּי־הֵנִ֥יא אָבִ֖יהָ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mhny' 'byh 'th byvm shm'v khlndryh v'sryh 'shr'srh 'lnpshh l' yqvm vyhvh yslchlh khyhny' 'byh 'th
verses.translation: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand; and the LORD will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־הָי֤וֹ תִֽהְיֶה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וּנְדָרֶ֖יהָ עָלֶ֑יהָ א֚וֹ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mhyv thyh l'ysh vndryh 'lyh 'v mbt' shptyh 'shr 'srh 'lnpshh
verses.translation: And if she be married to a husband, while her vows are upon her, or the clear utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַ֥ע אִישָׁ֛הּ בְּי֥וֹם שׇׁמְע֖וֹ וְהֶחֱרִ֣ישׁ לָ֑הּ וְקָ֣מוּ נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛הָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֻֽמוּ׃
verses.translit: vshm' 'yshh byvm shm'v vhchrysh lh vqmv ndryh v'srh 'shr'srh 'lnpshh yqmv
verses.translation: and her husband hear it, whatsoever day it be that he heareth it, and hold his peace at her; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אִ֠ם בְּי֨וֹם שְׁמֹ֣עַ אִישָׁהּ֮ יָנִ֣יא אוֹתָהּ֒ וְהֵפֵ֗ר אֶת־נִדְרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֵת֙ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֑הּ וַיהֹוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח־לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'm byvm shm' 'yshh yny' 'vth vhpr 'tndrh 'shr 'lyh v't mbt' shptyh 'shr 'srh 'lnpshh vyhvh yslchlh
verses.translation: But if her husband disallow her in the day that he heareth it, then he shall make void her vow which is upon her, and the clear utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul; and the LORD will forgive her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֵ֥דֶר אַלְמָנָ֖ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָק֥וּם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vndr 'lmnh vgrvshh khl 'shr'srh 'lnpshh yqvm 'lyh
verses.translation: But the vow of a widow, or of her that is divorced, even every thing wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand against her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בֵּ֥ית אִישָׁ֖הּ נָדָ֑רָה אֽוֹ־אָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ בִּשְׁבֻעָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mbyt 'yshh ndrh 'v'srh 'sr 'lnpshh bshb'h
verses.translation: And if a woman vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַ֤ע אִישָׁהּ֙ וְהֶחֱרִ֣שׁ לָ֔הּ לֹ֥א הֵנִ֖יא אֹתָ֑הּ וְקָ֙מוּ֙ כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְכׇל־אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vshm' 'yshh vhchrsh lh l' hny' 'th vqmv khlndryh vkhl'sr 'shr'srh 'lnpshh yqvm
verses.translation: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־הָפֵר֩ יָפֵ֨ר אֹתָ֥ם ׀ אִישָׁהּ֮ בְּי֣וֹם שׇׁמְעוֹ֒ כׇּל־מוֹצָ֨א שְׂפָתֶ֧יהָ לִנְדָרֶ֛יהָ וּלְאִסַּ֥ר נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם אִישָׁ֣הּ הֲפֵרָ֔ם וַיהֹוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח־לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mhpr ypr 'tm  'yshh byvm shm'v khlmvts' shptyh lndryh vl'sr npshh l' yqvm 'yshh hprm vyhvh yslchlh
verses.translation: But if her husband make them null and void in the day that he heareth them, then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips, whether it were her vows, or the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD will forgive her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־נֵ֛דֶר וְכׇל־שְׁבֻעַ֥ת אִסָּ֖ר לְעַנֹּ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ אִישָׁ֥הּ יְקִימֶ֖נּוּ וְאִישָׁ֥הּ יְפֵרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khlndr vkhlshb't 'sr l'nt npsh 'yshh yqymnv v'yshh yprnv
verses.translation: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may let it stand, or her husband may make it void.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־הַחֲרֵשׁ֩ יַחֲרִ֨ישׁ לָ֥הּ אִישָׁהּ֮ מִיּ֣וֹם אֶל־יוֹם֒ וְהֵקִים֙ אֶת־כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ א֥וֹ אֶת־כׇּל־אֱסָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֑יהָ הֵקִ֣ים אֹתָ֔ם כִּי־הֶחֱרִ֥שׁ לָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם שׇׁמְעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mhchrsh ychrysh lh 'yshh myvm 'lyvm vhqym 'tkhlndryh 'v 'tkhl'sryh 'shr 'lyh hqym 'tm khyhchrsh lh byvm shm'v
verses.translation: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he causeth all her vows to stand, or all her bonds, which are upon her; he hath let them stand, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־הָפֵ֥ר יָפֵ֛ר אֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵ֣י שׇׁמְע֑וֹ וְנָשָׂ֖א אֶת־עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mhpr ypr 'tm 'chry shm'v vnsh' 't'vnh
verses.translation: But if he shall make them null and void after that he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ בֵּֽין־אָ֣ב לְבִתּ֔וֹ בִּנְעֻרֶ֖יהָ בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hchqym 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh byn 'ysh l'shtv byn'b lbtv bn'ryh byt 'byh {p}
verses.translation: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל־עַמֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: nqm nqmt bny yshr'l m't hmdynym 'chr t'sf 'l'mykh
verses.translation: ’Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites; afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵאִתְּכֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וְיִהְיוּ֙ עַל־מִדְיָ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת נִקְמַת־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּמִדְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'lh'm l'mr hchltsv m'tkhm 'nshym ltsb' vyhyv 'lmdyn ltt nqmtyhvh bmdyn
verses.translation: And Moses spoke unto the people, saying: ‘Arm ye men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’S vengeance on Midian.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֚לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה לְכֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַצָּבָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'lf lmth 'lf lmth lkhl mtvt yshr'l tshlchv ltsb'
verses.translation: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵאַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃
verses.translit: vymsrv m'lpy yshr'l 'lf lmth shnym'shr 'lf chlvtsy tsb'
verses.translation: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָ֠ם וְאֶת־פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א וּכְלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tm mshh 'lf lmth ltsb' 'tm v'tpynchs bn'l'zr hkhhn ltsb' vkhly hqdsh vchtstsrvt htrv'h bydv
verses.translation: And Moses sent them, a thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy vessels and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל־מִדְיָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כׇּל־זָכָֽר׃
verses.translit: vytsb'v 'lmdyn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh vyhrgv khlzkhr
verses.translation: And they warred against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew every male.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל־חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־צ֤וּר וְאֶת־חוּר֙ וְאֶת־רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'tmlkhy mdyn hrgv 'lchllyhm 't'vy v'trqm v'ttsvr v'tchvr v'trb' chmsht mlkhy mdyn v't bl'm bnb'vr hrgv bchrb
verses.translation: And they slew the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian; Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־טַפָּ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־בְּהֶמְתָּ֧ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־מִקְנֵהֶ֛ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֵילָ֖ם בָּזָֽזוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshbv bnyyshr'l 'tnshy mdyn v'ttpm v't khlbhmtm v'tkhlmqnhm v'tkhlchylm bzzv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ת כׇּל־עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּמ֣וֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־טִֽירֹתָ֑ם שָׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: v't khl'ryhm bmvshbtm v't khltyrtm shrpv b'sh
verses.translation: And all their cities in the places wherein they dwelt, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־הַמַּלְק֑וֹחַ בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqchv 'tkhlhshll v't khlhmlqvch b'dm vbbhmh
verses.translation: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֩ וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־הַשְּׁבִ֧י וְאֶת־הַמַּלְק֛וֹחַ וְאֶת־הַשָּׁלָ֖ל אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה אֶל־עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lmshh v'l'l'zr hkhhn v'l'dt bnyyshr'l 'thshby v'thmlqvch v'thshll 'lhmchnh 'l'rbt mv'b 'shr 'lyrdn yrchv {s}
verses.translation: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp, unto the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכׇל־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לִקְרָאתָ֑ם אֶל־מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts'v mshh v'l'zr hkhhn vkhlnshy'y h'dh lqr'tm 'lmchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַ֖ל פְּקוּדֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל שָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְּבָ֥א הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqtsf mshh 'l pqvdy hchyl shry h'lpym vshry hm'vt hb'ym mtsb' hmlchmh
verses.translation: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה הַֽחִיִּיתֶ֖ם כׇּל־נְקֵבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mshh hchyytm khlnqbh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them: ‘Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם לִמְסׇר־מַ֥עַל בַּיהֹוָ֖ה עַל־דְּבַר־פְּע֑וֹר וַתְּהִ֥י הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה בַּעֲדַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hn hnh hyv lbny yshr'l bdbr bl'm lmsrm'l byhvh 'ldbrp'vr vthy hmgph b'dt yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to revolt so as to break faith with the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִרְג֥וּ כׇל־זָכָ֖ר בַּטָּ֑ף וְכׇל־אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th hrgv khlzkhr btf vkhl'shh yd't 'ysh lmshkhb zkhr hrgv
verses.translation: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhl htf bnshym 'shr l'yd'v mshkhb zkhr hchyv lkhm
verses.translation: But all the women children, that have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְכֹ֣ל  נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽחָלָ֗ל תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּשְׁבִיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tm chnv mchvts lmchnh shb't ymym khl hrg npsh vkhl  ng' bchll ttcht'v byvm hshlyshy vbyvm hshby'y 'tm vshbykhm
verses.translation: And encamp ye without the camp seven days; whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, ye and your captives.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־בֶּ֧גֶד וְכׇל־כְּלִי־ע֛וֹר וְכׇל־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּ֖ים וְכׇל־כְּלִי־עֵ֑ץ תִּתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhlbgd vkhlkhly'vr vkhlm'shh 'zym vkhlkhly'ts ttcht'v {s}
verses.translation: And as to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’hair, and all things made of wood, ye shall purify.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֔א הַבָּאִ֖ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l'zr hkhhn 'l'nshy htsb' hb'ym lmlchmh z't chqt htvrh 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war that went to the battle: ‘This is the statute of the law which the LORD hath commanded Moses:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־הַכָּ֑סֶף אֶֽת־הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֶת־הַבַּרְזֶ֔ל אֶֽת־הַבְּדִ֖יל וְאֶת־הָעֹפָֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'thzhb v'thkhsf 'thnchsht 'thbrzl 'thbdyl v'th'prt
verses.translation: Howbeit the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹ֣א בָאֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יָבֹ֛א בָּאֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khldbr 'shryb' b'sh t'byrv b'sh vthr 'kh bmy ndh ytcht' vkhl 'shr l'yb' b'sh t'byrv bmym
verses.translation: every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of sprinkling; and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make to go through the water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִבַּסְתֶּ֧ם בִּגְדֵיכֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאַחַ֖ר תָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhbstm bgdykhm byvm hshby'y vthrtm v'chr tb'v 'lhmchnh {s}
verses.translation: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye may come into the camp.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֙וֹחַ֙ הַשְּׁבִ֔י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְאֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: sh' 't r'sh mlqvch hshby b'dm vbbhmh 'th v'l'zr hkhhn vr'shy 'bvt h'dh
verses.translation: ’Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’houses of the congregation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָצִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וּבֵ֖ין כׇּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vchtsyt 'thmlqvch byn tpshy hmlchmh hyts'ym ltsb' vbyn khlh'dh
verses.translation: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, that went out to battle, and all the congregation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ֨ מֶ֜כֶס לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה מֵאֵ֞ת אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים לַצָּבָ֔א אֶחָ֣ד נֶ֔פֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵ֖שׁ הַמֵּא֑וֹת מִן־הָאָדָם֙ וּמִן־הַבָּקָ֔ר וּמִן־הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים וּמִן־הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.translit: vhrmt mkhs lyhvh m't 'nshy hmlchmh hyts'ym ltsb' 'chd npsh mchmsh hm'vt mnh'dm vmnhbqr vmnhchmrym vmnhts'n
verses.translation: and levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war that went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the flocks;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמַּֽחֲצִיתָ֖ם תִּקָּ֑חוּ וְנָתַתָּ֛ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mmchtsytm tqchv vntth l'l'zr hkhhn trvmt yhvh
verses.translation: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, as a portion set apart for the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
