verses.original: וּמִמַּחֲצִ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּקַּ֣ח  אֶחָ֣ד  אָחֻ֣ז מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים מִן־הָאָדָ֧ם מִן־הַבָּקָ֛ר מִן־הַחֲמֹרִ֥ים וּמִן־הַצֹּ֖אן מִכׇּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתָם֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֕י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmmchtst bnyyshr'l tqch  'chd  'chz mnhchmshym mnh'dm mnhbqr mnhchmrym vmnhts'n mkhlhbhmh vntth 'tm llvym shmry mshmrt mshkhn yhvh
verses.translation: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, even of all the cattle, and give them unto the Levites, that keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh v'l'zr hkhhn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ יֶ֣תֶר הַבָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּזְז֖וּ עַ֣ם הַצָּבָ֑א צֹ֗אן שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy hmlqvch ytr hbz 'shr bzzv 'm htsb' ts'n shshm'vt 'lf vshb'ym 'lf vchmsht 'lpym
verses.translation: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָקָ֕ר שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vbqr shnym vshb'ym 'lf
verses.translation: and threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vchmrym 'chd vshshym 'lf
verses.translation: and threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם מִ֨ן־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר כׇּל־נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vnpsh 'dm mnhnshym 'shr l'yd'v mshkhb zkhr khlnpsh shnym vshlshym 'lf
verses.translation: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of the women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִי֙ הַֽמֶּחֱצָ֔ה חֵ֕לֶק הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים בַּצָּבָ֑א מִסְפַּ֣ר הַצֹּ֗אן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vthy hmchtsh chlq hyts'ym btsb' mspr hts'n shlshm'vt 'lf vshlshym 'lf vshb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י הַמֶּ֥כֶס לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה מִן־הַצֹּ֑אן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy hmkhs lyhvh mnhts'n shsh m'vt chmsh vshb'ym
verses.translation: And the LORD’S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨בָּקָ֔ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַיהֹוָ֖ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhbqr shshh vshlshym 'lf vmkhsm lyhvh shnym vshb'ym
verses.translation: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand, of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vchmrym shlshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt vmkhsm lyhvh 'chd vshshym
verses.translation: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred, of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָם֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vnpsh 'dm shshh 'shr 'lf vmkhsm lyhvh shnym vshlshym npsh
verses.translation: And the persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’S tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶת־מֶ֙כֶס֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vytn mshh 'tmkhs trvmt yhvh l'l'zr hkhhn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: And Moses gave the tribute, which was set apart for the LORD, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ חָצָ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַצֹּבְאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmmchtsyt bny yshr'l 'shr chtsh mshh mnh'nshym htsb'ym
verses.translation: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men that warred—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֛י מֶחֱצַ֥ת הָעֵדָ֖ה מִן־הַצֹּ֑אן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vthy mchtst h'dh mnhts'n shlshm'vt 'lf vshlshym 'lf shb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: now the congregation’s half was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָקָ֕ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vbqr shshh vshlshym 'lf
verses.translation: and thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vchmrym shlshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: and thirty thousand and five hundred asses,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vnpsh 'dm shshh 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: and sixteen thousand persons—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִמַּחֲצִ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־הָֽאָחֻז֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לַלְוִיִּ֗ם שֹֽׁמְרֵי֙ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh mmchtst bnyyshr'l 'th'chz 'chd mnhchmshym mnh'dm vmnhbhmh vytn 'tm llvym shmry mshmrt mshkhn yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, that kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַלְפֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyqrbv 'lmshh hpqdym 'shr l'lpy htsb' shry h'lpym vshry hm'vt
verses.translation: And the officers that were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ נָֽשְׂא֗וּ אֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־נִפְקַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lmshh 'bdykh nsh'v 'tr'sh 'nshy hmlchmh 'shr bydnv vl'npqd mmnv 'ysh
verses.translation: and they said unto Moses: ‘Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war that are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־קׇרְבַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֗ה אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א כְלִֽי־זָהָב֙ אֶצְעָדָ֣ה וְצָמִ֔יד טַבַּ֖עַת עָגִ֣יל וְכוּמָ֑ז לְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnqrb 'tqrbn yhvh 'ysh 'shr mts' khlyzhb 'ts'dh vtsmyd tb't 'gyl vkhvmz lkhpr 'lnpshtynv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And we have brought the LORD’S offering, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet-rings, ear-rings, and girdles, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם כֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י מַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 'thzhb m'tm khl khly m'shh
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כׇּל־זְהַ֣ב הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵרִ֙ימוּ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה שִׁשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף שְׁבַע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁ֑קֶל מֵאֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמֵאֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khlzhb htrvmh 'shr hrymv lyhvh shshh 'shr 'lf shb'm'vt vchmshym shql m't shry h'lpym vm't shry hm'vt
verses.translation: And all the gold of the gift that they set apart for the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁי֙ הַצָּבָ֔א בָּזְז֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'nshy htsb' bzzv 'ysh lv
verses.translation: For the men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַזָּהָ֔ב מֵאֵ֛ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְהַמֵּא֑וֹת וַיָּבִ֤אוּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד זִכָּר֥וֹן לִבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqch mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 'thzhb m't shry h'lpym vhm'vt vyb'v 'tv 'l'hl mv'd zkhrvn lbnyyshr'l lpny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִקְנֶ֣ה  רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְאֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַמָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vmqnh  rb hyh lbny r'vbn vlbnygd 'tsvm m'd vyr'v 't'rts y'zr v't'rts gl'd vhnh hmqvm mqvm mqnh
verses.translation: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle; and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ בְנֵֽי־גָ֖ד וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyb'v bnygd vbny r'vbn vy'mrv 'lmshh v'l'l'zr hkhhn v'lnshy'y h'dh l'mr
verses.translation: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּשְׂבָ֥ם וּנְב֖וֹ וּבְעֹֽן׃
verses.translit: 'trvt vdybn vy'zr vnmrh vchshbvn v'l'lh vshbm vnbv vb'n
verses.translation: ’Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְלַֽעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מִקְנֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'rts 'shr hkhh yhvh lpny 'dt yshr'l 'rts mqnh hv' vl'bdykh mqnh {s}
verses.translation: the land which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִם־מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל־תַּעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'mmts'nv chn b'ynykh ytn 'th'rts hz't l'bdykh l'chzh 'lt'brnv 'thyrdn
verses.translation: And they said: ‘If we have found favour in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד וְלִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַאַֽחֵיכֶ֗ם יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lbnygd vlbny r'vbn h'chykhm yb'v lmlchmh v'tm tshbv ph
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben: ‘Shall your brethren go to the war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֣מָּה (תנואון) [תְנִיא֔וּן] אֶת־לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽעֲבֹר֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlmh (tnv'vn) [tny'vn] 'tlb bny yshr'l m'br 'lh'rts 'shrntn lhm yhvh
verses.translation: And wherefore will ye turn away the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּשׇׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khh 'shv 'btykhm bshlchy 'tm mqdsh brn' lr'vt 'th'rts
verses.translation: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ עַד־נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת־לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'lv 'dnchl 'shkhvl vyr'v 'th'rts vyny'v 'tlb bny yshr'l lbltyb' 'lh'rts 'shrntn lhm yhvh
verses.translation: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they turned away the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֥ף יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vychr'f yhvh byvm hhv' vyshb' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD’S anger was kindled in that day, and He swore, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה אֵ֚ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י לֹא־מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'myr'v h'nshym h'lym mmtsrym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh 't h'dmh 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm lytschq vly'qb khy l'ml'v 'chry
verses.translation: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן כִּ֥י מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: blty khlb bnypnh hqnzy vyhvsh' bnnvn khy ml'v 'chry yhvh
verses.translation: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have wholly followed the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְנִעֵם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־תֹּם֙ כׇּל־הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vychr'f yhvh byshr'l vyn'm bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh 'dtm khlhdvr h'shh hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD’S anger was kindled against Israel, and He made them wander to and fro in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים לִסְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhnh qmtm tcht 'btykhm trbvt 'nshym cht'ym lspvt 'vd 'l chrvn 'fyhvh 'lyshr'l
verses.translation: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’stead, a brood of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻן֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו וְיָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְהַנִּיח֖וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְכׇל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy tshvbn m'chryv vysf 'vd lhnychv bmdbr vshchtm lkhlh'm hzh {s}
verses.translation: For if ye turn away from after Him, He will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and so ye will destroy all this people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vygshv 'lyv vy'mrv gdrt ts'n nbnh lmqnnv ph v'rym ltpnv
verses.translation: And they came near unto him, and said: ‘We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם־הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל־מְקוֹמָ֑ם וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֙נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'nchnv nchlts chshym lpny bny yshr'l 'd 'shr 'mhby'nm 'lmqvmm vyshb tpnv b'ry hmbtsr mpny yshby h'rts
verses.translation: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place; and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־בָּתֵּ֑ינוּ עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l' nshvb 'lbtynv 'd htnchl bny yshr'l 'ysh nchltv
verses.translation: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy l' nnchl 'tm m'br lyrdn vhl'h khy b'h nchltnv 'lynv m'br hyrdn mzrchh {p}
verses.translation: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward, because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם־תַּעֲשׂ֖וּן אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה אִם־תֵּחָ֥לְצ֛וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mshh 'mt'shvn 'thdbr hzh 'mtchltsv lpny yhvh lmlchmh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them: ‘If ye will do this thing: if ye will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם כׇּל־חָל֛וּץ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛וֹ אֶת־אֹיְבָ֖יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'br lkhm khlchlvts 'thyrdn lpny yhvh 'd hvryshv 't'ybyv mpnyv
verses.translation: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before the LORD, until He hath driven out His enemies from before Him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִהְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ם מֵיְהֹוָ֖ה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠הָיְתָ֠ה הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֥את לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnkhbshh h'rts lpny yhvh v'chr tshbv vhyytm nqym myhvh vmyshr'l vhyth h'rts hz't lkhm l'chzh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: and the land be subdued before the LORD, and ye return afterward; then ye shall be clear before the LORD, and before Israel, and this land shall be unto you for a possession before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהֹוָ֑ה וּדְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ml' t'shvn khn hnh cht'tm lyhvh vd'v cht'tkhm 'shr tmts' 'tkhm
verses.translation: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD; and know ye your sin which will find you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֽוּ־לָכֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: bnvlkhm 'rym ltpkhm vgdrt ltsn'khm vhyts' mpykhm t'shv
verses.translation: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי־גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr bnygd vbny r'vbn 'lmshh l'mr 'bdykh y'shv kh'shr 'dny mtsvh
verses.translation: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke unto Moses, saying: ‘Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכׇל־בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ־שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: tpnv nshynv mqnnv vkhlbhmtnv yhyvshm b'ry hgl'd
verses.translation: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כׇּל־חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י דֹּבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: v'bdykh y'brv khlchlvts tsb' lpny yhvh lmlchmh kh'shr 'dny dbr
verses.translation: but thy servants will pass over, every man that is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו לָהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן וְאֶת־רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vytsv lhm mshh 't 'l'zr hkhhn v't yhvsh' bnnvn v'tr'shy 'bvt hmtvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: So Moses gave charge concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִם־יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי־גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן ׀ אִ֠תְּכֶ֠ם אֶֽת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן כׇּל־חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'lhm 'my'brv bnygd vbnyr'vbn  'tkhm 'thyrdn khlchlvts lmlchmh lpny yhvh vnkhbshh h'rts lpnykhm vnttm lhm 't'rts hgl'd l'chzh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them: ‘If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man that is armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you, then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְנֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְתֹכְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: v'ml' y'brv chlvtsym 'tkhm vn'chzv btkhkhm b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי־גָ֛ד וּבְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vy'nv bnygd vbny r'vbn l'mr 't 'shr dbr yhvh 'l'bdykh khn n'shh
verses.translation: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying: ‘As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאִתָּ֙נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔נוּ מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: nchnv n'br chlvtsym lpny yhvh 'rts khn'n v'tnv 'chzt nchltnv m'br lyrdn
verses.translation: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֣ם ׀ מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִבְנֵי־גָד֩ וְלִבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְלַחֲצִ֣י  שֵׁ֣בֶט  מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֶ֨ת־מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן הָאָ֗רֶץ לְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּגְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vytn lhm  mshh lbnygd vlbny r'vbn vlchtsy  shbt  mnshh bnyvsf 'tmmlkht sychn mlkh h'mry v'tmmlkht 'vg mlkh hbshn h'rts l'ryh bgblt 'ry h'rts sbyb
verses.translation: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to the cities thereof with their borders, even the cities of the land round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי־גָ֔ד אֶת־דִּיבֹ֖ן וְאֶת־עֲטָרֹ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת עֲרֹעֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vybnv bnygd 'tdybn v't'trt v't 'r'r
verses.translation: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עַטְרֹ֥ת שׁוֹפָ֛ן וְאֶת־יַעְזֵ֖ר וְיׇגְבְּהָֽה׃
verses.translit: v't'trt shvpn v'ty'zr vygbhh
verses.translation: and Atroth-shophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית נִמְרָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָרָ֑ן עָרֵ֥י מִבְצָ֖ר וְגִדְרֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.translit: v'tbyt nmrh v'tbyt hrn 'ry mbtsr vgdrt ts'n
verses.translation: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran; fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י רְאוּבֵן֙ בָּנ֔וּ אֶת־חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־אֶלְעָלֵ֑א וְאֵ֖ת קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vbny r'vbn bnv 'tchshbvn v't'l'l' v't qrytym
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־נְב֞וֹ וְאֶת־בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־שִׂבְמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tnbv v'tb'l m'vn mvsbt shm v'tshbmh vyqr'v bshmt 'tshmvt h'rym 'shr bnv
verses.translation: and Nebo, and Baal-meon—their names being changed—and Sibmah; and gave their names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֑הָ וַיּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vylkhv bny mkhyr bnmnshh gl'dh vylkhdh vyvrsh 'th'mry 'shrbh
verses.translation: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמָכִ֖יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vytn mshh 'thgl'd lmkhyr bnmnshh vyshb bh
verses.translation: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָאִ֤יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת־חַוֺּתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vy'yr bnmnshh hlkh vylkhd 'tchvtyhm vyqr' 'thn chvt y'yr
verses.translation: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the villages thereof, and called them Havvoth-jair.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֣בַח הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד אֶת־קְנָ֖ת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֧א לָ֦הֿ נֹ֖בַח בִּשְׁמֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnbch hlkh vylkhd 'tqnt v'tbntyh vyqr' lh nbch bshmv {p}
verses.translation: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lh ms'y bnyyshr'l 'shr yts'v m'rts mtsrym ltsb'tm bydmshh v'hrn
verses.translation: These are the stages of the children of Israel, by which they went forth out of the land of Egypt by their hosts under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־מוֹצָאֵיהֶ֛ם לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥לֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 'tmvts'yhm lms'yhm 'lpy yhvh v'lh ms'yhm lmvts'yhm
verses.translation: And Moses wrote their goings forth, stage by stage, by the commandment of the LORD; and these are their stages at their goings forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֤וּ מֵֽרַעְמְסֵס֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן מִֽמׇּחֳרַ֣ת הַפֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vys'v mr'mss bchdsh hr'shvn bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hr'shvn mmchrt hpsch yts'v bnyyshr'l byd rmh l'yny khlmtsrym
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם כׇּל־בְּכ֑וֹר וּבֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה שְׁפָטִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmtsrym mqbrym 't 'shr hkhh yhvh bhm khlbkhvr vb'lhyhm 'shh yhvh shptym
verses.translation: while the Egyptians were burying them that the LORD had smitten among them, even all their first-born; upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֑ס וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּסֻכֹּֽת׃
verses.translit: vys'v bnyyshr'l mr'mss vychnv bskht
verses.translation: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vys'v mskht vychnv b'tm 'shr bqtsh hmdbr
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽאֵתָ֔ם וַיָּ֙שׇׁב֙ עַל־פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵ֖י בַּ֣עַל צְפ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מִגְדֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'tm vyshb 'lpy hchyrt 'shr 'lpny b'l tspvn vychnv lpny mgdl
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Etham, and turned back unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon; and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַֽחִירֹ֔ת וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּ֑רָה וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mpny hchyrt vy'brv btvkhhym hmdbrh vylkhv drkh shlsht ymym bmdbr 'tm vychnv bmrh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Penehahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness; and they went three days’journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֵילִ֑מָה וּ֠בְאֵילִ֠ם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vys'v mmrh vyb'v 'ylmh vb'ylm shtym 'shrh 'ynt mym vshb'ym tmrym vychnvshm
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Marah, and came unto Elim; and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and threescore and ten palm-trees; and they pitched there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֵילִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'ylm vychnv 'lymsvf
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Elim, and pitched by the Red Sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיַּם־ס֑וּף וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּר־סִֽין׃
verses.translit: vys'v mymsvf vychnv bmdbrsyn
verses.translation: And they journeyed from the Red Sea, and pitched in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּר־סִ֑ין וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדׇפְקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mmdbrsyn vychnv bdpqh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, and pitched in Dophkah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדׇּפְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאָלֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: vys'v mdpqh vychnv b'lvsh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Dophkah, and pitched in Alush.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאָל֑וּשׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּרְפִידִ֔ם וְלֹא־הָ֨יָה שָׁ֥ם מַ֛יִם לָעָ֖ם לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'lvsh vychnv brpydm vl'hyh shm mym l'm lshtvt
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Alush, and pitched in Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרְפִידִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.translit: vys'v mrpydm vychnv bmdbr syny
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּקִבְרֹ֥ת הַֽתַּאֲוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mmdbr syny vychnv bqbrt ht'vh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sinai, and pitched in Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקִּבְרֹ֣ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vys'v mqbrt ht'vh vychnv bchtsrt
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and pitched in Hazeroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲצֵרֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִתְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mchtsrt vychnv brtmh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִתְמָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִמֹּ֥ן פָּֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vys'v mrtmh vychnv brmn prts
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Rithmah, and pitched in Rimmon-perez.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִמֹּ֣ן פָּ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּלִבְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mrmn prts vychnv blbnh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Rimmon-perez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִלִּבְנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִסָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mlbnh vychnv brsh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Libnah, and pitched in Rissah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִסָּ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּקְהֵלָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mrsh vychnv bqhlth
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקְּהֵלָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּהַר־שָֽׁפֶר׃
verses.translit: vys'v mqhlth vychnv bhrshpr
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Kehelah, and pitched in mount Shepher.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽהַר־שָׁ֑פֶר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲרָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mhrshpr vychnv bchrdh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from mount Shepher, and pitched in Haradah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲרָדָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vys'v mchrdh vychnv bmqhlt
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽחַת׃
verses.translit: vys'v mmqhlt vychnv btcht
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Makheloth, and pitched in Tahath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑חַת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽרַח׃
verses.translit: vys'v mtcht vychnv btrch
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Tahath, and pitched in Terah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑רַח וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִתְקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mtrch vychnv bmtqh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Terah, and pitched in Mithkah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּתְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mmtqh vychnv bchshmnh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Mithkah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽחַשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמֹסֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vys'v mchshmnh vychnv bmsrvt
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Hashmonah, and pitched in Moseroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמֹּסֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּבְנֵ֥י יַעֲקָֽן׃
verses.translit: vys'v mmsrvt vychnv bbny y'qn
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִבְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקָ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחֹ֥ר הַגִּדְגָּֽד׃
verses.translit: vys'v mbny y'qn vychnv bchr hgdgd
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Bene-jaakan, and pitched in Hor-haggidgad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֹ֣ר הַגִּדְגָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּיׇטְבָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mchr hgdgd vychnv bytbth
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Hor-haggidgad, and pitched in Jotbah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיׇּטְבָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַבְרֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mytbth vychnv b'brnh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Jotbah, and pitched in Abronah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽעַבְרֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעֶצְיֹ֥ן גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'brnh vychnv b'tsyn gbr
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Abronah, and pitched in Ezion-geber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעֶצְיֹ֣ן גָּ֑בֶר וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְמִדְבַּר־צִ֖ן הִ֥וא קָדֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'tsyn gbr vychnv bmdbrtsn hv' qdsh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Ezion-geber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin—the same is Kadesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקָּדֵ֑שׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vys'v mqdsh vychnv bhr hhr bqtsh 'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל־הֹ֥ר הָהָ֛ר עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיָּ֣מׇת שָׁ֑ם בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְצֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֥ד לַחֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'l 'hrn hkhhn 'lhr hhr 'lpy yhvh vymt shm bshnt h'rb'ym lts't bnyyshr'l m'rts mtsrym bchdsh hchmyshy b'chd lchdsh
verses.translation: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן־שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמֹת֖וֹ בְּהֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'hrn bnshlsh v'shrym vm't shnh bmtv bhr hhr {s}
verses.translation: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲרָ֔ד וְהֽוּא־יֹשֵׁ֥ב בַּנֶּ֖גֶב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן בְּבֹ֖א בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshm' hkhn'ny mlkh 'rd vhv'yshb bngb b'rts khn'n bb' bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֑ר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּצַלְמֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mhr hhr vychnv btslmnh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִצַּלְמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּפוּנֹֽן׃
verses.translit: vys'v mtslmnh vychnv bpvnn
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִפּוּנֹ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאֹבֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vys'v mpvnn vychnv b'bt
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֹבֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּעִיֵּ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים בִּגְב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'bt vychnv b'yy h'brym bgbvl mv'b
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעִיִּ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדִיבֹ֥ן גָּֽד׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'yym vychnv bdybn gd
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Ijim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדִּיבֹ֣ן גָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַלְמֹ֥ן דִּבְלָתָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vys'v mdybn gd vychnv b'lmn dbltymh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Dibon-gad, and pitched in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעַלְמֹ֣ן דִּבְלָתָ֑יְמָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּהָרֵ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י נְבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vys'v m'lmn dbltymh vychnv bhry h'brym lpny nbv
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, in front of Nebo.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהָרֵ֣י הָעֲבָרִ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vys'v mhry h'brym vychnv b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: And they journeyed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִבֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמֹ֔ת עַ֖ד אָבֵ֣ל הַשִּׁטִּ֑ים בְּעַֽרְבֹ֖ת מוֹאָֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychnv 'lhyrdn mbyt hyshmt 'd 'bl hshtym b'rbt mv'b {s}
verses.translation: And they pitched by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh b'rbt mv'b 'lyrdn yrchv l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn 'l'rts khn'n
verses.translation: ’Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֨וֹרַשְׁתֶּ֜ם אֶת־כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֨בַּדְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֖ת כׇּל־מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־צַלְמֵ֤י מַסֵּֽכֹתָם֙ תְּאַבֵּ֔דוּ וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־בָּמוֹתָ֖ם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ׃
verses.translit: vhvrshtm 'tkhlyshby h'rts mpnykhm v'bdtm 't khlmshkhytm v't khltslmy mskhtm t'bdv v't khlbmvtm tshmydv
verses.translation: then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured stones, and destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־בָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhvrshtm 'th'rts vyshbtmbh khy lkhm ntty 'th'rts lrsht 'th
verses.translation: And ye shall drive out the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein; for unto you have I given the land to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת־הָאָ֨רֶץ בְּגוֹרָ֜ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם לָרַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ וְלַמְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת־נַחֲלָת֔וֹ אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר־יֵ֨צֵא ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛מָּה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לְמַטּ֥וֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תִּתְנֶחָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vhtnchltm 'th'rts bgvrl lmshpchtykhm lrb trbv 'tnchltv vlm't tm'yt 'tnchltv 'l 'shryts' lv shmh hgvrl lv yhyh lmtvt 'btykhm ttnchlv
verses.translation: And ye shall inherit the land by lot according to your families—to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer thou shalt give the less inheritance; wheresoever the lot falleth to any man, that shall be his; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye inherit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תוֹרִ֜ישׁוּ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֘רֶץ֮ מִפְּנֵיכֶם֒ וְהָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵהֶ֔ם לְשִׂכִּים֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וְלִצְנִינִ֖ם בְּצִדֵּיכֶ֑ם וְצָרְר֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'ml' tvryshv 'tyshby h'rts mpnykhm vhyh 'shr tvtyrv mhm lshkhym b'ynykhm vltsnynm btsdykhm vtsrrv 'tkhm 'lh'rts 'shr 'tm yshbym bh
verses.translation: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then shall those that ye let remain of them be as thorns in your eyes, and as pricks in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr dmyty l'shvt lhm ''shh lkhm {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that as I thought to do unto them, so will I do unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֞ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־אַתֶּ֥ם בָּאִ֖ים אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפֹּ֤ל לָכֶם֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: tsv 'tbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy'tm b'ym 'lh'rts khn'n z't h'rts 'shr tpl lkhm bnchlh 'rts khn'n lgbltyh
verses.translation: ’Command the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye come into the land of Canaan, this shall be the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה לָכֶ֧ם פְּאַת־נֶ֛גֶב מִמִּדְבַּר־צִ֖ן עַל־יְדֵ֣י אֱד֑וֹם וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֥ה יָם־הַמֶּ֖לַח קֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.translit: vhyh lkhm p'tngb mmdbrtsn 'lydy 'dvm vhyh lkhm gbvl ngb mqtsh ymhmlch qdmh
verses.translation: Thus your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin close by the side of Edom, and your south border shall begin at the end of the Salt Sea eastward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֣ב לָכֶם֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ֙] תּֽוֹצְאֹתָ֔יו מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְיָצָ֥א חֲצַר־אַדָּ֖ר וְעָבַ֥ר עַצְמֹֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vnsb lkhm hgbvl mngb lm'lh 'qrbym v'br tsnh (vhyh) [vhyv] tvts'tyv mngb lqdsh brn' vyts' chtsr'dr v'br 'tsmnh
verses.translation: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out thereof shall be southward of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מֵעַצְמ֖וֹן נַ֣חְלָה מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vnsb hgbvl m'tsmvn nchlh mtsrym vhyv tvts'tyv hymh
verses.translation: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the Brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל יָֽם׃
verses.translit: vgbvl ym vhyh lkhm hym hgdvl vgbvl zhyhyh lkhm gbvl ym
verses.translation: And for the western border, ye shall have the Great Sea for a border; this shall be your west border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֣וּל צָפ֑וֹן מִן־הַיָּם֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל תְּתָא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vzhyhyh lkhm gbvl tspvn mnhym hgdl tt'v lkhm hr hhr
verses.translation: And this shall be your north border: from the Great Sea ye shall mark out your line unto mount Hor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר תְּתָא֖וּ לְבֹ֣א חֲמָ֑ת וְהָי֛וּ תּוֹצְאֹ֥ת הַגְּבֻ֖ל צְדָֽדָה׃
verses.translit: mhr hhr tt'v lb' chmt vhyv tvts't hgbl tsddh
verses.translation: from mount Hor ye shall mark out a line unto the entrance to Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבֻל֙ זִפְרֹ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָ֑ן זֶֽה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyts' hgbl zprnh vhyv tvts'tyv chtsr 'ynn zhyhyh lkhm gbvl tspvn
verses.translation: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan; this shall be your north border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֖ם לִגְב֣וּל קֵ֑דְמָה מֵחֲצַ֥ר עֵינָ֖ן שְׁפָֽמָה׃
verses.translit: vht'vytm lkhm lgbvl qdmh mchtsr 'ynn shpmh
verses.translation: And ye shall mark out your line for the east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּבֻ֧ל מִשְּׁפָ֛ם הָרִבְלָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם לָעָ֑יִן וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּבֻ֔ל וּמָחָ֛ה עַל־כֶּ֥תֶף יָם־כִּנֶּ֖רֶת קֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.translit: vyrd hgbl mshpm hrblh mqdm l'yn vyrd hgbl vmchh 'lkhtf ymkhnrt qdmh
verses.translation: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall strike upon the slope of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח זֹאת֩ תִּהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶ֖יהָ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyrd hgbvl hyrdnh vhyv tvts'tyv ym hmlch z't thyh lkhm h'rts lgbltyh sbyb
verses.translation: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Salt Sea; this shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ בְּגוֹרָ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה לָתֵ֛ת לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 'tbny yshr'l l'mr z't h'rts 'shr ttnchlv 'th bgvrl 'shr tsvh yhvh ltt ltsh't hmtvt vchtsy hmth
verses.translation: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying: ‘This is the land wherein ye shall receive inheritance by lot, which the LORD hath commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָראוּבֵנִי֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם וּמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־הַגָּדִ֖י לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם וַחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy lqchv mth bny hr'vbny lbyt 'btm vmth bnyhgdy lbyt 'btm vchtsy mth mnshh lqchv nchltm
verses.translation: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁנֵ֥י הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֑ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָֽחָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shny hmtvt vchtsy hmth lqchv nchltm m'br lyrdn yrchv qdmh mzrchh {p}
verses.translation: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sun-rising.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יִנְחֲל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt h'nshym 'shrynchlv lkhm 'th'rts 'l'zr hkhhn vyhvsh' bnnvn
verses.translation: ’These are the names of the men that shall take possession of the land for you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֛ד נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֖ד מִמַּטֶּ֑ה תִּקְח֖וּ לִנְחֹ֥ל אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vnshy' 'chd nshy' 'chd mmth tqchv lnchl 'th'rts
verses.translation: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to take possession of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt h'nshym lmth yhvdh khlb bnypnh
verses.translation: And these are the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.translit: vlmth bny shm'vn shmv'l bn'myhvd
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֱלִידָ֖ד בֶּן־כִּסְלֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: lmth bnymn 'lydd bnkhslvn
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־דָ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא בֻּקִּ֖י בֶּן־יׇגְלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vlmth bnydn nshy' bqy bnygly
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה נָשִׂ֑יא חַנִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־אֵפֹֽד׃
verses.translit: lbny yvsf lmth bnymnshh nshy' chny'l bn'pd
verses.translation: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם נָשִׂ֑יא קְמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־שִׁפְטָֽן׃
verses.translit: vlmth bny'prym nshy' qmv'l bnshptn
verses.translation: and of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־זְבוּלֻ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא אֱלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־פַּרְנָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vlmth bnyzbvln nshy' 'lytspn bnprnkh
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Eli-zaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא פַּלְטִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַזָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vlmth bnyyshshkhr nshy' plty'l bn'zn
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא אֲחִיה֖וּד בֶּן־שְׁלֹמִֽי׃
verses.translit: vlmth bny'shr nshy' 'chyhvd bnshlmy
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־נַפְתָּלִ֖י נָשִׂ֑יא פְּדַהְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.translit: vlmth bnynptly nshy' pdh'l bn'myhvd
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֑ה לְנַחֵ֥ל אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh 'shr tsvh yhvh lnchl 'tbnyyshr'l b'rts khn'n {p}
verses.translation: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh b'rbt mv'b 'lyrdn yrchv l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַו֮ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ לַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִֽנַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם עָרִ֣ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרָ֗שׁ לֶֽעָרִים֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: tsv 'tbny yshr'l vntnv llvym mnchlt 'chztm 'rym lshbt vmgrsh l'rym sbybtyhm ttnv llvym
verses.translation: ’Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and open land round about the cities shall ye give unto the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֧וּ הֶֽעָרִ֛ים לָהֶ֖ם לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֗ם יִהְי֤וּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם֙ וְלִרְכֻשָׁ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיָּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyv h'rym lhm lshbt vmgrshyhm yhyv lbhmtm vlrkhshm vlkhl chytm
verses.translation: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and their open land shall be for their cattle, and for their substance, and for all their beasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִקִּ֤יר הָעִיר֙ וָח֔וּצָה אֶ֥לֶף אַמָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vmgrshy h'rym 'shr ttnv llvym mqyr h'yr vchvtsh 'lf 'mh sbyb
verses.translation: And the open land about the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַדֹּתֶ֞ם מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֗יר אֶת־פְּאַת־קֵ֣דְמָה אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֟ה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־נֶ֩גֶב֩ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּאַמָּ֜ה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־יָ֣ם  אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֗ה וְאֵ֨ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפ֛וֹן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּאַמָּ֖ה וְהָעִ֣יר בַּתָּ֑וֶךְ זֶ֚ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם מִגְרְשֵׁ֖י הֶעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmdtm mchvts l'yr 'tp'tqdmh 'lpym b'mh v'tp'tngb 'lpym b'mh v'tp'tym  'lpym b'mh v't p't tspvn 'lpym b'mh vh'yr btvkh zh yhyh lhm mgrshy h'rym
verses.translation: And ye shall measure without the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the open land about the cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֵ֚ת שֵׁשׁ־עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְּנ֔וּ לָנֻ֥ס שָׁ֖מָּה הָרֹצֵ֑חַ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתְּנ֔וּ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם עִֽיר׃
verses.translit: v't h'rym 'shr ttnv llvym 't shsh'ry hmqlt 'shr ttnv lns shmh hrtsch v'lyhm ttnv 'rb'ym vshtym 'yr
verses.translation: And the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which ye shall give for the manslayer to flee thither; and beside them ye shall give forty and two cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה עִ֑יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: khlh'rym 'shr ttnv llvym 'rb'ym vshmnh 'yr 'thn v'tmgrshyhn
verses.translation: All the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with the open land about them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֤ת הָרַב֙ תַּרְבּ֔וּ וּמֵאֵ֥ת הַמְעַ֖ט תַּמְעִ֑יטוּ אִ֗ישׁ כְּפִ֤י נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִנְחָ֔לוּ יִתֵּ֥ן מֵעָרָ֖יו לַלְוִיִּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vh'rym 'shr ttnv m'chzt bnyyshr'l m't hrb trbv vm't hm't tm'ytv 'ysh khpy nchltv 'shr ynchlv ytn m'ryv llvym {p}
verses.translation: And concerning the cities which ye shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many ye shall take many, and from the few ye shall take few; each tribe according to its inheritance which it inheriteth shall give of its cities unto the Levites.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn 'rtsh khn'n
verses.translation: ’Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָכֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָכֶ֑ם וְנָ֥ס שָׁ֙מָּה֙ רֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה־נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqrytm lkhm 'rym 'ry mqlt thyynh lkhm vns shmh rtsch mkhhnpsh bshggh
verses.translation: then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer that killeth any person through error may flee thither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֧ם הֶעָרִ֛ים לְמִקְלָ֖ט מִגֹּאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ עַד־עׇמְד֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: vhyv lkhm h'rym lmqlt mg'l vl' ymvt hrtsch 'd'mdv lpny h'dh lmshpt
verses.translation: And the cities shall be unto you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation for judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑נוּ שֵׁשׁ־עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'rym 'shr ttnv shsh'ry mqlt thyynh lkhm
verses.translation: And as to the cities which ye shall give, there shall be for you six cities of refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת  שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶעָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְאֵת֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים תִּתְּנ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: 't  shlsh h'rym ttnv m'br lyrdn v't shlsh h'rym ttnv b'rts khn'n 'ry mqlt thyynh
verses.translation: Ye shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֤ר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔ם תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה שֵׁשׁ־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לְמִקְלָ֑ט לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה כׇּל־מַכֵּה־נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
verses.translit: lbny yshr'l vlgr vltvshb btvkhm thyynh shshh'rym h'lh lmqlt lnvs shmh khlmkhhnpsh bshggh
verses.translation: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the settler among them, shall these six cities be for refuge, that every one that killeth any person through error may flee thither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בִּכְלִ֨י בַרְזֶ֧ל ׀ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: v'mbkhly brzl  hkhhv vymt rtsch hv' mvt yvmt hrtsch
verses.translation: But if he smote him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם בְּאֶ֣בֶן יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥הּ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: v'm b'bn yd 'shrymvt bh hkhhv vymt rtsch hv' mvt yvmt hrtsch
verses.translation: And if he smote him with a stone in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֡וֹ בִּכְלִ֣י עֵֽץ־יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֨וּת בּ֥וֹ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: 'v bkhly 'tsyd 'shrymvt bv hkhhv vymt rtsch hv' mvt yvmt hrtsch
verses.translation: Or if he smote him with a weapon of wood in the hand, whereby a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יָמִ֖ית אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֑חַ בְּפִגְעוֹ־ב֖וֹ ה֥וּא יְמִתֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: g'l hdm hv' ymyt 'thrtsch bpg'vbv hv' ymtnv
verses.translation: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death; when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בְּשִׂנְאָ֖ה יֶהְדֳּפֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו בִּצְדִיָּ֖ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: v'mbshn'h yhdpnv 'vhshlykh 'lyv btsdyh vymt
verses.translation: And if he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him any thing, lying in wait, so that he died;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְאֵיבָ֞ה הִכָּ֤הוּ בְיָדוֹ֙ וַיָּמֹ֔ת מֽוֹת־יוּמַ֥ת הַמַּכֶּ֖ה רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֗ם יָמִ֛ית אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בְּפִגְעוֹ־בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'v b'ybh hkhhv bydv vymt mvtyvmt hmkhh rtsch hv' g'l hdm ymyt 'thrtsch bpg'vbv
verses.translation: or in enmity smote him with his hand, that he died; he that smote him shall surely be put to death: he is a murderer; the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meeteth him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בְּפֶ֥תַע בְּלֹא־אֵיבָ֖ה הֲדָפ֑וֹ אוֹ־הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו כׇּל־כְּלִ֖י בְּלֹ֥א צְדִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mbpt' bl''ybh hdpv 'vhshlykh 'lyv khlkhly bl' tsdyh
verses.translation: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled upon him any thing without lying in wait,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְכׇל־אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֥וּת בָּהּ֙ בְּלֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַיַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖יו וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְהוּא֙ לֹא־אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'v bkhl'bn 'shrymvt bh bl' r'vt vypl 'lyv vymt vhv' l''vyb lv vl' mbqsh r'tv
verses.translation: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָֽׁפְטוּ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין הַמַּכֶּ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֑ם עַ֥ל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vshptv h'dh byn hmkhh vbyn g'l hdm 'l hmshptym h'lh
verses.translation: then the congregation shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִצִּ֨ילוּ הָעֵדָ֜ה אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֗חַ מִיַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּם֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל־עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּה וְיָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗הּ עַד־מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhtsylv h'dh 'thrtsch myd g'l hdm vhshybv 'tv h'dh 'l'yr mqltv 'shrns shmh vyshb bh 'dmvt hkhhn hgdl 'shrmshch 'tv bshmn hqdsh
verses.translation: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, whither he was fled; and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־יָצֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א הָרֹצֵ֑חַ אֶת־גְּבוּל֙ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: v'myts' yts' hrtsch 'tgbvl 'yr mqltv 'shr ynvs shmh
verses.translation: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, whither he fleeth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָצָ֤א אֹתוֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם מִח֕וּץ לִגְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ וְרָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל הַדָּם֙ אֶת־הָ֣רֹצֵ֔חַ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vmts' 'tv g'l hdm mchvts lgbvl 'yr mqltv vrtsch g'l hdm 'thrtsch 'yn lv dm
verses.translation: and the avenger of blood find him without the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood slay the manslayer; there shall be no bloodguiltiness for him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְעִ֤יר מִקְלָטוֹ֙ יֵשֵׁ֔ב עַד־מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֑ל וְאַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל יָשׁוּב֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy b'yr mqltv yshb 'dmvt hkhhn hgdl v'chry mvt hkhhn hgdl yshvb hrtsch 'l'rts 'chztv
verses.translation: because he must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest; but after the death of the high priest the manslayer may return into the land of his possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ אֵ֧לֶּה לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyv 'lh lkhm lchqt mshpt ldrtykhm bkhl mvshbtykhm
verses.translation: And these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּ֨ל־מַכֵּה־נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְפִ֣י עֵדִ֔ים יִרְצַ֖ח אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֑חַ וְעֵ֣ד אֶחָ֔ד לֹא־יַעֲנֶ֥ה בְנֶ֖פֶשׁ לָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: khlmkhhnpsh lpy 'dym yrtsch 'thrtsch v'd 'chd l'y'nh bnpsh lmvt
verses.translation: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֙פֶר֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָמ֑וּת כִּי־מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vl'tqchv khpr lnpsh rtsch 'shrhv' rsh' lmvt khymvt yvmt
verses.translation: Moreover ye shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer, that is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־תִקְח֣וּ כֹ֔פֶר לָנ֖וּס אֶל־עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ לָשׁוּב֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בָּאָ֔רֶץ עַד־מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vl'tqchv khpr lnvs 'l'yr mqltv lshvb lshbt b'rts 'dmvt hkhhn
verses.translation: And ye shall take no ransom for him that is fled to his city of refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־תַחֲנִ֣יפוּ אֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בָּ֔הּ כִּ֣י הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יַחֲנִ֖יף אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלָאָ֣רֶץ לֹֽא־יְכֻפַּ֗ר לַדָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ־בָּ֔הּ כִּי־אִ֖ם בְּדַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'tchnypv 'th'rts 'shr 'tm bh khy hdm hv' ychnyf 'th'rts vl'rts l'ykhpr ldm 'shr shpkhbh khy'm bdm shpkhv
verses.translation: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are; for blood, it polluteth the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl' ttm' 'th'rts 'shr 'tm yshbym bh 'shr 'ny shkhn btvkhh khy 'ny yhvh shkhn btvkh bny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt not defile the land which ye inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell; for I the LORD dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת לְמִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי־גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַנְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyqrbv r'shy h'bvt lmshpcht bnygl'd bnmkhyr bnmnshh mmshpcht bny yvsf vydbrv lpny mshh vlpny hnsh'ym r'shy 'bvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the heads of the fathers’houses of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’houses of the children of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה לָתֵ֨ת אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֛ה בְּגוֹרָ֖ל לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽאדֹנִי֙ צֻוָּ֣ה בַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לָתֵ֗ת אֶֽת־נַחֲלַ֛ת צְלׇפְחָ֥ד אָחִ֖ינוּ לִבְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 't'dny tsvh yhvh ltt 'th'rts bnchlh bgvrl lbny yshr'l v'dny tsvh byhvh ltt 'tnchlt tslpchd 'chynv lbntyv
verses.translation: and they said: ‘The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel; and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָי֠וּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒ וְנִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָן֙ מִנַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְנוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִגֹּרַ֥ל נַחֲלָתֵ֖נוּ יִגָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vhyv l'chd mbny shbty bnyyshr'l lnshym vngr'h nchltn mnchlt 'btynv vnvsf 'l nchlt hmth 'shr thyynh lhm vmgrl nchltnv ygr'
verses.translation: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong; so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־יִהְיֶ֣ה הַיֹּבֵל֮ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִֽנַּחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יִגָּרַ֖ע נַחֲלָתָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'myhyh hybl lbny yshr'l vnvsph nchltn 'l nchlt hmth 'shr thyynh lhm vmnchlt mth 'btynv ygr' nchltn
verses.translation: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong; so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר כֵּ֛ן מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף דֹּבְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 'tbny yshr'l 'lpy yhvh l'mr khn mth bnyyvsf dbrym
