verses.translation: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying: ‘The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaketh right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת צְלׇפְחָד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לְנָשִׁ֑ים אַ֗ךְ לְמִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shrtsvh yhvh lbnvt tslpchd l'mr ltvb b'ynyhm thyynh lnshym 'kh lmshpcht mth 'byhm thyynh lnshym
verses.translation: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying: Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־תִסֹּ֤ב נַחֲלָה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִמַּטֶּ֖ה אֶל־מַטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אִ֗ישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֔יו יִדְבְּק֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vl'tsb nchlh lbny yshr'l mmth 'lmth khy 'ysh bnchlt mth 'btyv ydbqv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall cleave every one to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִמַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְאֶחָ֗ד מִמִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יהָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן יִֽירְשׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vkhlbt yrsht nchlh mmtvt bny yshr'l l'chd mmshpcht mth 'byh thyh l'shh lm'n yyrshv bny yshr'l 'ysh nchlt 'btyv
verses.translation: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־תִסֹּ֧ב נַחֲלָ֛ה מִמַּטֶּ֖ה לְמַטֶּ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר כִּי־אִישׁ֙ בְּנַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ יִדְבְּק֕וּ מַטּ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vl'tsb nchlh mmth lmth 'chr khy'ysh bnchltv ydbqv mtvt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall cleave each one to its own inheritance.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנ֥וֹת צְלׇפְחָֽד׃
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shv bnvt tslpchd
verses.translation: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְחׇגְלָ֧ה וּמִלְכָּ֛ה וְנֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלׇפְחָ֑ד לִבְנֵ֥י דֹדֵיהֶ֖ן לְנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vthyynh mchlh trtsh vchglh vmlkhh vn'h bnvt tslpchd lbny ddyhn lnshym
verses.translation: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֖ף הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים וַתְּהִי֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַל־מַטֵּ֖ה מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: mmshpcht bnymnshh bnyvsf hyv lnshym vthy nchltn 'lmth mshpcht 'byhn
verses.translation: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֞ת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lh hmtsvt vhmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh bydmshh 'lbny yshr'l b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: These are the commandments and the ordinances, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֡ר בָּֽעֲרָבָה֩ מ֨וֹל ס֜וּף בֵּֽין־פָּארָ֧ן וּבֵֽין־תֹּ֛פֶל וְלָבָ֥ן וַחֲצֵרֹ֖ת וְדִ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: 'lh hdbrym 'shr dbr mshh 'lkhlyshr'l b'br hyrdn bmdbr b'rbh mvl svf bynp'rn vbyntpl vlbn vchtsrt vdy zhb
verses.translation: THESE ARE the words which Moses spoke unto all Israel beyond the Jordan; in the wilderness, in the Arabah, over against Suph, between Paran and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-zahab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֨ד עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ מֵֽחֹרֵ֔ב דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַר־שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: 'chd 'shr yvm mchrb drkh hrsh'yr 'd qdsh brn'
verses.translation: It is eleven days journey from Horeb unto Kadesh-barnea by the way of mount Seir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בְּאַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy b'rb'ym shnh b'shty'shr chdsh b'chd lchdsh dbr mshh 'lbny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv 'lhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י הַכֹּת֗וֹ אֵ֚ת סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְאֵ֗ת ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹ֖ת בְּאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
verses.translit: 'chry hkhtv 't sychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn v't 'vg mlkh hbshn 'shryvshb b'shtrt b'dr'y
verses.translation: after he had smitten Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth, at Edrei;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב הוֹאִ֣יל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּאֵ֛ר אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: b'br hyrdn b'rts mv'b hv'yl mshh b'r 'thtvrh hz't l'mr
verses.translation: beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, took Moses upon him to expound this law, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ בְּחֹרֵ֣ב לֵאמֹ֑ר רַב־לָכֶ֥ם שֶׁ֖בֶת בָּהָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv dbr 'lynv bchrb l'mr rblkhm shbt bhr hzh
verses.translation: The LORD our God spoke unto us in Horeb, saying: ‘Ye have dwelt long enough in this mountain;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנ֣וּ  וּסְע֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם וּבֹ֨אוּ הַ֥ר הָֽאֱמֹרִי֮ וְאֶל־כׇּל־שְׁכֵנָיו֒ בָּעֲרָבָ֥ה בָהָ֛ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֥ה וּבַנֶּ֖גֶב וּבְח֣וֹף הַיָּ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַלְּבָנ֔וֹן עַד־הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃
verses.translit: pnv  vs'v lkhm vb'v hr h'mry v'lkhlshkhnyv b'rbh bhr vbshplh vbngb vbchvf hym 'rts hkhn'ny vhlbnvn 'dhnhr hgdl nhrprt
verses.translation: turn you, and take your journey, and go to the hill-country of the Amorites and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the Arabah, in the hill-country, and in the Lowland, and in the South, and by the sea-shore; the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֚אוּ וּרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֣ע יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה לַאֲבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֔ם וּלְזַרְעָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: r'h ntty lpnykhm 'th'rts b'v vrshv 'th'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm l'brhm lytschq vly'qb ltt lhm vlzr'm 'chryhm
verses.translation: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD swore unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־אוּכַ֥ל לְבַדִּ֖י שְׂאֵ֥ת אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lkhm b't hhv' l'mr l''vkhl lbdy sh't 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I spoke unto you at that time, saying: ‘I am not able to bear you myself alone;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם הִרְבָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykhm hrbh 'tkhm vhnkhm hyvm khkhvkhby hshmym lrb
verses.translation: the LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֽוֹתֵכֶ֗ם יֹסֵ֧ף עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כָּכֶ֖ם אֶ֣לֶף פְּעָמִ֑ים וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'bvtkhm ysf 'lykhm khkhm 'lf p'mym vybrkh 'tkhm kh'shr dbr lkhm
verses.translation: The LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as He hath promised you!—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָ֥ה אֶשָּׂ֖א לְבַדִּ֑י טׇרְחֲכֶ֥ם וּמַֽשַּׂאֲכֶ֖ם וְרִֽיבְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ykhh 'sh' lbdy trchkhm vmsh'khm vrybkhm
verses.translation: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לָ֠כֶ֠ם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים חֲכָמִ֧ים וּנְבֹנִ֛ים וִידֻעִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשִׂימֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hbv lkhm 'nshym chkhmym vnbnym vyd'ym lshbtykhm v'shymm br'shykhm
verses.translation: Get you, from each one of your tribes, wise men, and understanding, and full of knowledge, and I will make them heads over you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲנ֖וּ אֹתִ֑י וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טֽוֹב־הַדָּבָ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translit: vt'nv 'ty vt'mrv tvbhdbr 'shrdbrt l'shvt
verses.translation: And ye answered me, and said: ‘The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֞ח אֶת־רָאשֵׁ֣י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים חֲכָמִים֙ וִֽידֻעִ֔ים וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שָׂרֵ֨י אֲלָפִ֜ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֗וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֤י חֲמִשִּׁים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י עֲשָׂרֹ֔ת וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'qch 'tr'shy shbtykhm 'nshym chkhmym vyd'ym v'tn 'vtm r'shym 'lykhm shry 'lpym vshry m'vt vshry chmshym vshry 'shrt vshtrym lshbtykhm
verses.translation: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and full of knowledge, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, tribe by tribe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־שֹׁ֣פְטֵיכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹ֤עַ בֵּין־אֲחֵיכֶם֙ וּשְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין־אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵין־אָחִ֖יו וּבֵ֥ין גֵּרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'tsvh 'tshptykhm b't hhv' l'mr shm' byn'chykhm vshpttm tsdq byn'ysh vbyn'chyv vbyn grv
verses.translation: And I charged your judges at that time, saying: ‘Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תַכִּ֨ירוּ פָנִ֜ים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט כַּקָּטֹ֤ן כַּגָּדֹל֙ תִּשְׁמָע֔וּן לֹ֤א תָג֙וּרוּ֙ מִפְּנֵי־אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֥י הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט לֵאלֹהִ֣ים ה֑וּא וְהַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְשֶׁ֣ה מִכֶּ֔ם תַּקְרִב֥וּן אֵלַ֖י וּשְׁמַעְתִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: l'tkhyrv pnym bmshpt khqtn khgdl tshm'vn l' tgvrv mpny'ysh khy hmshpt l'lhym hv' vhdbr 'shr yqshh mkhm tqrbvn 'ly vshm'tyv
verses.translation: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; ye shall hear the small and the great alike; ye shall not be afraid of the face of any man; for the judgment is God’s; and the cause that is too hard for you ye shall bring unto me, and I will hear it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑וא אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃
verses.translit: v'tsvh 'tkhm b't hhv' 't khlhdbrym 'shr t'shvn
verses.translation: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּסַּ֣ע מֵחֹרֵ֗ב וַנֵּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַגָּדוֹל֩ וְהַנּוֹרָ֨א הַה֜וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ֣ר הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֹתָ֑נוּ וַנָּבֹ֕א עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vns' mchrb vnlkh 't khlhmdbr hgdvl vhnvr' hhv' 'shr r'ytm drkh hr h'mry kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhynv 'tnv vnb' 'd qdsh brn'
verses.translation: And we journeyed from Horeb, and went through all that great and dreadful wilderness which ye saw, by the way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵכֶ֑ם בָּאתֶם֙ עַד־הַ֣ר הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lkhm b'tm 'dhr h'mry 'shryhvh 'lhynv ntn lnv
verses.translation: And I said unto you: ‘Ye are come unto the hill-country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God giveth unto us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְ֠אֵ֠ה נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ עֲלֵ֣ה רֵ֗שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אַל־תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־תֵּחָֽת׃
verses.translit: r'h ntn yhvh 'lhykh lpnykh 'th'rts 'lh rsh kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh 'ltyr' v'ltcht
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee; go up, take possession, as the LORD, the God of thy fathers, hath spoken unto thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַי֮ כֻּלְּכֶם֒ וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ נִשְׁלְחָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ־לָ֖נוּ אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיָשִׁ֤בוּ אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אֶת־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲלֶה־בָּ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vtqrbvn 'ly khlkhm vt'mrv nshlchh 'nshym lpnynv vychprvlnv 'th'rts vyshbv 'tnv dbr 'thdrkh 'shr n'lhbh v't h'rym 'shr nb' 'lyhn
verses.translation: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said: ‘Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us back word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities unto which we shall come.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּיטַ֥ב בְּעֵינַ֖י הַדָּבָ֑ר וָאֶקַּ֤ח מִכֶּם֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: vyytb b'yny hdbr v'qch mkhm shnym 'shr 'nshym 'ysh 'chd lshbt
verses.translation: And the thing pleased me well; and I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנוּ֙ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֑ל וַֽיְרַגְּל֖וּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vypnv vy'lv hhrh vyb'v 'dnchl 'shkhl vyrglv 'th
verses.translation: and they turned and went up into the mountains, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֤וּ בְיָדָם֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיּוֹרִ֖דוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וַיָּשִׁ֨בוּ אֹתָ֤נוּ דָבָר֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טוֹבָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqchv bydm mpry h'rts vyvrdv 'lynv vyshbv 'tnv dbr vy'mrv tvbh h'rts 'shryhvh 'lhynv ntn lnv
verses.translation: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us back word, and said: ‘Good is the land which the LORD our God giveth unto us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א אֲבִיתֶ֖ם לַעֲלֹ֑ת וַתַּמְר֕וּ אֶת־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vl' 'bytm l'lt vtmrv 'tpy yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Yet ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּרָגְנ֤וּ בְאׇהֳלֵיכֶם֙ וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בְּשִׂנְאַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ אֹתָ֔נוּ הוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָתֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛נוּ בְּיַ֥ד הָאֱמֹרִ֖י לְהַשְׁמִידֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vtrgnv b'hlykhm vt'mrv bshn't yhvh 'tnv hvtsy'nv m'rts mtsrym ltt 'tnv byd h'mry lhshmydnv
verses.translation: and ye murmured in your tents, and said: ‘Because the LORD hated us, He hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנָ֣ה  אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹלִ֗ים אַחֵ֩ינוּ֩ הֵמַ֨סּוּ אֶת־לְבָבֵ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר עַ֣ם גָּד֤וֹל וָרָם֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּבְצוּרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְגַם־בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָקִ֖ים רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'nh  'nchnv 'lym 'chynv hmsv 'tlbbnv l'mr 'm gdvl vrm mmnv 'rym gdlt vbtsvrt bshmym vgmbny 'nqym r'ynv shm
verses.translation: Whither are we going up? our brethren have made our heart to melt, saying: The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and fortified up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵכֶ֑ם לֹא־תַעַרְצ֥וּן וְלֹא־תִֽירְא֖וּן מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lkhm l't'rtsvn vl'tyr'vn mhm
verses.translation: Then I said unto you: ‘Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה אִתְּכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykhm hhlkh lpnykhm hv' ylchm lkhm khkhl 'shr 'shh 'tkhm bmtsrym l'ynykhm
verses.translation: The LORD your God who goeth before you, He shall fight for you, according to all that He did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַמִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נְשָׂאֲךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׂא־אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־בְּנ֑וֹ בְּכׇל־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם עַד־בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vbmdbr 'shr r'yt 'shr nsh'kh yhvh 'lhykh kh'shr ysh''ysh 'tbnv bkhlhdrkh 'shr hlkhtm 'db'khm 'dhmqvm hzh
verses.translation: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bore thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came unto this place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה אֵֽינְכֶם֙ מַאֲמִינִ֔ם בַּיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbdbr hzh 'ynkhm m'mynm byhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Yet in this thing ye do not believe the LORD your God,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהֹלֵ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֜ם בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ לָת֥וּר לָכֶ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לַחֲנֹֽתְכֶ֑ם בָּאֵ֣שׁ  לַ֗יְלָה לַרְאֹֽתְכֶם֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ וּבֶעָנָ֖ן יוֹמָֽם׃
verses.translit: hhlkh lpnykhm bdrkh ltvr lkhm mqvm lchntkhm b'sh  lylh lr'tkhm bdrkh 'shr tlkhvbh vb'nn yvmm
verses.translation: Who went before you in the way, to seek you out a place to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way ye should go, and in the cloud by day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּקְצֹ֖ף וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh 'tqvl dbrykhm vyqtsf vyshb' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and swore, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִרְאֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדּ֥וֹר הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֚ת הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי לָתֵ֖ת לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'myr'h 'ysh b'nshym h'lh hdvr hr' hzh 't h'rts htvbh 'shr nshb'ty ltt l'btykhm
verses.translation: ’Surely there shall not one of these men, even this evil generation, see the good land, which I swore to give unto your fathers,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֽוּלָתִ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה֙ ה֣וּא יִרְאֶ֔נָּה וְלֽוֹ־אֶתֵּ֧ן אֶת־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דָּֽרַךְ־בָּ֖הּ וּלְבָנָ֑יו יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּ֖א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: zvlty khlb bnypnh hv' yr'nh vlv'tn 'th'rts 'shr drkhbh vlbnyv y'n 'shr ml' 'chry yhvh
verses.translation: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, he shall see it; and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children; because he hath wholly followed the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בִּי֙ הִתְאַנַּ֣ף יְהֹוָ֔ה בִּגְלַלְכֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר גַּם־אַתָּ֖ה לֹא־תָבֹ֥א שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: gmby ht'nf yhvh bgllkhm l'mr gm'th l'tb' shm
verses.translation: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying: Thou also shalt not go in thither;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־נוּן֙ הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְפָנֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יָ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה אֹת֣וֹ חַזֵּ֔ק כִּי־ה֖וּא יַנְחִלֶ֥נָּה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: yhvsh' bnnvn h'md lpnykh hv' yb' shmh 'tv chzq khyhv' ynchlnh 'tyshr'l
verses.translation: Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in thither; encourage thou him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטַפְּכֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠בְנֵיכֶ֠ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יָדְע֤וּ הַיּוֹם֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע הֵ֖מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ שָׁ֑מָּה וְלָהֶ֣ם אֶתְּנֶ֔נָּה וְהֵ֖ם יִירָשֽׁוּהָ׃
verses.translit: vtpkhm 'shr 'mrtm lbz yhyh vbnykhm 'shr l'yd'v hyvm tvb vr' hmh yb'v shmh vlhm 'tnnh vhm yyrshvh
verses.translation: Moreover your little ones, that ye said should be a prey, and your children, that this day have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּנ֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם וּסְע֥וּ הַמִּדְבָּ֖רָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־סֽוּף׃
verses.translit: v'tm pnv lkhm vs'v hmdbrh drkh ymsvf
verses.translation: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲנ֣וּ  וַתֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלַ֗י חָטָ֘אנוּ֮ לַיהֹוָה֒ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ נַעֲלֶה֙ וְנִלְחַ֔מְנוּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽתַּחְגְּר֗וּ אִ֚ישׁ אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י מִלְחַמְתּ֔וֹ וַתָּהִ֖ינוּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת הָהָֽרָה׃
verses.translit: vt'nv  vt'mrv 'ly cht'nv lyhvh 'nchnv n'lh vnlchmnv khkhl 'shrtsvnv yhvh 'lhynv vtchgrv 'ysh 'tkhly mlchmtv vthynv l'lt hhrh
verses.translation: Then ye answered and said unto me: ‘We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.’ And ye girded on every man his weapons of war, and deemed it a light thing to go up into the hill-country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹ֤א תַֽעֲלוּ֙ וְלֹא־תִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י אֵינֶ֖נִּי בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּ֣גְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'mr lhm l' t'lv vl'tlchmv khy 'ynny bqrbkhm vl' tngpv lpny 'ybykhm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Say unto them: Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַתַּמְרוּ֙ אֶת־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַתָּזִ֖דוּ וַתַּעֲל֥וּ הָהָֽרָה׃
verses.translit: v'dbr 'lykhm vl' shm'tm vtmrv 'tpy yhvh vtzdv vt'lv hhrh
verses.translation: So I spoke unto you, and ye hearkened not; but ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill-country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַיֹּשֵׁ֨ב בָּהָ֤ר הַהוּא֙ לִקְרַאתְכֶ֔ם וַיִּרְדְּפ֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה הַדְּבֹרִ֑ים וַֽיַּכְּת֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֛ם בְּשֵׂעִ֖יר עַד־חׇרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts' h'mry hyshb bhr hhv' lqr'tkhm vyrdpv 'tkhm kh'shr t'shynh hdbrym vykhtv 'tkhm bsh'yr 'dchrmh
verses.translation: And the Amorites, that dwell in that hill-country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּשֻׁ֥בוּ וַתִּבְכּ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־שָׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ בְּקֹ֣לְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א הֶאֱזִ֖ין אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtshbv vtbkhv lpny yhvh vl'shm' yhvh bqlkhm vl' h'zyn 'lykhm
verses.translation: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD hearkened not to your voice, nor gave ear unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּשְׁב֥וּ בְקָדֵ֖שׁ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים כַּיָּמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: vtshbv bqdsh ymym rbym khymym 'shr yshbtm
verses.translation: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנֵּ֜פֶן וַנִּסַּ֤ע הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם־ס֔וּף כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וַנָּ֥סׇב אֶת־הַר־שֵׂעִ֖יר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnpn vns' hmdbrh drkh ymsvf kh'shr dbr yhvh 'ly vnsb 'thrsh'yr ymym rbym {s}
verses.translation: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke unto me; and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַב־לָכֶ֕ם סֹ֖ב אֶת־הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה פְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם צָפֹֽנָה׃
verses.translit: rblkhm sb 'thhr hzh pnv lkhm tspnh
verses.translation: ’Ye have compassed this mountain long enough; turn you northward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָעָם֮ צַ֣ו לֵאמֹר֒ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹֽבְרִ֗ים בִּגְבוּל֙ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר וְיִֽירְא֣וּ מִכֶּ֔ם וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: v'th'm tsv l'mr 'tm 'brym bgbvl 'chykhm bny'shv hyshbym bsh'yr vyyr'v mkhm vnshmrtm m'd
verses.translation: And command thou the people, saying: Ye are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you; take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתְגָּר֣וּ בָ֔ם כִּ֠י לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֤ן לָכֶם֙ מֵֽאַרְצָ֔ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף־רָ֑גֶל כִּֽי־יְרֻשָּׁ֣ה לְעֵשָׂ֔ו נָתַ֖תִּי אֶת־הַ֥ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: 'lttgrv bm khy l''tn lkhm m'rtsm 'd mdrkh khfrgl khyyrshh l'shv ntty 'thr sh'yr
verses.translation: contend not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣כֶל תִּשְׁבְּר֧וּ מֵֽאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֑ם וְגַם־מַ֜יִם תִּכְר֧וּ מֵאִתָּ֛ם בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וּשְׁתִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'khl tshbrv m'tm bkhsf v'khltm vgmmym tkhrv m'tm bkhsf vshtytm
verses.translation: Ye shall purchase food of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בֵּֽרַכְךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔ךָ יָדַ֣ע לֶכְתְּךָ֔ אֶת־הַמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַזֶּ֑ה זֶ֣ה  אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א חָסַ֖רְתָּ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh brkhkh bkhl m'shh ydkh yd' lkhtkh 'thmdbr hgdl hzh zh  'rb'ym shnh yhvh 'lhykh 'mkh l' chsrt dbr
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hand; He hath known thy walking through this great wilderness; these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֞ר מֵאֵ֧ת אַחֵ֣ינוּ בְנֵי־עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר מִדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ הָֽעֲרָבָ֔ה מֵאֵילַ֖ת וּמֵעֶצְיֹ֣ן גָּ֑בֶר {ס} וַנֵּ֙פֶן֙ וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vn'br m't 'chynv bny'shv hyshbym bsh'yr mdrkh h'rbh m'ylt vm'tsyn gbr {s} vnpn vn'br drkh mdbr mv'b
verses.translation: So we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah, from Elath and from Ezion-geber. And we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אַל־תָּ֙צַר֙ אֶת־מוֹאָ֔ב וְאַל־תִּתְגָּ֥ר בָּ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֨ן לְךָ֤ מֵֽאַרְצוֹ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֣י לִבְנֵי־ל֔וֹט נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־עָ֖ר יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'lttsr 'tmv'b v'lttgr bm mlchmh khy l''tn lkh m'rtsv yrshh khy lbnylvt ntty 't'r yrshh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Be not at enmity with Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give thee of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵמִ֥ים לְפָנִ֖ים יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑הּ עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִֽים׃
verses.translit: h'mym lpnym yshbv bh 'm gdvl vrb vrm kh'nqym
verses.translation: The Emim dwelt therein aforetime, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְפָאִ֛ים יֵחָשְׁב֥וּ אַף־הֵ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וְהַמֹּ֣אָבִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֵמִֽים׃
verses.translit: rp'ym ychshbv 'fhm kh'nqym vhm'bym yqr'v lhm 'mym
verses.translation: these also are accounted Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשֵׂעִ֞יר יָשְׁב֣וּ הַחֹרִים֮ לְפָנִים֒ וּבְנֵ֧י עֵשָׂ֣ו יִֽירָשׁ֗וּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתָּ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ יְרֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbsh'yr yshbv hchrym lpnym vbny 'shv yyrshvm vyshmydvm mpnyhm vyshbv tchtm kh'shr 'shh yshr'l l'rts yrshtv 'shrntn yhvh lhm
verses.translation: And in Seir dwelt the Horites aforetime, but the children of Esau succeeded them; and they destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה קֻ֛מוּ וְעִבְר֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־נַ֣חַל זָ֑רֶד וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־נַ֥חַל זָֽרֶד׃
verses.translit: 'th qmv v'brv lkhm 'tnchl zrd vn'br 'tnchl zrd
verses.translation: Now rise up, and get you over the brook Zered.’ And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֣כְנוּ  מִקָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־עָבַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־תֹּ֨ם כׇּל־הַדּ֜וֹר אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhymym 'shrhlkhnv  mqdsh brn' 'd 'shr'brnv 'tnchl zrd shlshym vshmnh shnh 'dtm khlhdvr 'nshy hmlchmh mqrb hmchnh kh'shr nshb' yhvh lhm
verses.translation: And the days in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, were thirty and eight years; until all the generation, even the men of war, were consumed from the midst of the camp, as the LORD swore unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם יַד־יְהֹוָה֙ הָ֣יְתָה בָּ֔ם לְהֻמָּ֖ם מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vgm ydyhvh hyth bm lhmm mqrb hmchnh 'd tmm
verses.translation: Moreover the hand of the LORD was against them, to discomfit them from the midst of the camp, until they were consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י כַאֲשֶׁר־תַּ֜מּוּ כׇּל־אַנְשֵׁ֧י הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה לָמ֖וּת מִקֶּ֥רֶב הָעָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrtmv khl'nshy hmlchmh lmvt mqrb h'm {s}
verses.translation: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: that the LORD spoke unto me saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־עָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'th 'br hyvm 'tgbvl mv'b 't'r
verses.translation: ’Thou art this day to pass over the border of Moab, even Ar;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרַבְתָּ֗ מ֚וּל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן אַל־תְּצֻרֵ֖ם וְאַל־תִּתְגָּ֣ר בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא־אֶ֠תֵּ֠ן מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֤וֹן לְךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י לִבְנֵי־ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥יהָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vqrbt mvl bny 'mvn 'lttsrm v'lttgr bm khy l''tn m'rts bny'mvn lkh yrshh khy lbnylvt nttyh yrshh
verses.translation: and when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, harass them not, nor contend with them; for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽרֶץ־רְפָאִ֥ים תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אַף־הִ֑וא רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָהּ֙ לְפָנִ֔ים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'rtsrp'ym tchshb 'fhv' rp'ym yshbvbh lpnym vh'mnym yqr'v lhm zmzmym
verses.translation: That also is accounted a land of Rephaim: Rephaim dwelt therein aforetime; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּירָשֻׁ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'm gdvl vrb vrm kh'nqym vyshmydm yhvh mpnyhm vyyrshm vyshbv tchtm
verses.translation: a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִשְׁמִ֤יד אֶת־הַחֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽירָשֻׁם֙ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: kh'shr 'shh lbny 'shv hyshbym bsh'yr 'shr hshmyd 'thchry mpnyhm vyyrshm vyshbv tchtm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: as He did for the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽעַוִּ֛ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בַּחֲצֵרִ֖ים עַד־עַזָּ֑ה כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִכַּפְתֹּ֔ר הִשְׁמִידֻ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'vym hyshbym bchtsrym 'd'zh khptrym hyts'ym mkhptr hshmydm vyshbv tchtm
verses.translation: and the Avvim, that dwelt in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, that came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ סְּע֗וּ וְעִבְרוּ֮ אֶת־נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹן֒ רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠יָדְךָ֠ אֶת־סִיחֹ֨ן מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן הָֽאֱמֹרִ֛י וְאֶת־אַרְצ֖וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֑שׁ וְהִתְגָּ֥ר בּ֖וֹ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: qvmv s'v v'brv 'tnchl 'rnn r'h ntty bydkh 'tsychn mlkhchshbvn h'mry v't'rtsv hchl rsh vhtgr bv mlchmh
verses.translation: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of Arnon; behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּךָ֙ וְיִרְאָ֣תְךָ֔ עַל־פְּנֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ שִׁמְעֲךָ֔ וְרָגְז֥וּ וְחָל֖וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hyvm hzh 'chl tt pchdkh vyr'tkh 'lpny h'mym tcht khlhshmym 'shr yshm'vn shm'kh vrgzv vchlv mpnykh
verses.translation: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the peoples that are under the whole heaven, who, when they hear the report of thee, shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת אֶל־סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'shlch ml'khym mmdbr qdmvt 'lsychvn mlkh chshbvn dbry shlvm l'mr
verses.translation: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵלֵ֑ךְ לֹ֥א אָס֖וּר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.translit: ''brh b'rtskh bdrkh bdrkh 'lkh l' 'svr ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: ’Let me pass through thy land; I will go along by the highway, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣כֶל בַּכֶּ֤סֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵ֙נִי֙ וְאָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֛יִם בַּכֶּ֥סֶף תִּתֶּן־לִ֖י וְשָׁתִ֑יתִי רַ֖ק אֶעְבְּרָ֥ה בְרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'khl bkhsf tshbrny v'khlty vmym bkhsf ttnly vshtyty rq ''brh brgly
verses.translation: Thou shalt sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink; only let me pass through on my feet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽשׂוּ־לִ֜י בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וְהַמּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָ֑ר עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר־אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: kh'shr 'shvly bny 'shv hyshbym bsh'yr vhmv'bym hyshbym b'r 'd 'shr''br 'thyrdn 'lh'rts 'shryhvh 'lhynv ntn lnv
verses.translation: as the children of Esau that dwell in Seir, and the Moabites that dwell in Ar, did unto me; until I shall pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֗ה סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־הִקְשָׁה֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־רוּח֗וֹ וְאִמֵּץ֙ אֶת־לְבָב֔וֹ לְמַ֛עַן תִּתּ֥וֹ בְיָדְךָ֖ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl' 'bh sychn mlkh chshbvn h'brnv bv khyhqshh yhvh 'lhykh 'trvchv v'mts 'tlbbv lm'n ttv bydkh khyvm hzh {s}
verses.translation: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֙תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־סִיחֹ֖ן וְאֶת־אַרְצ֑וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֔שׁ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly r'h hchlty tt lpnykh 'tsychn v't'rtsv hchl rsh lrsht 't'rtsv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before thee; begin to possess his land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֩ סִיחֹ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכׇל־עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָֽהְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyts' sychn lqr'tnv hv' vkhl'mv lmlchmh yhtsh
verses.translation: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Jahaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֛הוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּ֥ךְ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖ו וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vytnhv yhvh 'lhynv lpnynv vnkh 'tv v'tbnv v'tkhl'mv
verses.translation: And the LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־כׇּל־עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַֽנַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּ֑ף לֹ֥א הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vnlkhd 'tkhl'ryv b't hhv' vnchrm 'tkhl'yr mtm vhnshym vhtf l' hsh'rnv shryd
verses.translation: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every city, the men, and the women, and the little ones; we left none remaining;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה בָּזַ֣זְנוּ לָ֑נוּ וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכָֽדְנוּ׃
verses.translit: rq hbhmh bzznv lnv vshll h'rym 'shr lkhdnv
verses.translation: only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, with the spoil of the cities which we had taken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵֽעֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנֹ֜ן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּנַּ֙חַל֙ וְעַד־הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־הַכֹּ֕ל נָתַ֛ן יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: m'r'r 'shr 'lshptnchl 'rnn vh'yr 'shr bnchl v'dhgl'd l' hyth qryh 'shr shgbh mmnv 'thkhl ntn yhvh 'lhynv lpnynv
verses.translation: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of Arnon, and from the city that is in the valley, even unto Gilead, there was not a city too high for us: the LORD our God delivered up all before us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֛ק אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֖וֹן לֹ֣א קָרָ֑בְתָּ כׇּל־יַ֞ד נַ֤חַל יַבֹּק֙ וְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: rq 'l'rts bny'mvn l' qrbt khlyd nchl ybq v'ry hhr vkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Only to the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not near; all the side of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill-country, and wheresoever the LORD our God forbade us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנֵּ֣פֶן וַנַּ֔עַל דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וַיֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכׇל־עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
verses.translit: vnpn vn'l drkh hbshn vyts' 'vg mlkhhbshn lqr'tnv hv' vkhl'mv lmlchmh 'dr'y
verses.translation: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan; and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, unto battle at Edrei.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אַל־תִּירָ֣א אֹת֔וֹ כִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־אַרְצ֑וֹ וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ לְסִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'ltyr' 'tv khy bydkh ntty 'tv v'tkhl'mv v't'rtsv v'shyt lv kh'shr 'shyt lsychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Fear him not; for I have delivered him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ בְּיָדֵ֗נוּ גַּ֛ם אֶת־ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּ֑וֹ וַנַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַד־בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'lhynv bydnv gm 't'vg mlkhhbshn v'tkhl'mv vnkhhv 'dblty hsh'yrlv shryd
verses.translation: So the LORD our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people; and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־כׇּל־עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־לָקַ֖חְנוּ מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִיר֙ כׇּל־חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vnlkhd 'tkhl'ryv b't hhv' l' hyth qryh 'shr l'lqchnv m'tm shshym 'yr khlchbl 'rgb mmlkht 'vg bbshn
verses.translation: And we took all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we took not from them; threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֜לֶּה עָרִ֧ים בְּצֻרֹ֛ת חוֹמָ֥ה גְבֹהָ֖ה דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִ֑יחַ לְבַ֛ד מֵעָרֵ֥י הַפְּרָזִ֖י הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: khl'lh 'rym btsrt chvmh gbhh dltym vbrych lbd m'ry hprzy hrbh m'd
verses.translation: All these were fortified cities, with high walls, gates, and bars; beside the unwalled towns a great many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ינוּ לְסִיחֹ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן הַחֲרֵם֙ כׇּל־עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃
verses.translit: vnchrm 'vtm kh'shr 'shynv lsychn mlkh chshbvn hchrm khl'yr mtm hnshym vhtf
verses.translation: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every city, the men, and the women, and the little ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים בַּזּ֥וֹנוּ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhlhbhmh vshll h'rym bzvnv lnv
verses.translation: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey unto ourselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּקַּ֞ח בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִוא֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ מִיַּ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִנַּ֥חַל אַרְנֹ֖ן עַד־הַ֥ר חֶרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vnqch b't hhv' 'th'rts myd shny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn mnchl 'rnn 'dhr chrmvn
verses.translation: And we took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites that were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of Arnon unto mount Hermon—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִידֹנִ֛ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לְחֶרְמ֖וֹן שִׂרְיֹ֑ן וְהָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י יִקְרְאוּ־ל֖וֹ שְׂנִֽיר׃
verses.translit: tsydnym yqr'v lchrmvn shryn vh'mry yqr'vlv shnyr
verses.translation: which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל  עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֗ר וְכׇל־הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־סַלְכָ֖ה וְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: khl  'ry hmyshr vkhlhgl'd vkhlhbshn 'dslkhh v'dr'y 'ry mmlkht 'vg bbshn
verses.translation: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salcah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַק־ע֞וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן נִשְׁאַר֮ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִים֒ הִנֵּ֤ה עַרְשׂוֹ֙ עֶ֣רֶשׂ בַּרְזֶ֔ל הֲלֹ֣ה הִ֔וא בְּרַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן תֵּ֧שַׁע אַמּ֣וֹת אׇרְכָּ֗הּ וְאַרְבַּ֥ע אַמּ֛וֹת רׇחְבָּ֖הּ בְּאַמַּת־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: khy rq'vg mlkh hbshn nsh'r mytr hrp'ym hnh 'rshv 'rsh brzl hlh hv' brbt bny 'mvn tsh' 'mvt 'rkhh v'rb' 'mvt rchbh b'mt'ysh
verses.translation: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את יָרַ֖שְׁנוּ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑וא מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֗ן וַחֲצִ֤י הַֽר־הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעָרָ֔יו נָתַ֕תִּי לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th'rts hz't yrshnv b't hhv' m'r'r 'shr'lnchl 'rnn vchtsy hrhgl'd v'ryv ntty lr'vbny vlgdy
verses.translation: And this land we took in possession at that time; from Aroer, which is by the valley of Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר הַגִּלְעָ֤ד וְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁן֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת ע֔וֹג נָתַ֕תִּי לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כֹּ֣ל חֶ֤בֶל הָֽאַרְגֹּב֙ לְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁ֔ן הַה֥וּא יִקָּרֵ֖א אֶ֥רֶץ רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytr hgl'd vkhlhbshn mmlkht 'vg ntty lchtsy shbt hmnshh khl chbl h'rgb lkhlhbshn hhv' yqr' 'rts rp'ym
verses.translation: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob—all that Bashan is called the land of Rephaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָאִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לָקַח֙ אֶת־כׇּל־חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב עַד־גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּֽעֲכָתִ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֹתָ֨ם עַל־שְׁמ֤וֹ אֶת־הַבָּשָׁן֙ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֔יר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: y'yr bnmnshh lqch 'tkhlchbl 'rgb 'dgbvl hgshvry vhm'khty vyqr' 'tm 'lshmv 'thbshn chvt y'yr 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth-jair, unto this day.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמָכִ֖יר נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vlmkhyr ntty 'thgl'd
verses.translation: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָראוּבֵנִ֨י וְלַגָּדִ֜י נָתַ֤תִּי מִן־הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַד־נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן תּ֥וֹךְ הַנַּ֖חַל וּגְבֻ֑ל וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vlr'vbny vlgdy ntty mnhgl'd v'dnchl 'rnn tvkh hnchl vgbl v'd ybq hnchl gbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the valley of Arnon, the middle of the valley for a border; even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן וּגְבֻ֑ל מִכִּנֶּ֗רֶת וְעַ֨ד יָ֤ם הָֽעֲרָבָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח תַּ֛חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
verses.translit: vh'rbh vhyrdn vgbl mkhnrt v'd ym h'rbh ym hmlch tcht 'shdt hpsgh mzrchh
verses.translation: the Arabah also, the Jordan being the border thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲצַ֣ו אֶתְכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ חֲלוּצִ֣ים תַּֽעַבְר֗וּ לִפְנֵ֛י אֲחֵיכֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כׇּל־בְּנֵי־חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: v'tsv 'tkhm b't hhv' l'mr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lkhm 'th'rts hz't lrshth chlvtsym t'brv lpny 'chykhm bnyyshr'l khlbnychyl
verses.translation: And I commanded you at that time, saying: ‘The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it; ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all the men of valour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֠ק נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם וְטַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵכֶם֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־מִקְנֶ֥ה רַ֖ב לָכֶ֑ם יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: rq nshykhm vtpkhm vmqnkhm yd'ty khymqnh rb lkhm yshbv b'rykhm 'shr ntty lkhm
verses.translation: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle—I know that ye have much cattle—shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־יָנִ֨יחַ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ לַֽאֲחֵיכֶם֮ כָּכֶם֒ וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־הֵ֔ם אֶת־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ לִֽירֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'd 'shrynych yhvh  l'chykhm khkhm vyrshv gmhm 'th'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lhm b'br hyrdn vshbtm 'ysh lyrshtv 'shr ntty lkhm
verses.translation: until the LORD give rest unto your brethren, as unto you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God giveth them beyond the Jordan; then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־יְהוֹשׁ֣וּעַ צִוֵּ֔יתִי בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר עֵינֶ֣יךָ הָרֹאֹ֗ת אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ לִשְׁנֵי֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כֵּֽן־יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לְכׇל־הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ר שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: v'tyhvshv' tsvyty b't hhv' l'mr 'ynykh hr't 't khl'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhykhm lshny hmlkhym h'lh khny'shh yhvh lkhlhmmlkhvt 'shr 'th 'br shmh
verses.translation: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying: ‘Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings; so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou goest over.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּֽירָא֑וּם כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַנִּלְחָ֥ם לָכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l' tyr'vm khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' hnlchm lkhm {s}
verses.translation: Ye shall not fear them; for the LORD your God, He it is that fighteth for you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְחַנַּ֖ן אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'tchnn 'lyhvh b't hhv' l'mr
verses.translation: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אַתָּ֤ה הַֽחִלּ֙וֹתָ֙ לְהַרְא֣וֹת אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶ֨ת־גׇּדְלְךָ֔ וְאֶת־יָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִי־אֵל֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כְמַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'dny yhvh 'th hchlvt lhr'vt 't'bdkh 'tgdlkh v'tydkh hchzqh 'shr my'l bshmym vb'rts 'shry'shh khm'shykh vkhgbvrtkh
verses.translation: ’O Lord GOD, Thou hast begun to show Thy servant Thy greatness, and Thy strong hand; for what god is there in heaven or on earth, that can do according to Thy works, and according to Thy mighty acts?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּ֗א וְאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הָהָ֥ר הַטּ֛וֹב הַזֶּ֖ה וְהַלְּבָנֹֽן׃
verses.translit: ''brhn' v'r'h 'th'rts htvbh 'shr b'br hyrdn hhr htvb hzh vhlbnn
verses.translation: Let me go over, I pray Thee, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly hill-country, and Lebanon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְעַבֵּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה בִּי֙ לְמַ֣עַנְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ רַב־לָ֔ךְ אַל־תּ֗וֹסֶף דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyt'br yhvh by lm'nkhm vl' shm' 'ly vy'mr yhvh 'ly rblkh 'ltvsf dbr 'ly 'vd bdbr hzh
verses.translation: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and hearkened not unto me; and the LORD said unto me: ‘Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto Me of this matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲלֵ֣ה  רֹ֣אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֗ה וְשָׂ֥א עֵינֶ֛יךָ יָ֧מָּה וְצָפֹ֛נָה וְתֵימָ֥נָה וּמִזְרָ֖חָה וּרְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶ֑יךָ כִּי־לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh  r'sh hpsgh vsh' 'ynykh ymh vtspnh vtymnh vmzrchh vr'h b'ynykh khyl' t'br 'thyrdn hzh
verses.translation: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thine eyes; for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצַ֥ו אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְחַזְּקֵ֣הוּ וְאַמְּצֵ֑הוּ כִּי־ה֣וּא יַעֲבֹ֗ר לִפְנֵי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהוּא֙ יַנְחִ֣יל אוֹתָ֔ם אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vtsv 'tyhvsh' vchzqhv v'mtshv khyhv' y'br lpny h'm hzh vhv' ynchyl 'vtm 'th'rts 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנֵּ֣שֶׁב בַּגָּ֔יְא מ֖וּל בֵּ֥ית פְּעֽוֹר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnshb bgy' mvl byt p'vr {p}
verses.translation: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶל־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th yshr'l shm' 'lhchqym v'lhmshptym 'shr 'nkhy mlmd 'tkhm l'shvt lm'n tchyv vb'tm vyrshtm 'th'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhy 'btykhm ntn lkhm
verses.translation: And now, O Israel, hearken unto the statutes and unto the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, giveth you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל־הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l' tspv 'lhdbr 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm vl' tgr'v mmnv lshmr 'tmtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹא֔וֹת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר כִּ֣י כׇל־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל־פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'ynykhm hr'vt 't 'shr'shh yhvh bb'l p'vr khy khlh'ysh 'shr hlkh 'chry b'lp'vr hshmydv yhvh 'lhykh mqrbkh
verses.translation: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did in Baal-peor; for all the men that followed the Baal of Peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from the midst of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ הַדְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: v'tm hdbqym byhvh 'lhykhm chyym khlkhm hyvm
verses.translation: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה  לִמַּ֣דְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֗ם חֻקִּים֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: r'h  lmdty 'tkhm chqym vmshptym kh'shr tsvny yhvh 'lhy l'shvt khn bqrb h'rts 'shr 'tm b'ym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the midst of the land whither ye go in to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֒ כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חׇכְמַתְכֶם֙ וּבִ֣ינַתְכֶ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם־חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן הַגּ֥וֹי הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm v'shytm khy hv' chkhmtkhm vbyntkhm l'yny h'mym 'shr yshm'vn 't khlhchqym h'lh v'mrv rq 'mchkhm vnbvn hgvy hgdvl hzh
verses.translation: Observe therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples, that, when they hear all these statutes, shall say: ‘Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י מִי־ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑יו כַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכׇל־קׇרְאֵ֖נוּ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khy mygvy gdvl 'shrlv 'lhym qrbym 'lyv khyhvh 'lhynv bkhlqr'nv 'lyv
verses.translation: For what great nation is there, that hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is whensoever we call upon Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִי֙ גּ֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים צַדִּיקִ֑ם כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vmy gvy gdvl 'shrlv chqym vmshptym tsdyqm khkhl htvrh hz't 'shr 'nkhy ntn lpnykhm hyvm
verses.translation: And what great nation is there, that hath statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֡ק הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֩ וּשְׁמֹ֨ר נַפְשְׁךָ֜ מְאֹ֗ד פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֨ח אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּפֶן־יָס֙וּרוּ֙ מִלְּבָ֣בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֥ם לְבָנֶ֖יךָ וְלִבְנֵ֥י בָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: rq hshmr lkh vshmr npshkh m'd pntshkhch 'thdbrym 'shrr'v 'ynykh vpnysvrv mlbbkh khl ymy chyykh vhvd'tm lbnykh vlbny bnykh
verses.translation: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes saw, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life; but make them known unto thy children and thy children’s children;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָמַ֜דְתָּ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֘יךָ֮ בְּחֹרֵב֒ בֶּאֱמֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַקְהֶל־לִי֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וְאַשְׁמִעֵ֖ם אֶת־דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִלְמְד֜וּן לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֹתִ֗י כׇּל־הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם יְלַמֵּדֽוּן׃
verses.translit: yvm 'shr 'mdt lpny yhvh 'lhykh bchrb b'mr yhvh 'ly hqhlly 'th'm v'shm'm 'tdbry 'shr ylmdvn lyr'h 'ty khlhymym 'shr hm chyym 'lh'dmh v'tbnyhm ylmdvn
verses.translation: the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me: ‘Assemble Me the people, and I will make them hear My words that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרְב֥וּן וַתַּֽעַמְד֖וּן תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וְהָהָ֞ר בֹּעֵ֤ר בָּאֵשׁ֙ עַד־לֵ֣ב הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עָנָ֥ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vtqrbvn vt'mdvn tcht hhr vhhr b'r b'sh 'dlb hshmym chshkh 'nn v'rpl
verses.translation: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the heart of heaven, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ ק֤וֹל דְּבָרִים֙ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֔ים וּתְמוּנָ֛ה אֵינְכֶ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים זוּלָתִ֥י קֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lykhm mtvkh h'sh qvl dbrym 'tm shm'ym vtmvnh 'ynkhm r'ym zvlty qvl
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto you out of the midst of the fire; ye heard the voice of words, but ye saw no form; only a voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־בְּרִית֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֑ים וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֔ם עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י לֻח֥וֹת אֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vygd lkhm 'tbrytv 'shr tsvh 'tkhm l'shvt 'shrt hdbrym vykhtbm 'lshny lchvt 'bnym
verses.translation: And He declared unto you His covenant, which He commanded you to perform, even the ten words; and He wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֹתִ֞י צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֑ים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'ty tsvh yhvh b't hhv' llmd 'tkhm chqym vmshptym l'shtkhm 'tm b'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כׇּל־תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם בְּחֹרֵ֖ב מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vnshmrtm m'd lnpshtykhm khy l' r'ytm khltmvnh byvm dbr yhvh 'lykhm bchrb mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves—for ye saw no manner of form on the day that the LORD spoke unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּ֨ן־תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם פֶּ֖סֶל תְּמוּנַ֣ת כׇּל־סָ֑מֶל תַּבְנִ֥ית זָכָ֖ר א֥וֹ נְקֵבָֽה׃
verses.translit: pntshchtvn v'shytm lkhm psl tmvnt khlsml tbnyt zkhr 'v nqbh
verses.translation: lest ye deal corruptly, and make you a graven image, even the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּבְנִ֕ית כׇּל־בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ תַּבְנִית֙ כׇּל־צִפּ֣וֹר כָּנָ֔ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּף בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: tbnyt khlbhmh 'shr b'rts tbnyt khltspvr khnf 'shr t'vf bshmym
verses.translation: the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the heaven,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּבְנִ֕ית כׇּל־רֹמֵ֖שׂ בָּאֲדָמָ֑ה תַּבְנִ֛ית כׇּל־דָּגָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־בַּמַּ֖יִם מִתַּ֥חַת לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: tbnyt khlrmsh b'dmh tbnyt khldgh 'shrbmym mtcht l'rts
verses.translation: the likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפֶן־תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וְֽ֠רָאִ֠יתָ אֶת־הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת־הַיָּרֵ֜חַ וְאֶת־הַכּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ֛ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם וַעֲבַדְתָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vpntsh' 'ynykh hshmymh vr'yt 'thshmsh v'thyrch v'thkhvkhbym khl tsb' hshmym vndcht vhshtchvyt lhm v'bdtm 'shr chlq yhvh 'lhykh 'tm lkhl h'mym tcht khlhshmym
verses.translation: and lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the host of heaven, thou be drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath allotted unto all the peoples under the whole heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִכּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם לִהְי֥וֹת ל֛וֹ לְעַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tkhm lqch yhvh vyvts' 'tkhm mkhvr hbrzl mmtsrym lhyvt lv l'm nchlh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: But you hath the LORD taken and brought forth out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be unto Him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֥ה הִתְאַנַּף־בִּ֖י עַל־דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֤י עׇבְרִי֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וּלְבִלְתִּי־בֹא֙ אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhvh ht'nfby 'ldbrykhm vyshb' lblty 'bry 'thyrdn vlbltyb' 'lh'rts htvbh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh nchlh
verses.translation: Now the LORD was angered with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י מֵת֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֵינֶ֥נִּי עֹבֵ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֕ם אֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy mt b'rts hz't 'ynny 'br 'thyrdn v'tm 'brym vyrshtm 'th'rts htvbh hz't
verses.translation: but I must die in this land, I must not go over the Jordan; but ye are to go over, and possess that good land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם פֶּֽן־תִּשְׁכְּחוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֤ית יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִמָּכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם לָכֶ֥ם פֶּ֙סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hshmrv lkhm pntshkhchv 'tbryt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr khrt 'mkhm v'shytm lkhm psl tmvnt khl 'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which He made with you, and make you a graven image, even the likeness of any thing which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא אֵ֖ל קַנָּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh 'sh 'khlh hv' 'l qn' {p}
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תוֹלִ֤יד בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּ֗ם וַעֲשִׂ֤יתֶם פֶּ֙סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָה־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khytvlyd bnym vbny bnym vnvshntm b'rts vhshchtm v'shytm psl tmvnt khl v'shytm hr' b'yny yhvh'lhykh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have been long in the land, and shall deal corruptly, and make a graven image, even the form of any thing, and shall do that which is evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke Him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעִידֹ֩תִי֩ בָכֶ֨ם הַיּ֜וֹם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ כִּֽי־אָבֹ֣ד תֹּאבֵדוּן֮ מַהֵר֒ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ לֹֽא־תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י הִשָּׁמֵ֖ד תִּשָּׁמֵדֽוּן׃
verses.translit: h'ydty bkhm hyvm 'thshmym v'th'rts khy'bd t'bdvn mhr m'l h'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn shmh lrshth l't'rykhn ymym 'lyh khy hshmd tshmdvn
verses.translation: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over the Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵפִ֧יץ יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vhpyts yhvh 'tkhm b'mym vnsh'rtm mty mspr bgvym 'shr ynhg yhvh 'tkhm shmh
verses.translation: And the LORD shall scatter you among the peoples, and ye shall be left few in number among the nations, whither the LORD shall lead you away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־שָׁ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִרְאוּן֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יֹֽאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֥א יְרִיחֻֽן׃
verses.translit: v'bdtmshm 'lhym m'shh ydy 'dm 'ts v'bn 'shr l'yr'vn vl' yshm'vn vl' y'khlvn vl' yrychn
verses.translation: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּמָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔נּוּ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: vbqshtm mshm 'tyhvh 'lhykh vmts't khy tdrshnv bkhllbbkh vbkhlnpshkh
verses.translation: But from thence ye will seek the LORD thy God; and thou shalt find Him, if thou search after Him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּצַּ֣ר לְךָ֔ וּמְצָא֕וּךָ כֹּ֖ל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְשַׁבְתָּ֙ עַד־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: btsr lkh vmts'vkh khl hdbrym h'lh b'chryt hymym vshbt 'dyhvh 'lhykh vshm't bqlv
verses.translation: In thy distress, when all these things are come upon thee, in the end of days, thou wilt return to the LORD thy God, and hearken unto His voice;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל רַחוּם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַשְׁחִיתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֣ית אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'l rchvm yhvh 'lhykh l' yrpkh vl' yshchytkh vl' yshkhch 'tbryt 'btykh 'shr nshb' lhm
verses.translation: for the LORD thy God is a merciful God; He will not fail thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which He swore unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שְׁאַל־נָא֩ לְיָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְמִן־הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אָדָם֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵ֥ה הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הֲנִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲנִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: khy sh'ln' lymym r'shnym 'shrhyv lpnykh lmnhyvm 'shr br' 'lhym  'dm 'lh'rts vlmqtsh hshmym v'dqtsh hshmym hnhyh khdbr hgdvl hzh 'v hnshm' khmhv
verses.translation: For ask now of the days past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one end of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲשָׁ֣מַֽע עָם֩ ק֨וֹל אֱלֹהִ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַיֶּֽחִי׃
verses.translit: hshm' 'm qvl 'lhym mdbr mtvkhh'sh kh'shrshm't 'th vychy
verses.translation: Did ever a people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ  הֲנִסָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ֠ב֠וֹא לָקַ֨חַת ל֣וֹ גוֹי֮ מִקֶּ֣רֶב גּוֹי֒ בְּמַסֹּת֩ בְּאֹתֹ֨ת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֜ים וּבְמִלְחָמָ֗ה וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָאִ֖ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'v  hnsh 'lhym lbv' lqcht lv gvy mqrb gvy bmst b'tt vbmvptym vbmlchmh vbyd chzqh vbzrv' ntvyh vbmvr'ym gdlym khkhl 'shr'shh lkhm yhvh 'lhykhm bmtsrym l'ynykh
verses.translation: Or hath God assayed to go and take Him a nation from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before thine eyes?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּה֙ הׇרְאֵ֣תָ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד מִלְּבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'th hr't ld't khy yhvh hv' h'lhym 'yn 'vd mlbdv
verses.translation: Unto thee it was shown, that thou mightiest know that the LORD, He is God; there is none else beside Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם הִשְׁמִֽיעֲךָ֥ אֶת־קֹל֖וֹ לְיַסְּרֶ֑ךָּ וְעַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ֙ אֶת־אִשּׁ֣וֹ הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּדְבָרָ֥יו שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: mnhshmym hshmy'kh 'tqlv lysrkh v'lh'rts hr'kh 't'shv hgdvlh vdbryv shm't mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: Out of heaven He made thee to hear His voice, that He might instruct thee; and upon earth He made thee to see His great fire; and thou didst hear His words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתַ֗חַת כִּ֤י אָהַב֙ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַיִּבְחַ֥ר בְּזַרְע֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וַיּוֹצִֽאֲךָ֧ בְּפָנָ֛יו בְּכֹח֥וֹ הַגָּדֹ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vtcht khy 'hb 't'btykh vybchr bzr'v 'chryv vyvts'kh bpnyv bkhchv hgdl mmtsrym
verses.translation: And because He loved thy fathers, and chose their seed after them, and brought thee out with His presence, with His great power, out of Egypt,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהוֹרִ֗ישׁ גּוֹיִ֛ם גְּדֹלִ֧ים וַעֲצֻמִ֛ים מִמְּךָ֖ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ לַהֲבִֽיאֲךָ֗ לָֽתֶת־לְךָ֧ אֶת־אַרְצָ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: lhvrysh gvym gdlym v'tsmym mmkh mpnykh lhby'kh lttlkh 't'rtsm nchlh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֮ אֶל־לְבָבֶ֒ךָ֒ כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vyd't hyvm vhshbt 'llbbkh khy yhvh hv' h'lhym bshmym mm'l v'lh'rts mtcht 'yn 'vd
verses.translation: know this day, and lay it to thy heart, that the LORD, He is God in heaven above and upon the earth beneath; there is none else.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת־חֻקָּ֣יו וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יךְ יָמִים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ {פ}
