verses.translit: vshmrt 'tchqyv v'tmtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm 'shr yytb lkh vlbnykh 'chrykh vlm'n t'rykh ymym 'lh'dmh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh khlhymym {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt keep His statutes, and His commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַבְדִּ֤יל מֹשֶׁה֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרְחָ֖ה שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'z ybdyl mshh shlsh 'rym b'br hyrdn mzrchh shmsh
verses.translation: Then Moses separated three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָנֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת־רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם וְנָ֗ס אֶל־אַחַ֛ת מִן־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖ל וָחָֽי׃
verses.translit: lns shmh rvtsch 'shr yrtsch 'tr'hv bblyd't vhv' l'shn' lv mtml shlshm vns 'l'cht mnh'rym h'l vchy
verses.translation: that the manslayer might flee thither, that slayeth his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in time past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וְאֶת־רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ לַגָּדִ֔י וְאֶת־גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן לַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי׃
verses.translit: 'tbtsr bmdbr b'rts hmyshr lr'vbny v'tr'mt bgl'd lgdy v'tgvln bbshn lmnshy
verses.translation: Bezer in the wilderness, in the table-land, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vz't htvrh 'shrshm mshh lpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה הָֽעֵדֹ֔ת וְהַֽחֻקִּ֖ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'lh h'dt vhchqym vhmshptym 'shr dbr mshh 'lbny yshr'l bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spoke unto the children of Israel, when they came forth out of Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן בַּגַּ֗יְא מ֚וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֔וֹר בְּאֶ֗רֶץ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: b'br hyrdn bgy' mvl byt p'vr b'rts sychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn 'shr hkhh mshh vbny yshr'l bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, when they came forth out of Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־אַרְצ֜וֹ וְאֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ  ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֗ן שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרַ֖ח שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyyrshv 't'rtsv v't'rts  'vg mlkhhbshn shny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn mzrch shmsh
verses.translation: and they took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֧חַל אַרְנֹ֛ן וְעַד־הַ֥ר שִׂיאֹ֖ן ה֥וּא חֶרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: m'r'r 'shr 'lshptnchl 'rnn v'dhr shy'n hv' chrmvn
verses.translation: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of Arnon, even unto mount Sion—the same is Hermon—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הָ֨עֲרָבָ֜ה עֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה וְעַ֖ד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֑ה תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlh'rbh 'br hyrdn mzrchh v'd ym h'rbh tcht 'shdt hpsgh {p}
verses.translation: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאׇזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'lkhlyshr'l vy'mr 'lhm shm' yshr'l 'thchqym v'thmshptym 'shr 'nkhy dbr b'znykhm hyvm vlmdtm 'tm vshmrtm l'shtm
verses.translation: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and observe to do them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּ֛נוּ בְּרִ֖ית בְּחֹרֵֽב׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv khrt 'mnv bryt bchrb
verses.translation: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א אֶת־אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֔נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: l' 't'btynv khrt yhvh 'thbryt hz't khy 'tnv 'nchnv 'lh ph hyvm khlnv chyym
verses.translation: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּנִ֣ים  בְּפָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה עִמָּכֶ֛ם בָּהָ֖ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: pnym  bpnym dbr yhvh 'mkhm bhr mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: The LORD spoke with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֠נֹכִ֠י עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין־יְהֹוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'md bynyhvh vbynykhm b't hhv' lhgyd lkhm 'tdbr yhvh khy yr'tm mpny h'sh vl''lytm bhr l'mr {s}
verses.translation: I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to declare unto you the word of the LORD; for ye were afraid because of the fire, and went not up into the mount—saying: .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִ֖י֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣֥ית עֲבָדִ֑͏ֽים׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh 'shr hvts'tykh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bd͏ym
verses.translation: I am the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א־יִהְיֶ֥͏ֽה־לְךָ֛֩ אֱלֹהִ֥֨ים אֲחֵרִ֖֜ים עַל־פָּנָֽ͏ַ֗י׃
verses.translit: l'yhy͏hlkh 'lhym 'chrym 'lpn͏y
verses.translation: Thou shalt have no other gods before Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽ֣א־תַעֲשֶֽׂ֨ה־לְךָ֥֣ פֶ֣֙סֶל֙ ׀ כׇּל־תְּמוּנָ֔֡ה אֲשֶׁ֤֣ר בַּשָּׁמַ֣֙יִם֙ ׀ מִמַּ֔֡עַל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר֩ בָּאָ֖֨רֶץ מִתָּ֑͏ַ֜חַת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּמַּ֖֣יִם  מִתַּ֥֣חַת לָאָֽ֗רֶץ׃
verses.translit: l't'shhlkh psl  khltmvnh 'shr bshmym  mm'l v'shr b'rts mt͏cht v'shr bmym  mtcht l'rts
verses.translation: Thou shalt not make unto thee a graven image, even any manner of likeness, of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥֣ה לָהֶ֖ם֮ וְלֹ֣א תׇעׇבְדֵ֑ם֒ כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵ֠ד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל־בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃
verses.translit: l'tshtchvh lhm vl' t'bdm khy 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh 'l qn' pqd 'vn 'bvt 'lbnym v'lshlshym v'lrb'ym lshn'y
verses.translation: Thou shalt not bow down unto them, nor serve them; for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the third and upon the fourth generation of them that hate Me,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹ֥֤שֶׂה חֶ֖֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֑֔ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י (מצותו) [מִצְוֺתָֽי]׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shh chsd l'lpym l'hby vlshmry (mtsvtv) [mtsvty] {s}
verses.translation: and showing mercy unto the thousandth generation of them that love Me and keep My commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־שֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l' tsh' 'tshmyhvh 'lhykh lshv' khy l' ynqh yhvh 't 'shrysh' 'tshmv lshv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh His name in vain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמ֛֣וֹר אֶת־י֥וֹם֩ הַשַּׁבָּ֖֨ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑֜וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖֣  יְהֹוָ֥֣ה אֱלֹהֶֽ֗יךָ׃
verses.translit: shmvr 'tyvm hshbt lqdshv kh'shr tsvkh  yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Observe the sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD thy God commanded thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translit: shsht ymym t'bd v'shyt khlml'khtkh
verses.translation: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְי֨וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔֜י שַׁבָּ֖֣ת  לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֗יךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כׇל־מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ־וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ־וַ֠אֲמָתֶ֠ךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכׇל־בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ כָּמֽ֑וֹךָ׃
verses.translit: vyvm hshby'y shbt  lyhvh 'lhykh l' t'shh khlml'khh 'th vbnkhvbtkh v'bdkhv'mtkh vshvrkh vchmrkh vkhlbhmtkh vgrkh 'shr bsh'rykh lm'n ynvch 'bdkh v'mtkh khmvkh
verses.translation: but the seventh day is a sabbath unto the LORD thy God, in it thou shalt not do any manner of work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy man-servant, nor thy maid-servant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy man-servant and thy maid-servant may rest as well as thou.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗֞ כִּ֣י־עֶ֤֥בֶד הָיִ֣֙יתָ֙  בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔֗יִם וַיֹּצִ֨אֲךָ֜֩ יְהֹוָ֤֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֤֙יךָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם֙ בְּיָ֥֤ד חֲזָקָ֖ה֙ וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑֔ה עַל־כֵּ֗ן צִוְּךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vzkhrt khy'bd hyyt  b'rts mtsrym vyts'kh yhvh 'lhykh mshm byd chzqh vbzr' ntvyh 'lkhn tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh l'shvt 'tyvm hshbt {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt remember that thou was a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God brought thee out thence by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm; therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן  יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khbd 't'bykh v't'mkh kh'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh lm'n  y'rykhn ymykh vlm'n yytb lkh 'l h'dmh 'shryhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh {s}
verses.translation: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God commanded thee; that thy days may be long, and that it may go well with thee, upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translit: l' trts͏ch {s} vl' tn'͏f {s} vl' tgnb {s} vl't'nh br'kh 'd shv' {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not murder. Neither shalt thou commit adultery. Neither shalt thou steal. Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑ךָ {ס} וְלֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗ךָ שָׂדֵ֜הוּ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl' tchmd 'sht r'kh {s} vl' tt'vh byt r'kh shdhv v'bdv v'mtv shvrv vchmrv vkhl 'shr lr'kh {s}
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s wife; neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his man-servant, or his maid-servant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶל־כׇּל־קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל־שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'thdbrym h'lh dbr yhvh 'lkhlqhlkhm bhr mtvkh h'sh h'nn vh'rpl qvl gdvl vl' ysf vykhtbm 'lshny lcht 'bnym vytnm 'ly
verses.translation: These words the LORD spoke unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice, and it went on no more. And He wrote them upon two tables of stone, and gave them unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשׇׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת־הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַ֔י כׇּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְזִקְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'khm 'thqvl mtvkh hchshkh vhhr b'r b'sh vtqrbvn 'ly khlr'shy shbtykhm vzqnykhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain did burn with fire, that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־כְּבֹד֣וֹ וְאֶת־גׇּדְל֔וֹ וְאֶת־קֹל֥וֹ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mrv hn hr'nv yhvh 'lhynv 'tkhbdv v'tgdlv v'tqlv shm'nv mtvkh h'sh hyvm hzh r'ynv khyydbr 'lhym 'th'dm vchy
verses.translation: and ye said: ‘Behold, the LORD our God hath shown us His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire; we have seen this day that God doth speak with man, and he liveth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ לָ֣מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔נוּ הָאֵ֥שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אִם־יֹסְפִ֣ים  אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠שְׁמֹ֠עַ אֶת־ק֨וֹל יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ ע֖וֹד וָמָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th lmh nmvt khy t'khlnv h'sh hgdlh hz't 'myspym  'nchnv lshm' 'tqvl yhvh 'lhynv 'vd vmtnv
verses.translation: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כׇל־בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖נוּ וַיֶּֽחִי׃
verses.translit: khy my khlbshr 'shr shm' qvl 'lhym chyym mdbr mtvkhh'sh khmnv vychy
verses.translation: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽשְׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַ֣תְּ  תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְשָׁמַ֥עְנוּ וְעָשִֽׂינוּ׃
verses.translit: qrb 'th vshm' 't khl'shr y'mr yhvh 'lhynv v't  tdbr 'lynv 't khl'shr ydbr yhvh 'lhynv 'lykh vshm'nv v'shynv
verses.translation: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God may say; and thou shalt speak unto us all that the LORD our God may speak unto thee; and we will hear it and do it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י שָׁ֠מַ֠עְתִּי אֶת־ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh 'tqvl dbrykhm bdbrkhm 'ly vy'mr yhvh 'ly shm'ty 'tqvl dbry h'm hzh 'shr dbrv 'lykh hytybv khl'shr dbrv
verses.translation: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spoke unto me; and the LORD said unto me: ‘I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee; they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֡ן וְהָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨ם זֶ֜ה לָהֶ֗ם לְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתַ֖י כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֑ים לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָהֶ֛ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: myytn vhyh lbbm zh lhm lyr'h 'ty vlshmr 'tkhlmtsvty khlhymym lm'n yytb lhm vlbnyhm l'lm
verses.translation: Oh that they had such a heart as this alway, to fear Me, and keep all My commandments, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֖ךְ אֱמֹ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם שׁ֥וּבוּ לָכֶ֖ם לְאׇהֳלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lkh 'mr lhm shvbv lkhm l'hlykhm
verses.translation: Go say to them: Return ye to your tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִי֒ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'th ph 'md 'mdy v'dbrh 'lykh 't khlhmtsvh vhchqym vhmshptym 'shr tlmdm v'shv b'rts 'shr 'nkhy ntn lhm lrshth
verses.translation: But as for thee, stand thou here by Me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm l'shvt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tkhm l' tsrv ymyn vshm'l
verses.translation: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you; ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם אֶתְכֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּן֙ וְט֣וֹב לָכֶ֔ם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּן׃
verses.translit: bkhlhdrkh 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tkhm tlkhv lm'n tchyvn vtvb lkhm vh'rkhtm ymym b'rts 'shr tyrshvn
verses.translation: Ye shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֣את הַמִּצְוָ֗ה הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vz't hmtsvh hchqym vhmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykhm llmd 'tkhm l'shvt b'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן תִּירָ֜א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִ֠שְׁמֹ֠ר אֶת־כׇּל־חֻקֹּתָ֣יו וּמִצְוֺתָיו֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוֶּ֒ךָ֒ אַתָּה֙ וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבֶן־בִּנְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֖עַן יַאֲרִכֻ֥ן יָמֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: lm'n tyr' 'tyhvh 'lhykh lshmr 'tkhlchqtyv vmtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh 'th vbnkh vbnbnkh khl ymy chyykh vlm'n y'rkhn ymykh
verses.translation: that thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְבּ֖וּן מְאֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshm't yshr'l vshmrt l'shvt 'shr yytb lkh v'shr trbvn m'd kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh {p}
verses.translation: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of thy fathers, hath promised unto thee—a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: shm' yshr'l yhvh 'lhynv yhvh  'chd
verses.translation: HEAR, O ISRAEL: THE LORD OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'hbt 't yhvh 'lhykh bkhllbbkh vbkhlnpshkh vbkhlm'dkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל־לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vhyv hdbrym h'lh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm 'llbbkh
verses.translation: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be upon thy heart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vshnntm lbnykh vdbrt bm bshbtkh bbytkh vblkhtkh bdrkh vbshkhbkh vbqvmkh
verses.translation: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vqshrtm l'vt 'lydkh vhyv lttpt byn 'ynykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand, and they shall be for frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזֻז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhtbtm 'lmzzvt bytkh vbsh'rykh {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּ֥י יְבִיאֲךָ֣  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָ֣תֶת לָ֑ךְ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וְטֹבֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־בָנִֽיתָ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khy yby'kh  yhvh 'lhykh 'lh'rts 'shr nshb' l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb ltt lkh 'rym gdlt vtbt 'shr l'bnyt
verses.translation: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land which He swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee—great and goodly cities, which thou didst not build,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֨תִּ֜ים מְלֵאִ֣ים כׇּל־טוּב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־מִלֵּ֒אתָ֒ וּבֹרֹ֤ת חֲצוּבִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־חָצַ֔בְתָּ כְּרָמִ֥ים וְזֵיתִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־נָטָ֑עְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vbtym ml'ym khltvb 'shr l'ml't vbrt chtsvbym 'shr l'chtsbt khrmym vzytym 'shr l'nt't v'khlt vshb't
verses.translation: and houses full of all good things, which thou didst not fill, and cisterns hewn out, which thou the didst not hew, vineyards and olive-trees, which thou didst not plant, and thou shalt eat and be satisfied—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pntshkhch 'tyhvh 'shr hvtsy'kh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: then beware lest thou forget the LORD, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א וְאֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: 'tyhvh 'lhykh tyr' v'tv t'bd vbshmv tshb'
verses.translation: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; and Him shalt thou serve, and by His name shalt thou swear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֵֽלְכ֔וּן אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים מֵאֱלֹהֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l' tlkhvn 'chry 'lhym 'chrym m'lhy h'mym 'shr sbybvtykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples that are round about you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֛א יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ פֶּן־יֶ֠חֱרֶ֠ה אַף־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְהִשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'l qn' yhvh 'lhykh bqrbkh pnychrh 'fyhvh 'lhykh bkh vhshmydkh m'l pny h'dmh {s}
verses.translation: for a jealous God, even the LORD thy God, is in the midst of thee; lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and He destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תְנַסּ֔וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִסִּיתֶ֖ם בַּמַּסָּֽה׃
verses.translit: l' tnsv 'tyhvh 'lhykhm kh'shr nsytm bmsh
verses.translation: Ye shall not try the LORD your God, as ye tried Him in Massah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמ֣וֹר תִּשְׁמְר֔וּן אֶת־מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְעֵדֹתָ֥יו וְחֻקָּ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: shmvr tshmrvn 'tmtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm v'dtyv vchqyv 'shr tsvkh
verses.translation: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and His testimonies, and His statutes, which He hath commanded thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר וְהַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ וּבָ֗אתָ וְיָֽרַשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt hyshr vhtvb b'yny yhvh lm'n yytb lkh vb't vyrsht 'th'rts htbh 'shrnshb' yhvh l'btykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore unto thy fathers,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַהֲדֹ֥ף אֶת־כׇּל־אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lhdf 'tkhl'ybykh mpnykh kh'shr dbr yhvh {s}
verses.translation: to thrust out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ בִנְךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר מָ֣ה הָעֵדֹ֗ת וְהַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khyysh'lkh bnkh mchr l'mr mh h'dt vhchqym vhmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhynv 'tkhm
verses.translation: When thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying: ‘What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ עֲבָדִ֛ים הָיִ֥ינוּ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּצִיאֵ֧נוּ יְהֹוָ֛ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt lbnkh 'bdym hyynv lpr'h bmtsrym vytsy'nv yhvh mmtsrym byd chzqh
verses.translation: then thou shalt say unto thy son: ‘We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֡ה אוֹתֹ֣ת וּ֠מֹפְתִ֠ים גְּדֹלִ֨ים וְרָעִ֧ים ׀ בְּמִצְרַ֛יִם בְּפַרְעֹ֥ה וּבְכׇל־בֵּית֖וֹ לְעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'vtt vmptym gdlym vr'ym  bmtsrym bpr'h vbkhlbytv l'ynynv
verses.translation: And the LORD showed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his house, before our eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאוֹתָ֖נוּ הוֹצִ֣יא מִשָּׁ֑ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔נוּ לָ֤תֶת לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'vtnv hvtsy' mshm lm'n hby' 'tnv ltt lnv 'th'rts 'shr nshb' l'btynv
verses.translation: And He brought us out from thence, that He might bring us in, to give us the land which He swore unto our fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַוֵּ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְט֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֔ים לְחַיֹּתֵ֖נוּ כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vytsvnv yhvh l'shvt 'tkhlhchqym h'lh lyr'h 'tyhvh 'lhynv ltvb lnv khlhymym lchytnv khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that He might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־נִשְׁמֹ֨ר לַעֲשׂ֜וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את לִפְנֵ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtsdqh thyhlnv khynshmr l'shvt 'tkhlhmtsvh hz't lpny yhvh 'lhynv kh'shr tsvnv {s}
verses.translation: And it shall be righteousness unto us, if we observe to do all this commandment before the LORD our God, as He hath commanded us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָשַׁ֣ל גּֽוֹיִם־רַבִּ֣ים ׀ מִפָּנֶ֡יךָ הַֽחִתִּי֩ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֗י וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י שִׁבְעָ֣ה גוֹיִ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים וַעֲצוּמִ֖ים מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: khy yby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'lh'rts 'shr'th b'shmh lrshth vnshl gvymrbym  mpnykh hchty vhgrgshy vh'mry vhkhn'ny vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy shb'h gvym rbym v'tsvmym mmkh
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and shall cast out many nations before thee, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתָנָ֞ם יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ וְהִכִּיתָ֑ם הַחֲרֵ֤ם תַּחֲרִים֙ אֹתָ֔ם לֹא־תִכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית וְלֹ֥א תְחׇנֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: vntnm yhvh 'lhykh lpnykh vhkhytm hchrm tchrym 'tm l'tkhrt lhm bryt vl' tchnm
verses.translation: and when the LORD thy God shall deliver them up before thee, and thou shalt smite them; then thou shalt utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy unto them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א תִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בָּ֑ם בִּתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תִתֵּ֣ן לִבְנ֔וֹ וּבִתּ֖וֹ לֹא־תִקַּ֥ח לִבְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vl' ttchtn bm btkh l'ttn lbnv vbtv l'tqch lbnkh
verses.translation: neither shalt thou make marriages with them: thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָסִ֤יר אֶת־בִּנְךָ֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְעָבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְחָרָ֤ה אַף־יְהֹוָה֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ֖ מַהֵֽר׃
verses.translit: khyysyr 'tbnkh m'chry v'bdv 'lhym 'chrym vchrh 'fyhvh bkhm vhshmydkh mhr
verses.translation: For he will turn away thy son from following Me, that they may serve other gods; so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and He will destroy thee quickly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אִם־כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּ֙ לָהֶ֔ם מִזְבְּחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתֹּ֔צוּ וּמַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תְּשַׁבֵּ֑רוּ וַאֲשֵֽׁירֵהֶם֙ תְּגַדֵּע֔וּן וּפְסִילֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֥וּן בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khy'mkhh t'shv lhm mzbchtyhm tttsv vmtsbtm tshbrv v'shyrhm tgd'vn vpsylyhm tshrpvn b'sh
verses.translation: But thus shall ye deal with them: ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and hew down their Asherim, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'm qdvsh 'th lyhvh 'lhykh bkh bchr  yhvh 'lhykh lhyvt lv l'm sglh mkhl h'mym 'shr 'lpny h'dmh
verses.translation: For thou art a holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be His own treasure, out of all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א מֵֽרֻבְּכֶ֞ם מִכׇּל־הָֽעַמִּ֗ים חָשַׁ֧ק יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וַיִּבְחַ֣ר בָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אַתֶּ֥ם הַמְעַ֖ט מִכׇּל־הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: l' mrbkhm mkhlh'mym chshq yhvh bkhm vybchr bkhm khy'tm hm't mkhlh'mym
verses.translation: The LORD did not set His love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people—for ye were the fewest of all peoples—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ מֵאַהֲבַ֨ת יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם וּמִשׇּׁמְר֤וֹ אֶת־הַשְּׁבֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֧יא יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֑ה וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khy m'hbt yhvh 'tkhm vmshmrv 'thshb'h 'shr nshb' l'btykhm hvtsy' yhvh 'tkhm byd chzqh vypdkh mbyt 'bdym myd pr'h mlkhmtsrym
verses.translation: but because the LORD loved you, and because He would keep the oath which He swore unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֵל֙ הַֽנֶּאֱמָ֔ן שֹׁמֵ֧ר הַבְּרִ֣ית וְהַחֶ֗סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֛יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָ֖ו לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyd't khyyhvh 'lhykh hv' h'lhym h'l hn'mn shmr hbryt vhchsd l'hbyv vlshmry mtsvtv l'lf dvr
verses.translation: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, He is God; the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love Him and keep His commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְשַׁלֵּ֧ם לְשֹׂנְאָ֛יו אֶל־פָּנָ֖יו לְהַאֲבִיד֑וֹ לֹ֤א יְאַחֵר֙ לְשֹׂ֣נְא֔וֹ אֶל־פָּנָ֖יו יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmshlm lshn'yv 'lpnyv lh'bydv l' y'chr lshn'v 'lpnyv yshlmlv
verses.translation: and repayeth them that hate Him to their face, to destroy them; He will not be slack to him that hateth Him, He will repay him to his face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֨ אֶת־הַמִּצְוָ֜ה וְאֶת־הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshmrt 'thmtsvh v'thchqym v'thmshptym 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'shvtm {p}
verses.translation: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  עֵ֣קֶב תִּשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֤ת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְשָׁמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אֶֽת־הַבְּרִית֙ וְאֶת־הַחֶ֔סֶד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhyh  'qb tshm'vn 't hmshptym h'lh vshmrtm v'shytm 'tm vshmr yhvh 'lhykh lkh 'thbryt v'thchsd 'shr nshb' l'btykh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, because ye hearken to these ordinances, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep with thee the covenant and the mercy which He swore unto thy fathers,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲהֵ֣בְךָ֔ וּבֵרַכְךָ֖ וְהִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וּבֵרַ֣ךְ פְּרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֣ וּפְרִֽי־אַ֠דְמָתֶ֠ךָ דְּגָ֨נְךָ֜ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ שְׁגַר־אֲלָפֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֔ךָ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'hbkh vbrkhkh vhrbkh vbrkh prybtnkh vpry'dmtkh dgnkh vtyrshkh vytshrkh shgr'lpykh v'shtrt ts'nkh 'l h'dmh 'shrnshb' l'btykh ltt lkh
verses.translation: and He will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee; He will also bless the fruit of thy body and the fruit of thy land, thy corn and thy wine and thine oil, the increase of thy kine and the young of thy flock, in the land which He swore unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה מִכׇּל־הָעַמִּ֑ים לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְךָ֛ עָקָ֥ר וַֽעֲקָרָ֖ה וּבִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: brvkh thyh mkhlh'mym l'yhyh bkh 'qr v'qrh vbbhmtkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt be blessed above all peoples; there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵסִ֧יר יְהֹוָ֛ה מִמְּךָ֖ כׇּל־חֹ֑לִי וְכׇל־מַדְוֵי֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם הָרָעִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֗עְתָּ לֹ֤א יְשִׂימָם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּנְתָנָ֖ם בְּכׇל־שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhsyr yhvh mmkh khlchly vkhlmdvy mtsrym hr'ym 'shr yd't l' yshymm bkh vntnm bkhlshn'ykh
verses.translation: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness; and He will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee, but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ אֶת־כׇּל־הָֽעַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ לֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵֽינְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֤א תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־מוֹקֵ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'khlt 'tkhlh'mym 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh l'tchvs 'ynkh 'lyhm vl' t'bd 't'lhyhm khymvqsh hv' lkh {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt consume all the peoples that the LORD thy God shall deliver unto thee; thine eye shall not pity them; neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י תֹאמַר֙ בִּלְבָ֣בְךָ֔ רַבִּ֛ים הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵיכָ֥ה אוּכַ֖ל לְהוֹרִישָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: khy t'mr blbbkh rbym hgvym h'lh mmny 'ykhh 'vkhl lhvryshm
verses.translation: If thou shalt say in thy heart: ‘These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א מֵהֶ֑ם זָכֹ֣ר תִּזְכֹּ֗ר אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה וּלְכׇל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: l' tyr' mhm zkhr tzkhr 't 'shr'shh yhvh 'lhykh lpr'h vlkhlmtsrym
verses.translation: thou shalt not be afraid of them; thou shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּסֹּ֨ת הַגְּדֹלֹ֜ת אֲשֶׁר־רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְהָאֹתֹ֤ת וְהַמֹּֽפְתִים֙ וְהַיָּ֤ד הַחֲזָקָה֙ וְהַזְּרֹ֣עַ הַנְּטוּיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצִֽאֲךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כֵּֽן־יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לְכׇל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה יָרֵ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hmst hgdlt 'shrr'v 'ynykh vh'tt vhmptym vhyd hchzqh vhzr' hntvyh 'shr hvts'kh yhvh 'lhykh khny'shh yhvh 'lhykh lkhlh'mym 'shr'th yr' mpnyhm
verses.translation: the great trials which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out; so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the peoples of whom thou art afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם֙ אֶת־הַצִּרְעָ֔ה יְשַׁלַּ֛ח יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם עַד־אֲבֹ֗ד הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֛ים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִ֖ים מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vgm 'thtsr'h yshlch yhvh 'lhykh bm 'd'bd hnsh'rym vhnstrym mpnykh
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and they that hide themselves, perish from before thee. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַעֲרֹ֖ץ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּקִרְבֶּ֔ךָ אֵ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְנוֹרָֽא׃
verses.translit: l' t'rts mpnyhm khyyhvh 'lhykh bqrbkh 'l gdvl vnvr'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them; for the LORD thy God is in the midst of thee, a God great and awful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשַׁל֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛ל מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ מְעַ֣ט מְעָ֑ט לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ כַּלֹּתָ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר פֶּן־תִּרְבֶּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vnshl yhvh 'lhykh 'thgvym h'l mpnykh m't m't l' tvkhl khltm mhr pntrbh 'lykh chyt hshdh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will cast out those nations before thee by little and little; thou mayest not consume them quickly, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתָנָ֛ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְהָמָם֙ מְהוּמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vntnm yhvh 'lhykh lpnykh vhmm mhvmh gdlh 'd hshmdm
verses.translation: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them up before thee, and shall discomfit them with a great discomfiture, until they be destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֤ן מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לֹֽא־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִֽדְךָ֖ אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vntn mlkhyhm bydkh vh'bdt 'tshmm mtcht hshmym l'ytytsb 'ysh bpnykh 'd hshmdkh 'tm
verses.translation: And He shall deliver their kings into thy hand, and thou shalt make their name to perish from under heaven; there shall no man be able to stand against thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֑שׁ לֹֽא־תַחְמֹד֩ כֶּ֨סֶף וְזָהָ֤ב עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ לָ֔ךְ פֶּ֚ן תִּוָּקֵ֣שׁ בּ֔וֹ כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: psyly 'lhyhm tshrpvn b'sh l'tchmd khsf vzhb 'lyhm vlqcht lkh pn tvqsh bv khy tv'bt yhvh 'lhykh hv'
verses.translation: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire; thou shalt not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein; for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־תָבִ֤יא תֽוֹעֵבָה֙ אֶל־בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ חֵ֖רֶם כָּמֹ֑הוּ שַׁקֵּ֧ץ ׀ תְּשַׁקְּצֶ֛נּוּ וְתַעֵ֥ב ׀ תְּֽתַעֲבֶ֖נּוּ כִּי־חֵ֥רֶם הֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'tby' tv'bh 'lbytkh vhyyt chrm khmhv shqts  tshqtsnv vt'b  tt'bnv khychrm hv' {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt not bring an abomination into thy house, and be accursed like unto it; thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khlhmtsvh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm tshmrvn l'shvt lm'n tchyvn vrbytm vb'tm vyrshtm 'th'rts 'shrnshb' yhvh l'btykhm
verses.translation: All the commandment which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore unto your fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת־כׇּל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹלִֽיכְךָ֜ יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֜ לְנַסֹּֽתְךָ֗ לָדַ֜עַת אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖ו אִם־לֹֽא׃
verses.translit: vzkhrt 'tkhlhdrkh 'shr hvlykhkh yhvh 'lhykh zh 'rb'ym shnh bmdbr lm'n 'ntkh lnstkh ld't 't'shr blbbkh htshmr mtsvtv 'ml'
verses.translation: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God hath led thee these forty years in the wilderness, that He might afflict thee, to prove thee, to know what was in thy heart, whether thou wouldest keep His commandments, or no.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶ֒ךָ֒ וַיַּאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶת־הַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־כׇּל־מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־יְהֹוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'nkh vyr'bkh vy'khlkh 'thmn 'shr l'yd't vl' yd'vn 'btykh lm'n hvdy'kh khy l' 'lhlchm lbdv ychyh h'dm khy 'lkhlmvts' pyyhvh ychyh h'dm
verses.translation: And He afflicted thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that He might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every thing that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂמְלָ֨תְךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: shmltkh l' blth m'lykh vrglkh l' btsqh zh 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם־לְבָבֶ֑ךָ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מְיַסְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: vyd't 'mlbbkh khy kh'shr yysr 'ysh 'tbnv yhvh 'lhykh mysrkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt consider in thy heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶת־מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו וּלְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vshmrt 'tmtsvt yhvh 'lhykh llkht bdrkhyv vlyr'h 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in His ways, and to fear Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh mby'kh 'l'rts tvbh 'rts nchly mym 'ynt vthmt yts'ym bbq'h vbhr
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths, springing forth in valleys and hills;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ־זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'rts chth vsh'rh vgpn vt'nh vrmvn 'rtszyt shmn vdbsh
verses.translation: a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig-trees and pomegranates; a land of olive-trees and honey;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל־בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא־תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: 'rts 'shr l' bmskhnt t'khlbh lchm l'tchsr khl bh 'rts 'shr 'bnyh brzl vmhrryh tchtsb nchsht
verses.translation: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'khlt vshb't vbrkht 'tyhvh 'lhykh 'lh'rts htbh 'shr ntnlkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat and be satisfied, and bless the LORD thy God for the good land which He hath given thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pntshkhch 'tyhvh 'lhykh lblty shmr mtsvtyv vmshptyv vchqtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm
verses.translation: Beware lest thou forget the LORD thy God, in not keeping His commandments, and His ordinances, and His statutes, which I command thee this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־תֹּאכַ֖ל וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבָתִּ֥ים טֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ׃
verses.translit: pnt'khl vshb't vbtym tbym tbnh vyshbt
verses.translation: lest when thou hast eaten and art satisfied, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְקָֽרְךָ֤ וְצֹֽאנְךָ֙ יִרְבְּיֻ֔ן וְכֶ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה־לָּ֑ךְ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vbqrkh vts'nkh yrbyn vkhsf vzhb yrbhlkh vkhl 'shrlkh yrbh
verses.translation: and when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָ֖ם לְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vrm lbbkh vshkhcht 'tyhvh 'lhykh hmvtsy'kh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: then thy heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמּוֹלִ֨יכְךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר  הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ ׀ שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־מָ֑יִם הַמּוֹצִ֤יא לְךָ֙ מַ֔יִם מִצּ֖וּר הַֽחַלָּמִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: hmvlykhkh bmdbr  hgdl vhnvr' nchsh  shrf v'qrb vtsm'vn 'shr 'ynmym hmvtsy' lkh mym mtsvr hchlmysh
verses.translation: who led thee through the great and dreadful wilderness, wherein were serpents, fiery serpents, and scorpions, and thirsty ground where was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּאֲכִ֨לְךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֗ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔ךָ לְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hm'khlkh mn bmdbr 'shr l'yd'vn 'btykh lm'n 'ntkh vlm'n nstkh lhytbkh b'chrytkh
verses.translation: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that He might afflict thee, and that He might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ כֹּחִי֙ וְעֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֶת־הַחַ֥יִל הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt blbbkh khchy v'tsm ydy 'shh ly 'thchyl hzh
verses.translation: and thou say in thy heart: ‘My power and the might of my hand hath gotten me this wealth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת־בְּרִית֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vzkhrt 'tyhvh 'lhykh khy hv' hntn lkh khch l'shvt chyl lm'n hqym 'tbrytv 'shrnshb' l'btykh khyvm hzh {p}
verses.translation: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God, for it is He that giveth thee power to get wealth, that He may establish His covenant which He swore unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתָּ֖ם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'mshkhch tshkhch 'tyhvh 'lhykh vhlkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym v'bdtm vhshtchvyt lhm h'dty bkhm hyvm khy 'bd t'bdvn
verses.translation: And it shall be, if thou shalt forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I forewarn you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ מַאֲבִ֣יד מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם כֵּ֖ן תֹּאבֵד֑וּן עֵ֚קֶב לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khgvym 'shr yhvh m'byd mpnykhm khn t'bdvn 'qb l' tshm'vn bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm {p}
verses.translation: As the nations that the LORD maketh to perish before you, so shall ye perish; because ye would not hearken unto the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
